sal byengs rgyartswa

rtsom pa bo mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/—— rtsom pa bo mtshams spyor mdor bsdus/ — dge rgan chen mo dpa' ris sangs rgyas ni/ spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya so gcig par/ dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong du sku 'khrungs/ spyi lo 19 54lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i skad yig sde tshan nas mthar phyin/ snga phyir slob grwa 'di ga'i bod yig sde tshan gyi dbe rgan/ zhib 'jug slob ma'i slob dpon dang / sde tshan gtso 'dzin bcas mdzad myong / las 'khyur ngal gso byas rjes slob grwa 'di ga'i ge sar zhib 'jug khang gi ched 'drongs zhib 'jug pa dang / zhang kang bod rig pa zhib 'jug 'dun ma'i 'dun 'dzin gzhon pa sogs 'gan bzhes gnang bzhin mchis/ khong gi brtsams chos su/ dpe chos rna ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba'i dpe chos rnams la/ khungs dang / 'grel ba dang / dper brjod dang / rgya skad kyi dpe chos mthun pa sogs bkod yod/ thengs lngar dpar ba/ bod ljongs zhib 'jug spyi lo 19 9 ༷lo'i deb bzhi ba'i steng du bkod pa'i dag yig ming mdzod spel ba'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus zhes pa las/ 'di ni bod skad kyi dpe chos tshig mdzod sngar stongs pa'i ga skong zhig ste/ dpe khrid dang / rtsom nga/ dang / lo tsā ba nye bar mkho bar rin thang che bas/ dge slob dang lo tsā ba

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/rnams dga' ba ha cang skyes zer1/brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron zhes bya ba 'di/ thengs gsum dpar zin pa dang / nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo sogs kyis bslab deb tu bkol ba'am/ dpyad gzhi gtso bor 'dzin pa/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo kun g.yu hphang lags kyis dpyad gtam du/ bstan bcos 'di ni/ bcings grol tshun chad nas da thug dbar mdzub mo snga bgrangs/ ris pa'i rtsal las thon pa'i mdzad rjes phul byung bla na med pa 'i ga ste/ gzhung don gal che ba rtags 'jug gi skor/ ming bi ngo bo 'gyur lugs skor/ ming gi byung 'phel skor/ bya ba'i ming gi rigs kyi dbye ba dang phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs skor/ phrad kyi 'jug pa dmigs bsal skor sogs gzhung lugs tshad ma dang ldan pa sngar ma mchis pa'i srol gsar ba btod byung / de dag khebs rgya che bas mtha' 'khyol ba dang / zhib cha gsal bas gnad zin pas na/ dpe khrid dang brtag dpyad du 'jug pa'i rin thang che ba sogs gsungs/sdeb sbyor rig pa'i srol 'byed ces bya ba las/ yi ge dang ming tshig brjod pa phyogs kun nas bod skad dang lhan skyes kyi ngag gi rol mo'i snyan cha phun sum tshogs pa yod pa mdor bsdus nas/ sgra drag zhan bar ma'i sdeb sbyor dang / nga ro gug kyed drang ba'i sdeb spyor bcas kyi gnas lugs dang 2

rtsom pa bo mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/'jug tshul gsal bar spros shing / legs sbyar gyi sdeb sbyor bod skad la mi 'phrod pa'i gnas tshul gsal bar bstan thog bod rang skad kyi sdeb sbyor rig pa'i gzhung lugs gsar ba'i srol thog mar phyes byung / 'dis bod skad kyi rang bzhin dang khyad chos/ ming dang tshig gi sbyor ba sogs kyi mtha' dpyad pa dang lag len du 'jug pa dang / snyan ngag brtsam pa dang bcas par phan thogs che'o/ /bod yig 'bri tshul mthong ba kun smon zhes bya ba las/ bod yig gi lo rgyus dang / 'bri srol dar tshul dang / 'bri tshul sna tshogs kyi khyad chos dang /sgyug 'gros 'then stangs dang smyug kha skor tshul gyi ming deng 'bri thabs/ yig rtsal gyi ro spyong tshul dang nyams dpyad tshul sogs gsal bar bshad yod/'di ni da snga 'byung ma spyong ba'i bod yig 'bri tshul gyi gzhung lugs cha tshang ba'i bstan bcos dang bo zhig yin/ dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung zhes bya ba ni/ dag yig rig pa'i srol 'byed cig yin te/ bod yig gi byung ba dang phan yon/ ming gi sbyor tshul/ming gi rigs rgyud byung tshul dang 'phel tshul/ ming gi ngo bo 'gyur lugs/ bya ba'i ming gi khyad chos gsum/ zhe sa/ mngon brjod/ nyams mtshon pa'i sgra/dpe chos kyi 'jug pa/ yig nor 'byung rkyen dang sel thabs/ ming dang tshig gi 'grol tshul sogs rigs pa'i lam nas/ khebs rgya che ba'i sa lung la/ zhib —

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/cha gsal ba'i lcags kyus zin pa'i sgo nas/ da snga skyes bu phal gyi snang ngor ma shar ba'i gsang ba ste/ ming gi sbyor ba las/ rten cing 'brel bar byung ba mi bslu ba'i bden pa dag mngon par bstan yod pas/ ming gi tshogs pa bslab dpyad 'jug gsum gsal ba'i rnam 'dren yin no/ /bsgyur rtsom la tshan rig rgyun shes ma zhes bya ba yod/gzhan yang / gling ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung gi lha gling dang / gru gu go rdzong /dpa' ris rab gsal gyi gsung 'dum/ bla ma dkar po'i rnam thar sogs zhu dag gam gung bsgrigs nas zhan par du dpar yod/ ge sar rig mdzod ces bya ba'i sgrig 'gan gtso bo bzhes nas deb dang bo dpar zin/dpyad rtsom du/ skad cha dang yi ge ni rig gnas kyi gter mdzod che shos yin/ bya ba'i ming gi rigs gsum gyi dbye ba dang phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs rnam par bshad pa/ bod yig gi byung rabs dang rtsod gzhi'i mtha' dpyad pa/ bod kyi sgyu rtsom brtsam pa'i khog 'bubs/thabs shes zung 'jug gi bslab deb sa skya'i legs bshad/ mngon brjod kyi byung rabs dang phan yon/ ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi bang mdzod chen mo ge sar sgrung gi zur tsam gleng ba sogs lnga bcu lhag phud yod pa las/ la la rgyal khab phyi nang gi 'grel yod dus deb tu cha tshang ba'am gnad btus sam bsgyur nas bkod yod pa dang / la la rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa dag gis gcigs su 4

bzung /zhing chen dang pu'u rim pa yan chad kyi bya dga' mang bo thob par dper na/ spyi lo1998lor krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rig gnas pu'u dang / mi rigs don mdzad u yon lhan khang dang / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs dang / spyi tshogs tshan rig khang bcas kyis bya dgar gdangs pa'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom ge sar sgrung myur skyob dang zhib 'jug tu byas rjes khyad 'phags bzhag pa'i sngon thon mi sna'i mtshan snyan thob pa lta bu'o/ /krung go rgyal khab kyi deng rabs kyi slob gso mdzad mkhan grags can gyi ming mdzod chen mo dang / deng rabs krung go'i mi rigs kyi sgra rig pa ba zhes pa sogs su rtsom pa bo nyid kyi mdzad rjes bkod yod do/ /

mgo brjod/ sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rtsa ba gnyis slob dpon thon mi mchog gis mdzad par grags pa ltar na/ bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i phyi mo'i gzhung de byung nas/ lo ngo stong dang sum brgya lhag 'gor song / gna' de 'dra snga mo zhig nas/ gzhung des bod mi rigs rang gi skad spyi'i khyad chos dang bstun nas/ yi ge'i sbyor ba dang / ming gi sbyor ba dang / tshig gi sbyor ba sogs brda sprod pa'i chos nyid rtsa ba bo rnams mdor bsdus nas legs par bston byung / de nas bzung ste/ dus rabs rim byon gyi mkhas pa mdo dbus khams gsum gang gi yin yang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs de la brten nas/bod spyi khyab kyi skad cha ltar/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan pa sogs bod yig tu bsgyur ba dang / bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs dang /gzhan yang / bslab bya/ legs bshad/ lo rgyus/ rnam thar/ rtogs brjod/snyan ngag zlos gar/ sgrung la sogs pa brtsams pa yin pas/ sus bltas kyang skad cha'i thad nas mi go ba med pa'i bogs —thon pa yin no/ /bshad pa'am rtsom pa 'dod pa ji bzhin bad 'phrod pa dang / go bde ba dang / rtsal thon pa bcas/ brda dag la kha gsal zhing don 'byor ba la rag

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/las pas na/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs ni/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum du lce'i dbang bor sprul ba'i tshul du snang bas/ mkhas pa gang mang gis brda sprod gcigs su bzung nas/ sum rtags kyi rtsa ba rgya cher dgrol ba dang / yang na/sum rtags kyi rtsa ba gzhir bzung nas/ lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas kha bskangs shing zur brgyan nas/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung ha cang gting zab cing khebs che bar btang yod/spyir lo rgyus kyi chu bo dal 'bab ring mo las/ bod kyi brda sprod gzhung lugs kho lag rdzogs pa'i skyes bu dam pa lta du zhig tu gyur nas/ mdo dbus khams gsum bod yongs rdzogs kyi skad rigs la kha lo bsgyur nas/ srid 'byor rig gsum kun dar ba la phan chen po thogs kyin 'dug go /'on kyang skad cha'ang spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i rjes 'brangs nas dar bzhin yod pas/sgra rig pa gsar ba gsos su ma btab na/ rang re'i brda sprod gzhung lugs kyang mu mthud nas legs cha kun 'dzoms kyi tshad la slebs dka'/ da snga'i brda sprod gzhung rnams la bltas na/ zhib cha ma thon sa/ kha mi gsal sa/phyogs ma khyab sa/ thod mi thug sa/ 'drel ma chags sa/ rtsod pa yod sa mang du mthong ste/ sum rtags dag gsum la byang cha med pa rnams la bshad na/dka' ba'i gnas su gyur 'dug dper na/ rnam dbye dang bor mtshan nyid dang ming gi chags tshul tsam las/ ming gi sbyor tshul dang / de'i rigs kyi dbye

ba dang 'jug pa'i khyad par sogs bstan med pas/ tshig gi sbyor ba la ming gang 'tsham du 'jug pa'i gsal kha mi yong / tshig phrad skor zhig la brda chad byas med pas/ bu skyes pa la ming ma btags pa bzhin 'bod dka'/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad kha shas kyi 'jug pa spyir btang tsam las dmigs bsal can bstan med pas/ de dag ci'i phyir 'jug pa'i dogs pa mi chod/ tshig sbyor la la'i rnam pa mtshungs pa tsam la bltas nas/ mtshan nyid mi gcig kyang gcig par rlom nas/ dkar nag rkya 'thab pa'i dbye ba mi phyed/ sgra ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul la drag zhan bar ma'i khyad par rags pa tsam las sgra gdangs ha lam gcig pa rnams kyi gnas byed rtsol ba'i zhib cha bstan med —pas/ yig 'bru sgra gdangs mtshungs pa'am nye ba can rnams kyi khyad par blo la 'dzin dka' zhing / rtsom du yi ge'i dag cha thon dka'/ bya ba'i ming gi 'gyur lugs mdor bsdus nas chos nyid ji tsam mchis pa so sor bstan med pa dang / byed pa'i rtsol ba dang las kyi 'gyur ba mtshon byed kyi bya tshig phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i 'gyur lugs kyang bstan med pas/ bya ba'i ming gi 'jug pa bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba dang dus kyi rnam bzhag dang mi mthun pa gang mang byung ba lta bu sogs so/ / gong gsal gyi dogs pa rnams ci thub kyis bsal ba'i sgo nas/ brda sprod gzhung lugs 'dzin skyong spel bar byas nas/ bod yig slob mkhan

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/rnams la phan cung zad gdags pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ kho bos dpe khrid kyi nyams myong dang blo bskyed la brten nas/ tshad ma dang ldan pa/ brjod pa gsal ba/ khebs rgya che ba/ bkol sa mang ba/ ro bro ba bcas gzhir bzung nas/ da snga'i mkhas pa rnams kyis brtsams pa'i sum rtags dag gsum sogs kyi gzhung rnams las/ rig pa'i rtsal drangs shing / legs pa'i bcud bsdus nas/ brda sprod gsal bar byed pa'i ngag gi sgron me zhes bya ba 'di brtsams pa yin la/ rang gi skyes sbyangs dman pas/ ma rtogs log rtog gi 'khrul ba yod srid/ gzur gnas mkhas pa rnam pas nor bcos mdzad rogs gnang bar thugs rje che zhu'o/ /rtsom pa bos bris/

dkar chag‘dkan chagartsom pa bo mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/ (1)rjes 1111 1—1———tshon// (1)brda sprod gzhung gi tha snyad gal chen 'ga' zhig gi go don mdor bstan pa/ (1)dang bo/ bod kyi brda sprod gzhung la sum rtags zer 1——————1/ (na/)gnyis pa/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad kyi khyad par/ (2)gsum pa/ ming dang phrad kyi dbye ba/ (3)bzhi ba/ tha snyad dang brda dang brda chad kyi dbye ba/ (4)lnga ba/ bya ba'i ming dang bya tshig gi 'brel ba dang khyad par/ (4)'i skosum cu ba ra/ le'u dang bo/ rnam dbye bshad pa/ (7)don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ (7) dang bo/ ming gi mtshan nyid/ (8)1

dkar chag don tshan gnyis pa/ bdag sgra (110)don tshan gsum pa/ rgyan sdud/ (116)don tshan bzhi ba/ lhag bcas/ (123)don tshan lnga ba/ 'byed sdud/ (129)don tshan drug pa/ mnyam sbyor/ (136)don tshan bdun pha/ 'dren sgra/ (141)don tshan brgyad pa/ 'dren sdud/ (145)don tshan dgu ba/ dogs slong / (147)don tshan bcu ba/ skul smon/ (149)le'u gsum pa/ phrad rang dbang can bshad pa/ (164)don tshan dang bo/ ni sgra/ (154)don tshan gnyis pa/ dang sgra/ (169)don tshan gsum pa/ nges bzung / (166)don tshan bzhi ba spyi sgra/ (174)don tshan lnga ba/ dgag sgra/ (180)rtags 'jug gi skor/le'u dang bo/ yi ge spyi bshad pa/ (186)don tshan dang bo/ yi ge'i ngo bo/ (186)3

brda sprod gas byed ngag sgron/don tshan gnyis pa/ srog dang rkyen gyi yi ge (186)don tshan gsum pa/ pha ma bu za yi ge (188)don tshan bzhi ba/ mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi yi ge (190)don tshan lnga ba/ sbyor mi rung ba che khag bcu/ (194)don 66na drug pa/ kyis 11shāka lha// (196)don tshan bdun pa/ sgra'i nga ro'i dbye ba/ (198)don tshan brgyad pa/ nga ro'i rtsa ba gsum/ (202)don tshan dgu ba/ dbyangs gsal rnams kyi gnas dang byed pa'i /spyi shā pa tshog (203)le'u gnyis pa1 rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ (207)don tshan dang bo/ ming gzhi'i rtags kyi dbye ba/ (207)don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/ (209)dang bo/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba/ (209)gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi 'jug yul/ (210)gsum pa/ sngon 'jug gi sgra'i 'jug tshul/ (215)bzhi ba/ sngon 'jug gi 'jug don/ (216)don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/ (225)dang bo/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba dang 'jug

dkar chag tshul/ (225)gnyis pa/ dzes 'jug gi 'jug yul/ (233)gsum pa/ 'jug yang 'jug gi 'jug don/ (234)bzhi ba/ 'jug yang 'jug gi ming mtha' 'dren tshul/ (237)don tshan bzhi ba/ sgra mtshungs bsgyur bas nyams mtshon tshul/ (241)don tshan lnga ba/ bod skad kyi sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul/ (246)le'u gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs bshad pha/ (254)don tshan dang bo/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs shes pa'i dgos pa/ (254)don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhag (266)dang bo/ bya ba'i ming gi dus gsum spyi tsam pa/ (20 7)gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus gsum bye brag pa/ (262)don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur (1gab / (266)dang bo/ dus gsum spyi khyab pa'i sbyor tshul/ (267)5

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gnyis pa/ dus gsum bye brag pa'i spyor tshul/ (271)gsum pa/ dus gsum thor du ba'i sbyor tshul/ (274)bzhi ga byed pa gzhan dang ma 'grel ba'i bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'am lugs/ (278)don tshan bzhi ba/ bya las dang byed las phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i 'gyur lugs/ (281)dang bo/ bya las dang byed las ming gzhi gcig pa'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/ (282)gnyis pa/ bya las dang byed las ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/ (286)don tshan lnga ba/ bya ba rigs gsum rten cing yel ba'i byung tso/ (290)dang bo/ bya ba rigs gsum gyi 'brel ba dang khyad par/ (290)gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming rigs gsum mtha' gcig tu nges pa med tso/ (294)

bad krod gzhung gi tha snyad gal chen 'ga' zhig gi go don mdor bstan pa/brda sprod gzhung gi tha snyad gal chen 'ga' zhig gi go don mdor bstan pa/— dang bo/ bod kyi brda sprod gzhung la sum rtags zer don/bod kyi brda sprod gzhung gi rtsa ba sum cu ba dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis su 'dus pas sum rtags zhes grags so/ /de yang rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs kyi 'jug tshul lung du bstan pa'i phyi mo'i gzhung la sum cu ba'i mtshan gsol don ni/ mkhas dbang si tus mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba'i tshigs bcad gsum ni/ rtags 'jug sogs gzhung gzhan bdun ga'i thun mong ba yin zhing / tshigs bcad de gsum dor ba'i shul du/ yi ge uli kā li gnyis/ /zhes pa man gyi tshigs bcad sum cu tham pa nyid kyis gzhung rdzogs pas na/ grangs nges pa'i sgo nas btags so/ /zhes gsungs pas grub pa dang / sgra drag zhan bar ma rnams pho mo ma ning gi rtags kyi dbye bas mtshan cing / bdag gzhan dus gsum bya byed las gsum sogs gsal bar byed pa'i phyi mo'i gzhung la rtags kyi 'jug pa'i mtshan gsol ba yin la/ snga

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ma ni gtso cher tshig gi sbyor ba dang / phyi ma ni gtso cher ming gi sbyor ba yin te/ming dang tshig gi sbyor ba ston byed la brda sprod ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad kyi khyad par/rnam dbye'ang tshig phrad yin mod/ tshig phrad las logs su bkar don ni/de gnyis kyi nus pa mi gcig rnam dbye ni gtso cher bdag gzhan chos gnyis rnam par dbye ba'i sgra ste/ chos gnyis gnad du bzung nas tshig tu bsgrub pa la/ so so'i rnam pa ma 'dres par phye zhing / gtso cher bya ba'i yul lam/ byed pa'am/ dgos pa'am/ 'byung khungs sam/ 'grel ba'am/ rten gzhi sogs don nges can zhig gas lnga bar byed pha'i sgra yin la/ sgra —de tshig sbyor du ma bcug na/ chos gnyis kyi ngo bo gcig tu 'dres nas don kho thag zig ston mi srid pas/ tshig sbyor du med du mi rung ba zhig yin te/ dper brjod na/ slob khang du 'gro zhes par/ la'i don can gyi du sgra ma sbyar na/ bya ba'i yul slob khang dang / bya ba 'gro ba gnyis rnam par ma phyed pas/ 'gro sa'i yul dang 'gro ba'i bya ba gnyis ngo bo gcig par gyur nas/ slob khang rang 'gro ba'i don can du 'khrul bar gyur 'gro'o/ /— tshig phrad ni ming ngam tshig 'phrad par byed pa'i sgra ste/ ming dang ming ngam/ tshig dang tshig go rim bzhin du mtshams sbyar nas/ tshig sgrig pa'am/

bad sprod gzhung gi tha snyad gal chen 'ga' zhig gi go don mdor bstan pa/ngag gi phreng ba spel ba'am/ tshig mdzes par byed pa'am/ don gsal bar byed pa'i sgra yin la/ tshig sbyor du ma bcug kyang go brda 'phrod pas/ tshig sbyor du med kyang rung ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ stag dang gzig dang dom dang bad ༵sdi~X ṭwāṃ na 'phro ༷pa'o/ no// /zhes pa'i tshig gi dang sgra tsho kyang go gsum pa/ ming dang phrad kyi dbye ba/ming ni don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra ste/ brjod bya'i chos spyi tsam pha'am bye pa brag pa dang / de rnams gang rung gi khyad chos sam/ bya ba'am/ grangs ka dbye rdo ba tshig ༵ da ni da/ don ༵ kau bo tsam brjod pa'i nuXn pal me/ da ༵bye /de tshig sgrub byed kyi rkyen yin pas/ tshig sbyor du zhugs tshe/ brjod bya sna tshogs mi khyad par gsal bar byed thub/ 'dir ming dang / phrad dang / tshig dang / brjod pa'i 'drel ba/ dpe'i gzugs su dkyus gcig tu bkod na/ ming gi mu teg phrad kyi skud par brgyus nas ni/ /tshig gi phreng ba spel nas brjod pa'am rtsom — du grub/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /

brda krod gas byed ngag tsho/ — bzhi ba/ tha snyad dang brda dang brda chad kyi dbye ba/tha snyad ni tshig gi thung ba'i mthar thug pa ste/ ming dang rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs 'dus yod/ de la ngag sbyor bar byed pa'i bdag nyid can zhes kyang bya'o/ /brda zhes bya ba ni/ don go bar byed pa'i bdag nyid can te/sems don gang ci ngag gi rjod byed de/ tha snyad dang tshig gi go bar byed pa dang / lus kyi rnam 'gyur te/ mig brda dang lag brda lta du sogs kyis go bar byed pa dag la zer ro/ /brda chad ni/ bzo dang / gso ba/ rtsis/ rdzas 'gyur/ chos lugs la sogs pa'i rigs so so kho nar yod pa'i ched dmigs kyi ming ngo /lnga ba/ bya ba'i ming dang bya tshig gi 'brel ba dang khyad par/bya ba'i ming zhes pa dang / bya tshig ces pa gang yang sems can gyi rtsol ba dang / bem po'i 'gyur ba sogs mtshon byed kyi brda yin/ de la rnam dbye'i skabs su bya ba'i ming du 'bod pa ni/ brjod bya'i rtsol ba'am 'gyur ba so so ba'i ngo bo tsam brjod pa'i cha nas btags pa yin la/ rtags 'jug gi skabs su bya ba'i tshig ste bya tshig tu 'bod pa ni/ tshig gi cha shas gsum gyi ya gyal

yin pa'i cha nas btags pa'o/ /tshig gi cha shas gsum lda bya byed las gsum ste/ dper na/ ngas ja 'thung / zhes pa las/ nga ni byed pa dang / ja ni las dang / 'thung ni bya ba'o/ /brda chad du rim bzhin byed tshig dang las tshig dang bya tshig ces grags so/ /

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ sum cu ba'i skor / le'u dang bo/ rna ma dbye ba shad pa /rnam dbye brgyad po go rim bzhin/ / dang bo ngo bo tsam brjod pha/ /gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / / gsum pa byed pa bzhi dgos ched/ /lnga ba 'byung khung sa drug bal ba/ / ba dun pa rten gnas brgyad 'bod pa'o/ / don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ gang zhig don gyi ngo bo tsam/ / brjod pa ming gi mtshan nyid yin/ / 'dod rgyal rjes grub so so la/ / —dngos ming btags ming rnam pa gnyis/ / byung ba ming gi 'byung slol dang / /

bdi krod gsal byed ngag sgron/'dra ba'am 'drel ba rkyen byas nas/ /sgra gcig du mar mched pa ni/ /rjod byed ming gi 'phel tshul yin/ /sgra 'ga' bsdebs pa'i ming la yang / /rkyang 'dus tshogs pa'i dbye ba yod/ /dngos po khyad chos bya ba dang / /grangs mtshon ming gi rigs bzhi yin/ / dang bo/ ming gi mtshan nyid/ming gi mtshan nyid ni/ yi ge du ma 'dus nas don gang yang rung ba zhig gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i brda yin la/ de'i mtshan gzhi dper na/ mi zhe na smra shes shing don go ba can zhig dang / me zhe na tsha zhing sreg pa can dang / lcags rta zhe na lcags kyis bzos pa rta ltar bzhon nas 'gro thub pa can zhig tu go ba dang / de bzhin/ gnam/ lug dkar bo/ mdzes pa/ shar ba/ 'don pa/brgya/ dung phyur/ lta du la sogs pa chos gzhan gyi ngo bo dang ma 'dres par rnam par bye nas/ chos gang nyid kyi ngo bo tsam bstan pa yin pas/ /rnam dbyer bzhag par bshad kyang / rigs pas dben par mthong ste/ legs sbyar gyi skad lugs ltar rnam dbye dang bo'i rkyen si mdzam lta du dag logs su ster rgyu med pa'i phyir dang / skad rigs gang gi ming rnams kyang chos gang nyid kyi

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang go ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ ngo bo tsam go bar byed pa las/ chos gzhan gyi ngos 'dzin par mi 'gyur bas/bod skad kyi ming ngo cog rnam dbyer brtsis chog na/ rgya skad sogs kyi ming ngo cog kyang rnam dbyer brtsis chog pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na bod skad kyi ming ngo cog rnam dbye dang bor bzhag pa e 'grig ce na/ 'grig yang dag ste/ legs sbyar gyi skad lugs ltar rnam dbye dang bo'i rkyen phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/ 'di ni bod rang skad kyi khyad chos thun mon ma yin pa zhig yin/ rgya skad sogs la 'di 'dra'i khyad chos med do/ /khyad chos 'di'i gab pa mngon par phyung na/ rnam dbye dang bo zhes bya ba'i chos kyi de nyid bde blag tu rtog par 'gyur te/ ming gi khungs gcig kyang /don gnyis sam du mar 'jug pa'i ngo bo mi 'dra ba rnam par dbye ba'i rkyen sna tshogs yod pas/ rnam dbye'i gral du bzhag pa tshad mas grub bo/ /de lugs kyi zhib cha ngas brtsams pa'i rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon phyung zhes bya ba las gsal/ 'dir mdzub mos ri ston gyi dpe 'ga' bstan na/'byar nas 'dug pa sbyar nas 'byor ba min/ zer ba'i tshig 'di las/sbyar ba dang / 'byor ba dang / 'byar ba ni/ ming gzhi gcig pa las rten cing 'brel ba'i bya ba rigs gsum yin/ gang zhig gang la 'jug pa'i shes byed ni rnam dbye yin/ sa mgo can ni byed pa'i rtsol ba ste/ 'bras bu 'byung byed kyi rgyu yin zhing / sa mgo bsubs pa'i na ro can ni las kyi 'gyur ba ste/ rgyu 9

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin no/ /sa mgo dang na ro med pa bo ni ngang gis byung ba ste/ gang zag gis bsgrubs pa ma yin no/ /de dag gi sgra spyi 'dra yang gal te sa mgo yod med dang / na ro yod med kyi sgra lci yang dang / dbyangs mtho dman gyi rnam dbye med na/ so ba ngo bo ji ltar shes/ rgya skad la 'i de 'dra'i bya ba rigs gsum la tran(tsho)zhes pa'i ming gcig gis chog pas/rnam dbye dang bo'i rkyen ster rgyu med do/ /dpe de bzhin/ bkab nas khebs pa'i 'og tu gab nas 'dug zer ba'i tshig 'di'i nang gi bkab pa('das pa gzhir bzung ba)dang / khebs pa dang / gab pa dag ni ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa las rten cing 'brel ba'i bya ba rigs gsum ste/ rnam par phye ba'i rkyen ni/sgra drag zhan bar ma yin la/ ming gzhi pho yig ka yis byed pa'i rtsol ba dang /ma ning gi yi ge kha yis las kyi 'gyur ba dang / mo yig ga yis ngang gis byung ba bstan pa'o/ / bkag khog 'gog dgag bzhi'i don gyi ngo bo gcig kyang / ldog pa mi gcig pa'i rnam dbye ni/ sngon 'jug pho yis 'das pa dang / mo yis da lta ba dang / ma ning gis ma 'ongs pa bstan pa dang / ming gzhi 'gyur ba'i skul tshig la 'phul mi 'thob bo/ /gser rkon gyis gser rko ba dang / lud pa lu ba/ zer ba las/ gser rkon ni gser rko ba bo dang / gser rko ba ni bya ba yin zhing / lud pa ni las 10

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam bsgyud pa/dang / lu ba ni bya ba yin pa rnam par bye ba'i rkyen ni/ rjes 'jug na dang da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa yin no/ /tshogs 'tshogs pa dang / gros bgros pa'i tshig gnyis so so'i snga ma dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ma bya ba'i ming yin pa'i rnam dbye ni/ sngon 'jug yod med nyid yin te/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i sngon 'jug dor na/ de dang 'byel ba'i dngos po'i ming du gyur pa yin/shar nas shar ba dang / sgrog gis sgrog pa'i tshig gnyis so so'i snga ma dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ma bya ba'i ming yin pa'i rnam dbye ni/ ming mtha' thob min la rag las te/ bya ba'i ming gi ming mtha' pa'am ba dor na/ de dang 'grel ba'i dngos po'i ming du gyur pa yin/de ltar don gyi ngo bo brjod pa'i ming ngo cog rnam dbyer brtsis pa ni/gtso cher rten cing 'brel ba'i ming rnams khungs gcig kyang ngo bo mi gcig pa nom par dbye ba'i rkyen phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa'i phyir dang / tshig gi sgrub byed ming yin pas/ rnam dbye brgyad kyi dang bor bzhag pa yin no/ /gnyis pa/ ming gi byung tshul/ ming gi byung tshul la 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub rnam pa gnyis yod la/ so sor yang dngos ming dang btags ming gnyis su dbye'o/ /'dod rgyal gyi dngos ming ni/ dngos po gang zhig gang zag gis thog mar ngos 'dzin tshe/ rgyu 11

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/mtshan med par brda zhig sbyar ba de'i ming du chags pa 'dod pa ltar rgyal bar gyur pas de skad grags so/ /de'i mtshan gzhi dper na/ nyi ma/ sprin/ ri bo/ mtsho/ khang ba/ gser/ sdong bo/ bya/ khyi/ lta bu sogs sgra bshad med pa nyid kyis/ ming gi thog ma'i byung tshul yin par mngon zhing / 'di ni phyis kyi rjes grub kyi ming gi sgrub byed yin/ rjes grub kyi dngos ming ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming gang 'tsham zhig gzhir bzung nas/ de la 'grel yod kyi ming ngam sgra zhig sbyar nas/ chos gzhan zhig ston pa'i brdar gyur pa ste/ dper na/ dpe cha 'jog sa'i khang ba la dpe khang dang / nags skyes pa'i ri bo la nags ri dang / gser gyis bzos pa'i gzhong ba la gser gzhong dang / de bzhin/ bla brang / dge rgan/ zlos gar/ ske rgyan/ri dwags/ 'dab chags/ dug sbrul/ lta bu sogs so/ /'dod rgyal gyi btags ming ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi dngos ming gang chos gzhan zhig gi ming du btags nas/ de'i ming du gyur pa zhig ste/ dper brjod na/ bu mo zhig la rgyu mtshan med par rang 'dod kyis pad ma zhes btags pa/ de'i ming du grags par gyur pas/ 'dod rgyal ba yin zhing / bu mo pad ma zhes pa'i 'jug yul dngos min pas/ btags ming yin no/ /de bzhin khyi zhig la seng ge dang / skye bo ngan pa zhig la bdud ces dang / le lo ma zhig la rul ma zhes btags pa lta du sogs so/ /12

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/rjes grub kyi btags ming ni/ rjes grub kyi dngos ming gang gi rkyen zhig —la bltos nas chos gzhan zhig gi ming du btags pa ste/ bud shing la sbar byed kyi cha nas me shing zer ba lta bu/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa dang / chu la 'tsho ba skyel ba'i bya la chu bya zer ba lta bu/ rten brten pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas btegs pa dang / deng gi char mi la las sgor mo la kun dga' don grub ces 'bod pa yang / gnas skabs su spyi tshogs na don ngo mi lta rgyu ngo lta ba'i srol ngan pa zhig rlung ltar g.yo ba'i 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa dang / gnam gru la lcags bya zer ba 'dra ba'i cha nas btags pa dang / nyi ma la snang ba'i mdzod zer ba mngon par brjod pa'i sgo bsha rdo rdo yod 1 ṭwāṃ/'do/ da rgyal rdo min la rje 1 grub pa yi pen no yi/ na/ zhing / sgra gsum pa/ ming gi 'phel tshul /ming gi 'phel tshul la/ gong gsal 'dod rgyal gyi ming la brten nas rjes grub kyi ming dang / dngos ming la brten nas btags ming byung ba phud/da dung gtso che ba gsham gsal tshan pa gsum yod/gcig ming gzhi dang ming mtha' sbyar ba'i ming gi 'phel srol/spyir ming gzhi ni 'phul rten rnams kyi 'jug yul yin mod/ skabs 'dir don gyi ngo bo zhig ston pa'i sgra gnyis yan las ming gi gzhi mar gyur 13

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/pa'i sgra la zer ba yin/ de yang/1 ming gang rung zhig gzhir bzung nas/ ming mtha' mi gcig pa zhig sbyar nas ming du ma re byung ba/ dper na/ ri/ zhes pa la ming mtha' gang 'os sbyar nas/ sa 'dzin la ri bo/ ri la 'dug pa'i mi la ri pa/ chu mi 'drong ba'i sa zhing la ri ma/ ri dwags rna ring mjug thung kha sho can la ri bong / rin du brin pa la ri ba/ bris pa'i gzugs ris la ri mo zer ba sogs so/ /'di rnams las gzhir bzung ba'i ri zhes pa phal cher sa 'dzin gyi don yin yang /mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ ri mo'i ri ni sdeb spyor gyi dbang gis ris kyi sa mtha' dor ba dang / ri ba'i ri ni gong khug pa'i don yin/ 'di rigs ming —gi 'phel srol gzhan las kyang yod pa rig par bya'o/ /2 ming mthar gu ngu 'u du gang rigs sbyar nas ming can gang gi chung ba'i rigs kyi ming dag byung ba/ lug dang lu gu/ sgyug ma dang sgyu gu/ thag pa dang tha gu/ mchig dang mchi gu/ spug dang spu gu/ mi dang mi'u/ rta dang rte'u/drel dang dre'u/ ra dang re'u/ sha ba dang she'u/ gla dang gle'u/ sprel dang spre'u/ nya dang nye'u/ bya dang bye'u/ zo ba dang ze'u/ rdza ma dang dze'u/ spyil bo dang spyil bu/khrol ma dang khrol bu/ gzhong ba dang gzhong bu/ rdzing dang rdzing bu/ nor dang nor bu lta bu sogs dang / che bo med la chung ngu tsam gyi ming ngu/ tsi gu/ snang ngu / se'u/ srin bu lta bu sogs so/ / 14

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/gnyis/ ming gzhi zhig gzhir bzung nas 'brel yod kyi ming rnams sbyar ba'i ming gi 'phel srol/ 1 'brel gzhi snga ma dang 'brel chos phyi mar sbyar nas ming du ma re byung ba/ dper na/ lag pa 'brel gzhir bzung nas/ 'byel chos rnams sbyar ba las/ lag mgo lag mthil/ lag bol/ lag mdzub/ lag ngar/ lag ris/lag rdum/ lag shubs/ lag sprulas/ lag phyi/ lag dmar/ lag 'gro/ lag cha/lag rjes/ lag pod/ lag brda/ lag len la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /2 rang ldog las gzhi ldog khul du phyung nas ming du ma re byung ba/dper na/ dum pa dang rdza dum las/ snga ma rang ldog dang phyi ma gzhi ldog yin/rang ldog las gzhi ldog logs su bkar nas dngul bum/ gser bum/ shing bum/ rag dum/ gter bum sogs yod pa lta bu'o/ / gsum/ 'dra ba'am 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i ming gi 'phel srol/ 'dra ba'am 'grel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ ming gcig pa'am/ ming gzhi gcig pa'am/ ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa zhig gzhir bzung nas/ de'i sgra gdangs cung zad cung zad re bsgyur nas ming du ma re byung ba la/ 1 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ mtshon byed dpe'i ming zhig la brten nas/ mtshon bya don gyi ming gang 'tshams re sbyar nas ming du ma re byung ba1khal rta ltar go chod pa'i shing gis bzos pa 'e 'drud byed la shing rta dang /15

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/yul skad du mis 'drud pa'i shing rta chung chung la shing rte'u dang / 'phrin skyel ba rta ltar mgyogs dgos pas bang chen la bya ma rta dang / lcags las bzos pa'i spos 'khor ni rta ltar bzhon nas rgyug rung bas lcags rta dang / me mda' 'phang bar myur du 'bar ba'i me rdzas la me rta dang / zho bsnyal ba myur du chags par 'jug pa'i zho rtsi(ru ma)la dpa' ris skad du ru rta/ gru skad bde ba rta'i gom 'gros ltar ldem ldem byed pa'i 'gyur khug chags pa'i rgyun la ngag rta dang / sman nad thog 'phral du 'dren pa'i rdzas sbyor la sman rta zer ba lta du sogs so/ /2 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ ming gzhi zhig gi sgra cung zad bsgyur nas ming du ma re byung ba/ kha dog 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa/ dper na/ kha dog dkar bo'i ldog zla nag po la bltos nas/ nor ha lam nag nag yin pas gnag dang / 'bri byed tshon rtsi phal cher nag po yin pas snag tsha/ snag tsha'i bum pa la snag kong / shing ljon pa'i tshal la rgyang nas bltas na nag rog ger snang bas nags/ sha dang tshil gyi zlas phyed pa'i sha ni nag sang nger byas pas sha snag zas g.yo skol byed pa'i khang ba ni dud pas nag zib be byas phas nag tshang / zla ba'i mar ngo dkar cha nyams pas nag phyogs zer ba lta du sogs ming gzhi gcig pa'o/ / dbyibs 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa/ dper na/ kor kor la bltas nas/16

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/rdo ril ril la gor ma/ dngul gyi dong tse la sgor mo/ shing rta'i phang lo la 'khor lo/ mchig la lag skor/ khyi rgyag byed la mgo skor/ g.yul rdung byed la 'khor ma/ mtha' 'khor la khor yug bskor nas gzhog pa la sgor ba lta bu sogs ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa'o/ /'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa 'di rigs las 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa 'dres pa yang yod de/ 'khor lo dang 'bril ba'i bya ba la 'khor ba dang /'khor bar byed pa'i bya ba la skor ba lta bu/ 'byung 'gyur gyi 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byed pa las/ 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byed pa yang yod pa shes par bya'o/ / 3 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ ming gzhi gang rung zhig gi sgra cung zad re bsgyur nas ming du ma re byung ba/ 'brel nye bar bltos nas/ gdung rgyud kyi 'brel ba yod pa'i mi la sha nye'am nye du/ bza' tshang sgrig pa la gnyen sgrig pa/ gnyen gyi bar ba la gnye bo/ nye bar byed pa la bsnyen pa/ gus pa'i sgo nas sne len byed da la bsnyen bkur/ rigs rgyud dang khyo shug gi 'brel ba yod pa'i mi la gnyen bshes/ 'jam pa la mnyen pa/ mnyen par byed pa la mnye ba/ dga' ba la mnyes pa lta bu sogs ming gzhi gcig pa'o/ /'dzin par bltos nas1 lag tu thogs pa la bzung ba/ bzung nas byung ba la zin pa/ don thor du thigs pa gsog gsog byas nas bris pa la zin 17

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/tig lcags kyu la zung nga ste/ sha zung / khab bzung / bzho gzung / chang zung /lus kyi 'tsho byed la zungs te/ dwangs ma sha khrag rus pa chil/ /khams dang rkang mar zungs bdun zer/ /rgyud la brjed med du gtan 'jags pa la gzungs/ gos bzo bar thig gshar rgyag pa la gzungs 'debs pa/ lcags thag la gnya' zungs rgyud mo/ sa gzhi la nor 'dzin nam 'dzin ma/ sprin la chu 'dzin/ mig la gzugs 'dzin/ rna ba la thos 'dzin/ sna la dri 'dzin/ lce la ro 'dzin/ yul gzung bar bya ba dang / yul can 'dzin par byed pa la gzung 'dzin lta bu sogs ming gzhi sde ba gnyis can no/ /mi mngon par bltos nas/ g.yogs pa la bkab pa/ bkab byung ba la khebs pa/ 'gebs byed la khebs/ khed la gab tshig mngon par mi mthong ba'i sa khung ngam brag khung la gab khung / sgyid khung la sgab khung / rgyal bo'i pho brang ste phyi mkhar gyis bsgribs pas rgyal bo'i khab zer ba lta bu sogs ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa'o/ /sems can dang rtsi shing sogs las rigs gang rung zhig yin yang /nang gi nyer len dang phyi'i mthun rkyen rtem cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas rgyud pa 'phel ba ji bzhin/ gong gsal ming gi 'phel srol rnam gsum dang / sgos su 'dra ba'am 'grel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i ming gi 'phel srol 'di/ ming gi rigs rgyud kyi 'phel srol yin la/ ming gang gang 'dra mas sa1 pa'am 'grel 18

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dngam/ ngo bos brjod pa/ chags pa rnams gas gcig pa'i khongs gtogs yin te/ ming gcig pa dang / ming gzhi gcig pa dang / ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa gang rung ni/ ming skyed byed kyi nyer kun yin shang / nyer kun di'i 'brel phul ni/ phyi'i mthun rkyen te/ de dag phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i sgo nag ming gi rigs rgyud 'phel ba yin no/ /ming gi rigs rgyud 'phel srol 'di/ gna' mi bod kyi kun tu brtags pa'i rig pa las byung ba yin te/ lang kar gshegs pe'i mdo las/ming du gdags par ma mdzad na/ /'jig rten thams cad rngongs par 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ — gna' mi bod kyis shes bya'i chos shig 'jig rten pa rnams la go brda sprad sla ba'i ched bye/ don gang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming 'dogs tshe/ ming du gdags pa'i dngos po de dngos po gang dag dang rten cing 'brel bar grub pa dang / de'i nang gi nyer len dang phyi yi mthun rkyen ji ltar 'grel nga dang / de'i byed ma dang khyad chos rje da dra yin pa kun la brtags nas/ ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin du btags pas na/ rjes grub kyi ming thams cad za sgra bshad yod par ma zad/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming la lar yang tshig phrad dam sdeb sbyor gya sgo nas sgra bshad du rung ngo / /de'i phyir gna' mi bod kyi ming gi nigs rgyud spel sro4 'di/ nga tshos bslab dzor bya ba'i rig pa gal chen zhig yin te/ ming bkral na/ go ba de ltar blangs nas gnad du khel ba zhig dgos/ ltar snang dang 'ol tshod gyis mi chog ming btags na/ rgyu rkyen 19

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/ rten 'brel kun la btags nas mtshan nyid dang mthun pa zhig dgos/ chal chol dang nyag nyog tsam gyis mi chog mi chog don na/ ming ma go na/ brda mi 'phrod/ ming ma dag na/ don mi 'byor/ tshig gi sgrub byed ming yin/ ming gi dbang 'byor na/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med 'gro/ sbra gser tshang gis/ ji ltar mig dbang yod kyang dmus long gis/ /snang byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi mthong bzhin/ /brda dag gzhung la ma sbyangs rig pa gzhan/ /bslabs kyang gnad don 'khrul med rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes brda dag blo gsal 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba'i mjug tu gsungs pa 'dis/ dag yig rig pa mkhas par sbyang ba'i dgos pa gsal bar bstan snang ngo / / bzhi ba/ ming gi rigs kyi dbye ba/ ming gi rigs kyi dbye ba/ dbang bo drug gi spyod yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'du shes sogs mtshon byed kyi tha snyad ji snyed pha la ming zhes bya la/ming gi rigs la/ dngos po'i ming dang / khyad chos kyi ming dang / bya ba'i ming dang / grangs ka'i ming bcas rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dngos po'i ming ni/ sems can dang / bem po dang / byas pa dang / 'du shes la sogs pa spyi dang bye brag gi ngo bo tsam mtshon byed kyi tha snyad yod do cog ste/ dper na/ mi/ bod/ gzhon nu/ seng ge phug ron/ nya/ lta bu sogs sems can gyi ming dang / sdong bo/ stag pa/ lo ma/ gser/ chu/ rlung / lta bu 20

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/sogs bem po'i ming dang / ril du/ lham pa/ gru gsum ma/ zur brgyad pa/—lta bu sogs dbyibs kyi ming dang / mtshon chen/ sgo/ zam pa/ sgam/ ras/ glog pra/lta du sogs byas pa'i ming dang / skad cha/ bsam blo/ spyod stangs/ rnam 'gyur/ zhe sdang / lta du sogs 'du shes kyi ming za/ /tshig phreng spel ba las/ dngos po'i ming la la bya ba'i ming du sbyar chog pa'ang yod/ dper brjod na/ yul dang phu 'brog mda' zhing gsum/ /bdag rgyu yin nams ma rgyu yin/ /zhes dang / rgya gar dri med 'od dkar de/ /lan dri ngan bas ma dgra gong / /dum chung rgyan la phul na bsam/ /dgos pa'i dus su ma mchod na/ /gling ge 'dzin pa'i rtags la zhog /grel ba'i dus su ma mgon na/ /lha mthu chen min pa'i rtags la zhog /(gru gu go rdzong las)ces pa'i nang gi rtags kyis mtshan pa lta bur mas so/ /khyad chos kyi ming ni/ reg bya dngan rnam bdang / rang bzhin dang / tshugs ka dang / ngang tshul dang / mas da dri ro sogs mtshon byed kyi tha snyad ji snyed pa ste/ 'jam pa/ 'khyags pa/ yang ba/ lta du sogs reg bya'i ming dang / yag sa dkar ba/ nyag nyog lta bu rnams rnam pa'i ming dang / bzang ba/ srun pa/ byams pa/ lta bu bas bzhin gyi ming dang / drang ba/ gug pa/'dzig 'dzig lta du rnams tshugs ka'i mim dang / mgyogs pa/ rno ba/ dul bo/lta du rnams ngang tshul gyi ming dngag tsheb/ ring ba/ mang ba/ lta du rnams tshad 21

bdam da gsal byed ngag sgron/kyi ming dngad zhim pa/ dme ba/ mngar ba/ sgyur ba/ lta bu sogs dri dang ro'i ming ngo khyad chos kyi ming gi ming mtha' pa ba ma rnams po na ro dang ba'i dod du mo sbyar na dngos po'i ming du gyur pa mang ste/ dper brjod na/ sha tsho ba dang ga tshon po zhes pa'i go ba len tshul mi gcig ste/ snga ma tshig tu ltar nas/ sha khyad gzhi dang / tsho ba khyad chos kyi ngo bo gnyis su bstan pa yin pas/ sha tsho ba'am tsho ba za zhes bshad tshul med cing / phyis ming du sbyar nas sha dang tshon po chos can de'i ngo bo gcig tu bstan pa yin pas/ sha tshon po'am tshon po za zhes zer rung bas gsal/ de bzhin du zhim pa zhe na ro'i khyad chos mtshon pa dang / zhim po zhe na ro'i chos can mtshon pa yin te/ ka ra la zhim po zer yang / zhim pa mi zer/ zhim po zo zhes bshad srol yod kyang / zhim pa zo zhes bshad srol med pa dang / nor lug mang bas phyug por gyur/ zhes pa'i mang ba ni khyad chos kyi ming yin la/ mang bos bkyags na gdung ma yang / zhes pa'i mang bo ni dngos po'i ming yin te/ de gnyis phan tshun brje mi rung bas gsal/ de bzhin/ bzang ba dang bzang bo/ rno ba dang non po/ dma' ba dang dma' mo/ phra ba dang phra mo/ lta bu sogs las snga ma rnams khyad chos kyi ming tsam dang / phyi ma rnams dngos po'i ming gi cha dang ldan pa'o/ /tshig gi sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis khyad chos kyi ming bya ba'i ming du 'jug 22

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo boms brjod pa/pa'ang mang / dper na/ gser bzang ma yi snying dbang bton zin pa da lta'i bar du spun nas ma go yi(bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las)/ zhes dang / hrig nas ma 'dug slobs byed(dag yin gsar bsgrigs las)/ces dang / khyod rnams sems ma sdug dang / mi rnams los 'ong zhes sems gso btang(zhabs dkar ba'i sham thar las)/ zhes pa'i tshig dag las rtags kyis mtshan pa lta rtsa rnams dang / mtha' na/ khyad chos mtshon byed kyi ming 'dus ma'i cha shas slar so sor phye nas/ cha shas snga ma dngos po'i ming dang / cha shas phyi ma bya ba'i ming du gas pa'ang mang ge bag yod pa ni 'dod ma chags pa dang / zhe migabab dang / gti mi mug pakasum gyis rgyu byas shing mi dge ba spong ba'o(chos kyi rnam grangs las)zhes pas gsal/ bya ba'i ming ni mas can gyi rtsol ba dang / bem po'i 'a sogs mtshon byed kyi tha snyad ji snyed pa tsā slob pa/ bltas pa/ bsgrub pa/ rgyun pa/lding ba/ 'phur ba/ babs pa/ 'a sgyur ba/ 'byams pa/ 'bar ba/ shar ba/'gyur ba/ lta bu sogs go / bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa mang / dper na/ da slab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed sab rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /zhes pa las/ 'dzin dang bshad gnyis ma gtogs/ bslab pa/ smra ba/ brjod pa/ sbyor ba bzhi bo dngos po'i 23

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ming du gyur yod pa lta bu'o/ / bya ba'i ming la dus kyi rnam bzhag yod pas/ dngos po'i ming du gdags par gang la gang 'tsham du gdags dgos te/ byed pa'i sgo nas btags pa la da lta ba thob pa/ sangs rgyas la ston pa'am rnam 'dren/ skyed sring mi la gso ba bo'am skyong mkhan/ sgo kha'i so pa la sgo srung ba bo'am tsheg bar bsdus na sgo srung / chos khrims la sdom ba/ sog le lta du la gcod byed dam 'dra spyad/ lta bu sogs so/ /las kyi sgo nas btags pa la ma 'ongs pa thob pa/ bzhon bya'i rta la bcib pa/ shes bya'i gnas la bslab pa'am bslab par bya ba/ za rgyu 'thung rgyu la bza' btung / gzhan la phan phyir ster rgyu bo la sbyin pa/ spos la bdug pa/stan la gding bya/ lta bu sogs so/ / 'bras bu'i sgo nas btags pa la 'das pa thob pa/ sngon gyi lo rgyus sam rnam thar la byung ba/ rdzas kyis bcos nas grub pa'i bal la bal bcos ba/nyon mongs pa'i dgra bcom zin pa'i gang zag la dgra bcom pa/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba blos btang ba'i chos pa la bya btang ba/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' gsung la bstan pa/ lta bu sogs dang / yang / brjod bde ba'i ched du chos byung la chos 'byung zhes pa 'dra yang yod/ / nus pa'i sgo nas btags pa la bya las 'das pa thob pa/ 'ching byed la 24

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/byungs(bcings nas chings)/ 'jig byed la khyogs(bkyags nas khyogs)/bar mtshams gcod byed la chod(bcad nas chod)ka sman sogs 'thum spyad la thum(btums nas 'thums)/ snam bu sogs 'thag byed la thags(btags nas thags)/ rgyang la lta spyod la rgyang mthong(bltas nas mthong)/'jom par byed pa bo la chom po(bcom nas choms)/ zhes pa lta bu sogs las skul tshig dang 'dra ba mang yang ga tshig dngos min te/ bya las dang skul tshig skor zhig ming gzhi 'dra ba'i phyir dang / ming 'di rigs la spyir sngon 'jug mi dgos pa'i phyir dang (ming gzhan dang 'khrul ba med na yang 'jug kyang mi dgos1/ ming 'di rigs kyis 'brel yod dngos po gzhan gyi ming sbyor ba'i nus pa yod pa'i phyir(thod chings/ mgul chings/ sku chings/rmas chings/ chings yig lta du)ro/ / bya ba'i ming dang bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'gyur ba gnyis yig gzugs 'dra yang 'don tshul mi gcig 'byung ba/ 'dzin pa/ 'bod pa/ lta ba/ sgrub pa/ bslab ba/ bstod pa/ lta du sogs bya bar 'jug tshe/ ming mdza' pa ba dag gi sgra zor yang bar 'don pa dang / dngos por 'jug tshe sgra gdangs lci zhing gsal bar 'don par byed do/ /gzhan yang / dpe'i sgo nas bya ba'i ming da lta ba rigs 'dra gnyis bsdebs nas khyad chos kyi ming du sbyar rung ste/ dper mtshon na/ khra mda' 25

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ thog rgod 'bab 'bab/ rdul 'tshub sgrug pa 'khrig 'khrig phar rgyug rbab rgod 'dril 'dril/ tshur rgyug spyang mo 'dur 'dur/— ming— phar bsad shing chag 'grem 'grem/ tshur bsad gram— rdo spung spung / khrag dmar chu logs ga brug nyi ma dang sprin yang khrag gis mdangs 'gyur ba tsam byung ba'i dus der(gru gu go rdzong las)zhes pa las 'bab 'bab ces gnyis rer sbyar ba ltar ro/ / — bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhag dang / bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba sogs kyi zhib cha rtags 'jug gi skabs su shes par bgyi/ 'dir shes dgos pa ni/bya ba'i ming tshig sbyor du 'jug tshe/ ming mtha' sbyor mi sbyor bab dang bstun nas ci rigs byas chog dper brjod na/ blang dor gnas la 'thoms pa'i mun/ /thos pha'i sgron mes ma bsal na/ /dmus long byes su 'khyams pa ltar/ /ci bya gtol med ngang du 'dzad/ /de phyir thog mar gzhung chen la/ /slob gnyer phu thag chod pa gces/ /(dbyangs can dga' blo'i bslab bya las)zhes pa las/ 'thoms pa/ 'khyams pa/ chod pa rnams la ming mtha' sbyar yod pa dang / bsal/ 'dzad/ gces rnams la ming mtha' sbyar med pa lta bu yin pho da/ ming rkyang du 'god tshe/ ming mtha' cis kyang sbyar da gos/ ma sbyar na/ mi nyung ba zhig dngos po'i ming du 'khrul srid/ dper na/ shar dang shar ba/ skyes dang skyes pa/ gtam dang gtam pa/ 'gyed dang 'gyed pa1 sems dang sems pa sogs kyi snga ma rnams dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ma rnams bya 26

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ba'i ming yin pa gsal/ — grangs ka'i ming ni/ grabs ka mang nyung ji tsam pa dang / rim pa du ba sogs mtshon byed kyi tha snyad yod tshad da gcig bcu/ brgya/ stong / khri/'bum/ sa ya/ bye ba/ dung phyur/ drug cu re lnga/ brgya rtsa brgyad/ stong dang bzhi brgya/ phyed dang brgyad/ lta bu sogs mang nyung brtsi ba'i bgrang grangs kyi ming dang / gsum pa/ bcu ba/ brgya dang drug cu ba/ spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya gya drug pa/ lta bu sogs rim pa brtsi ba'i rim grangs kyi ming dang / bzhi ba bo/bcu ba bo/ brgya tham pa bo/ lta bu sogs bgrang bya rnams las grangs can zhig dmigs kyis bkar ba'i dgar grangs kyi ming dang / drug po/ brgya bo/ kun po/ gnyis ka lnga ga lta bu sogs grangs mang nyung 'a tsam mchis pa'i spyi grangs kyi ming dang / bzhi cha gcig bcu ma gsum/༄ brgya cha'i drug cu/ stong cha'i lnga bcu/ lta bu sogs bu cha ma cha'i ji tsam zin ba 'i ma grangs kyi ming dang / ldab bco lnga/ nyis skor/ sum skor/ brgya 'gyur/ stong 'gyur/ lta du sogs sngar gyi grangs ka las ldab ga tshod 'phar ba 'i ldab grangs kyi ming dang / 'ga'/ kha shas/ du ma/ bcu yas mas/ brgya lhag khri ma 'bum/ lta bu sogs des shes med par tshod dpog pa'i tshod grangs kyi ming ngo/ /grangs ka'i 'bri tshul zur bkod/ ‘ — grangs ka'i 'bri ka'adi lta rten—/

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun/ / brgyad dgu bcu brgya stong khri 'bum/ /sa ya bye ba dung phyur 'das/ /bcu nas bcu dgu'i bar dag tu/ / bco lnga bco brgyad ma gtogs pa/ /bcu yi u ni or mi bcu'i / /bcu phrag gnyis la nyi shu zer/ /bcu yi gnas su bcu 'jug par/ /mtha' med min pa bas 'phul spong/ / sum cu drug cu bdun cu dang / /bzhi bcu lnga bcu dgu bcu bzhin/ / de la brgya'i bar sla bris su/ /nyer gcig so gnyis zhe gsum dang / /nga bzhi re lnga don drug dang / /gya bdun go brgyad ces par bya/ /brgya yan gnas su gcig gnyis gsum/ /sdun na bzhag na gas 'phul bsgyur/ /rjes su sbyar na mi 'dor te/ / 28

le'u dang bo'i don sa dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ chig khri nyis stong sum brgya dang / / 'dum gcig khri gnyis stong gsum bzhin/ / de las gcig la chig ces grags/ / brtsi gzhi'i sdun gyi gas 'phul dor/ /chig shad nyis thog sum 'grel bzhin/ /chos can rang grangs sdun du 'jug / brtsi bya'i chos mi‘nga rjes su sbyor/ / sum mdo sum sgrog ces pa ni/ /chos kyi ngo bo re re tsam / mdo gsum sgrog gsum bya ba ni/ / ldog pa tha dad ji bzhin no/ / — lnga ba/ ming gi spyor tshul/ rjes 'jug gi ming mtha' 'dren tshul/ ming rkyang ba'i sbyor ba yin zhing /tsheg bar sdud tshul dang tshig sna sdud tshul/ ming 'dus ma'i sbyor ba yin la/dngos po regs mthun pa'am 'brel dam pa du ma lhan na 'god tshul/ ming gi tshogs pa'i sbyo ra ba yin te/ de lugs legs par rtogs na/ tshogs gsum gyi 'jug par dag cha thon pa'o/ / ming rkyang ba ni/ chos gang rung zhig gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming de'i cha 29

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ —shas gang yang bsdu mi rung ba zhig ste/— dper na/ gad zag gi 'tsho skyong la ma bsten pa'i srog chags rtswa gzan la ri dwags zhes grags/ ming 'di'i cha shas snga ma bsdus na/ dwags tsam gyis don ci yang mi ston pa dang / cha shas phyi ma bsdus na/ ri zhes pas don gyi ngo bo gzhan zhig ste/ rdul brtsegs ston par 'gyur ba lta du'o/ / ming rkyang ba la grub tshul bzhi yod de/gcig sgra gcig pus don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa/ dper na/ gnam/ rtswa/ b.lug khab/ lta bu sogs so/ /gnyis/ sgra gnyis bsdebs nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa la rigs bzhi —yod la/ 1 ming du grub pa'i sgra gnyis bsdebs nas chos gzhan zhig ston pa/dper na/ zhabs kyu/ nor bu/ chu 'dzin/ srog chags/ lta du'o/ / 2 sgra snga ma ming du grub pa dang / phyi ma ming du ma grub pa gnyis bsdebs nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa/ dper na/ mkhan po/ yi dwags/ spyil skrung(dkyil dkrung)/ lta bu'o/ /3 sgra snga ma ming du ma grub pa dang / phyi ma ming du grub pa gnyis bsdebs nas don zhig ston pa/ dper na/ rgun chang / prog zhu/ snang rus/ lta bu'o/ /4 ming du ma grub pa'i sgra gnyis bsdebs nas chos shig ston pa/ dper 30 tsho

le'u dang bo'i donas dang bo/ ngo sko tsam brjod pa/na/ seng ges ga tse/ en chi/ pa go lta du sogs las gnyub ba zhig mi rigs gzhan gyi tha snyad bod 'gyur stso chags phal na/ gong gi rnam pa 'di bzhi la ming ki sbyor ba mu bzhi zed/ — ‘gsum/ sgra gsum yin chad kyig don gyi ma bo tsam ston pa/ 'phyang mo nyugamyo stob/ 'dzam bu gling / nor shu gling ga yo rgyan pad ma/ sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan/ thon mi sam sgo ṭa/ spang skong phyag brgya ba/ ka ba ring bo zur brgyad pa/krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab/ lta du sogs so/ / bzhi/ ming mtha' gu ngu 'u bu gang rung zhig sbyar nas dngos po gang gi chung ngu'i rigs ston pa/ she'u(sha ba)/ rte'u(rta)/ ze'u(zo ba)/ skre'u(sgro ba)/gtsag bu/ lan bu/ spyil bu(spyil bo)/ khrol bu(khrol ma)/ gzhong du(gzhong ba)/tha gu(thag pa)/ dbyu gu(dbyug pa)/ lu gu(lus/ gru gu/ (gru)/ snang ngu/chung ngu/ thung ngu/ lta du sogs so/ / ming 'dus ma ni tsheg bar ram tshig sna bsdus nas ming du grub pha ste/rnam pa bdun yod de/ gcig khyad gzhi dang khyad chos ‘bsdus pa/ pad ma yang yin la dkar bo yang yin no/ /zhes pa la/ pad ma dkur bo zer ba dang / a ga ru yin la nag po'ang yin/ zhes pa la/ ar nag zer ba/ de bzhin du/ mi chen/ ri rab/ lo yags/ nags stug po/ glar bo che/ lta du'o/ / — 31

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ gnyis/ bgrang bya dang grangs bsdus pa/ 'byung ba sa dang chu dang me dar rlung bzhi la/ 'byung ba bzhi/ zhes dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs la/ tshogs gnyis/ zhes pa/ de bzhin/ dug gsum/ 'gyur bzhi/'khor ba rigs drug bkra shis rtags brgyad/ lta bu'o/ / gsum/ 'bru mang bo bsdus pa/ shes rab rgya mtsho la sher rgyam/ byu ru dkar bo la byur dkar/ phyag na rdo rje la phyag rdor1 dbul zhing 'phongs pa la dbul 'phongs/ dud nas 'gro ba la dud 'gro/ kha sna gnyis nas 'thung ba la gnyis 'thung / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sher phyin/ lta du'o/ /bzhi/ don gzhan ston par bsdus pa/ shar lho zhes pa ma bsdus pa'i skabs su/ shar phyogs dang lho phyogs so sor ston pa dang / bsdus tshe me mtshams ston pa red/ de bzhin/ dkar ser/ rkyang nag 'bring tha/ lta bu'o/ /lnga/ ldog zla bsdus pa/ ring thung / bzang ngan/ dkar nag dal mgyogs/ la lung / ri klung / rong 'brog lta bu'o/ / drug gzhi mthun pa bsdus pa/ blo rig 'od zer/ dkar gsal/ 'jam mnyen/ brtag dpyad/ bslab sbyang/ lta du'o/ /bdun/ las dang bya ba bsdus pa/ longs spyod/ thag gcod/ gros bsdur/bed spyod/ lta bu sogs so/ / gong gsal gyi ming gi sbyor ba las/ sgra nyung mthar brten nas 'bod sla 32

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ba dang / sdeb legs par brten nas brjod bde ba dang / 'dra chags par brten nas kha gsal ba byas pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal ba gsum thon pa 'di dag ming gdags pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa yin no/ /deng thon rdzas gsar ba char shul gyi spang la sha mo brdol ba bzhin byung dang 'byung gin yod pas/ming de ltar btags na legs so/ /rong 'brog gi kha skad las/ bal bcos sa/rgyu skar bzos ma/ 'khor rkyal/ dbugs rgyag shing rte'u/ glog 'thag glog gsag la sogs pa'i ming gsar ba byung ba rnams mnyung la brjod bde zhing don gsal ba bcas bod skad kyi khyad chos kun tu 'dzoms snang / tha snyad gsar ba 'di rigs khyab gdal du gtang bar shin tu 'os so/ /gzhan yang —/ spying gi cha shas la gtso phal dang / stobs mtshungs pa dang /dbyer mi rung ba bcas kyi khyad par yod/ de lugs legs par shes na/ tshig —gi dag chus don gyi gnad 'byen cing / /don gyi go bas tshig gi dag thon pa//zhes pa ltar/ tshig sna sdud tshe blang dor mi rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /de la cha shas snga ma gtso ba'i ming ni/ shes rab/ brtson 'grus/ rig gnas/ rgyal /bab/ mun nag lta bu sogs dang / cha shas phyi ma gtso ba'i ming ni/ chab srid / dpal 'byor/ bsil gdugs/ rgya mtsho/ gong 'pheg rgyu skar/ thag ring / lta bu sogs te/ 'di rigs kyi ming ngam tshig sna sdud tshe/ ma shas gtso bo bzhag nas phal ba bsdu dgos/ dper na/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor dang rig gnas 33

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/gsum la/ srid 'byor rig gsum du bsdus pa las/ chab dpal rig gsum zhes sdud mi rung / de bzhin du/ shes rab dang brtson 'grus zung du 'grel ba la/ shes brtso na zung 'brel/ zhes dang / bsil gdugs rnam par dkar ba la/gdugs dkar/ zhes dang/ skyes thob kyi shes rab dang / sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan dman pa la/ skyes sbyangs dman pa/ zhes dang / bzo las deng rabs can du 'gyur ba dang / zhing las deng rabs can du 'gyur ba dang / rgyal khab srung stobs deng rabs can du 'gyur ba dang / tshan rig lag rtsal deng rabs can du 'gyur bar/ 'gyur bzhi zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /cha shas gnyis ka stobs mtshungs pa'i ming ni/ 'od zer/ bsam blo/dar rgyas/ brtag dpyad/ mdzes sdug 'jam mnyen/ lta bu sogs te/ 'di rigs kyi ming sna bsdu ba la/ spyir gang rung bsdus chog zla ba'i 'od zer la/zla 'od dam zla zer/ lang tsho dar rgyas byung ba la/ lang tsho dar ba'am/ lang tsho rgyas pa/ 'dab brgya mnyen zhing 'jam pa mdzes sdug dpal gyis yid ni kun tu 'phrog pa la/ 'dab brgya mnyen la mdzes pas yid 'phrog pa'am/ 'dab brgya 'jam zhing sdug pas yid 'phrog pa/ lta bu'o/ / cha shas gnyis ka dbyer mi rung ba'i ming la gcig tu bsdu rung ba dang /gang rung bsdu mi rung ba gnyis las/ snga ma ni sgyu gu /sla nga / byu ru1 sgo nga/ phru gu rdo rje/ lta bu sogs te/ tshig sbyor rdu cha shas phyi ma rjes 'jug tu bsdus 34

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ ngo bon ma brjod pa/byur dkar/ kyu ༵ rgod kyi phru/ ༵༵ rnyi da zlo ga la ༵ga rdo ṭwāṃ dī la ṭwāṃ bhe rdor/ra ༵ ༵ shas ga/ nyis ka ba kyi sdebs dī/sa ming dī gruX dī ṭwāṃ/na pas ro/ ma/cha rdo dī gang ༵nga /zhig bheX bye/ ga rngo / tshu 〉 /༷ / ༷ ༷/ / // bye ༷ / / / bye/ snye ༷༷ ༷bye1 khro bye ༷/ khro bye/ ༷༷ ༷/ ༷/༷//༷ byebyerdo/ ṭwāṃ/ da/ rtso/dī gsum/du/ sgra tshad bzo — — —— — 35

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/don tshan gnyis pa/ 'grel sgra/rnam dbye drug pa 'grel sgra ni/ / gi spyod byed 21 yi lnga ste/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi / na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi/ /'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i /rkang ba skong tshe yi thob cing / /'grel chos gang zhig 'grel gzhi ni/ / gang dang 'grel bar ston byed yin/ / tshig don snga phyi mi mthun par/ /ston pa'i rgyan du'ang 'jug pa yod/ /'grel sgra'i thob thang ni/ rjes 'jug da ba sa gsum dang / yang 'jug da sa gnyis la kyi thob ste/ dper na/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo/ yib kyi byang bu/ ras — — —kyi kha tshar/ phyogs kyi rtsa ba/ pha rol kyi don/ lta du dang / rjes 'jug na ma ra — — —la bzhi la gyi thob ste/ dper na/mdun gyi lam/ khyim gyi las ka gser gyi rgyan cha/ rma tshab gyi me tog lta bu dang / rje sa 'jug 'a kho mtha' med la 'i thob ste/ dper na/ nga'i yin/ nam mkha'i sprin/ lta du tsheg bar bsdus shing / rkang ༷ — 36

le'u dang bo'i gas gnyis pa1 'brel sgra/ba skong ba'am brjod bde ba'i dgos pa yod tshe/ 'i sgra'i dod na༅ bcun ste/dper na/ kha bshad chu yi spu ba dang / /lag len gser gyi thigs pa3yin/ /shā yi ra co/ lta bu tsheg bar bye ba'o/ / — — —— 'grel sgra ni 'grel gzhi dang 'brel chos kyi 'byed ba gsal bar byed pa'i mdang /—yang na/ chos gnyis rnam par phye zhing gtso cher 'amachos gang 'brel gzhi gang dang 'brel ba'i don ston ma kyi sgra ste/ gos kyi ri swo zhes pa dper mtshon na/ gos ni 'brel gzhi dang / ri mo ni 'brel chos yin par go ba ni/ kyi zhes pa'i sgras bstan pa'o/ /bdag gi dpe cha/ zhes pa dper mtshon na/ bdag dang dpe cha zhes pa'i chos gnyis gi snas rnam par zu zhing /gtso cher 'byel chos dpe cha de 'brel gzhi bdag dang 'brel nas yod pa'i don gsal bar byas so/ /de bzhin/ pa blo bzang gi slog pa red/ bod kyi rig gnas dar ba'i sos ka bslebs byub/ mkhas pa'i gas pa yon tan red/ skya mi'i gshog pa rta mchog red/ ‘ rlu 1bhe gi zhon par ma brten dri bsung ngad/ /phyogs bcur spro zhing dus kun 'dab ma'i 'dzum/ /yongs su bzhan 'di tsung li kro'u in le'i/ /ngo mtshar mdzad rjes yin gyi pad dkor min/ /(gtan 'bebs kyi dpe ste dung dkar ba'i snyan ngag las)lta du noms las 'brel sgras bdag dang bdag gi 37

bad krodakasalakhyedarag sgron/ ba'i 'brel ba bstan pa/ — — ljon shing gi yal 'dab rab tu rgyas/ gna' mis stag pa'i shun par yi ge bris rabs snang /lag po'i phyi nang sha red/ mdzu gu lnga bo spun red/ shar phyogs ri bo'i rtse nag /dkar gsal zla ba shar byung //ma skyes a ma'i zhal ras/ /yid la 'khor 'khor byas byung / /(tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur las)lta bu noms las 'grel sgras yan lag dang yan lag can gyi mas ba bstan pa/ bang mdzod kyi 'byu/ rgya mtsho'i za rlabs chil chil g.yo/ nam mkha'i bya pho mo mi shes na'ang / mgo nag mi'i rnam 'gyur los shes/phye ma leb kyis gshog rlung gis/ /lhun po 'gyel bar bya ba'i dogs/ /sdom gyis ba thag phra mo yis/ /gangs kyi seng ge bcing ba'i dogs/ /lta bu rnams las 'brel sgras rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba bstan pa/ sde dge'i dril bu grags pa che/ jar paṇa gyi 'phrul 'khor spus ka bzang /bal bo'i se'u ma zos kyang / /kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/mas lan hphang gi bzhin dpal nga nyid la/ 1yod ces nya gang zla ba snyems 38

le'u dang bo'i don tshan gnyis pa/ 'grel sgra/ma byed/ /mtsho rdzing da lo—bu 'bab ldan 'gram skyes pa'i/ /dkar 'jam pad ma la yang yod phyir ro/ /(rab btags kyi dpe ste tshe tan zhabs drung gi snyan ngag spyi don las)lta bu rnams las 'byel sgras khungs dang thon rdzas kyi 'byel ba bstan pa/ na — — gon po de'i bsam pa bzang gtsug lag khang gi bkod pa brjid cing mdze sa/dgung nyi ma'i 'od zer gar khyab la/ /gling ge sar snyan pa ma khyab med/ /gu ling gser gyi 'od ya la/ /ra gan ser pos 'ong le min/ /me shel nyi snama'i gzi mdangs la/ /me khyer srin dus 'gran le min/ /(gru gu go rdzong smad so las)lta bu rnams las 'brel sgras cha dang ma can gyi 'brel ba bstan pa/gro yi myu tsu/ pha ma'i bu la thengs gsum/ rgod ma'i bu la thengs gcig byu ru phug ron gyi sgo nga che chung tsam zhig nyos/ lam kha'i shing gi 'bras bu de/ /byis pas rdo char 'bebs pa'i rgyu/ /bdag po ngan pa'i longs spyod kyang / /phal cher dgra yi g.yab mo yin/ /(shing gi bstan bcos las)lta bu rnams las 'brel sgras rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba bstan pa/ — 1gna' dus kyi lo rgyus/ — 1 —

brda krod gsal byedang ga sgron/spyi tshogs gsar ba'i srid 'byor rig gsum dar zhing rgyas/rang rgyal deng sang gi don gnyer gtso bo ni dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun yin/lang tsho yol ba'i mdza' grogs rgan po khyod/ /lo mang thal ba'i sdong rgan rjes su 'gro/ /kha dog mi sdug gnyer mas yongs khengs shing / /rigs mthun gzhan gyi gral nas phyung bas so//(mnyam nyid kyi dpe ste snyan ngag spyi don las)lta bu rnams las 'grel sgras skabs dang don gyi 'brel ba bstan pa/bsags pa'i nor/bslabs shing sbyangs pa'i yon tan/byas pa'i rjes dang grub pa'i rtags/mkhas chen dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis brtsams pa'i brda sprod blo gsal dga' ston las rnam dbye sogs kyi brjod pa gsal/ lta bu rnams las 'grel sgras bya ba dang grub pa'i 'grel ba bstan pa/mdzes shing sdug pa'i me tog mtho ba'i sgang dang dma' ba'i gshong /dga' ba'i bro 'khrab cing skyid pa'i gru len/rab dkar ti se'i lhun por 'ja' tshon gyis/ /'khyud nas sgeg pa'i gar gyis spyos byed cing / /sgra 'dzin sim pa'i blu dbyangs len shes na//nges 40

'i 'u dang bo'i don tshan gnyis pa/ 'brel sgra/par mas lan hphang gi rjes su 'gro(rmad byung gi dpe ste snyan ngag spyi don las)/lta bu rnams las 'brel sgras khyad gzhi dang khyad chos kyi 'brel ba bstan pa/lus kyi 'khri shing 'khyog po'i rtser smin pa'i/ /ral ba'i me tog tsam pa ka yi rdul/ /'thung 'dod mig gi bung ba kem kem g.yo/ /rgan po'i skyed tshal 'di ni ya re nga/ /(ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can te bod mkhas pa'i snyan ngag lag) shes rab lang tsho'i dpal dar zhing / / thos pa'i nor gyis rab tu phyug /spyod pa'i 'khor lo bskor mkhas pa/ 4ma kyis gzhan yid cis mi 'phrog /(yan lag gnyis gzugs te rdo rje rgyal bo'i snyan ngag las)lta bu rnams las 'brel sgras dpe dang dpe can gyi 'grel ba bstan pa/ skad kyi gdangs/gser gyi gzhong ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ gnag snum skra yi lan bu byed bcings rtser/ /zla tshes gsar ba'i rgyan ldan phyag sor gyis/ /rin chen rgyud mangs zer mdzad dbyangs lha mos/ /deng 'dir blo gros snang ba mchog stsol cig /(rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa ste zhwa dmar bas)lta du rnams las 'brel sgras bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'grel ba ste/dngos po gang rgyu cha gang las grub pa'i 'brel ba bstan pa/41

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/lta ba'i mig rngoXnd gso byed kyi sman pa/ gcod par byed pa'i sta re/ tshul khrims nyes spyod dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i zla ba'i 'od/ /skye dgu'i dbus na lhun po lho dur brjid/ /stobs kyis bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dud/ /(byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len gyi rnam bzhag mdor bsdus las)lta bu rnams las 'brel sgras byed pa — gcig pa'i 'brel ba ste/ chos gang byed pa gang du 'jug pa'i 'grel ba bstan pa — blta ba'i dpe cha/ bri bar bya ba'i ri mo/ bslab bya'i yon tan/ nga la dri rgyu'i dogs gzhi mang / lta bu rnams las las gcig pa'i 'brel ba ste/ chos gang bsgrub bya gang dang gcig pa'i 'brel ba bstan pa/'dir bdag nyid gcig pa'i dang / byed ba gcig pa'i dang / las gcig pa'i 'grel ba gsum dril na/ ngo bo gcig pa'i 'grel ba'o/ /gzhan yang / 'drel sgra rnams rnam dbye ma yin pa'i phrad tsam gyi tshul du mi mthun pha'i tshig rgyan la'ang 'jug ste/ dper brjod na/ gtam smra ba ni sla 42

le'u dang tho'i don rags pa/ gyed sgra/yi g.yul 'gyed pa ni dka'o1 /zhes pa'i yis pi brjod don snga phyi mi mthun ma 'gal bar bstad pa'i sgon ga tshig mdzes par byed pa'i— rgyan du gyur pa'o/ de bzhin/ — — pa mkhas blun brtag la yar gzhan gyi skyon —'tshol ba lta bu shin gyi/ de ཿ gnyis kyi khyad par phegs par phye nas blang dor bya ba'i chedas na pa'i phyir ro//(dge ldan legs bshad kyi bal ba las/) g.yo can snyan ba smra ba ni/ / rang don yin gyi gus phyir min/ /srin bya bsnyen nas dgod pa ni/— /ltas ngad gtong gi da ga 'a nas min/ /(sa skya'i —legs bshad las)lha bu sogs so/ / don tshan gsum pa/ sded sgra/— rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra yi/ / thob thang 'grel sgra nyid dang mtshungs/ /— bya ba gang gis byas pa yi/ / byed pa gtso phal ston byed de/ / byed pa bo ni sems can dang / / byed por snang ba'i bem po yin/ / byed pa yo byad rgyu cha dang / /

brda spod gsal byed ngag sgron/ thabs dang rgyu mtshan spyod tshul yin/ / ka pa 'brel sgra'i mthar sa sbyar na/ gis kyis gyis 'is yis rnams su grub pa'i sgra ste/ ming mtha' 'dren tshul 'brel sgra'i thob thang dang 'dra'o/ /'dir dmigs bsal can 'is sgra'i sbyor tshul/ si tu mchog gis gsungs pa ltar/chos rgyal mes dbon dus kyi rdo ring rnams su 'a mthar 'is zhes sbyar mod/ skad gsar bcad kyi lugs la sa tsam las mi 'byung ba ni/ 'a mtha' zor yang bas phal cher bsdus pa'i shugs kyis/ 'is zhes pa'i 'i yang bsdus nas sa gcig pu las mi mthong bar zad kyi/ thob thang la ni med pa ma yin no/ /byed sgra la rnam dbye zhes pa ni/ bdag gzhan gnyis kyi ngo bo ma 'dres par rnam par phyes nas/ gtso cher byed pa ston pa yin te/ blo bzang kis tshe ring bos she na/ 'bod pa bo blo bzang ni bdag dang / bod bya tshe ring ni gzhan yin par/ byed sgra gis zhes pas rnam par phye nas bstan pa yin/ gal te byed sgra ma sbyar na/ blo bzang tshe ring zhes bdag gzhan gnyis kyi ngo bo ga cig tu gyur nas/ bod bya'i yul tsam las/ 'bod pa bo ston rgyu med song ba/lta bu'o/ /rtags 'jug ma khrid gong / bdag gzhan sogs kyi don bshad na/cung zad go dka' bas/ rags par bshad na/ gsham gsal ltar ro/ /byed sgra ni byed pa ston byed kyi sgra ste/ bya ba gang zhig byed pa gang gis byas zin pa'am/ byed bzhin pa'am/ byed par 'gyur ba gang rung ston par 44

le'u dang bo'i don tshan gsum pa/ gyed sgra/ byed pa'i sgra yin no/ / byed pa gtso phal gnyis yod de/ byed pa gtso bo la byed pa bodang / byed pa phal ba la byed pa zhes bya la/byed pa bo ni khya ba sgrub pa'i sems can dang /bya ba sgrub pa'i tshul can du snang ba'i bem po dag yin zhing / byed pa di sems can gang gis bya ba zhig lag len du bkol ba'i bos da(dbang bo dang yan lag sogs kyang 'dus)dang / rgyu cha dang / thabs dang— / rgyu mtshan dang / byed tshul rnams yin te/ blo bzang gis bshad ce na/ bshad pa ni bya ba dang / blo bzang ni byed pa bo yin par gis sgras rnam par zu nas gtso cher skad cha bshad mkhan blo bzang yin par bstan pa dngad pir gyis ri mo 'bri ba na/ri mo ni las dang / 'bri ba ni bya ba dang / pir ni byed pa yin par gis sgras gsal bar mas pas / shing bzos sta res shing gcod 'a na/ shing gcod pa'i bya ba de'i byed pa gtso phal shing bzo dang sta re ni bdag dang / shing ni las te gzhan yin par rnam dbyes/sum pas gsal bar byas so/ / go1— ri gsal gyi dper brjod 'di gsum las/ snga ma'i tshig sbyor du byed pa kha yin par dngos su ma bstan kyang shugs las rtogs pa dang bar ma'i byed pa bo tshig zin du med kyang shugs bstan tu gsal bas/ phyi ma ltar byed pa gtso phal sogs mngon sum du brjod pa'i dgos pa yod na ma gtogs/shugs bstan gyis chog ste/ tshigs sna gas ba'i phan cha yod do/ /de bzhin/ 46

bad sprod gsol byed ngag sgron/ne tsos mi skad lad mo byed/ sus bsags ma yin sus za yin/ rgyun du gzhan gyis bskyang dgos pa'i 1 /skye bon ma zhig ci nas nyams/ /bya rog gis ni bzung ba yi/ /rus sbal sa la lhung zhes grags/ /(sa skya'i legs bshad las)lta bu rnams las byed sgras byed pa bo sems can bstan pa/pad mas so phreng ngom/ legs bshad sgron mes ma rig mun pa sel/thugs chung chung de 'dra dgos dogs med/ /rdo chung chung lhags pas 'khyer dogs med/ /ri zung chu' pang khas theg dogs med/ /shing chung gis gnam rgya reg dogs med/ /(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las)rang shong khung byur 'khren pa'i phyi long gis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten rgya khyen ji ltar rtogs/ /nyi 'od ngoms med 'thung ba'i zla gzhon gyis/ /gling bzhi'i mun pa sel ba'i tshul la ltos/ /(dor zhi mchog gis)lta bu rnams las byed sgras byed pa bo bem po bstan pa/ lcags khem gyis sa rko/'phrul 'khor gyis bzo las spel/mig gis mthong zhing lag gis zin pa'i rang pyong can ni rig pa rgod/zla 'od zer gyis kun da'i be sar gsal/ ka'od stong ldan pas pad

le'u dang bo'i don tshan gsum pa/ byed sgra /dkar 'dab da rgya grol/ /mdzes ma'i kha chus ba ku la ka /rkang bas mya ngan med ba'i me tog dgod/ /(don skor ba'i rgyan te —bodas khas pas)lta bu rnams las byed sgras byed pa ste/ byed pa bos bkol ba'i mag cha dang / rang gi dbang bo'am yan lag sogs bstan pa/ — gser gyis rgyan ma rdung / bhe — —khang ba'i klad rdza g.yam gyis bkab/ — mar dang phyur bas thud bzo༄/ pa dug mo —nyung gisasakhrisand sel zhing migs da/ lta du sogs las byed sgras byed ma ste rgyu ma bas pa/ — skad cha shed kyis mod/ — — — — —'bad rtsol gang thub kyis bas snang byed/ bsam pa rnam dag dang 'dun pa rtse gcig gis mi dmangs la phan 'dogs/ don ldan tshig di gcig gis kyang / /rnamar ma can mdon mang ston/ /(dbyangs can dga' blos)lta bu rna mas las byed sgras byed pa ste thabs bstan pa/ pa— pa rtags kyis sheso/ 3 bden pas stongs/ tso

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/yon tan gyidi che/thon mi rgya gar du chas pa thang sang las lo bzhis 'phyis pa tsam mo/ / (thon mi'i zhal lung las ) mgar gyi shing de rnams chu 'gram du khyer nas/ chu la bsgyur bas/ rtsa ba lci bas thur du song / rtse mo yang bas gyen du lus so/ /(rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long las/) gzhung 'di zab pas rgya mtsho dang / /snying bo phyug pas dbyig gi mdzod/ /gces par 'os shaṃs nor du 'dra/ /blo ldan rnams kyis rten pad 'os/ /(rgyu'i dpe ste snyan ngag sgron gsal las)lta bu rnams las byed sgras byed pa ste rgyu mtshan bstan pa dang / rgyu mtshan bstan ched byed sgra khyad chos kyi'am bya ba'i ming mthar sbyar tshe/ rgyu mtshan gsal byed kyi tshig grogs dang sprags nas sbyar chog ste/ mi de phrag dog pa'i dbang gis gzhan gyi yon tan la mi dga' lta/ rgyal bo shin tu khro gtum che ba'i rkyen gyis blon po dag gis zhu ma phod/rmongs pa'i stabs kyis don ma shes/ bza' btung med pa'i rkyen gyis bslang du mi 'gro ka med byung / pho brang gi 'khor ba rnams sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i chang gi btung ba bag med par spyad pa'i dbang gis ches cher myos pa'i gom stabs 'khyor zhing /5 48

le'u dang bo'i don tshan gas pa/—byed sgra/rnam 'gyur ci dang ci yang ston par byed/ (gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las)lta bu rnams so/ /yang / des na/ de bas na/ de lta bas na/ zhes pha'i byed sgra yang3 mtshan gsal byed du 'jug pa'o/ /wal gyis shar ba/ blo lings kyis bdags/ rtsis rig mthar gyis sbyang dgos/ sprin dkar zho gsar spungs pa 'dra zhig mdun du nar gyis byung ba'i nang du/ lha'i du dkar po lus zud sprin gseb tu nub cing / lus phyed thon pa zhig na re/ (bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las/)rgyun chags brtson pa ma btang bar/ /bags kyis bsgrubs na ci yang 'grub/ chu bo dal gyis 'bab pa yis/ /yangs pa'i bar bskor nas 'gro/ /(chu yi bstan bcos las)lta du rnams las byed sgras byed pa ste byed tshul lam 'byung tshul bstan pa/tshig sbyor du byed sgra 'jug mi 'jug las gang byed pa bo gzhan dang 'brel ma 'brel la thug yod/ bya byed tha dad pa'am bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba yod na byed sgra 'jug dgos/ de las ldog na byed sgra mi 'jug de lugs dpyis phyin par rtogs dgos na rtags 'jugabasarag las/ 'dir rob tsam bshad na/ bya ba la rigs gsum yod de/ byed pa dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang /49

brda sprod gsal byed ngas sgron/las dang 'brel ba'i ma ba dang / rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i bya ba dang gsum mo/ / de la snga ma gnyis ni phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i bya ba rigs gnyis yin te/ rngon pas ri dwags bsad nas sod pa mang / zhes pa dper mtshon na/ri dwags bsad pa ni byed pa'i las te/ byed pa bo dang 'brel ba'i las yin zhing / ri dwags sod pa ni bya ba'i las te/ bya ba'i yul dang 'grel ba'i las yin pas/ bsad pa ni byed pa dang 'grel ba'i bya ba yin la/ sod pa ni bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'grel ba'i bya ba yin zhing / byed pa bo rngon pas bya ba'i yul ri dwags la bsad pa'i bya ba ma bcug na/ bya ba'i yul ri dwags rang sod par mi 'gyur ro/ /des na byed pa bos bya ba'i yul lam las la phar 'jug pa'i rtsol ba bsad pa lta bu'i bya ba dang / las kyi steng nas tshur snang ba'i 'gyur ba sod pa lta bu'i bya ba rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis phar 'jug tshur snang gi sgo nas rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba rang shugs su chags 'dug ste/ ri dwags bsad pa'i rgyu 'di med na/ ri dwags rang sod par 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu ni 'byung sa med do/ /de'i 3ra bya ba'i rigs 'di gnyis gang rung las la sbyar na/ las de sgrub pa'i byed pa dngos sam shugs la yod pas/ byed pa ston pa'i byed sgra cis kyang 'jug dgos te/ rngon pas ri dwags bsad byung / rngon ༷ pas ri dwags sod zin/ bya ba chen po yun gyis bsgrub/ /ngang thung 'bad ༷ —50

le'u dang bo'i don tshan gsum pa/ byed sgra/pas mthar mi phyin/ /zhes dang / mang bo gcig tu blo mthun na/ /nyam chung gis kyang don chen 'a grub/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ / bya ba'i rigs ba sum pa ni/ bya byed tha mi dad pa ste/ byed pa rang gi ngang gis grub par snang ba'i bya ba yin/ 'di 'dra'i tshig sbyor las byed las dang bya las logs tsu ster rgyu med de/ nga 'gro zer ba la/ 'gro ba'i bya ba 'di las la phar 'jug pa'i rtsol ba min la/ las las tshur snang ba'i 'gyur ba'ang min/'gro byed nga yin la/ 'gro bya'ang nga yin pas/ byed pa bo dang bya ba'i yul tha dad du mi snang ba'am/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba med cing / ngo bo gcig par 'gyur bas/ rnom dbye gsum pa 'jug mi tshung / nyi ma shar ba na/ shar ba'i bya ༵ rdo ༵ ༵ju rdonga~X dgo sa pa rmed song sna/ nga zhing / ngo bo gcig tu yod pas na/ —des na byed pa gang gi bya nga zhig thad kar las dngos dang 'grel nas med na/ rnam par dbye ba'i dgos pa med pas/ byed sgra 'jug srol med/ nga lug rdzi byas/ zhes pa'i tshig 'di'i byas pa ni/ gzhan du na bya byed tha dad pa can yin pas/ byed pa ston pa kyi byed sgra 'jug dgos mod/ skabs 'dir las la rtsol ba 'jug dgos don med de/ nga dang lug rdzi ngo bo gcig tu grub pa'i bya ba mtshon pa tsam yin pas/ byed sgra mi 'jug go / dpal ldan ja nyo bar 'gro zer ba'i tshig 'di las/ ja nyo ba'i las 'di 51

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/'gro ba'i dgos pa tsam du zad de/ 'gro ba'i bya ba ma grub na/ ja nyo sa mi 'grodes na tshig 'di'i gnad ka 'gro ba la thug yod/ 'gro bi bya ba'i las dang 'brel med la/ 'gro bya 'gro byed gnyis ka ngo bo gcig par snang bas/ rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug don med song /nga 'gro la bshad/ nad pa nyal nas dpe cha lta/ lta bu dag las/ tshig phrad la dang nas kyis bya ba snga phyi dus rim gyis 'jug par mtshams sbyar nas/bya ba phyi ma de bya ba snga ma grub pa'i shul du 'jug pa yin par bstan yod/des na 'jug rim snga ma'i bya ba de las dngos dang 'grel med pas/ byed sgra 'jug don med song / 'di ni bod skad kyi goms srol lam brda sprod pa'i chos nyid cig yin te/ tshad ldan du mthong ngo/ /don gyi zhib cha ku sha'i rtse ltar phra ba tsam yang rnam par phye nas ston pa 'di/ bod skad rang gi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig go / don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/su ru ra dang tu du na/ /phal cher la dang 'jug pa mtshungs/ /sa su ga ba drag mthar tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/'a dang mtha' med ra'am ru/ /na la dag ni skas sa bstun sbyor/ / las dang ched dang rten gnas dang / /de nyid tshe skabs ston byed yin/ /la don ni la'i don can gyi sgra ste/ rnam dbyer 'jug pa na/ rang dbang can na dang / gzhan dbang can su ru ra tu du bcas las su bya ba dang /dgos ched dang / rten gnas dang / tshe skabs dang / de nyid rnams ston byed du/ la sgra'i 'jug pa dang phal cher mthun pas1 spyi ming du la don zhes btags so/ /'dir phal cher zer don ni/ don ston tshul dang / brjod bde min dbang gis/ 'di rnams don lnga bo gang la gang 'jug pa dang / gang mi 'jug pa'i thad du khyab che chung gi khyad par yod de/ dper na/ gzugs la lta/bslab sbyang du dpe cha nyo/ mtsho lho na yod/ lhag par mdzes/ dus tshod brgyad thog tu song / lta bu sogs la/ gzugs su lta/ bslab sbyang na dpe cha nyo/ mtsho lho la yo da/ lhag pa la mdzes/ dus tshod brgyad thog na song / zhes mi rjod pas gsal/ thob thang ni/ 'jug yang 'jug sa la su thob ste/ g.yas su nyal/—yongs su rdzogs pa/ lta bu dang / rjes 'jug ga ba dang / yang 'jug da a tu —63

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/thob ste/ sgam thog tu bzhag khab tu bzhes/ tshig zind tu gsal/ pha rold — ༷ —tu phyin pa/ lta bu dang / rjes 'jug nga da na ma ra la drug la du thob ste/ gong — —du 'phel/ bshad du 'gro drin du gzo/ khyim du bsdad/ 'khyer du 'jug— — — — —gzhal du ci/ lta bu dang / rjes 'jug 'a dang mtha' rten med pa la ra dang ru ༷༷ ci rigs 'jug ste/ mtha' ru phyin pa/ je mtho ru 'phur/ lta bu tsheg bar bye ba ༷ —dang / mthar phyin/ je mthor 'phur/ lta du tsheg bar bsdus pa'o/ /༷ —de yang sgra 'dres na gdangs 'gyur/ zhes pa bzhin/ kha skad du tshig phrad kyi sgra rnams rjes 'jug gis drangs pa'i shugs kyis zur chag cing brjod sla bar gyur nas/ rjes 'jug gi rang sgra ha lam la don gyi tshab tu zor yang bar byas nas 'jug pa yin te/ dper na/ g.yag ga khal 'gel/ g.yon phyogs ga bsdad byung / gang nga 'gro rgyu/ tshod da ma lta/ bshan na yod/ rgyal khab 'a phan — — — —thogs/ khyim ma 'gro/ nam mkha' 'a 'phur/ mjal skor ra shog yul la bud — — — —song / lta bu sogs dang / sa mtha' can la dmigs bsal gyis 'a 'jug ste/bkra shis 'a sgor mo skyi/ lta bu'o/ /༷༷ da ni la don 'jug pa'i don tshan lnga bo'i khyad par mdo tsam bstan pa/las dang ched dang rten gnas dang / /de nyid tshe skabs lnga bo'i khyad/ / yul la bya ba 'jug pa dang / /

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/yul gyi dgos pa sgrub pa las/ /—las dang dgos ched 'dra ba min/ /bya byed ngo bo tha dad dang / /tha mi dad pa'i cha nas ni/ / —las dang de nyid khyad par byung / /yul gang bya ba byed sa dang / /dngos po yod sa ston pa las/ /las dang gnas gzhi so so yin/ / bya ba gang zhig yul dang dus/ /gang dang ldan pa'i cha nas ni/ /gnas gzhi tshe skabs mi gcig go /de dag rim bzhin dper brjod na/ / thab tu me btang zhes pa'i tshe/ /bya byed ngo bo tha dad pa/ /yin pas de nyad min pa dang / /bya ba 'jug sa bstan phas na/ /dgos ched yang ni min pa dang / /yul la bya ba byed tsam gyis/ /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gnas gzhi'ang min te las dngos yin/ / mgron por me gtong zhes pa na/ /yul gyi dgos pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /dgos ched yin gyi bya yul min/ /thab tu me yod ces pa na/ /dngos po'i yod sa bstan pas na/ /rten gnas yin gyi las sogs min/ /me ni drag tu 'bar ba na/ /bya byed ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir/ /bya ba'i yul min de nyid yin/ /nub mor me btang zer ba'i tshe/ /byed dus mtshon pas tshe skabs nyid/ /las dang rten gnas min pa gsal/ /dang bo/ las su bya ba/gnyis pa las su bya ba ste/ /bya ba 'jug sa'i phyogs dang gnas/ /la don gang rung sbyar bar bya /bya ba 'jug sa'i yul de ni/ /

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/byed pa'i cha dang ldan pa la/ /ra la min pa sbyor mi rung / /las su bya ba'i las ni bya ba'i yul dang / bya ba ni sems can gyi rtsol ba dang bem po'i 'gyur ba'o/ /des na bya ba'i yul zhig gzhir bzung nas/ de la bya ba byed pa la/ las su bya ba zer ro/ /bya ba'i yul la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ bya yul tsam mam bya ba'i yul phal ba ni/ bya ba gtad sa'i phyogs tsam dang / bya ba byed sa'i gnas tsam yin pa'i rigs la/ na sgra sbyar na brjod mi bde ba ma gtogs/ la don rnams la sgra'i dod du thob thang ltar gang rung 'jug chog dper na/ pe cin du 'gro ba na/ pe cin bya ba'i yul dang / 'gro ba bya ba yin par du sgras rnam par phye zhing / gtso cher 'gro zhes bya ba gtad sa'i phyogs pe cin yin par bstan pa dang / rdzi bos ne'u gsing du lug 'tsho ba na/ byed pa bo rdzi bos lug 'tsho ba'i bya ba byed sa'i gnas te bya ba'i yul ni/ ne'u gsing yin par go ba ni/ du zhes pa'i la'i don can gyi sgras bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin/ snod du bcug tshe ring khyim du logargyu skar bzos ma nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phangs/blun po'i yon tan khar 'byin te/ /mkhas pa'i yon tan khong du sped/ /

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/sog ma chu yi steng du 'phyo/ /nor bu steng du bzhag kyar 'bying / /(sa skya'i legs bshad las)lta bu bya ba 'jug sa'i phyogs tsam ston pa'i rigs la/phyogs mtshon byed kyi ming ste/ phyi nang / mdun rgyab/ g.yas g.yon/ phar tshur/mgo mjug stod smad/ steng 'og thog mtha' bar gsum sogs la la don sbyar rgyu mang / 'di rigs kyi khyad chos ni/ gang zhig gang du phyin pa'am 'jug par mngon/ lug khyu ri ngos su 'byams/ — nags tshal du sdong bo gcod/ kho tshos tshoms chen du glog brnyan lta yin yod/ nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa der/ /don med nam mkha'i bya yang 'khor/ /gang la bde spyid 'dzoms pa der/ /ma bsdus par yang skye bo 'du/ /(shing gi bstan bcos las)lta bu rnams las/ la don gyis bya ba byed sa bstan pa yin gyi/ dngos po yod sa bstan pa min pas na/ las su bya ba ma gtogs/ gnas gzhir mi 'gro ste/ bya ba'i yul zhes pa'i ming gis kyang don gyi ngo bo 'di gsal bar byas yed pas bsnyon du med do/ /'di rigs kyi khyad chos ni gang gis gang du ci zhig byed par mngon/byed pa bos bya ba 'jug sa'i yul lam blo gtad sa'i yul gang byed pa'i cha dang ldan pa ni/ bya ba'i yul dngos sam gtso bo yin pa'i rigs la/ rjes 58

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/'jug 'a dang mtha' med dag la ra sgra zor yang bas/ la sgra'i tshab tu 'jug chog pa ma gtogs/ la don gzhan dag la'i tshab tu 'jug mi rung / dper na/yo byad drel la bkal zer ba la/ yo byad drel du bkal mi zer/ don ni gong gsal bya ba 'jug sa'i phyogs tsam mam gnas tsam bstan pa ma yin par/byed pa bos las te yo byad dgal sa'i yul ni drol yin la/ drel de yang byed par gyur nas las kyi dngos po de khur du blangs par gyur pas na/ la sgra rang ma gtogs/ la sgra'i tshab gzhan gyis ston sa mi 'gro ste/ rdzong dpon gyi gros tshogs la rdzong dpon rang zhugs pa las/ las byed phal ba zhig tshab tu mngag mi rung ba lta bu'o/ /yang na byed pa bos phar bya ba'i yul la bya ba zhig bcug pa na/ yul de byed par gyur nas tshur ltos bcas kyi lan zhig bca' rgyu shugs bstan du yod pa zhig ste/ dper na/ dgra la 'thab pa na/ byed pa bos phar bya ba'i yul dgra la 'thab pha'i bya ba 'jug pa'i tshe/ bya ba'i yul dgra de yang byed pa bor gyur nas/ tshur ngo ya byed pa'am/ mgo gdags pa'am/ yang na 'bro ba'i bya ba zhig bca' rgyu tshig zin du med kyang don la gnas 'dug go /de bzhin/me la sregasdong bo chu bor bskur/ nad par gos skon/

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/za khang la skams lug btsong /ka pā la nas spu zhig btogs/ /kha yi zur du btsugs pa 'dra/ /ga nas bltos kyang 'dre 'dra ba/ /nga la gnod pa ma skyel ang / /dar seng dkar mo gangs stod 'grims pha la/ /kha char bu yug gnod pa ma mdzad cig thang dkar rgod po gnam 'phang gcod pa la/ /mda' mkhan dpa' bos gnod ‘4 ma mdzad cig /(snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las)lta bu sogs te/ 'di rigs kyi khyad chos ni/ byed pa bo'i shugs rkyen thebs sa'i yul der ltos ba cas kyi 'gul skyod cig 'byung nges par mngon/yang / byed pa bo'i dbang bo drug gang rung gi rtsol ba 'jug sa'i yul dngos yin par ston pa la'ang / la ra gnyis ma gtogs la don gzhan dag tshab tu 'jug mi rung / don ni/ yid sogs kyi bya ba yul de la dngos su bcug med kyang / yul de la brten nas bsgrub pha'am 'byung ba yin te/ yul de'i rgyu rnams rang 'bras skyed pa'i byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dper na/stag la skrag pa na/ skrag pa'i bya ba de bya ba'i yul stag gi 'jigs par pa nas byung ba yin pa/ la sgras gsal bar byas pa dang / grogs la blo gtad pa na/ grogs kyi gzhung drang zhing zhe bzang ba la bltas nas yid ches par byed pa yin no/ /de bzhin/dgra la sdang zhing gnyen la byams 60
