le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/gna' gtam la nyan dga' che/ gtam mdo med bshad na rna la gzan/ /sha rus pa zos na so la gnod/ /yon tan ldan pa yon tan la/ /dga' yi yon tan med rnams min/ /sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa me tog la/ /dga' yi sha sbrang de lta min/ /(sa skya'i legs bshad las)lta bu sogs so/ /'di rigs kyi khyad chos ni/ yul gang la blo kha phyogs pa tsam gyis snang ba ci rigs shig shar bar mngon/gong gsal bya ba zhig bya ba'i yul phal ba ste las tsam la sbyar na/ de gnyis ka'i bar du la don zhig 'jug dgos te/ chos gnyis kyi ngo bo ma 'dres par so sor dbye ba'i ched du yin zhing / bya ba zhig bya ba'i yul gtso bo ste las dngos la sbyar na/ de gnyis ka'i bar du la don 'jug mi rung ste/las dang bya ba'i ngo bo tha dad du mi snang ba'i phyir yin/ dper na/ bla brang du 'gro dang / bla brang 'gro ba ba gnyis don mi gcig snga ma ni bla brang bya ba'i yul du bzung nas/ de la 'gro ba bo zhig 'gro ba'i don can du gyur yod la/phyi ma ni bla brang 'gro ba bor gyur nas/ de rang 'gro ba'i don can du gyur to//sdong bu 'dzugs dang / sdong bo la 'dzugs zer ba gnyis don mi 'dra/ snga ma 'dzugs pa'i bya ba de las kyi dngos po sdong bo dang mnyam du sbyar nas/shugs bstan gyi bya ba'i yul sa la sdob bo rang 'dzugs pa yin pas/ bya ba dang las ngo bo gcig par snang bas/ rnam dbye 'jug don med song / phyi ma 61

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/'dzugs pa'i bya ba de shugs bstan gyi byed pa mdung lta bu'i yo byad cig gis bya ba'i yul sdong bo'i steng du 'jug pa yin pas/ bya ba dang yul gyi ngo bo tha dad du snang bas/ rnam dbye 'jug pa'i dgos pa byung ngo / /sha gtub pa dang /sha la gtub pa gnyis don mi 'dra/ snga ma gtub bya dang gtub byed 'grel zhing / gtub pa'i sbyor bar brten nas/ sha rang gri kha nas dum dur song ba ma gtogs/ sha bya ba'i yul du bzhag nas/ de'i steng du gtub pa'i bya ba gzhan zhig byed pa'i rnam pa mi 'char ba dang / phyi ma gtub byed kyis gtub bya zhig bya ba'i yul sha'i steng du bzhag nas gtub pa ma gtogs/ sha rang sil bur gyur pa'i rnam pa mi snang ngo/ /de bzhin/sa brkos/sdong bo gcod/ dpa' chen gyis— lug bsha'/ kun tu rgyus tshul khrims bsrungs/ (mdo mdzangs blun las)lta bu sogs la rnam dbye gnyis pa 'jug srol med do/ /gnyis pa/ dgos ched/ rnam dbye bzhi ba dgos ched ni/byed pa bo dang bya ba'i yul/gang gi dgos pa bsgrub pa'i ched/ 62

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/ bya ba byed par ston byed yin/ /byed pa bo gang zag ma zad srog chags gzhan ci rigs shig yin yang /bya ba zhig byed par dmigs yul re yod/ dper na/ lug gtsang bo'i khar rgyug pa yang / chu 'thung ku dmigs yul re yod mod/ rnam dbye bzhi ba ni dmigs yul de lta bu zhig mi ston par/ byed pa bo ci rigs shig gis rang gi dgos pa'am bya ba'i yul gyi dgos pa zhig bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba zhig byed par ston pa yin no/ / byed pa bos rang gi dgos pa zhig gi ched du bya ba byed par ston pa ni/rong bas lto gos su zhing btab pa/ dper mtshon na/ lto gos dgos pa'i ched du byed pa bo rong bas zhing btab pha'i bya ba byas pa yin par/ su sgras bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin/ cha ma la 'gro/ g.yul du go bgos/rgyal khab bsrung bar dmag rtsal— sbyong / gos su nyos kyang sha la brjes(thon mi'i zhal lung las)/ 'gyur bzhi bskrun par na gzhon gang mang༄ga rtsal sbyang bar mngags/de'i tshe tshong ba lnga brgya tsam zhig rgya mtshor zhugs te/ rin po che len du song ba las chu srin kha gdangs pa dang phrad nas/ gru yang shin tu mgyogs 63

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/par chu srin gyis za 'dod pa'i khar song ngo(mdo mdzangs blun las)lta bu sogs so/ /de yang bya ba sbyar sa'i gzhi la chos dang bya ba'i khyad par yod kyang /don la tha dad med de/ spyir tshig sna bsdus ma bsdus pa'i phyir yin/ cha ma la 'gro zhes pa'i tshig kha grol na/ cha ma 'thu bar 'gro zer ba lta bus gsal/byed pa'i cha dang ldan pa'i bya ba'i yul gyi dgos pa bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba byed par ston pa la/ ra sgra zor yang bas chog pa las la don gzhan dag la'i tshab tu 'jug mi rung / mgron po la me btang ba dper mtshon na/ bya ba'i yul mgron po'i dgos pa bsgrub pa'i ched du me btang ba'i bya ba byed pa'i tshe/ bya ba'i yul mgron po de byed par gyur nas/ kha lag bsro ba'am du ba 'then par me de bed spyod par 'gyur bas gsal/ de bzhin/rta la chas byen/ grogs dga' bar rogs ram byed/dbul bo rnams la sbyin pa gtang bar bya/khrel med rnams la phan btags kyang / /bya ba zin na brjed par—'gyur/ /chu bo pha rol brgal ba na/ /gru gzings ltos pa med par 'dor/ /(chu yi bstan bcos las)lta bu sogs so/ / dgos ched dang las su bya ba'i tshig sbyor la la dper na/ zhing la chu 64

le'u dang bo'i don tshad bzhi ba/ la don/'dren dang / rka la chu 'dren/ lta bu ches mtshungs pas na/ kha cig gis gnyis ka'ang las su bya ba'i mtshan gzhid 'dod ba ni/ don gyi zhib cha ma gtogs par mngon te/ gcig tu/ sum cu ba'i gzhung lugs ni/ tshig gi sbyor tshul gyi rnam pa tsam ston pa ma yin gyi/ don gyi khyad par gyi ngo bo nyid ston pa yin pa'i gnad 'di ma zin la/ tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa mtshungs pa tsam gzhir bzung ba'i phyogs su lhung ba'i phyir dang / gnyis su/ bya ba'i yul gyi dgos pa bskrub par bya ba ched du byed pa'i dgos ched dang / bya ba'i yul gyi dgos pa mi ltos par bya ba tsam byed pa'i las su bya ba gnyis kyi spu ris ma phyed pa'i phyir dang /gsum du/ byed pa bo'i dmigs yul dang / bya ba'i yul gyi dgos pa gnyis kyi khyad par ma phyed par/ nya nyung mnyam bsre byas pa'i phyir/ de lugs kyi chos nyid ma rtogs log rtog tu gyur pa yin no/ /yang / la las/ zhing la chu 'dren pa'i zhing ni/ lo tog la ma dmigs par sa la dmigs pa yin na/ las su bya ba'i mtshan gzhir 'gro'o zer/ tshig 'khri skam pos brdar sha mi chod pas/ /lung dang rigs pas dpyad na rang bzhin rto‘kas/ /sgra rig pa'i thad du thon mi gnyis par grags pa'i si tu paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ bya ba gang zhig gis bya ba'i yul de'am/ de dang 'grel ba'i las la phan 'dogs par 'gyur ba'i don gyi ched du bya ba'i yul la 'jug pa rnam dbye bzhi ba/ zhes gsungs pas gnad 'di phigs te/ legs bshad tshad 65

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ldan du mthong ngo / /der brten/ zhing la sa ru bzung yang / sa yis lo tog bskyed par chu yi dgos pa yod pas/ chu 'dren pa yang bya ba'i yul(sa)de dang 'grel ba'i las te/ myu gu 'bus pa'am ljang bu skye ba la phan 'dogs pa yin pas/ dgos ched kyi mtshan gzhi rang yin no/ /'dir dgos pa zhes pa dang / phan 'dogs pa zhes pa gnyis tshig bshad tshul mi gcig kyang don ston tshul gcig ste/ byed pa bo rang gi'am bya ba'i yul gang gi dgos pa sgrub pa ni phan 'dogs pa nyid de/ dgos pa bsgrubs byung na phan thogs song ba ma yin nam/dgos ched gsal byed kyi sgra ste/ ched/ phyir/ slad/ don/ rgyu mtshan rnams gang rung tsam mam/ la don gyi grogs su sbyar nas/ byed pa bo dang bya ba'i yul gang rung gi dgos pha ston chog dper na/ don de la rtsod pa chung ched du spang ri 'di nas sum cha de spre'u la gsol ༷ ras gnang rogs mdzod(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las)/skyes pa'i tshul zhugs mdzes ma kru'u dbyin thes/ /leng hreng pe la rang gshis mtshon slad du/ /nor du'i 'phra ldan rgyan cha'i tshon bu gcig /slob —dpon dga' ma'i snyim par gtad nas song / /(phra mo'i rgyan te snyan ngag spyi don los/) nga bu sprang bu 'dra ba zhig gi don la kho skyes pa khyo ga'i srog bcad pas mi ༷༷༷ 66

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/yong ngo ('gro ba bzang mo'i rnam thar las)/ lta du rnams las la don la dgos ched gsal byed kyi tshig grogs sbyar nas dgos pa bstan pa'o/ /mi rigs 'dra mnyam du nges ched mi rigs srid jus gtan la phab bo / pa bur shing gcod pa ro yi phyir/ /wa skyes gsod pa pags pa'i slad/ /don mthun 'joms pa nor gyi don/ /rgyal bor rgol ba 'bangs kyi ched / /(shing gi bstan bcos las)lta du sogs dgos ched gsal byed kyi sgra tsam gyis dgos pa bstan pa'o/ / gsum pa/ rten gnas/rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas ni/ /gang zhig gar yod ston byed de/ /gnas dang gnas pa'i don can du/ / la don gang yang 'jug rung gi / rten dang brten pa'i don can du/ /ra la min pa 'jug mi rung / /rten gnas ni chos gang zhig gnas gang du yod par ston par byed pa ste/ri rtsa na chu mig yod zer bar/ chu mig ces pha'i chos de yod sa'i gnas ni/ ri rtsa yin par na sgras bstan pa'o/ / gnas dang gnas pa'i don can te/ gnas bya'i chos shig gnas gzhi 67

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gang na yod pa tsam du sbyar ba'i don can ni/ gnas gzhi phal ba yin pas/thob thang ltar la don gang rung 'jug chog ri ngos su lug yod/ ces pa dper mtshon na/ gnas gzhi ri ngos dang gnas bya lug gnyis gzhi gcig min pas rang shugs su 'bral sla ste/ lug ri ngos na yod pa tsam mo/ /yang /ri'i phang ba la grong sde chags pa dper mtshon na/ ri'i phang ba dang grong sde gzhi gcig min pas/ so sor 'phral rung la/ grong ba rnams ri'i phang ba der bsdad ma 'dod na/ gnas gzhan zhig tu spor chog pa lta bu yin no/ /de bzhin/zi ling du bzo grwa mang / khyem du 'grul ba 'ga' yong nas yod/dkyil 'khor bar snang khams na yod/ /lha bzo dkyil 'khor dbus na bzhugs/ /(khed) brag ri'i nyin du shug pa dang srib tu gsom pa skyes/chu snod brgya la zla ba brgya/mang mang 'dus pa'i tshogs gral du/ /'dra 'dra lta bu mang na yang / /rang rang khyad chos mi 'dra ba/ /skye bo rnams kyi byad gzugs bzhin/ /(thog ma'i zung ldan te snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron las)lta bu sogs so/ /rten dang brten pa'i don can te/ brten bya'i chos shig rten gzhi gang 68

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/la thogs pa'am dbang ba nyid du sbyar ba'i don can ni/ rten gzhi gtso bo yin pas/ ra sgra zor yang bas ma gtogs la don gzhan rnams la'i tshab tu 'jug mi rung / dper na/ sil sdong la yal ga mang / zhes pa'i la'i dod du du sgra 'jug mi rung ste/ rten dang brten pa gnyis gzhi gcig la 'brel dam po chags yod pas/ rang shugs su so sor 'bral mi rung ba dang / bkra shis la gzig spogs shig yod/ ces pa'i la'i tshab tu su sgra 'jug mi rung ste/ rten gzhi bkra shis dang brten bya gzig spogs gnyis bdag dang bdag gi bar 'brel bas/ gang— zhig gang du yod pa tsam bstan pa ma yin gyi/ gang zhig gang la dbang ba dngos bstan pa yin zhing / de yang rang shugs su so sor mi 'bral ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin/mi dmangs la rang dbang yod/ rgyu la 'bras bu thogs/ bshad pa'i kha la tshangs dbyangs grub/ /nyan pa'i yid la ye shes skyes/ /(gru gling g.yul 'gyed yas/) dam ka dpon btsan lha rdo rje na re/ kho re mi dmar rta dmar skya/ bshad rgyu khyod la yod kyang bden pa nga la yod/ zer nas glu 'di blangs so/ /(stag gling g.yul 'gyed las/) brtson 'grus can la grub pa mang / /rang myong can na rig pa rgod/ /lta 69

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/bu sogs so/ / bzhi ba/ tshe skabs/tshe skabs bya ba byed dus dang / /'byung dus nam yin ston byed do/ /tshe skabs ni bya ba gang zhig nam tshod byed pa dang / 'gyur ldog gang zhig nam tshod byung ba'i dus ston byed yin no/ /de la snga ma ni dper brjod na/ skya rengs su lus rtsal sbyangs/ zhes par/ skya rengs ni dus tshod dang / lus rtsal sbyangs pa bya ba yin pa/ su zhes pa'i la'i5 don can gyi sgras rnam par phye zhing /lus rtsal sbyangs pa'i dus ni skya rengs yin pa gsal bar byas pa lta bu/ de bzhin/bod yig thog maka thon mi 'a ṭas gsar snge brtsams pa yin zhes grags/bcings grol ma byas gong du ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba ha cang sdug deng skabs su rang rgyal du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi phrin las rnam bzhi deng rabs can du sgyur bzhin ma chis/nye char nga tshos zab sbyang byed kyin yod/rjes rnyi ngas rgya yig kyang e shes shese blta/ rdzun dang phra ma g.yo rgyu gsum/ /'phral lam du 'gro yang phugs su phung / / 70

(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyudaXg ༷༷ ba rim ba/ bzhin ga/ nyis rer bya ba byas zin pa'i dus 'das pa dang / byed bzhin pa'i dus da lta ba dang / byed 'gyur gyi dus ma 'ongs pa rnams bstan pa'o/ /na ning nas da lo'i bar du nga mtsho sngon mi rigs slobaka na zab sbyang byas shing bsdad/ zla brgyad paka kho pe cin grong khyer sogs su ltad mo blta bar bud song /nya gang du zla 'dzin byung / nyin mo dkar la ro nyal ma byed/ nam gung du cung zad gnyid/ lta bu rim bzhin lo/ zla/ tshes/ nyin/rta di tu~Xbhe rdzi bye rdo/'o/ / snye kho myur du bud song / nam zhig la 'ong rgyu cha ma 'tshal/ lta bu dus kyi rgyun dang / glo bur dang /nges med rnams bstan pa'o/ / phyi ma/ 'gyur ldog gang zhig nam tshod byung ba'i dus ston par dper na/bye bye ༷ byeXs bye rdo ༷ ༷ tu pa re char pa da/ bab/sa/ yud ྾ snge yang thang song / 71

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/rgyal tshab rje ni rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug lor 'khrungs nas rab byung bdun pa'i lcags phag lor gshegs( 1364—1431)/ lta bu sogs so/ /lnga ba/ de nyid/de nyid las dang bya ba gnyis/ /ngo bo gcig tu grub pa dang / /tshul dang tshad gnyis sbyar ba las/ / khyad chos nges can ston byed yin/ /spyir de nyid ces pa de kho na nyid de/ chos rnams kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa'i nges par ngos 'dzin mod/ skabs 'di'i de nyid ni/ de 'dra'i don min gyi/ de de rang yin pa'i ngo bo gcig 'gyur ston byed yin te/ las dang bya ba gnyis ngo bo gcig tu grub pa'i de nyid tsam la'i don can gyi sgra la brten nas shes chog pa zhig yin/ de yang nang gses khyad par bzhi yod de/ba/cig las dang bya ba gnyis ngo bo gcig tu sbyar nas chos gang gi ngang tshul stan par byed pa zhig ste/nyi ma 'od du 'tsher/ zhes par/ 'od ni las dang 'tsher ba bya ba gnyis du sgras ngo bo gcig tu sbyar cing / 'tsher ba 'od de nyid las logs su med la/'od kyang 'tsher ba las logs su med par byas nas/ nyi ma'i ngang tshul bstan 72

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ la don/pa'o/ /de bzhin/me tsha sreg tu grub/chu rlan gsher du nges/rkyen ngan grogs su shar/khrom pa zabs su 'don pa bco lnga yod/chos skyong bzang bo bsil ldan sngongs 'di yi/ /grangs med mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan ma yin te/ /dran dbang gzhan gyi rnam dpyod spobs pa'i tshogs/ /'phrog pa'i chom rkun nyid du nges pa lags/ /(chos la bsnyon dor te dbyangs can dgyes glu las)lta bu sogs so/ / gnyis/ las dang bya ba gnyis ngo bo gcig tu sbyar nas/ bya ba'i yul gyi 'gyur tshul ston par byed pa zhig ste/rgya yig bod yig tu bsgyur/ zhes pa na/ las bod yig dang bya ba bsgyur ba gnyis tu sgras ngo bo gcig tu sbyar nas bya ba'i yul rgya yig gi rnam pa 'gyur tshul bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin/rta rgyug par byed/ba bris ma drus mar re/glu shags yi ger bris/ mtshon cha thams cad kyang me tog gi char du gyur/(legs bshad rin po 73

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/che'i gter mdzod las/)kha zas ma zhu dug tu 'gyur/ /dug kyang shes na sman du 'gyur/ /(sa skya'i legs bshad las/)khong 'dab chags lcags la bzos pa min/ /nga spre'u mar la bzos pa min/ /(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/) nga dgung sngon dbyings kyi sprin gsar la/ /gos dro 'jam yong ba'i re ba byed/ /sprin gos su sbon pa she nas yong / /'brug glog lce dang 'grogs sbrang char ngom/ /(snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las )gri brgyab rdo la dbyug pa red/ mdung bsnun brag la mdzub mo red/zhags 'phen pha bong skud 'then red/(gru gling g.yul 'gyed las)lta bu sogs rjes —gsum/ bya las ngo bo gcig tu sbyar nas byed pa'i spyod tshul lam 'gyur tshul ston pa ste/ khong ga ler phebs pha na/ las ga le dang bya ba phebs pa gnyis ra sgras ngo bo gcig tu sbyar nas byed pha bo khong gi 'gro tshul mtshon pa dang / de bzhin/rta mgyogs par rgyugakha ba lhab lhub tu babs/ku shu smin nas kha dog dmar bor gyur/74

bzhi/dag khyad choXbyeXsnyeX/ byetram̐tram̐/ bags kyi cigaX/ /sbya/ra nas khyad gzhi kho thag re ston pha ste/'tsho ba lhag par skyid pa na/ tshad lha ga pa dang khyad chos skyid pa gnyis ra sgras ngo bo gcig tu sbyar nas/ khyad gzhi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul kho thag cig bstan pa dang / de bzhin/ —hūm̐ sa snang ༷ mchog zhengs bye gyur khyad bye zhig re 'phagaX/// bye ga ༵cig gdung 'degs /'phrul gyis yongs brten cing / /gser gur gros/༷ —/ byeX ༷/ dī rnyi ༵ kau rna mdzes pa ma par ba/ kra//zhe/ sha mo ṭwāṃ gab tshig snyed byis ṭwāṃ smra ba'i dbang bo khyen kyi rnam dpyod 'edi/ /rab tu sra zhing tsub pa'i rang car blos gcod te lta du dī/ bde pags/ dīX /ra /no/ brdo/ khyad par brjod pa~X rgya/na/ rdog da ga byang sa ca nad ga 'a —75

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/don tshan lnga ba/ na sgra/na sgra gal 'dzugs gzhung 'dzugs dang / /rgyu mtshan dang ni mthun mi mthun/ /'os dang mi 'os smon pa dang / /the tshom rnams la 'jug pa yin/ /na sgra la don du don tshan lnga la 'jug pa gong gsal/ phrad rkyang du 'jug pa mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa de 'dra mi gcig kyang / mtha' dpyad na don tshan brgyad 'dra yod de/dang bo/ gal 'dzugs pa /brjod bya'i chos shig gi mtha' gcig dmigs kyis bkar nas ston pa/dper na/ mi de skyes bu dam pa dang phal ba gnyis las/ skyes bu dam pa yin nges na/ yon tan khyad par can dang ldan pa zhig yin dgos/ (gser tog pa'i sum rtags las/)sang nyin lam grogs e yod/ yod grang na 'u cag 'gro(blo gsal 'jug ngogs las)/dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ /rang gi 'bangs la lhag par byams/ /ma rabs mtho sar bzhag gyur na/ /rang gi ris la lhag par 'tshe/ /(rgyal bo 76

le'u dang bo'i don tshan lnga ba/ na sgra/lugs kyi bstan bcos las)lta du dang / 'di 'dra'i rigs la gal te dang gal srid ces pa'i brtag pa mtha' bzung(gang brtag par bya ba skabs thog yin pa'i dbang du btang nas mtha' bzung ba)gi tshig grogs sbyar rgyu mang ste/gal te bu khyod kyis yul du mthu'i rtags ma thon par log byung na/ nga ma rgan khyod rang gi mdun du lcebs nas shi sdod do zer/(mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las )gal srid nga 'ong ma thub na nga'i tshab tu mi gzhan zhig mngags/ (dag yig gsar bsgrigs las)lta bu sogs so/ /gnyis pa/ gzhung 'dzugs pa/brjod bya'i don snying dmigs kyis bkar nas gsal bar ston pa ste/tha snyad ces par 'grol tshul mang yang / dngos su na ming dang phrad kyi spyi ming ngo theg chen dang theg dman la 'dra sa dang mi 'dra sa mang mod/ mdor na theg chen gyi lugs ni sgo kun nas gzhan la phan 'dogs pa dang / theg dman gyi lugs ni gzhan la gnod pa mi skyel ba nyid do/ /ming gi chags tshul dril na 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub gnyis so/ /spyir bzo rigs la rgyas par phye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / gtso bor bsdu na/ sgra ba rin shes kyis/ bzo ni lus dang ngag dang yid bzo'o zhes 77

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/gsungs pa ltar ro/ /(rol mo'i bstan bcos las)lta bu sogs so/ /gsum pa/ rgyu mtshan ston pa/rgyu yod na 'bras du 'byung / (blo gsal 'jug ngogs las/)rlung ma g.yugs na sdong bo mi g.yo/ (rta ngan na la thag je ring red/ dpa' med na dgra yas je brnyas red/) rgyun chags brtson pa ma btang ka/ /mi 'grub bya ba ci yang med/ /chu thigs rtag tu 'bab pa yis/ /brag gi ri bo 'bigs la ltos/ /(chu yi bstan bcos las )rig pa'i gnas lngar legs par ma sbyangs na/ /dgra bcom gyis kyang kun mkhyen thob mi srid/ /de bas don gnyis mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen lam 'dir mkhas rnams brtson par rigs/ /(stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi gsung)lta du sogs so/ / gzhan yang / me med na du ba ji ltar yod/ ces pa lta bu rnams la/ mkhas pa la las rgyu mtshan don gyis bstan pa'i dper 'khod pa 'grig mod kyang / 'dri khul byas pa tsam las rgyu mtshan bstan pa'i rigs las dbye ba cher mi snang bas/ de'i khongs su bsdus na 'os snyam/bzhi ba/ mthun pa dang mi mthun pa bstan pa las/ 1 tshig snga phyi mthun par bstan pa/ 78

le'u dang bo'i don tshan lnga ba/ na sgra/ spyi hūm̐ hūm̐/ rdo mtho dī tshad/ 'a/ dom pas 'jal na 'dom pas 'jal/ /(bya sprel gyi gtam rdo las/) gal te gshegs na gshegs par mdzod/ //nyid kyi bgrod pas bdag la ni/ /gdung ba yun ring 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'di la khyod ni dogs mi 'tshal/ /(rjes na tshig don snga ṭwāṃ ༵ mthu rdon pa kar ba rnyi na pa /las)lta du'o/ / par spyi snye/༷/ khro khro bye ༷bye bye skre / bye ༵/ na lta bu/ sogs dī /da/ge ba la yid 'jug lnga ba/ 'os pa dang mi 'os pa bstan pa las/1 'os su che ba ste/ 'os pa nan gyis 'dzin par bstan pa/chu la me 'bar na shing la los 'bar/blun pos ༵ dhi lang shes rdod mkha/dī dī rnyi ṭwāṃ smos ( / ṭwāṃ gas dī 'ju/ ga ngogs las)lta bu'o/ /79

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/2 'os par dka' ba ste/ mi 'os pa dmigs kyis 'dzin par bstan pa/las yin pa byas na min pa zer/ dpe pad ma bris na khyi rjes zer/ (gru gu go rdzong las/)bzang byas na ngan/ ja blugs na gcin/nang du bsdad na gyang ngos logs ris zer/ /phyi la song na mgo yang 'phyan mo zer/ /(snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las )3 'os shing mi 'os pa ste/ dngos po gcig gis bya rung ba de/ dngos po gzhan zhig gis bya mi rung bar bstan pa/ blo gros ldan pas mi rtogs na/ /blun po'i tshogs kyis ci la rtogs/ /mig ldan rnams kyis mi mthong na/ /long bas mthong ba srid 'gyur ram/ /('os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ste snyan ngag rnam bshad gsal sgron las) lta bu sogs so/ /drug pa/ smon pa ston pa/byed kyi nad drag na grong ba kun dga'o/ /bdag mkhas par gyur na ci ma rung(blo gsal 'jug ngogs las/) sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan na snyam mo(si tu'i 'grel chen las)lta bu sogs so/ /80

le'u dang bo'i don tshan drug pa/ la sgra/ don tshan drug pa/ la sgra/la sgra mtshams sbyor gzhan 'dren dang / 1nyams dang 'byung khungs ston pa dang / / lhag ma sdud pa rnams la 'jug /la sgra rnam dbye'i phrad gtso bo yin par ma zad/ tshig phrad rkyang ba'ang yin la/ snga ma'i 'jug pa bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /phyi ma'i 'jug pa rgyugs che ba gsham gsal/dang bo/ tshig snga phyi'i mtshams spyor ba la bzhi ste/1 khyad chos mthun pa gnyis mtshams sbyar nas khyad gzhi gang gi rang bzhin nam rnam pa mtshon pha/ thag pa sra la grim pa zhig gis tshe tshe rkang lag bkyigs shing bsdams/(g.yag lug ra yag gi gtam rgyud las/)gtam 'jigs la zil che ba/ don bzang la bcud che ba 'ga' dang 'ga' thongs sheg(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/)da rang gnyis gros cha rlengs che la bab brtan pa/ phugs nas mi 'gyod pa gcig byed dgos pa 'dug(sgom chen dang rdza cig las/) dkar mo rgyan zhes bya ba bu mo gzugs mdzes la mi chos pher ba/ dgra 81

bad krod gsal gyed ngag sgron/gnyen gang la'ang chags sdang gi rus thon pa zhig yod pa/ (mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las/) bzhin ras khro gnyer nag la rid pa 'di/ /gzhan gyis shes dogs gdong 'bag gyon pa min/— /g.yar bo'i lang tsho rga bas bcom byas nas/ /mi sdug rang mdog dus su bstan pa yin/ 1(nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam las)lta bu'o/ / —2 khyad chos 'gal ba gnyis mtshams sbyar nas mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan byed pa/kha 'jam la khog rtsub/ mi de nga rgyal che la yon tan gyis dbul ba zhig go / mgo bo che yang lta byed mig ni chung / /dri 'dzin ring la mjug ma thung zhing phra/ /gom stabs dku la bgrod pa shin tu mgyogs/ /stobs ldan glang bo'i bzhon pa mig sngar mdzes/('gal ba'i rgyan te dung dkar bas)lta bu'o/ /3 bya ba gnyis mtshams sbyar nas dus snga phyi'i go rim bstan pa/rta zhon la song tsha ru nyo la slog pa bzo/ khyod shin hūṃ legs par nyon la yid la zungs shig dang / khyod la bstan par bya'o/ /(mdo mdzangs blun las)lta du'o/ /82

le'u dang bo'i don tshan drug pa/ la sgra/ 'a tshig ka gnyis mtshams sbyar nas don bes can zhig bstan pa / — 7yon tan tshar bo slob dka' la/ ‘/shes bzhinas da na nyams phabs/ /chu jigs bsags pas 'geng dka' yang / /dbo na cig ba nyid du 'dzad/ /(chu yi bstan bcos las/) gdang kha'i bya pho 'di la dpe longs la/ /zhogs pa lang ba'i snga ma bu mos mdzod/ /sgo khya'i khye mo 'di la dpe longs la/ /dgung mo nyan ba'i rjes ma bu mos mdzod/ /(snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las/) 1 bstod pas dga' bar mi 'gyur la/ /smad pas mi dgar mi 'gyur zhing 1 /rang gi yon tan legs kan—sa pa/ /—skye bo dam pa'i ba nyid yin/ /(sa skya'i legs bshad lag)lta du sdogs so/ / — gnyis pa/ don gzhan 'dren pa/ pe stag gzig don skred so shes gcan gzan yin la/ gla gnyan shā gtsod sogs sde dwags yin no/ / ḍa ka kha bye cha ta tha dang / /pa pha tsa tsha sha sa ar/ /mgrin pa man gyi sgra med la/ /gzhan rnams de dang ldan pa'o/ / shing bcad nas chod pa las/ bcad pa byed pa'i rtsol ba yin la/ chod pa las —kyi 'gyur ba yin no/ /lta bu rnams so/ / — za ra — 3 ‘rngo 83

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gsum ba/ 'byung khungs ston pa/ — bde skyid la du gu skyes/ zhes pa dper mtshon na/ bu gu skyes zhes 'byung bya'i chos 'di'i 'byung sa'i khungs ni de'i ma bde skyid yin pa la sgras bstan pa'o/ /des na 'di rigs kyi la sgra'i tshab tu byed sgra 'jug mi rung / bde skyid kyis bu gu bskyed zer na/ don skyon du 'gyur te/ khog pa'i bu de nam skye/ dus kyi gzhan dbang yin gyi/ ma yi rang dbang min pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i bde skyid ni bu gu skyed byed kyi byed pa bor mi 'gyur te/ bu gu skye sa'i skye khungs su nges pa/ tshad mas grub pa'o/ / de yang / sdong bo la yal ga skye se/ zhes pa dang gshibs na/ tshig sbyor gyi byem/ ༵ ༵ bhe skyes dī sngon shing /la thog rdo shing gyi ga ༵mig ༵ 'gre rtse la ba san/ mi ༵sgras yal ga rten sa'i gzhi sdong bo yin par bstan pa dang / bu gu skyes pa ma las chad cing so sor bye bas na/ la sgras bu gu 'byung sa'i khungs bde skyid yin par bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin/bla ma la lung mnos/ dge rgan la dpe khrid nyan/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ / rte4

le'u dang bo'i don tshan drug pa/ la sgra/ — ngang bas chu la 'o ma kun pa ltar/ / rang gis dod pa dang du za bar bya/ / (dpe chos rin spungs las)lta du rnams so/ / bzhi ba/ lhag ma bsdus pa1 tshig de'i don gsal bas/ — — tshog gi zla bo lhag ma bshad pa'i dgos pa med par bsdus byung bar ston pa zhig ste/ dper brjod na/ she sgo kha ma 'jogakhyis zos 'gro/ zhe so pa'i tshig 'dis go brda gsal bar 'phrod pas na/ de'i rjes su/ bdag byos sam/ nang du khyer/ lta bu'i tshig grogs lhag ma bshad mi dgos par bsdu ba'i ched du/ sha sgo kha ma 'jog khyis zos 'gro la/ zhes pa ltar tshig mthar la sgra sbyar nas lhag ma bsdus par bstan pa'o/ /la sgra ma sbyar na tshig don de 'dra mi 'byor— ba'i skyon du snang ba'i phyi re ro/ /de bzhin/ ngas kho la bshad yod7/— khyod song dang khos rogs ram bye de la/ brku byed kyin sdod dang —/ khrims la thogs 'gre le / pho nyal ba mang na —don mgo 'chor la/ mo nyal ba mang na las mgo 'chor la/ lta bu sogs so/ /lnga ba/ nyams mtshon pa—/ — pa yid kyi 'gyur ba ste dga' ba'am khro ba sogs rab tu rgyas nas ngag du thon pa'i nyams(nyams 'gyur tshi ka' bo bka'i skabs sags la)sna tshogs 85

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/ mtshon par 'jug pa zhig ste/ skyon gyi nyes dmigs ma rtogs par/ /gol sar yang 'khyor glen pa la/ /zhes pa'i tshig mtha'i la sgras mi sdug pa'i nyams mtshon pa'o/ /de bzhin/ yi ge ma shes rdugs pa la/ sgrung dpe lta 'dod ce re long / rmi lam nang du byung ba'i sa ma de/ /da lta dngo—sa su yod na dga' ba la/ / ('gro ba bzang mo las ) — a zhang gis ni a khu la bu mang bo yod pas rgol ma nus/ gzhan yul mi nged rang la dkar ba rnams ni ma smad tsho snying rje ba la zer/ mi ngu ba mi 'dug(mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las ) gzhan sems bsrung ba'i khral med rang dbang can/ /dri ldan me tog gsar ba'i bcud kyis 'tsho/ /bar snang yangs por bde ba'i snang glus 'khor//yid 'ong sbrang rtsi'i bu 'di skyid pa la/ /(skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan te bod mkhas pas) lta bu sogs rim bzhin mi sdug pa'i nyams dang / sgeg pa'i nyams dang / snying rje ba'i nyams dang / rmad byung gi nyams sogs mtshon pa'o don tshan bdun pa/ 'byung khungs/nas las gnyis ni 'byung khungs dang / /86

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bdun pa/ 'byung khungs/dgar dang sdud pa rnams la 'jug / gzhan yang nas sgra phrad rkyang du/ / mtshams sbyor dag la'ang 'jug pa yod/ / rnam dbye lnga ba nas las gnyis ni 'byung khungs dang / de'i yan lag gi tshul du snang ba'i dgar ba dang / sdud pa dag ston byed yin la/ karma si tu'i sum rtags 'grel chen rga de ltar dgams da la 'jug pa'i sgra 'di rnams kyang 'phrad gzhan ma yin par/ rnam dge lnga ba'i yan lag nyid du shes dgos te/ dgar ba ni gang— las dgar ba'i gzhi de las khyad par du byung ba ltar snang ba dang / sdud pa ka thog —ma gang nas brtsams bde las bsdu rgyu gnas skabs thams cad byung ba dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ 'byung khungs kyi rnam dbye sbyar bar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'byung khungs nyid du smos pas chog go snyam na/'byung khungs la 'jug par bstan pa ni 'byung khungs dngos dang / de dang cha 'dra ba gtso bo rnams sdud pa'i don dang / dgar sdud gsungs pa ni 'byung khungs dngos dang cha mthun pha gnyis ka ma yin yang / tshig sbyor tsam gyis cha mthun dang 'dra rung du yod pa'i phyir/ snga be'i yan lag phal bar gyur pa rnams sdud pa'i don yin pas skyon med da/ /zhes gsungs pa khebs che bas/mkhas pa'i legs bshad dus thong ma /na nas las gnyis ni phrag rang da bar can yin yang don la 'jug tshe/ 87

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gang 'jug gang mi 'jug pa'i khyed par yod de/ gsham gsal gyi don ston tshul las shes par bya 'byung khungs ni gang las 'byung ba'i khungs dang / de las byung ba'i chos gnyis so sor 'byed cing gtso cher 'byung khungs la nye bar byed pa'i rnam dbye ste(gser tog sum rtags las)/ dper na/ rgya mtsho nas nor bu byung / zhes par/ 'byung bya nor bu dang / 'byung khungs rgya mtsho yin par nas zhes pas bstan pa'o/ /de la rigs gnyis te/ dang bo/ 'byung khungs dngos/ chos gang zhig khungs gang las dngos su byung ba'am phyung ba'i khungs spyi tsam pa la las sgra dang khungs zur tsam pa la nas sgras ston pa ste/sa nas sa skyes/ ri rtsa nas chu mig byung / kha nas tshig shor yu ba thung / (sgom chen dang rdza cig las/)thabs mkhas pas rgya mtsho mtha' nas bskor/ /don nor bu rgya mtsho'i gting nab zhe blangs/ /(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/) rang don gzhan don byed snyam gang yin yang / /sems la bsam pa ngag nas smra mi bya/ /ngag nas smras nas ji bzhin 'bad pas sgrubs/ /ma grub bar du yal bar 'dor mi rung / /(bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las)lta bu 88

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bdun pa/ 'byung khungs/rnams lag nas sgras 'byung khungs zur tsam bstan pa/ sa bon las myu gu skyes/ — me tog las dri bsung 'thul/ legs bshad byis pa dag las kyang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs su len/ /dri zhim byung na ri dwags kyi/ /lte ba las kyang gla rtsi len/ /(sa skya'i legs bshad las/) yul gyi bde sdug skyon yon rnams/ /ga cher don med ngag las gsal/ /bden pa'i mi la dri zhing dpyad/ rdan med ngag las don mang rtogs/ /(rgyal bo lugs kyi bstan bcos las)lta bu rnams las las sgras 'byung khungs spyi tsam pa bstan pa'o/ / 'byung khungs dngos ston pa la/ spyir nas las gang rung sbyar chog pa 'dra yang / phra zhib rigs pas gags na/ don— la khyad par yod de/ sa nas rtswa skyes ma/ sa las rtswa skyes mi zer/ sa bon las myu gu skyes la/ sa bon nas myu gu skyes mi zer/ 'di ni brjod bde mi bde tsam gyi don min par/ 'byungakhungs spyi dang rtsar gyi khyad par gtod pa'i phyir te/ 'byung bya myu gu de 'byung khungs sa bon spyi la rag las nas yod pa lta du'i rigs la las sgras ston pa dang / 'byung bya rtswa de 'byung khungs bkar tsam mtsho cha shas shig la rag las nas yod pa lta bu'i rigs la nas sgras ston pa yin/ 'di lugs mkhas

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/chen rnams kyi gsung las gsal te/ rgyal dbang lnga bas rnam 'gyur gyi dpe la/gangs can mkhas pa'i dbang bo shong ston rje/ /'phags yul paṇa chen khrod nas byon pa bzhin/ /sngon med legs par ba shad pa'i —gsung gi tshogs/ /drang srong phur bu'i ngag las blangs pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnas lugs 'di 'byung rmengs cha 'dra ba dang / dgar ba dag la'ang khyab bo/ /gnyis pa/ 'byung khungs cha 'dra ba/'byung khungs dngos min yang / skabs der chos gang zhig gang las byung ba'i 'byung khungs kyi tshul du snang ba zhig yin par ston pa la/ nang gses kyi dbye ba ltar nas las gang 'tshams re 'jug dgos/ lha sa nas 'ongs/ nam mkha' nas phab/ thag pa phra sa nas chad/ rdog pa srab sa nas brdol/ nged gnyis nas sngon chad drang srong chen po don kun grub pa de'i drung nas zab rgu'i gdams ngag thob pa yin kyang / nyams su ni cung zad kyang ma lo po (gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las)lta bu 'byung khungs dang 'dra ba'i zur tsam pa ste/ gnas phyogs sam dngos po'i cha shas shig las chos shig bral ba'am dzal ba ston pa'i rigs la nas sgra 'jug pa/ —rta las lhung / 90

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bdun pa/ 'byung khungs/ stan las lang sa — du ba'i 'jug ldog la ma spongs par shin —tu nyam nga ba'i bya ba las byol zhing gzur nus pha ni dpa3 zhing mdzangs pa'i rtags yin/ — lta bye 'byung khungs dang 'dra ba'i gzhi spyi tsam pa las chos shig byung ba bstan pa'i rigs la las sgra 'jug pa/ du ba las me shes/ — — kha gdangs pa las blo rig — —spyod pa las bsam pa bzang ngan go blo dang ldan na ma smras kyeng 1 /kam 'gyur nyid las bsam pa go /b.lobo'i se'u ma zos kyang na /ka dog nyid las bro ba shes/ /(sa skya'i legs bshad las)lta du 'byung khungs dang 'dra ba'i rkyen zhig las shes pha zhig byung ba bstan pa'i rigs la las sgra —'jug pa/ sum rtags shes pa'i thog nas snyan ngag sogs sbyang / kho dga' ba'i ngang nas gru 'di ltar blangs so/ / — mi la rdo rje seng ges tshong gi sgo na sa nor spel bas sngar las kyang phyug par 'gyur/ (mi la ras pa'i rnam —thar las/) — mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas dpar/ gong rtsa 'dzugs nas thag bcad 4yin/

— brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/de nas dus gzhan zhig la bu mo de phu nu mo gzhan dag dang phrad nas/so so nas khro'i yon tan ci yod smras pa/(mdo mdzangs blun las)lta bu 'byung khungs dang 'dra ba'i byed pa zhig las bya ba zhig byung ba bstan pa'i rigs la nas sgra 'jug pa/ khang ba shing las grub pa/brtson 'grus las yon tan 'byor/ longs spyod yod do cog ngal rtsol las byung ba yikanyi ma 'bum gyi khengs pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /gser sbyangs las grub lha mi'i mchod sdong che/ /srid na rnyed dka'i nor du'i 'phra tshoms kyis/ /spras 'di 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig nyid/ /('byor ba rgya che ba'i rgyan te sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos)lta bu 'byung khungs dang 'dra ba'i rgyu zhig las 'bras bu zhig byung ba bstan pa'i rigs la las sgra 'jug pa sogs rigs bsgres nas shes par bya'o/ / gsum pa/ rigs mthun pa'i dgar ba/rigs mthun pa'i dgar ba ni dgar gzhi rigs mthun pa spyi las dgar bya bye brag pa mchog dman gang rung zhig logs su bkar nas ston pa ste/rta yi nang nas cang shes mchog —— bzhon pa'i gras nas bong du zhan/ 92

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bdun pa/ 'byung khungs/ rgyu skar dbyus nas zla ba gsal/ kyekye ri ga bor kyid nang nga de pho tshur ༵ / byen sho/ sa lto go/༵ ṭwāṃ/ma gnyis bya dang ri dwags kyi/ /khrod nas blo ldan yin no zhes/ /rna ba gnyis kyis sngar nas thos/ /don yang dag yin pa da lan shes/ /(bya sprel gyi gnyam rgyud las)lta bu drug sgra dang 'brel ba'i sde tshan zhig gi nang nas phyi ru bkar ba la nas sgra 'jug pa/kha dog rnams las dkar po nyid mdzes sngo /(pra ti'i sum rtags las/)khang ba mang bo zlos gser tog can de ni dpe kang yin no/ /(thon mi'i zhal lung las/) bzo spo de tsho las kun bzang dang grags pa lag rtsal mkhas/ nas bkar rdo ma ༵ dī sa sgra 'ju ga pa'o/sa/ brga pa btsog—— lta bu thad kar bsdur bzhi ba/ rigs mi mthun ba'i —dgar ba/ rigs mi mthun pa'i dgar ba ni/ 'gal zlar gyur pa'i dngos po zhig mtshungs chos yod pa'i dngos po zhig dang bsdur nas dgar ba la las sgra kho na 'jug pa ste/ —rta las rnga mong— rke 1 mi rkyel skyid ba'i gong ba 'ams/snarang yul sdug pa'i cha kha dro/ mi 'grig 'grig pa'i las ka las/ lha khang la skor ba brgyab ba dga'/ 93

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ (bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/) pad ma rdul mang zla ba 'dzad/ /de dag las kyang khyod kyi bzhin/ /mtshungs pa las kyang khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa smad pa'i dpe ru 'dod/(snyan ngag me long las/) bsod snyoms dgos na/ skye gzugs rma bya las mdzes pa/ gsung ngag khu byug las snyan pa/ thugs rig 'ja' tshon las bkra ba/ sku dbang ri rab las che ba/ myang stod rinang ba'i dpon mo snang sa 'od 'bum bya ba pha gi yin pa de la zhus/ (snang khu 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las)lta bu sogs dang / las sgra'i 'jug tshul 'di'i dod du bas sgra 'jug rung ste/ 'gro ma nus la bas thur la ngal/ /dgra ma thub phyi las nang gi btsog (gru gu go rdzong las/)bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu byung ba'i bsod nams ni/ ri rab lhun po bas dpangs mtho/ rgya mtsho bas gting zab/ nam mkha' bas rgya che'o zhes gsungs so/ /(mdo mdzangs blun las/) —bdag pas gzhan gces/ lta bu sogs go / lnga ba/ sdud pa/yul dang / dus dang / chos dang / grangs sogs mgo gang nas brtsams shing / mtha' gang la thug pa'i bar mtshams gang yod rnams sdud par byed pa la nas sgra 16na 'jug ste/ —94

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bdun pa/cho 'byung khungs/lha sa nas bla brang bar/ rgyal khab gsar ba tshugs kas da thug bar lo ngo sa bdun 'gor song /byis pa 'dis brgya nas stong bar gyi grangs ka brtsi shes/ mgo brtsams kas mjug rdzogs pa'i bar du brtson pa ma btang ngo / /chung ༵ ༵dī ༵la rgya sbonga~X na chod zhi gan dī// /che/ (rnyi ka sprel gyi gtam rgyud lasaXlta/ bu/ sogs so/ / — bcos dang ༵tshung /sa byes/ sgra~X dī der shā bsas pa~X bgyi'o ba/ ra /'dir — rdo ṭwāṃ /sgra lhag bye ga ga / ༷ rte bye bhe bheX// ༷ / ༷/ —༷ / spyibyes/ ༷༷ bye / —bye/ 'as ci byed/ lta bu dang / yang sa cha la la'i kha skad du/ rjes 'jug da'i spo rje sa 'jug la ltar klog pe'i dbang gi so/——da sgra las sgrar 'gyur ba yod de/bsdad das ma 'dug la/ bsdad la ga ma bas grags pa lta du'o/ / —— — 2

brda krod gsal byedang ga sgron / —don tshan brgyad pa/ 'bod sgra/'bod pa'i sgra ni gang zag la/ /go brda rgyag pa'i brda dag yin/ /yid 'gyur ngag tu shar ba'i nyams/ ༄ /mtshon byed brda yang 'bod sgrar 'dod/ /mar ༵nga dī jug pa ༵da rdo/ mar ba / spyi ra rang la/ sa che ༵ ༵lab ༵ dang kye'am kye bye dang / rang dang mnyam pa'i yul la ka ye dang / rang las dman pa'i yul la wa ye'am a bas/ bod bya spyir btang ba la sa rog ces bos mod/ de yang mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /gzhan yang dgra dang mi dga' sa'i skyes pa la kho re dang / skyes med la mo re zhes 'bod pa yod/ sbyor tshul gsham gsal/ — ste mi'i bdag po gzigs su gsol/ ( mi dbang rtogs brjod las1)kye kye ri dwags dang de pho tshur la gson/ ( bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/)grogs po nyon dang ka ye/ ka ye thu gang ‘ka 'gro/ 96

le'u dang bo'i don sa brgyad pa/ 'bod sgra/‘ — li rog khyod su la btsal gyin yod/ — zlo bas mtshams rdo'i mdun na gams pa'i skyes pa ma yengs nyon dang /( rgyal du nor bzang go dam thar las/) — wa khra ma 'gro wa ye/ rte rgod kyi tshig rngon de srog bdag stag dmar dbang btsan gyi mtshang la phog pas/ sprul la tsher lcag brgyab pa bzhin/ rnga —rgyal bzod glags med pa zhig skyes nas/ phulas dung gde phrag la gzar cing / ya/ kho re pho gsar dmar po skya/ los byas tshad bsham bshad kha pho che/ nga dpa' bo tshig gsum 'dra ma yod/ zer nas gru 'di blangs so/ / ( gru gu go rdzong las/)'gong mo bston bshig tshabs chen mo re/ ( ja chang lha mo'i bstan bcos lag/) — — byang lan med tshangs pa me ri des/ — a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo'i gru nyan pa dang / nga rgya4 shin tu 'khrugs te/ ral gri phrag gong du phyar zhing gdong du bud nas/ ya mo re snang chen tshe zad ma/ dus de ring dpa' bo'i gru la nyon/ ( gru gu go rdzong bas) lha bu sogs so/ / nyams mi 'dra ba ston pa'i ngag gi brda sna tshogs kung 'bod sgra yin par 'dod/ de la7 thog mar nyams 'gyur zhes bya ba shes dgos/ nyams 'gyur gnyis su phye ba'i blo yi 'char sgo la 'gyur ba dang / 'gyur ba de lus ngag tu

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron / thon pa'i rnam pa la nyams zer ro/ /de yang snyan ngag spyi don las/ spyir nyams dang 'gyur zhes pa ni/ dga' ba dang khro ba sogs yid kyi kun slong g.yos nas phyi lus ngag tu ma shar ba'i gnas skabs ni 'gyur ba yin la/ de nyid stobs rgyas nas dbugs kyi rgyu ba yang rgyun ldan dang mi 'dra zhing /bzhin 'dzum pa'am khro gnyer bsdus pa lta du lus ngag tu shar ba ni nyams yin no/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / — zlos gar ram snyan ngag gi sgo nas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mtshon par mkhas pa'i sgyu rtsal gal bo che zhig ni/ nyams sna tshogs ji ma ji bzhin du 'don pa'i lus kyi stangs stabs dang / ngag gi brda sbyor la thug yod pas/ sgeg pa dgod pa rmad byung dang / /dpa' ba drag shul 'jigs rung dang / /snying rje dang ni mi sdug pa'o/ /zhes pha rnams la gar ram snyan ngag gi nyams brgyad ces grags/ yid kyi 'gyur ba shugs drag par gyur nas ngag tu thon pa'i nyams sna tshogs pa yod kyang / — ba stan bya ha lam nyams 'di brgyad du bsdu rung ngo / /de la/ dang bo/ sgeg pa'i nyams mtshon ba/ dga' zhing chags pa'i nyams mtshon pa'i 'bod sgra la/ kye kye/ e e/ ma ho/ a ma/ e ma/ a ha ha sogs yod/ 'jug tshul dper na/ 98

le'u dang bo'i don tshad brgyad pa/ 'bod sgra/dga' skyid de ltar yog — — sem〈 mtshor che/( rgya bza' lta ba tu bzhes pha las/) kye kye ngas snyan/ kye kye bka'i na/ ma skrag ma skrag sems kyi dpa' skyed/( gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las/) bhesrin mo'i rgyal mo te had de langs nas/ sa ma 'a di 'dra'i dga' ba la/de ring nga la mkha' 'gro'i sha 'gyed byung /( spu gling g.yul bad kas1 ) — e ma ho mtshungs ga rgyas ba'i sras/ — nyam ho phul byung yod tan gter/ /e ma ho mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /e ma ho sa yi dbang phyug zug /(gzhon yi ma med mags brjod lag) — snapad ma'i phung bor bung ba'i bu/ /shun gun 'phur ba'i lo byung dbyangs/ /tha dad gdangs ‘'gyur de dag ni/ 'a ho skye dgu'i dga' skyed sgra/ /(gnas gsum nges pa ste snyan ngag gi rnam —bshad shegs la sgron mas) lta du'o/ / pa gnyis pa/ dgod ba'i nyams mtshon pa/ pa dga' bar ba tu rgyas pa'i 7nyams mtshon pa'i 'bod sgra la/ ha ha/ te te/ him him sogs yod de/ kho shin tu dga' nas ha ha— bkag ha ha ku re byas so mkhas ba'i dbang/ / — — — —

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /khyed thugs 'gyed che brtan brjid lhun po bzhin/ /tshig gi bser bu phra mos g.yo ma yin/ /shing bal reg pa'i khang bzang ji bzhin no/ / ( dpa' ris rab gsal gyi gsung 'bum las/) mgos na na/ sked pa a tsha tsha/ rkang ba a chu chu/ ci red/ phur ba brdabs nas rta rtod pa red/ yin thal/ lung ba'i phu yi 'dre phrug cigalung mdor bslebs nas ki zhig btab/ ci red/ nyim nyim/ 'phyan btang ba yin thal/ gzhon nu tshos gtam mtshar ba de thos ma thag tu/ ha ha dang te he dgod ma shor ba gcig kyang med do/ /lta bu'o/ / gsum pa/ mad byung gi nyams mtshon pa/ngo mtshar ba nye bar 'phel ba'i nyams mtshon pa'i 'bod sgra la/ kye ma ho/ a le/ a re/ a la la/ e ma/ a mtshar sogs yod de/ — a le sngon 'brog da sgon thang stong 'dir da ni lha'i grong khyer 'phos pa 'dra'o/ /don du 'du'o ka lda lda/ /gnad du 'dril lo lteshaṃ sdo/ /zhes zer bas/ 'dab yangs kyi yid la lhag par 'thad de blo gros mthar phyin pa zhig 100

le'u dang bo'i don sha brgyad pa/ 'bod sgra/skad do/ / (gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las/) sa mtshar byis pa lo dgu can zhig slob grwa chen mor zhugs byung zer/gzhon nu mun pa can gyis bsam pa/ e ma/ mngon par dga' ba'i — gtsug lag khang zhes pa 'di'o/ / ( gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod mas/)khyod kyi grags pa'i phung bo ni/ /dpag nus min yang 'dir shong ba/ /sa skyong srid pa gsum gyi ni/ /gas dag ka pa shin tu yangs/ / ( ngo mtshar phul byung ste bod mkhas pas) lta bu'o/—rwa / bzhi ba/ dpa' ba'i gas mtshon pa/ — rgod geyer che ba'i nyams mtshon pa'i 'bod sgra ngo/ kye ho/ a'u gi ho ma ya sogs yod de/ kye ho 'di 'tshogs kun gyis nyon/ dgras ba la nye/— tshang mas dpa' skyed dang / rgyal kha nga tshor dbang / yang bskyar ma dang gcig 'phen lam nas/ thog rgod dgra la ho ma ya/she gru gu go rdzong las/) —— ci — a nyog rgyags ba'i stong gtam/ sdug khyod 'dras nga 4 'gran pa a'u tsi( gru gu go rdzong las) lta du'o/ / ri —— lnga ba/ drag shul gyi nyam mtshoms 1 kyi — khro ba nye bar 'phel ba'i bam/kun1 pa'i la/ — 101

brda sprod gsal byedang gas / hin/ hi hi dag yod de/ — hin/ khyod khyi rgan gcigs pa'i khum rtags la/ nga ga shin rje 'dzum pa'i gsod rtags 'jog hi nyi/ khyod lta bu nga'i sen mo'i bar gyi shig red/ 'phral ma nyid du yan lag snye bo sa la phob dang dga'/ lta bu'o/ / drug pa/ 'jigs rung gi nyams mtshon pa/ — —bag tsha zhing khum pa'i nyams mtshon pa'i 'bod sgra la/pha pha a tsa ma/ a tse/ a ma ma sogs yod de/shes rab kyi ral gri so gnyis ma/ shes bya'i mkha' la gdengs ches pas/ /rang mgo zas pa a tsa ma/ /rno phyogs gcig yin na chog pa la/ / ( gung thang bstan pa'i sgon mes/) gdon de 'jigs shing skrag ste ha las nas/ pha pha mi la mi la zhes yang yang zer zhing 'jigs pa'i skad du ma shor/ ( mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las/)kyi had kyi hud 'jigs shing skrag pa/ a tsi sa tsi glo bur rkyen ngan/ / ci byed ci byed ma rung 'chi ba/ /'phral du 'di ru bdud po su sleb/ /( gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las) lta bu'o/ / bdun pa/ snying rje'i nyams mtshon pa / mya ngan rgyas pa'i nyams mtshon pa'i 'a bod sgra la/ 102

le'u dang bo'i don— tshan brgyad pa/ 'bod sgra/ kye ma/ kyi hud/ a kha kha/ a ma ma ma/ a tsha(sreg pa la)/ a chu chu(grang ba la) / a yo(na ba la) sogs yod/ lha chos byed par bdag pos gtsug g.yu brgyan/ ka mi chos byed par a nes phrag dog byas/ /pha ma'i drung du bu mo sdod dbang med/ ‘/kye ma kyi hud bu mo sems pa sdug / (snang sa —'od 'bum gyi rnam thar los/) byams brtses skyong ba'i pha ma srog dang bral/ /yul mi gnyen bshes dgra sdes lhag med bcom/ /lhab lhab me lce 'bar ba'i khyim gyi nang / /gson por 'tshig pa'i du phrug kye ma hud/ /(snying rje'i nyams te tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/) byang me gling rgyal bos/ da ni bka' blon de drag3mas gling sdig gis dmar bsad btang bas mi tshad/ rgyal bo sku mched gnyis kyang thar med byas/ da ji ltar bya bsams nas sa ga kha zer/(me gling gas 'gyed las/) — ka — — — yid 'phrog mas 'di bod do/ /ma mas ma 'di 'dra'i sems nyid kyi skyo ba/ pa bsam blo gang nas btang yang 'bral du dzad pa mi da dug ces rgyal bo'i stag dong gi dkar thag nas bzung ste spyan chab bsil/(rgyal byu nor bzang gi rnam bor lag〉 4 — —pa — — kye ma rgas par gyur pa'i —༷ mi bzod pa— 'dil gzigs/ kyi 103

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /hud rgan mos sdug bsngal ni bzod dka'o/ /(gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod las)lta bu'o/ / zhe5brgyad pa/ mi sdug ba'i nyams mtshon pa/sgyugs bro bar smad pa'i nyams mtshon pa'i 'bod sgra la/phe/ nye te/ ha ha/ a ha/ ho ho/ kyi hud sogs yod/phe/ khrel med ma/ ngo tsha med na khyi dang 'dra/ te te nyams rtogs med pa'i sgom chen dgod re bro/ /rang don mi 'khyor gzhan don ya re mtshan/ /(sgom chen dang rdza tsig las/)ha ha kha nas tshig shor yu ba thung /(sgom chen dang rdza cig las/)ho ho rang tshod ma thub ngo re tsha/kyi hud rgan mo mi sdug khro gnyer ma/ /bya byed lugs dang mi mthun ci phyir byed/ /(nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam las/) rang mthong che zhing sngags 'os yon tan phra/ /don med smra ba mang yang legs bshad nyung / /nas tshod rgan yang blo gros ches gzhon pa/ /kyi hud rmongs pa'i 'khrul 'dis su ma bcom/ /('gal ba'i rgyan las rdzas 'gal ba ste zhwa dmar bas/) gong gsal nyams brgyad po so so mtshon byed kyi 'bod sgra du ma re yod pa/ skabs dang bstun nas gang 'os 'jug dgos/ 'bod 'il la'i 'jug 104
le'u dang bo'i don tshan brgyad mo 'bod sgra/ yul mtha' gcig tu ma nge sa te/ 'grel nye ba'i nyams gnyis gsum la 'jug pa'ang yod do// — — — — — — — —— pa — pa —

brda spyod gsal byed ngag sgron / pa byu le'u gnyis pa/ phrad gzhan dbang can bshad pa/don tshan dang bo/ rdzogs tshigago ngo do no bo mo 'o/ /ro lo so to rdzogs tshig ste/ /skabs bab brjod don rdzogs pa tsam/ /ston byed sgra yin thob thang ni/ 1pad drag to dang mtha' med 'o/ / gzhan rnams rjes 'jug rang 'drar sbyar/ /rdzogs tshig gi thob thang ni/ da drag mthar to dang / mtha' rten med pa'i mthar 'o dang / gzhan rnams rjes 'jug rang 'dra'i rjes su sbyar ba yin/ dper na/ phyind to/ /mtho'o/ /mchog go bzang ngo / /— — — —byed do/ /yin no/ /khyab bo/ /lam mo/ /mda' 'o ( mda'o) / /gser ༷ — — — ༷ ro/ /dbul lo/ /phebs so/ /lta bu'o/ / — — —go sogs tshig mthar sbyar bas/ skabs bab kyi brjod don de nyid re 106

le'u gnyis pa'i das na dang bo/ rdzogs tshigazhig rdzogs bar ston pas rdzogs tshig ces dang / rjod byed tshig gang go rjes su slar yong ba'i tshig grogs dag bsdu bar byas pas slab bsdu zhes dang /don de tsam rjod pa'i tshig gi zla bo rnams re zhig sdud par byas pas zla sdud ces grags ga ming gi rnam grangs tsam las don gcig ste/ dper brjod na/ khyim bdag gis gsol ba/— 'di ni bdag gis rtogs pa ma lags kyi/bdag gi mna' sa blo dang ldan pa zhig mchis pa des rtogs so/ /(mdo mdzangs blun las) zhes pa'i tshig mthar so sgra sbyar nas/ sus rtogs pa'i don de 'jogs par bstan pa'o/ /yang na/ bdag gis rtogs pa ma lags gri zhes pā tsam gyis brjod gas tshang bas/ —tshig 'di'i rjes su slar yang tshig grogs sams ga gi zla bo ste/ 1 bdag gi mna' ma blo dang ldan pa zhig mchis pa des rtogs so/ /zhes tshig kha bskangs shum rdzogs tshig sbyar ba de la spar bsdu'am zla sdud ces kyang byas rke bzhin/ mi yi de nyid thob pa gang ka /bdag gzhan phan par brtson pa'o/ /(dre med dris lan rin po—ba phreng ba las/) ( de la brten nas yul de yang 'byor ba rgyas pa/ lo phyugs legs pa/bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa byung ba yin pa ra gda'o/ —/(bya sprel gyi gnyam rgyud las/) tshul khrims ni byang chub tu 'jug pa'i rtsa ba/ zag pha med ba'i mchog107

brda spyod gsal byedang ga sgron /mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde bar 'gro ba'i lam sdo/ /tshul khrims dag pa bsrungs pa'i bsod nams ni tshad med dpag tu med do/ / ( mdo mdzangs blun las/) — drang srong chen po myur mgyogs che/ /'bod do gling dkar grogs la byon/ /mchod do gtor ma skyems phud bzhes/ /rbad do sdang ba'i dgra srog chod/ /bcol lo bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs/ / ( mon gling g.yul 'gyed las/) dkar rdo mkha' la zla ba'i gzugs/ 'dod ldan khrod na na chung gdong / mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sa na/ /chos skyong bzang bo'i snam dpyod mchog / ( yon tan brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed de dbyangs can dgyes gru las/) lta du sogs so/ / bu mo zhig btsas na nor phyugs kyang rgyal bos bzhes par zad na/ gal —te khye'u zhig byung na kho nor bdag dngos yin no snyam du bsams nas/ rgyal bo la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / ( mdo mdzangs blun las/) khyod sngon gzhan dang blo sna mi stun par/ /slob gnyer tsam la sdug rus byas sdo skad/ /da ni ri stongs 'di 'drar grogs med du//sgrub la 'bad kyang su zhig dad par 'gyur/ / ( cha'i rgyan las smad pa'i zol gyis bstod pa ste zhwa dmar bas/) 108

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan dang bo/ rdzogs tshigabacom ldan 'das kyis ngas bltas na 'khor 'di'i nang na sbyin pa rnam bar dag pa ni 'di las 'da' ba med do/ /zhes bka' bstsal to/ /( mdo mdzangs blun las) lta bu rnams kyi rdzogs tshig gi rjes su tshig gzhan byung yang / snga ma'i tshig grogs min pa gsal/ 4gzhan yang / — nges par byed pa'i rdzogs chig tu/ bdag— dang bdag gi ba la yin dang / gzhan dang —gzhan gyi ba la red 'jug pa mang /dper na/ nga yin/ 'di nga tsho'i slob grwa yin/ nga 'gro rgyu yin/khyod tshang gi red/ rteg da7ga 'a tshang gi khyim mtshes kun bde tshang red/kho ya tram̐ rdo/ da/ dī mdo zlo kha ska rdo ༷dī bye dī/ 'i dus gsa~X —ṭwāṃ/de kyi/ rdzogs tshig tu/ ma 'ongs pa la red dang / da lta ba la gi dang / 'das pa la zig 'jig pa mang ste/ nam la rgyu rdod/ kha 'phro tshog gros byas nas thag gcad rgyu —da/ 'gro kha mi nyan ki dpe cha 'don gin yod ki yi ge bskur btang zig chab rom chags bzhag zig rtswa bskams song zig lta bu sogs dang / spyir —dus gsum la red sbyar chog /rgyang mthong gis bltas na rig rgyu( gi) red/ glog brnyan lta gin yod pa red/dpe cha zhig brtsams byung ba red/ rnyi du'o1 pa/ yang / ma rangs pa'am zug za byed po'i rdzogs tshig tu lo sgra sbyor tshul

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /yod de/ rgyu nor gsog sgrub byed pa de/ gsar brje'i don du yin no lo/ /kha gsag ngo srung byed pa de/ /gzhung don kho na yin no zer/ / ( brda sprod blo gsal dga' ston las/)shes rab med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /blun po yon tan mi slob dzwa/ /brtags na shes rab med nyid kyis/ /blun pos 'bad pa lhag par dgos/ /( sa skya'i legs bshad las/) des na mi rtag pa'i chos 'du shes bcos ma ma yin pa zhig rgyud la ma skyes na/ chos zhu lo dang byed lo ji tsam byas kyang / mthar chos dred kyi rgyur 'gyur ba yin/ ( klong chen snying teg gi khrid yig las) lta bu sogs so/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ bdag sgra/pa po ba bo ma mo rnams/ —/ gang ming gi ni ma mtha' na/ /sngar med gsar du sbyar ba na/ / bdag po'i sgra ru shes par bya/ /skyes pa mtshon byed pa po ni/ /110

le'u gnyis pa'i don shaganyis ba/ bdag sgra/ga da ba sa na mar sbyar/ / ba bong 'a ra la dang / / ba mtha' med rnams la 'jug pa yin/ /bud med mtshon byed mas gnyis/ /rang dbang can te ci rigs sbyar1 /bdag sgra ni ming gang rung gi ma mtha' na/ sngar pha po sogs ci rigs sbyar med par/ de rigs gsar du sbyar tshe/ dngos po'am/ bya ba'am/khyad chos gang zhig gang zag gang la yod par gyur pa'i cha nag bdag po'i don can du song bas bdeg sgra zhes bya'o/ /de rnams kyi mtshan gzhi gsham gsal/ dang bo/ dngos ba'i ming tshu sbyar ba/ — 'brog sku mdun/ blun/ ba phyug yi kha lo/ rnying ma/chang / khams/ bla zang sogs la bdag sgra sbyar nas/ 'brog pa/ sku mdun pa/ blun po/ phyug po/ klu ba/ kha lo ba/ rnying ma ba/ chang ma/ khams mo/ bla brang ma/ zhes pa sogs gang zabakag ming du gyur pa dang / dngos po'i ming la mas zhes ba'ang nyung shas shig sbyar chog ste/yig mkhan/ gar mkhan/ gar mkhan ma/ snyan ngag mkhan/ lta du rnams so/ / — pa — 111

— bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming da lta ba la sprur ba/yod pa/ byed pa/ shes pa/ rtsom pa/ smra ba/ rtse ba/ sgo srung ba/zhing 'breg pa/ rta zhon pa/ sprang ba sogs kyi ming mtha' pa ba dag ni ming gi cha shas yin la/ — de tsho'i mtha' mar bdag sgra gsar du sbyar nas/yod pa bo/ byed pa bo shes pa bo/ rtsom pa ba/ smra ba bo/ rtse ba bo/ sgo srung ba bo/ zhing 'greg pa bo/ rta zhon pa bo/ sprang ba ma/ lta bu sogs gang zag ston par gyur to/ / 'di rigs la zhib ma shes dgos sa/ ( 1) bdag sgra ha lam bo sbyar yang / ba sbyar na mi chog pa med pa'ang mang ste/ yod pa bo la yod pa ba dang / shes pa bo la shes pa ba lta bu/ ( 2) gang zag tu sbyar ba'i ming la la'i tsheg bar bsdus chog ste/ byed pa bo la byed— mo dang / yod pa bo la yod po lta bu/ ( 3) las su bya ba'i ming mtha' dang bdag sgra bsdus chog ste/sgo srung ba bo la sgo srung dang / rta zhon pa ba la rta zhon lta bu'o / /( 4) nyams su len pa bo/ lag tu len bra bo lta bu'i la'i don can gyi sgra bsdus na ming mtha' gtsam bdag sgrar gyur te/ nyams len pa/ lag len pa lta bu/ ( 5) si tu'i 'grel chen las/ bdag po'i sgra la pa nyid do/ /zhes pa/ bdag sgra mtha' gcig tu de ltar sbyar na brjod mi bde ba mang mod/ legs cha'ang cung zad mthong ste/ bya ba'i ming shar ba/112

le'u gnyis pa'i don ma gnyis pa/ bdag sgra/—bzo ba/ mdzal ba lta bu sogs kyi ming mtha' ba'i dod du pa sbyar na/ shar pa/ bzo pa/ mjal pa/ lta bu gang zag gi ming du grub par ma zad/tshig sna bsdus pa/ yig gzugs su bya ba'i ming dang / gang zag gi ming gi khyad par yang phyed pa/ ( 6) bdag sgra'i dod du gang zag gi ming sbyar chog ste/ shes mi/ mjal mi/ sgo srung mi lta du/ ( 7) bya ba byang cha can ༄la bdag sgra mkhan zhes pa sbyar chog ste/ 'bri mkhag 'don mkhan/ glu len mkhan/ lta bu sogs so/ / — — — gsum pa/ khrad chos kyi ming gas ba ma dag nyung nyung tsam las phal cher zan ldan sbyar ba/ kun la bdag sgrag 'dra ba can ldan sdo rigs sbyar chog yon tan pa/le lo ba/ dbang chen ka — blo ldan/ stobs ldan/ blo gros dang ldan pa/shes rab can/ brtson 'grus can/ ser sna can/ lta khu sogs te can ldan gnyis po gang zhig gang la yod pa ston pa'i sgo nas bdag zodang — mtshungs kyang / de dag sems can gzhan dang bem po la'ang 'jug ste/ —seng ge la stobs ldan/ ri bongs la blo 1ldan dam rig pa can/ nyi ma la drod gsal zan/ — mes rgyal la stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa zhes sbyar chog pas gabs / —— kha cig gis ma ni nges med skabs dang sbyar/ cho — zhes ma yig gis skyes 113

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron snye —pho mo khyad med la mtshon te/— gong ma/ bla ma/ ja ma/ slob ya/ lta bu sogs dper bkod pa 'thad par ma mthong ste/ tha snyad 'di rigs thog ma nyid nas gang zag gi ming du grub yod pas/ ma ni ming mtha'am ming gi cha shas su grub pa nyed las/ bdag sgra byas nas gsar du sbyar ba ma yin no/ /der ma zad glen pa/ btsan po/ khol bo/ rong ba/ lta bu sogs kyi cha shas phyi ma rnams kyang thog ma nyid nas gang zag gi ming du grub pa'i ming mtha' yin gyi bdag sgra ma yin zhing / pho mo'i zlas bye tshe/ de rigs kyi skyes ma rnams la da gzod glen ga btsan mo/ khol mo/ rong mo zhes bdag sgra gsar du sbyar ba yin no/ / zhar byung dang bo/ ming mabs ming mi gcig pa spel tshul/ming mtha' pa po ba bo ma mo rnams ming spel ba'i nus pa ha cang che ste/bdag sgrar sbyar nas gang zag gi ming gang rung ston par ma zad/ ming gang rigs kyi mthar sbyar na/ don rmi ngo bo gzhan zhig ston pa'i ming du 'gyu ra la/ lcags kyu/ zhes pa yo byad cig gi ming yin mod/ de la ming mtha' ba sbyar nas/— lcags kyu ba zhe na/ ma zhig gi ming du gyur to/ /dpe de bzhin/ — khu byug dang / khu byug bo'i snga mkhya zhig gi ming dang / phyi ma sngo sman zhig gi ming ngo / /shing rta dang / shing rta mo'i snga ma 'drud byed kyi ming dang / phyi ma bya zhig gi ming ngo / /shing par dang / shing dpar 114

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ bdag sgra ma'i snga ma yi ge'am ri mo dpar byed kyi ming dang / phyi ma dpar byung ba'i yig cha'am ri mo'i ming ngo/ /khru gang dang/ khru gang ba'i snga ma grangs tshad kyi ming dang / phyi ma dpe cha sna ring ngam de ring tshad kyi dngos po zhig gi ming yin pa lta bu sogs so/ /des mi tshad/ tshig gang 'tshams kyi mthar sbyar na/ tshig de tsam don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming du bsgyur thub/dper na/ shing 'dom do ba sbom phra mnyam pa khyad par med pa zhig bskur te/ shing 'di'i mgo mjug gang yin la bye brag phye zhig bsgo'o(mdo mdzangs blun las) /zhes pa las/ shing 'dom do ba zer ba ming tsam bstan pa yin/ gal te ming mtha' ba dor na/ tshig tu gyur pa yin no/ /shel gyi mchod rten bang rim bzhi ba cig phyag tu byung ( bka' chems ka khol ma las) zhes pa las/ pa shel gyi mchod rten bang rim bzhi ba zer ba/ ming tsam bstan pa dang / ming mtha' ba dor nas/ shel gyi mchod rten bang rim bzhi zer na/ tshig tu gyur pa yin par/ rigs bsgres nas shes par gyis shig / zhar byung gnyis pa/ mdo dbus skad du ming mtha' pa ba'i sbyor srol spyi gcig sa dang mi gcig sa/rtags kyi 'jug pa'i lugs ltar na/ / ming mtha' pa ba'i thob thang ni/ga da ba sa na mar pa/ / nga 'a ra la mtha' med ba'o/ 1 —115

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /mtha' rten ga da ba sa dang / / na ma drug po'i sbyor srol ni/ /mdo dbus khyad med gcig pa yin/ / rjes 'jug nga 'a ra la dang / /mtha' med rnams la khyad par yod/ / sam skad kun tu ba sbyar cing / /dbus skad bya ba'i ming la ni/ / cha ya khyad med ba sbyar te/ /song ba myur ba spyon 'dor ba/ / don go ba dang dga' ba bzhin/ /dngos por nga la mtha' med gsum/ / cha ya khyad med pa sbyar te/ /bla brang pa dang mchil pa dang / / bye'u mchil pa dang rnga pa bzhin/ /'a ra gnyis por cha la pa/ / ya la ba sbyar dper brjod na/ /red mda' ba dang mda' pa dang / / rgya gar ba dang gar pa bzhin/ /khams skad dbus skad rjes mthun te// pa po ba bo ji bzhin sbyor/ /ming mtha' sbyar ba yul dang bstun/ / mdo dbus skad kyi khyad chos thon//ya ma zung du sbyar ba ni/ / thob thang gang la'ang mi 'byor ro//don tshan gsum pa/ rgyan sdud/kyang yang 'ang gsum rgyan sdud de/ /

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/rgyan sdud/mthun dang mi mthun rgyan gnyis dang / /sdud pa dag la 'jug pa ste/ /ga da ba sa drag mthar kyang / /nga na ma ra la mthar yang /'a dang mtha' med 'ang ngam yang /rgyan sdud kyang yang 'ang gsum gyi thob thang ni/ rjes 'jug ga da ba dang / 'jug yang 'jug sa dang / da drag rnams la kyang thob ste/yag kyang / bzhad kyang / bab rkyang / mdzes kyang / legs kyang /— — — — —byind kyang / thard kyang / 'gyeld kyang / lta bu dang / rjes 'jug nga ༷ ༷ ༷ na ma 'a ra la rnams la yang thob ste/ bzang yang / mngon yang / 'cham — — —yang / dga' yang / shar yang / gsal yang / lta bu dang / rjes 'jug — ༷ ༷ ༷ 'a dang mtha' rten med par 'ang dang / rkang ba skong tshe yang thob ste/ blo'ang ༷༷ mdzangs la dpa' yang che/ lta bu'o/ /༷༷ rgyan sdud kyi nang tshan rgyan zhes pa tshin rgyan te/ tshig mdzes byed kyi rgyan du 'jug pa ma/ mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan sna kha gnyis yod de/ dang bo/ mthun ba'i tshig rgyan/chos mthun pa gnyis gzhi gcig la tshanas mdzes par byed pa ste/ 117

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /dper na/nyi ma'i 'od ni gsal yang gsal/dmar yang dmar la mkhas kyang mkhas/ri dwags gzhan gyis lab gyur na/ /mdzes kyang mdzes la 'dra yang chags/ /(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/) khyed gnyis thugs sems gser dang 'dra/ /gser bzang bo'i kha dog ngoms kyang dgos/ /dgos kyang dgos te byung yang byung / /nged bya sprel tshogs kyi gyod gzhi 'di/ /khyod gnyis kyis sdum pa mdzad zer na/ /mi 'grig pa yang yong don med/ /(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/)nyon dang gna' mi'i gtam dpe la/ /brnyas ches na zhe nag gting nas 'khrug /za ches na sbrang dkar mchin kha na/ /yun ring na bu mo ma la 'khon//zer yang zer la bden kyang bden/ / ( stag gling g.yul 'khrug las) lta bu/tshig gi tha snyad rigs 'dra gnyis nges bya dang nges byed du sbyar ba'i sgo nas/ brjod don gnad du phab cing tshig mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /dpal yang 'bar la yid kyang 'phrog( pra ti'i sum 'grel las/)kha dog mdzes la dbyibs kyang legs/( gsung rab rgya mtsho'i sum rtags las/) bang yang myur la sha yang rgyas/( thon mi'i zhal lung las) / lta bu/ 118

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rgyan sdud/don mthun pa gnyis tshig gcig la sbyar nas/ gser gzhung la mar khus bkang ba bzhin brjod gzhi gang gi yon tan rgyas par btang ba'i sgo nas tshig mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa/ mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan/ don snga phyi mi mthun pa gnyis gzhi gcig la sbyar nas tshig mdzes par byed pa ste/ dper na/mig mthong med kyang rna thos yod/ ( rgyal bu nor bzang gi rnam thar las )tshig la snyan cha mi che yang /don la zab dgu'i ro bcud gda'/ ( gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las/) 1rang 'dod dang ham pa g.yo sgyu gsum/ /'phral lam du 'gro yang phugs mi brtan/ / ( bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/) skad rigs thams cad shes na bzang mod kyang / /rang gi pha skad brjed na ngo tsha yin/ /( bslab bya nor bu'i phreng 4 las )skye bo dam ma rgud gyur kyang / /spyod pa'i khyad par lhag par mdzes / ṭwāṃ gas ka bsha rdo dī dī/rdon sding / /me lce gyen du 'bar bar mthong / / ( sa skya'i 'on te snying stobs mthu rtsal ldan na yadī / /shes rab zab mo'i dpal 119

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /dang mi ldan na/ /'jigs pa med zlas gdong lnga'i dbang bo ni/ /blo ldan ri bong 'phrul gyis bcom zhes thos/ /(gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las) lta bu/ tshig don phan tshun 'gal bar sbyar cing log phyogs nas ngang tshul lam spyod tshul zhig mngon sum du gtod pa'i rgyan du gyur to/ /mi mthun pa'i rgyan la tshig grogs kyang sbyar rgyu yod de/ yin na yang /'on kyang / lta bu dag dang / mi mthun pa gsal byed kyi phrad kyang yod de/'on te/ 'on tang / mod rnams so/ /sdud pa ni bsdu bar bya ba zhig dngos su bstan tshe/ bsdu bya dang sdud byed gnyis ka tshig snga phyir brjod pa yin zhing / shugs la bstan tshe/ bsdu rgyu'i tshig grogs bsdus nas/ sdud byed kyi tshig tsam brjod pas chog pa yin te/ dper brjod na/ khos rgya yig kyang shes/ zhes pa na/ sdud byed kyi tshig tu kyang sgra sbyar nas/ bsdu bya bod yig 'dra shes pa bsdus pa'i don can du grub mod/ gal te bsdu bya gsal bar byed pa'i dgos pa yod na/khos bod yig shes la/ rgya yig kyang shes zer ba ltar/ sdud byed kyi tshig grogs su bsdu bya bod yig shes pa lta bu brjod pa'o/ /'di la rigs gsum yod de/ /dang bo/ phan tshun sdud pa/dpe cha 'di chab srid kyi bslab deb kyang yin/ skad yig gi bslab deb 120

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rgyan sdud/kyang yin/ khong ni nga tsho'i slob grwa'i mgo 'dren yang yin la/ bod yig dge rgan yang yin/ khyod 'gro dgos dang / zla ba'ang 'gro dgos/ lta bu rnams bsdu bya dang sdud byed gnyis stobs mnyam pas/ ‘ tshig snga phyi'i go rim brjes nas phar sdud tshur sdud byas chogaganyis pa/ snga mas pyi ma sdud pa1blun pos kyang shes na mkhas pa lta ci smos/mi dmangs kyi don du srog kyang sdo phod na/ dka' tshegs 'dzem ga la dpe/ rang skyon mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang/ skyon du go ba shin tu dka'/mi de rang gi grib ma la'ang yid mi ches/ sa ma yang nga bu gcig pu la sems 'phreng bas/ nged rnams mthong mthong gi bar du/ nga la mig ce re ngu zhing bsdad 'dug(mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las) lta du rnams las snga ma gsum du bsdu bya dngos su bstan pa dang / phyi ma gnyis su bsdu bya shugs la bstan pa'o//gsum pa/ pyi mas snga ma sdud pa/sum rtags ma zad/ snyan ngag kyang shes/

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron /—rta yis brgal dka'i chu bo yang / /mang du gyes na lug kyang thub/ /dbyangs can khyod zhal mtshar sdug ldan po yis/ /chu skyes pad ma'i rjes su 'gro min te/ /mig ldan kun yid 'phrog pa'i 'dzum mdangs dang / /zhim po'i dri bsung phyogs bcur 'thul 'dis kyang / /(bsdus pa'i dpe ste paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis/) kho ri mo bris na'ang mkhas/nged spre'u sdod pa'i gnas la yang / /khyod bya tshogs yong dang yong bzhin yod/ /lta bu rnams las tshig snga ma gsum du bsdu bya dngos su bstan pa dang / phyi ma gnyis su bsdu bya shugs la bstan pha'o/ /gzhan yang / yang sgra kyang 'ang gnyis dang mi mthun par don gzhan ston par 'jug pa'ang yod de/kho de ring yong la/ yang na sang nyin yong ngo dper brjod 'di yang na las su bya ba'i yin/ yang na dgos ched kyi yin/ lta bu rnams na sgra dang bsdebs nas gdam nga'i don du 'jug pa/nam yang / de yang / slar yang / de nas yang / da thengs yang rgyal kha lon song / bsam blo yang yang btang / don de go sla bas yang dang yang du bshad mi dgos/ lta bu rnams bskyar ba'i don du 'jug pa'o/ /

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ lhag bcas/ — don tshan bzhi ba/ lhag bcas/de te ste gsum lhag bcas te/ /na ra la sa drag mthar te/ /da de ga nga ba ma 'a /mtha' med rnams la sa ste thob/ /mtshams sbyor dam bca' gzhan 'dren dang / /'gal ba rnams la 'jug pa'o/ / lhag bcas de te ste gsum gyi thob thang ni/ rjes 'jug da mthar de dang / na ra la sa da drag gi mthar te dang / ga nga ba ma 'a dang mtha' med rnams kyi mthar ste thob ste/ bshad de/ yin te1 'dar te/— — —gsal te/ byas te/ bsgyurd te/ bzhag ste/ bzang ste/ khyab ste/— — — — — —bgam ste/ 'ba' ste/ go ste/ lta bu sogs so/ /༷ — ༷ lhag bcas ni tshig snga ma'i brjod don ma rdzogs pa'i lhag ma dang bcas pa drangs nas don cha tshang zhig ston par byed pa'i sgra'o/ /de yang lhag ma 'dren tshul rnam pa bzhi yod de/123

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /dang bo/ mtshams spyor ba'i lhag bcas/bya ba snga ma'i 'phror yang bya ba zhig mtshams sbyar nas de dag phan tshun gyi 'grel chags lugs nges can zhig ston pa/ja bskol te 'khol/ chang 'thungs te bzi/ pas bon btab ste myu gu skye/bya ba 'bad pas bsgrubs te phun sum tshogs par grub song / lta bu sogs byed pa'i rtsol ba dang las kyi 'gyur ba gnyis dus rim par 'jug par mtshams sbyar nas/ rgyu gang las 'bras du gang byung bar bstan pa'o/ /lag pa bsnyal te zas za/sgron me bkar te dpe cha lta/'dang yang yang brgyab ste dpyad pa/bya ba che chung gang byed kyang / /mkhas pas rtag —tu bsgrims te bya/ /( sa skya'i legs bshad las) lta bu rnams byed pas bya ba gnyis dus rim gyis 'jug par mtshams sbyar nas/ mthun rkyen gang la brten nas don gang gnyer bar bstan pa'o/ / gshog pa brkyangs te 'phur/tsheg sgra deng bcas te 'bar/ 124

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ lhag bcas/mtshar skyes te ha ha bgod/mig ches cher bgrad de zhib tu bltas/ lta bu sogs bya ba gnyis ha lam dus mnyam par 'jug par mtshams sbyar nas sgrub byed gcig par bstan pa'o/ /gong gsal mtshams spyor ba'i lhag bcas kyi tshab tu nas sgra 'jug pa mang ste/ ja bskol nas 'khol/ 'dang brgyab nas bshad/ me tog gad nas 'bras bu thogs/ lta bu sogs so/ /gnyis pa/ dam btsa' ba'i lhag bcas/tshig snga ma'i don gsal byed du tshig phyi ma drangs nas shes bya'i gnas nges pa zhig ston pa ste/ mi rtag ste byas pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dper mtshon na/ mi rtag pa yin par dam bcas nas de'i rgyu mtshan byas pa yin par ste sgras bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ me yod de du ba yong ba'i phyir/spyod pa bzang ste gzhung drang zhing blo gsal ba'i rtags so/ /dga' bar rigs te rgyal kha lon pas so/ /lta du rnams rgyu mtshan 'dren pa'o/ /tshig rgyan te tshig mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan no/ /dpe chos te dpe'i sgo nas brjod bya'i chos kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i 126

bad sprod gsol byed ngag sgron /ngag rgyun zhig go /sangs rgyas te ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs pa dang shes bya la blo gros rgyas pa'o/ / ( smra sgo mtshon cha las) lta bu rnams nges tshig 'dren pa'o/ / 'byung ba bzhi ste sa chu me rlung ngo / /'dod yon lnga bye gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya'o/ / rig gnas che ba lnga ste/ sgra dang tshad ma dang bzo dang gso ba dang nang don rig pa'o/ /lta bu rnams dbye ba 'dren pa'o/ /nyi ma la 'jig rten mig ces bya ste/ 'od stong can nam/ snang ba'i mdzod dam/ mun pa'i dgra yang zer ro/ /go la sogs pa rdzogs tshig ste/ slar bsdu zla sdud ces kyang bya/ nyi ma'i gnyen ni pad ma ste/ dri bzang khang yang de yin no/ /lta du rnams ming gi rnam grangs 'dren pa'o/ / blun pos bsam par/ ka ye thabs bzang bo zhig gda' ste/ tsan dan sol bar btang nas 'tshong dgos phar 'dug snyam nas/ tsan dan mer bsregs te sol bar btang / ( dge ldan legs bshad kyi 'grel ba las )dge rgan bskyang rgyu gal che ste/ 'gyur bzhi bskrun par mi sna dgos/mi sna bskyang bar slob gso dgos/ slob gso bsgrub par dge rgan dgos/nga rgyal rang nyid nyams byed de/ /thos lam 'gog cing grogs dang 1 26

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ lhag bcas/'gal/ /byur sna 'dren la 'gran zla bslang / /nyes dmigs mang bas tshar du chod/ /lta bu rgyas bshad 'dren pa'o/ / dud 'gro ni —dud nas 'gro ba ste/ rta nor lug gsum la sogs pa'o/ /'gros mgyogs te rlung las myur/ skyes sman de mgo bo yang la khog pa dog ste/ dkar lhab nag 'tshub ston kha'i gnam ngo 'dra'o/ / bzhin ras mdzes te/ chu skyes gsar ba'i dpal 'phrog cing / zla ba la'ang skyengs pa ster/ lta bu dpe 'dren pa'o/ / gsum pa/ gzhan 'dren pa'i lhag bcas/rjod byed snga ma'i 'phror brjod bya gzhan zhig drangs nas/ tshig snga phyi'i don tha dad par ston pa ste/ 'di ni ra gan te 'di ni gser ro/ /khyi rgan 'dzum na dga' rtags lte/ /gshin rje 'dzum na gsod pa'i rtags/ / g.yi dkar ni ri dwags min te gcan gzan no/ /lta bu rnams so/ /bzhi ba/ 'gal ba 'dren di'i lhag bcag/brjod bya snga ma'i 'phror brjod bya log pa zhig drangs nas tshig snga 127

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /phyi'i don 'gal bar ston pa ste/kha bshig pa sla ste las pa dka'/ /gos dral ba sla ste drub pa dka'/ /sgyud g.yo ba sla ste bsdum pa dka'// ( gru gu go rdzong las/) skyid zer ba dpon po'i lag na yod/ /nga nyo bsam yod de nyo thabs med/ /sdug zer ba g.yog po'i mgo na yod/ /nga btsong bsam yod dī btsong thabs med/ /skyon gyis gos pa ches sla ste/ /yon tan slob pa de lta min/ /shing la me lce mched sla yang / chu bo 6 sor 'byed pa dka'/ / ( shing gi bstan bcos las) lta bu sogs so/ / gzhan yang / lhag bcas kyi sgra bya ba la 'jug tshe/ bya ba de'i ming mtha' pha ba dag sbyor mi sbyor gyi khyad par shes rgyu gal che/ dper na/ shog bu ras la brdzus pa ste/ /ma yin yin mdog byas pa'i dpe'o/ /zhes dang /shog bu ras la brdzus te/ /gon pa e nyan lta gi /zhes pha'i tshig gnyis kyi lhag bcas kyi don ston tshul mi gcig snga ma bya ba ming mtha' can la sbyar nas dam bcas pa dang / phyi ma bya ba ming mtha' med pa ba la sbyar nas mtshams sbyar ba yin no/ /

le'u gnyis pa'i don sa lnga ba/ khud sdud/— don tshan lnga ba/ 'byed sdud/gam ngam dam nam bam mam 'am/ /ram lam sam tam mas de/ / 5da drag tam dang mtha' med 'am/ / gzhan rnams ming mtha'i rjes mthun sbyor/ /'byed pa sdud pa the tshom dang / /dri ba gdam nga noms la 'ju ga /'byed sdud kyi thob thang ni/ mtha' rten dang mthun par sbyar ba/gcig gam/ rung ngam/ med dam/ yin nam/ 'thab bam bsam ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ —mam/ zer ram/ yul lam/ shes sam/ lta du dang / rjes 'jug — ༷ ༷ ༷ 'a dngos su bris yod med la 'am thob ste/ /kha skong ba'i tshe bar tsheg 'jug pa dang / skong mi dgos na bar tsheg mi 'jug ste/ dga' 'am/ go 'am/dga'am/ go'am/ lta du dang / yang 'jug da'i ma thar tam tho ba ste/zind / gas sgyurd tam/ phrald / lta du sogs so/ /don gyi sbyor tshul la 'byed pa dang / sdud pa dang 1 the tshom dang /129

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron /dri ba dang / gdam nga lnga yod de/dang bo/ 'byed pa/dbye gzhi gcig las dbye ba du ma so sor 'byed pa ste/ dper na/dus tshigs bzhi ste/ dbyar ram/ ston nam/ dgun na ma/ dpyid do/ /zhes pa na/ dbye gzhi dus tshigs bzhi las/ dbye ba dbyar ston dgun dpyid rnams ram dang nam dag gis so sor phye ba/ lta bu'o/ /de bzhin/dug gsum ni 'dod chags sam/ zhe sdang ngam/ gti mug go /mkhan slob chos gsum ni/ mkhan po bo rnyi sa twa 'am/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sam/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan no/ /rton pa bzhi dang mi rton pa bzhi ste/ chos la rton pa dang gang zag la mi rton pa'am/ don la rton pa dang tshig ya mi rton pa'am/ nges don la rton pa dang drang don la mi rton pa'am/ ye shes la rton pa dang rnam shes la mi rton pa'o/ /lta bu rnams dbye ba'i rnam grangs nges pa yod tshul lo/ /slob ma'i nyer mkho ni sgyu gu'am/ snag tsha'am/ shog gu rnams so/ /rang re'i slob grwa na mi rigs mang ste/ rgya'am bod dam/ sog po'am/ yu gur ram/ te he sogs bcu lhag cig yod do/ /legs par shes na 'di lta ste/ 'chad dam rtsod pa'am rtsom la mkhas/lta bu rnams dbye ba'i rnam grangs nges pa med tshul lo 130

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ 'byed sdud/gnyis pa/ sdud pa/bsdu bya du ma bsdu gzhi gcig tu sdud pa ste/ dper na/ srong btsan sgam po'am/ khri srong lde btsan nam/ mnga' bdag khri ral ba can ni chos rgyal mes dbon rnams gsum mo/ /zhes pa'i bsdu bya srong btsan/ khri srong /mnga' bdag bcas 'am dang nam sgra dag gis chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum zhes pa'i bsdu gzhi gcig tu bsdus pa dang / de bzhin/deng rabs can du 'gyur bar kha gtad pa'am/ 'jig rten khams la kha gtad pa'am/ ma 'ongs par kha gtad pa ni/ slob gso bya ba'i gtad so gsum mo/ /snyan ngag gam/ mngon brjod dam/ sdeb sbyor ram/ zlos gar ram/skar rtsis rnams5 rig gnas chung ba lnga'o/ /lta bu bsdu bya'i rnam grangs nges pa yod tshul lo/ / chu skyar ram ne tso ni 'dab chags so/ / gser ram/ dngul lam/ zangs sam/ lcags sam/ rdo sol sogs ni gter rdzas yin/ming gzhi gnyis sam gsum 'drel lam/ /de la dbyangs kyi gzhi ldan yang / /gang du 'ang 'jug min sbyar ba 'ang min/ / ( sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las) lta bu bsdu bya'i rnam grangs nges pa med tshul lo/ / 131

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /mu tig ni rin thang che ste/ mu men nashaṃ byu ru yang ngo / /thang dkar ni bya yin la/ khā ta'am skya ga sogs kyang bya yin/ lta bu snga mar sbyar ba'i chos phyi mar sbyar ba bsdus pa'o/ /gsum pa/ the tshom/yin min mtha' gnyis ma nges par dogs pa za bar ston pa ste/ci 'di ljon pa'i skyed mos tshal la gnas pa'i lha mo zhig kam/ mi'i du mo khyad par du mdzes pa zhig yin snyam the tshom du gyur/ ( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las/)a ma lan gcig shi nas slar log pa/ /'di ni mi lam yin nam mngon sum yin/ /mi lam yin na du chung snang ba skyo/ /mngon sum yin na bu chung los kyang dga'/ / ( snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las )dkar mdzes chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i dum bu la/ /rnam bkra dbang gzhu gsar bas 'khyud dam ci/ 'on tang smra ba'i lha mo khyed kyi skur/ /sna tshogs dar gyis bklubs sam 'phyang mo nyug /( je tshom gyi dpe ste dbyangs can dgyes glu las/) 'grig gam mi 'grig brdar sha mi chod/ lta bu sogs so/ / bzhi ba/ dri ba/ brjod bya'i don gsal byed du dri bar 'jug pa ste/132

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ 'byed sdud/don dag de thag chod dam/ pha mas bu mo ma mjal yun ring song / /bu mo snang sa sku khams bde lags sam/ / ( snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las/) sang nyin khyod 'gro rgyu'am mi 'gro/rgyal bos smras pa/ rten la sha gzhan zhig sbyin na za'am/ khras smras pa/ bdag ni gsar du bkum pa'i sha rlon pa mchis na 'tshal lo zhes smras pa/ ( mdo mdzangs blun las) lta bu ma shes pa dris pa/ri mgo lnga na mtsho zhig 'dug zer ba shes sam/ da lta bshad zin pa go'am ma gong yi rigs rgyud grags pa bsam grub de/ /phyi yi lcags ri nang gi nor bu yin/ /pho lo drug gsum bco brgyad bslebs nas yod/ /khyod kyis de yi khyim thab mi byed dam/ /( snang sa 'od 'dum gyi rnam thar las) lta du tshod bgam par dris pa'o/ /khyod bud yong ngam/ nyin gung nyi mas gdungs pa yi/ /glang bo dag ni mtshor 'jug pa/ /nyi ma'i phyogs gyur pad mo rnams/ /gzhom par 'dod pa yin nam snyam/ /( sems ldan rab rtog ste snyan ngag me long las) lta bu shes ba zhin du dris pa'o1 / 133

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /kha nas thon tshad lab na 'thus yong ngam/ /sems la gang shar lag len 'thus yong ngam/ / ( sgom chen dang rdza cig las/) rigs gzugs lang tsho ldan na yang / /yon tan pa 5med na mdzes ma yin//rma bya spu sdug yid 'ong yang / /chen po'i rgyan du 'os sam ci/ / ( sa skya'i legs bshad las/) gal te mongs pa la la dag de'i tshul ma shes pas log par rtog na yang/ngas gshin rje'i gshed ma 'dra ba'i dpung gi tshogs mngags te/ tshar bcad na mi 'jigs sam/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gtam gyi dril rngams po che rab tu bsgrags/ ( mi dbang rtogs brjod las) lta du khong slong du dris pa'o/ /gong gsal/ dogs gzhi dri ba la mtha' gnyis po cha mnyam par dogs na/ mtha' gnyis ka bkod nas yin nam min zhes pa lta bur sbyar ba dang /mtha' gcig shas che bar phyogs pa la mtha' de tsam bkod nas yin nam/yang na min nam zhes pa 'dra sbyar ba'o/ / gzhan yang dri ba la e sgra yang 'jug pa mang ste/di khyod kyis shes sam zhes pa la/ khyod kyis e shes zhes dris pa lta du'o/ /am skad du dri ba la ne zhes pa'i sgra 'jug pa khyab che/ dper na/ khyod yong ne/ don dag de blo bzang gis mi shes ne/ lta bu'o/ / 134

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ 'byed sdud/lnga ba/ gdam nga /gdam bya gnyis sam du ma las gang rung zhig bdams nas nges par byed pa ste/ yon tan kun rdzogs skye bo bsten/ /yang na tha mal 'grogs pa bde/ /dum pa chu yis gang ba 'am/ /yang na stong ba khur ba sla/ / ( sa skya'i legs bshad las/) kha btags g.yogs pa de ske la kun nas re zhig ri mor bris pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar g.yo 'gul med paXm/ dgun gyi khu byug bzhin du smra ba snad par yud tsam gnas/ ( rdo ring paṇa ṭi ta'i rnam thar las/ )khyod rang dbang ba'i nor gsor se ba gcig gam/ nas phul gang ngam/mar nyag gcig gam/ gos dar rkyang sna gcig dud 'gro tshe 'dzugs gcig kyang mig spes ma mthong / ( mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las/) mig rig rig por lta zhing / 'di ni mngon gyem snang ba'am/ mi lam mam/ sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor ram/ mig shes 'phrul ba gang las byeng snyam du rtog par byed pa las/ mngon sum gyi dga' ba nyams su myong bar rig nas yid la ngo mtshar rgya cher gyur/ ( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las) lta bu sogs so/ / gong gsal gyi the tshom dang dri ba dang gdam nga gsum ni 'byed pa'i 136

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron /khongs su gtogs pa'o//don tshan drug pa/ mnyam sbyor/cing zhing shing gsum mnyam sbyor te/ /ga da ba dang da drag cing / / nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /mtha' med zhing dang sa mthar shing / /khyad chos mnyam par sbyor ba dang / /bya ba dus mnyam sbyor ba 'o/ /mnyam sbyor gyi sgra cing zhing shing gsum gyi thob thang ni/ rjes 'jug ga da ba dang yang 'jug da'i rjes su cing thob ste/ drag cing / 'dod cing /— —'thab cing / bsgyur cing/ lta bu dang / rjes 'jug nga na ma 'a ra la dang /༷༷ ༷ mtha' rten med mthar zhing thob ste/ bzang zhing / yin zhing / 'jam — — —zhing / dga' zhing / 'bar zhing / 'gyel zhing / bde zhing / lta bu dang /༷༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ 'jug yang 'jug sa la shing thob ste/ shes shing / yangs shing / lta bu ༷ ༷ sogs so/ / cing zhing shing gsum don sbyor tshul gnyis yod de/ 136

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan drug pa/ mnyam sbyor/dang bo/ khrad chos mnyam bar sbyor ba/khyad chos gnyis mnyam du sbyar nas khyad gzhi gang gi rang bzhin nam rnam 'gyur zhig mtshon par byed pa ste/ nga tsho'i 'tsho ba bde zhing skyid/snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i tshig gis gdas par gsol bas/ rgyal bo zla ba'i blo gros yab sras ni tshig de dag bden par bzung ste dga' zhing mgu( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las/)mchu ni dmar zhing gug pa dang / /gshog pa ljang zhing mnyen pa 1 dang / /mgrin pa kha dog sum phreng can/ /ne tso 'di dag tshig 'jam ldan/ / ( rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan te snyan ngag me long las )sked pa phra zhing ro smad sbom/ /mchu dmar mig ni dkar ba min/ /lte ba dma' zhing nu ma mtho/ /dud med lus kyis su ma bcom/ /( 'gal ba'i rgyan las rdzas 'gal ba ste snyan ngag me long las) lta bu sogs so/ /gnyis pa/ bya ba dus mnyam par spyor ba/ /gcig bya ba gnyis dus mnyam par sbyar nas byed pa bo gcig yin par mtshon pa ste/mgo bo gug gug byas shing bzang ngo zer/ rgan pos rta bong gi sbangs/ ba lang gi lci ba/ khyi lud rnams 137

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /'thu zhing 'ong /(mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las )dri bral rab dkar mdzes pa'i gzi byin chags/ /dal gyis g.yo zhing bgrod pa'i cha lugs can/ /bltas pas mi ngoms snying gi dum bu khyod/ /ston kha'i sprin gyi phung bor lan brgyar 'gran/ /( sbyar ba'i dpe ste snyan ngag spyi don las/) mchu sgros u dum wa ra'i 'dab ma'i dbus/ /srab 'jam ro 'dzin glog dmar rab 'khyug cing / /ma 'dres rnam par gsal ba'i spyan gyi 'ja'/ /smin ma'i nags klung stug po'i khrod na g.yo/ /(mi ldan pa'am mi 'os pa'i gzugs can te rgyal dbang lnga bas) lta bu'o/ /gnyis/ bya ba gnyis dus mnyam par sbyar nas so so'i 'byung gzhi gcig par mtshon pa ste/'khor la byams pas snyoms khyab na/ /'khor rnams 'du zhing don kun 'grub/ /( rgyal bo lugs kyi bstan bcos las )ya rabs rnams la bstod rgyab zhing / /ma rabs rnams kyi mgo 'phang —smad/ /de ltar legs nyes shan 'byed pa'i/ /mi bdag gang na yod pa der/ /skye bo ya rabs dga' 'gyur zhing / /ma rabs rnams kyang bag yod 'gyur/ /(gong dang gcig)lo 'ga' lon nas blta ru phyin pa'i tshe/ /de las mi min sprel min bzhi 138
