le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan drug pa/ mnyam sbyor/brgyar 'phel/ /shing thog zad cing bkres pas 'thab cing rtsod/ yi dwags lta bu snying rje'i gnas su mthong / / ( mkhas pa'i dga' ston las) lta bu'o/ /gsum/ bya ba gnyis dus mnyam phar sbyar nas/ snga rkyen phyis 'byung mtshon pa ste/ mda' 'phangs shing phog ras gshags shing shogs/ skyin thang drag shul byung ba na/ skyes pa'i rtswa ljang snyol zhing 'gro 'greng ba'i rkang spugs gcog cing 'gro bkod pa'i yal 'dab gcod cing 'gro smin pa'i 'bras su gtor zhing 'gro rgyas pa'i me tog brlag cing 'gro( gtam phad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las) lta bu'o/ / bzhi/ bya ba gnyis dus mnyam par tshig ka gnyis la sbyar nas/ don nam gnas tshul zhig gsal bar mtshon pa ste/dregs pas yon tan nyams 'gyur zhing / /'dod pas ngo tsha nyams par byed/ / ( sa skya'i legs bshad las/)mun pa shin tu stug pos rang gi gzugs kyang mi mthong zhing / sdod gnas kyi shing sdong gi yal ga rnams rlung gis bskyod cing sprugs pas sa la 1—lhung la khad lhung la khad la/ shing gi yal ga gcig la sbar 'then byas te 139

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /—gnas so/ /(bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las/)rlung dmar gyi gseb nas ser ba tha ra ra 'bebs shing / steng gi nam mkha' nas 'brug sgra 'u ru ru bsgrogs te/ glog dmar gyi zhags pa bar snang la 'tshub 'tshub 'khyugs byung bas/ ( gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las)lta bu'o/ / lnga/ bya ba gnyis dus mnyam par sbyar nas byed yun ring tsam mtshon pa ste/ glu len zhing 'dugadape cha brtes shing bsdad do/ /blon po gzhan dag kyang rgyu mtshan de rnams thos pas ma dga' ste/ yid la zug rngu bskyed par gyur na'ang / legs nyes dpyod pa'i blo gros ma thon te/ thabs tshul ji lta bu zhig bzang ngam snyam ste som nyi'i dra bar chud cing gnas/ ( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las) lta bu sogs so/ / yang / bya ba byed yun ring tsam mtshon pa'i rigs kyi da lta ba la kyin gyin gin yin bzhi dang bzhin sgra dang / 'das kyang ma 'gags pa la nas sgra dang / lhag bcas sbyar ba mang / dper na/ 'tsho ba bde bzhin mchis/ glog brnyan lta yin yod/ ja 'thung gin 'dug ri mo bris nas bsdad snang / mgron po dang zhal brda gnangs te bzhugs so/ /lta du 'o/ / 140

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bdun pa/ 'dren sgra/don tshan bdun pa/ 'dren sgra/ —ces zhes gnyis ni 'dren sgra ste/ /ga da ba dang da drag ces/ /nga na ma 'a ra la sa/ /mtha' med rnams la zhes sbyar nas/ /lung dang don gzhan 'dren pa dang / /rjod byed sgra 'am ming dang tshig /gang gi gsal byed 'dren pa'o/ / ces zhes gnyis kyi thob thang / rjes 'jug ga da ba dang da drag gi mthar ces thob ste/ shog ces/ yod ces/ rgyal khab ces/ phar — — —phyind ces/ lta du dang / rjes 'jug nga na ma 'a ra la mtha' med rnams la —zhes thob ste/ 'jang zhes/ yin zhes/ khyim zhes/ dka' zhes/ 'bar — — — —zhes/ yul zhes/ dro zhes/ lta du dang / 'jug yang 'jug sa'i mthar — — —gna' dus su thob thang ltar shes sbyar kyang / go ba'i don du 'khrul sla bar gzigs nas mkhas pa phyi ma rnams kyi se dmigs bsal du zhes sbyar ba'o/ /don la 'jug pa gsum yod de/ 141

brda sprod gas4 byed ngag sgron 1 dang bo/ lung 'dren pa/gtam mam rtsom du bstan bcos gzhan las tshig rtsa ba can lung du drangs nas brjod bya'i don nges par byed pa dang / yang na/ mkhas chen dag gi tshig don can nam/ yongs grags kyi gtam dpe'am/ dpe chos sam/ legs bshad sogs drangs nas smra ba'i nus pa ji cher gtong ba ste/zhing du chu 'dren pa ni/ dgos ched kyi dper brjod yin te/ si tu'i 'grel chen las/ bya ba gang zhig gis bya ba'i yul de'am/ de dang 'drel ba'i las la phan 'dogs par 'gyur ba'i don gyi ched du bya ba'i yul la 'jug pa rnam dbye bzhi ba zhes pas gsal/ sngon rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la/ bod khams su 'khrug long rkun jag med par yul skyid dus bde bas/ rgan mo gser khur 'joms mkhan med ces grags/ rdzud pa lam thur la bdezhesas pa ltar/ ngan lob kha sla bas/ byis pa dag la bsam pa yar sems dang / skud pa yar 'khel bslab rgyu gal che/rang mthong che ba'i rtsa ba nga rgyal yin/ rgyal bo lugs kyi bstan bcos ༵ ༵/thoX do/ da dre/ gas rdo ༵ ṭwāṃ ni ༵ na mi ma /thong //dmus/ ༷dag ltas ni de ga bheX 142

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bdun pa/ 'dren sgra/ mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs par soms bshad pa mi bden spyod pa bden/ /ngus pa mi bden mchi ma bden/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshig la de 'dra ma rton don la rton rgyu gal che/ lta du sogs so/ /gnyis ba/ don gzhan 'dren pa/ming ngam tshig gi shul du nan tan nam/ dpe'am/ zur za sogs don khyad par can zhig drangs ga ste/lo'u zhun chung dus/ thengs gcig dpe khrid mnyan du yong ba 'phyis pas/ dge rgan gyis bka' bkyon tsam gnangs/ khos 'gyod bshags su —mdun 'jog gi ngos la snga zhes yi ge re brkos pa/ de nas kho rang rgyun du snga ba gsum gyi sngon mar sleb par byas so/ /mtsho mo pha rol —gyi nags tshal na/ le nyin mchog gi g.yu yi las khang zhes pa yod/ de'i klad ni sa sngon dang / gzhi ne'u gsing yin/ yu tho zhig ni khong gi bzhugs stegs so/ /log 'tsho zas nor rnyed pa 'ga'/ /mkhas pa dbul bo khyad du gsod/ /sprel rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/ /mjug ma med bhes bzhad gad byed/ / ( sa skya'i legs bshad las) lta bu sogs so/ /143

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron /gsum pa/ sgra ming tshig gsum gyi gsal byed 'dren pa/dper na/ ku hu zhes grag pa'i bya de khu byug go /gdon de 'jigs shing skrag ste ha las nas/ pha pha mi la mi la zhes yang yang zer zhing 'jigs pa'i skad du ma shor/(mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las1)gru gu ga yu a dar rgyal bo'i ke'u tshang gtor zer ba'i ke'u tshang zhes pa ni brag phug go /snyan ngag me long zhes bya ba las/ rtsom gyi lus srog rgyan gsum dang /skyon yon sogs gsal bar bstan snang /'gro grogs grib ma nag ril dang / 'dug grogs pus mo skya ril red/ces pa mgon med skyabs bral gyi dpe'o/ /rdzun gyis pha rol bslus so zhes/ /snyam na rang nyid bslus pa yin/ /lan gcig rdzun par smra ba de/ bden par smras kyang dogs pa skye/ /( sa skya'i legs bshad las/)rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis pa zhes/ /sngags pa don ldan blo bzang grags pa yi/ /mkhyen brtse nus gsum 'jam dpal pad dkar 'dzin/ /gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su grub pa bzhin/ / ( rim pa can gyi rgyan te snyan ngag spyi don las) lta bu sogs so/ / gzhan yang / kha skad du ces zhes dag gi dod du zer yang 'jug 144

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan brgyad pa/ 'dren sdud/mod/ tshig dngos drang ba la ces zhes dag dang / tshig gi don tsam drang ba la zer sbyar na/ drang bya'i khyad par gsal bar gtod pa'i legs cha mchis te/ dper na/ chos zhes pa sems rgyud 'chos pa yin zhes btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gsungs pa dang / zhe rgyud bcos na 'chos par 'gyur ba'i sgo nas chos zeka ba yin/ lta bu'i tshig gnyis ka'i don 'dra yang / snga ma'i zhes sgras tshig dngos drangs nas lung bstan pa dang /phyi ma'i zer sgras gsung de yi don tsam drangs pa'o/ /'di ltar khag bgos nas sbyar na/ gtam bshad lugs dang mthun par ma zad/ tshig dngos drangs pa dang tshig shul gyi don tsam drangs pa'i 'khrul ba'ang spang bar 'gyur bas/ de lugs kun gyis spel bar shog cigadon tshan brgyad pa/ 'dren sdud/ce'o zhe'o she'o gsum/ /gzhan gyi skad cha drangs pa tsam/ /sdud par byed pa'i sgra yin te/ /thob thang mnyam sbyor dag dang mtshungs/ /ce'o zhe'o she'o gsum ni/ ces zhes shes gsum rdzogs tshig dang 'brel ba'i phrad gsum te/ ces bya'o/ /zhes bgyi'o/ 1shes bya ba'o/ lta bu rnams 145

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /kyi tsheg bar bsdus nas grub pa yin la/ thob thang ni cing zhing shing gsum gyi —thob thang dang mtshungs shing / 'jug don ni ces dag gi 'jug pa dang rdzogs tshig gi 'jug pa gnyis ka'i cha dang ldan te/dang bo/ gzhan tshig drangs pa tsam gyis brjod don bsdus pa/mi shes shes khul ma byed/ blun po smra ba nyung na mdzes she'o/ /lan bdun gyi bar du ci zhig 'dod ces dris pa dang / khyod kyi go cha 'dod do zhe'o/ /( khyad par 'phags bstod kyi 'grel ba las )rgyal bo smra ba tshig gcig yin pas/ blon po dag gis yar zhu ma phod ce'o/( gru gu go rdzong las/)za 'dod ngal 'dzem lto 'dun can/ /spu med pa yi phag pa yin/ /zhe'o/ / bya tshig 'jug mkhas na/ brjod pa gson nyams ldan/ de'i phyir tshig sbyor gyi ngo la bya ba'i ming ni ‘ra dren byed yin zhe'o/ /glu skad snyan mo thos nas/ pi wang grags so zhe'o/ /mi de lag mi gtsang zhe'o/ /lta bu sogs so/ /gnyis pa/ ming dang tshig gi don de tsam rdzogs par ston pa tshig gi zla bo re zhig sdud par 'gyur ba'i don ston pas na/ go 146

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan dgu ba/ dogs slong /sogs la zla sdud ce'o/ /gso ba rig pa'i tshig mdzod g.yu thog dgongs rgyan rtsom mkhan gyi ming la dbang 'dus she'o / / mi dpa' mdzangs can mgo thon pa'i nyin yod pa'i dpe la snye'u nang snyung bu zhe'o/ /lta bu sogs so/ / sa mdo'i kha skad du ce'o dag gi dod du zer gi zhes 'jug pa mang /mi de kha 'jam khog lhub cig red ce'o la/ mi de kha 'jam khog rtsub cig red zer gi /lta bu'o/ / — don tshan dgu ba/ dogs slong / — ce na zhe na she na gsum/ / brjod gzhi gang zhig 'dri khul rmis/ /dogs pa slong ba'i sgra yin te/ /thob thang mnyam sbyor dag dang mtshungs/ /ce na zhe na she na gsum ni dogs pa slong ba'i sgra ste/ 'dri ba'i tshul gyis nyan mkhan la rnam shes gtod par bcug thog brjod par bya ba'i gzhi gang ston par byed pa ste/ skyes bu glen pa gang zhe na/ /mkhas bya'i gnas la mi slob pa'o/ /( dri 147

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /ma med pa'i dris lan las/)tshul khrims kyi phan yon ci red ce na/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ tshul khrims nyes spyod dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu/ /snyen mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i zla ba'i 'od/ /skye dgu'i dbus na lhun po lta bur brjid/ /stobs kyis —bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dud/ /ces gsungs so/ /bslab la 'du shes ji lta ba 'dzin dgos she na/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sgan pa chen po'i 'du shes dang /yon tan la sman bzang bo'i 'du shes dang / slob grogs la nad g.yog gi 'du shes dang / rtogs pa dang nyams su len pa la nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /snyan ngag me long la gzhung tshad ji tsam dang don ji tsam gyis bsdus yod ce na/ le'u dang bor sho lo ka 1༷5 gnyis par 365 gsum pararte8stu ste khyon sho lo ka656yod/( snyan ngag gnad bsdus mdzub mos ri ston las) lta bu sogs te phal skad kyi zer na zhes pa dang don gcig go /

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bcu ba/ skul smon/— don tshan bcu ba/ skul smon/ — cig zhig shig gsum skul sbon te/ 1pa las su nye bar skul ba dang —/ / —— 'dod don 'grub par smon pa dang / /grangs tshod ston par 'jug pha 'o/ /cig zhig shig gsum gyi thob thang gong bzhin no/ /don gyi sbyor tshul la gaXng ste bo/ / gzhan la mngag pa'i tshig mthar spyor ba/ khyod kyis dpe cha ltos/ lta du dang / gdams ngag gi tshul du skrag ba la/ skul tshig gi mthar dang sgra sbyar ba/ ltos dang / lta bu dang / skabs su bab ya nye ba'i tshul du skul ba la/ skul tshig gi mthar cig zhig shig gang 'tsham re sbyar bar bya ste/zhib tu ltos shig yig skyon lus par ma 'jugaji ltar bsgo shā yid la 'doms bar byas te/ blang dor bag yod par byos shig ( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod lag) 149

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /de'i tshe srid pa gzhon nus gsol ba/ mi'i bdag po mkhyen par mdzod cig de ni bdag kho nas bsgral bar khas 'che na/ de bzhin du gnang tshu stsol cig rgyal bos lags so/ khyod kyis ji ltar smras pa bzhin du gyis shig ces gnang ba byin no/ / ( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las )jo sras rtsar phebs pa dang / mi khyod 'ong sar nga 'ongs pa med pas bdag la srog stsol cig zer/ ( mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las) lta bu sogs dang / yang / gzhan gyi spyod pa 'gog par nye ba'i tshul gyis skul ba la/dgag sgra dang sbyar ba'i bya ba da lta ba'i mthar 'jug pa/ ma mjal ba yun ring song bas gang mgyogs gnyen 'phrad la phebs chog pas sdug bsngal ma mdzad rdog ( snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las )dngul gshog can gye gser sbrang bung ba khyod/ /ha lo'i me tog nga la ma chags shig/ ( snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las) lta bu sogs so/ / gnyis pa/ smon pa'i tshig mthar spyor ba/dper na/ bkra shis par gyur cigadage legs smon lam 'grub gyur cika bdaka gi re ba rdzogs gyur rdog bu khyod tshe rab brtan gyur rdog dpal 'byor longs spyod 160

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bcu ba/ skul smon/rgyas gyur cig( gzhon dzu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las/) bkra shis bde legs su 'gyur— bar shog cig lta du dang / smon pa'i don du bya ba da lta ba'i mthar shog sgra'ang 'jug ste/ji 'dod thams cad 'grub par shogagatan du bde ba 'thob par shog lhag bsam lus stobs rdzogs pa'i shes rab kyi/ /sa srung dbang bo rigs pa'i sna zhags kyi/ /mtshon cha rab tu 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs myur du mthar byed shog / ( dpa' risarab gsal gyi rigs lam ga bur chu rgyun las/) ngag gi 'dod pa 'bad med du/ /'jo ba'i dbyangs can lha mo de/ /blo gros rgyas pa'i dngos grub kun/ /stsol ba'i bkra shis dpal ston shog— /( shis brjod kyi rgyan te rgyal dbang lnga bas) lta du sogs so/ / gsum pa/ grangs mang nyung gi tshod tsam ston pa/ nga tsho'i slob grwa na slob ma stong tsho gnyis lhag cig yod/ dregs pas long ba 'ga' zhig ni/ /rang gi skyon rnams ma bsams par/ /yon tan phra mos rab mgu ba/ /khrom pa'i nang gi sbal ba bzhin/ /( mgon po klu snyub kyi gsung) lta du grangs rags tshod bstan pa/ / sgor mo stong zhig bskyis nas bad song /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /sngon 'das pa'i dus na/ khyim bdag cig la khye'u spun gnyis shika yod de/ gcig ni sbyin pa zhes bya/ gcig ni tshul khrims zhes bya ste/ ( mdo mdzangs blun las/) las grogs lnga drug tsam zhig dgos/ lta bu grangs nges tshod bstan pa/ngo zhig thug na 'dod/ skabs shig na nags tshal dang nye ba'i 'dabs rol zhig tu bu mo gzhon nu ma lam gol bar 'khyams pa gcan gzan gtum po dag sges gtses te/lus srog bral ma thag pa zhig mdun du mthong ngo /— / ( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs brjod las/) bya ba chen po sgrub pa'i tshe/ /'bad pa yis ni grogs bzang bsten/ /nags tshal chen po mes bsreg na/ rlung zhig ci nas grogs su dgos/ / ( sa skya'i legs bshad las) lta bu rnams grangs gcig gi tshod bstan pa ste/spyir gcig ces pa bsdus nas brtsi gzhi'i rjes su thad kar sbyar ba yin/don ni gcig tu kha skad du gcig zig ces brjod kyang yig skad du gcig cig ce na brjod mi bde zhing sgra gcig bas cig ni gcig gi tshab dang tshad kyi phrad go gnyis bcad pa dang / gnyis su brtsi gzhi 'di rigs las mang bo zhig la gcig ces nges pa ster dka' yang / gcig gi tshod du snang bas/ cig shig zhig gsum thob thang ltar gcig lta bu'i tshod du sbyar ba yin no / /162
grangs mang nyung gi tshod ston pa'i rigs la am skad du zig sgra zor yang bar byas nas 'jug ma yin te/ mi 'a ka' zig 'ong gin yod/ lta du'o/ /

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron /le'u gsum pa/ phrad rang dbang can bshad pa/don tshan dang bo/ ni sgra/ni sgra dgar dang brnan pa dang / /rgyu mtshan kha skong rnams la 'jug /dang bo/ dgar ba/dgar gzhi gcig las dgar bya gcig gam du ma dmigs kyis bzung nas mchog tu'am/ dman pa'am1 tha dad pa'am/ ngo bo ma 'dres pa'am/ dgar bya du ma so sor bkar nas khyad par ba zhig ston pa ste/ yon tan dang ldan pa ni mi go chod can no/ /zhes pa las/ dgar ba'i gnas mi yi tshogs pa dmigs kyis ma smras kyang / de rnams las yon tan dang ldan pa gang ni sgras logs su bkar nas bstan pa lta bu/ de bzhin/bsam 'phel dbang rgyal ni nor bu rnams kyi mchog go (blo gsal 'jug ngogs las) lta bu mchog tu dgar ba/tshig med don ni byis pa'i gna' gtam ste/ /don med tshig spyi ne tso'i ma ṇi yin/ / ( rdo sbis dge bshes kyi gsung) 164

le'u gsum pa'i don sa dang bo/ ni sgra/spyod pa'i tha chad dī ma byin par len pa'o/ /bong bu ni bzhon pa pom zhig go lta bu dman par dgar ba'o/ /phyugs las ni zhing las dang mi 'dra/ sngon po ni ljang gu dang tha dad pa red/ lta bu tha dad par dgar ba'o//nor bu de rin po che'i bye brag go gro ba ni ljon shing zhig min la/ stag pa'i shun pa shog bu 'dra ba de'o/ /lta bu ngo bo ma 'dres par so sor dgar ba'o/ /dbyangs bdun ni bar ma dang / drang srong / sa 'dzin/ drug skyes/lnga ldan/ blo gsal/ 'khor nyan rnams so/ /mchog gsum ni sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun no/ /lta bu dgar gzhi gcig las dgar bya du ma so sor dgar ba'o/ /gzhan yang / lha'i nang nas brgya byin ni mig stong dang ldan pa'o/ /rta — mchog ni rta gzhan las 'gros mgyogs/ lta bu sogs ni sgra'i dgar ba dngos min te/ nas las dag gi dkar ba'o/ / gnyis pa/ ba pa/ khyad chos sam/ yon tan nam/ bya ba ci rigs shig ni sgras nan tan byas nas mngon par bstan pa ste/ me tog 'di dag mdog ni mdzes/ dri ni zhim/ bung ba ma bos mgron 155

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron /du 'ongs/lam thag ni ring / nyi ma ni dro/ yang na khyod kyis gtam zhig shod/yang na ngas gtam zhig bshad/ (blo ro rtse sgrung las ) lta bu khyad gzhi gang gi khyad chos nan tan byed pa'o/ /khyod smra ni mkhas/ gzugs ni bzang / blo ni che/ rgyal bor mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yod/ ( bya mgron sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las/)khong ni dpa' zhing khong ni mdzangs1 sgye'u nang snyung bu yin te/ dmag dpon du bskos na 'os su che'o / /bod kyi rig gnas kyi cha du mar sbyangs pa rtsal du thon pa'i rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor ni gzhon nu'i dus nas bod kyi klu gar rol mo'i sgyu rtsal la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin/ lta du skye bo gang gi yon tan nan tan byed pa'o/ / spang bar bya ba dī spongs/ bsgrub par bya ba dī sgrubs/khyod la byang na zhe tshan ci 'dra yod gsungs/ sngar yod zer ba ni ma thos/ yi ge ni de gda'/ rnal 'byor ba la dris pas/ rgyus ni mi 'byeg zhus/ (mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las) lta bu bya ba nan tan byed pha'o/ /gsum pa/ rgyu mtshan/ — tshig snga ma'i don gsal byed du ni sgras tshig phyi ma drangs nas mngon par 156

— le'u gsum pa'i don tshan dang bo/ ni sgra /ston pa ste/ — —kun gsal zhe se bya ba ni/ 'jig rten kun la gsal ba'i snang ba can te nam mkha'o/ /(dung dkar ba'i sum rtags las/)sher phyin ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /lta bu ming gang gi nges tshig brnan gyis bstan pa'o/ / me ni tsha zhing sreg pa'o/ /sprin ni rlangs pa bar snang du 'phags pa grang reg dang phrad nas chu rdul phra mor chags pa'i tshogs pa'o/ /lta bu chos can gang gi mtshan nyid brnan gyis bstan pa'o/ / stag gzig dom dred la sogs pa ni gcan gzan no/ / snying dang / glo ba/ mkhal ma/ mtsher ba/ mchin pa bcas ni don lnga'o/ /lta bu bsdu bya de dag gi bsdu gzhi brnan gyis bstan pa'o/ /lus kyi snod drug ni rgyu ma/ long ga pho ba/ gnye ma/ ldang ba/ mkhris pa rnams so/ / phyugs rigs ni rta nor lug gsum la sogs pa'o/ /lta bu dbye gzhi de'i dbye ba rnams brnan gyis bstan pa'o/ / bod kyi glu yi sgrig tshul ni/ gtso cher rim pa gsum yod pa'i dang bo dang gnyis pa mtshon byed kyi dpe yin la/ gsum pha mdor bstan pa'i don yin te/ yar bcad tshig la dpe zhig dgos/ /dpe med na gtam la gong ba pa 157

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron /med/ /mar bcad tshig la mdo zhig dgos/ /mdo med na gtam la rum kha med/ /ces zer srol yod/ lta bu brjod gzhi'i nang don brnan gyis bstan pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ kha skong/ tshig— gi zla bo zhig gi 'bru ma longs par ni sgra bsnan nas kha bskangs shing do bsnyams nas ngag snyan phar byed pa ste/rta ni rkun mas brkus song / ba lang ra na lus yod/ lta bu tshig gi sdeb bcos nas brjod bde bar byas pa'o/ /gang ming brjod pa'i dang bo ru/ /kye sbyar ba ni bod pa yin/ / ( sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/) pad ma rnams ni mi zum zhing / /nam mkha' la yang mi 'gro ba/ /khyod gdong zla bas bdig gi ni/ /sbog rnams 'phrog pa nyid du 'bad/ /( 'gal ba'i gzugs can te snyan ngag me long las )zhum pa'i sems ni byung ba'i tshe/ /sems kyi gzengs ni bstod par bya/ / ( byang chub rdums dpa'i nor bu'i phreng ba las) lta bu tsheg bar gyi sa stong bzung nas kha bskangs pa'o/ /

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ dang sgra/don tshan gnyis pa/ dang sgra/dang sgra sdud dang 'byed pa dang / /rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdams ngag dang / / bya ba sbyar sa'i yul dang ni/ /ldan pa mtshungs 'gal rnams la 'jug /sum rtags kyi gzhung rnams su dang sgra'i 'jug pa lngar bshad kyang /don du dgur snang ngo / /dang bo/ spud pa/bsdu bya'i grangs nges ma nges ci rigs gzhi gcig tu sdud pa ste/ snag tsha dang / sgyu gu dang / shog bu rnams ni yi ge bri ba'i nyer mkho'o/ /dzā te dang / cu gang dang / gur gum dang / li shi dang /sug smel dang / ka ko la ni sman bzang drug go /de dag rim bzhin snying dang / /glo ba dang / mchin pa dang / srog rtsa dang / mkha' ma dang / mtsher ba la phan pas sman bzang drug ces bya'o/ /lta du chos can nam rigs bsdus pa'o/ / 169

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /dkar bo dang / dmar bo dang / ser bo dang / sngon po rnams kha dog go /mgrin pa ring zhing phra ba dang / /lto ba ldir zhing che ba dang / /mchu ni 'phyang zhing zhabs zhum pa'i/ /ka la sha 'di bdud rtsi'i snod/ /(rigs rang bzhin brjod pa ste a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar gyis) lta bu khyad chos bsdus pa'o/ /nyi ma sum brgya dang drug cu re lnga tshang na lo gcig lon pa yin/srog gcod pa/ log par g.yem pa/ ma byin par len pa ste lus kyi las gsum dang / rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal te ngag gi las bzhi dang / brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste yid kyi las gsum bcas la mi dge ba bcu zer/ lta bu bgrang bya bsdus pa'o/ /rang rgyal bzo zhing thon skyed dang / /rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor lhan cig 'phel/ /mi dmangs yid kyi dga' spro dang / /rgyal khab snyan grags lhan cig rgyas/ /(bya ba tha dad pa lhan cig brjod pa ste rdo rje rgyal bos/)rig pa glegs bam la gnas dang / /ma bsgrubs pa yi gsang sngags dang / tshags su ma byas yo byad rnams/ /dgos pa'i dus su sleb par dka'/ /(rgyal bo lugs kyi bstan bcos las)lta bu bya ba bsdus pa'o/ /'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom rnams la/ /thogs pa med na mkhas pa yin/160

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ dang sgra/ston pa'i nang na rten dgel ston pa dang / /shes rab nang na rten 'grel shes pa gnyig /'jig rten dag na rgyal ba'i dbang bo bzhin/ /phul byung legs par khyed mkhyen gzhan gyis min/ / ( rten 'grel bstod pa las) lta bu yon tan bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ dbye ba—/ dbye bar bya ba'i grangs nges ma nges ci rigs gzhi gcig las so sor 'byed pa ste/ 'dod yon rnams kyi mchog ni/ mdzes pa dang / snyan pa dang / zhim pa dang / mngar ba dang / 'jam pa'o/ / ro drug ni mngar ba dang / sgyur ba dang / kha ba dang / bska ba dang / tsha ba dang / lan tshwa ba'o/ /lta bu khyad chos snams so sor phye ba'o blo mthun de gtam yig rtsis gsum la mkhas pa deng / nye ring mi 'dzin pa dang / las la brtson pa dang / 'thab la dga' ba zhig go yul 'dir drod gsher 'dzoms pas/ shing sna mang ba dar / lo yags pa dang / 'tsho ba skyid pa'o/ /lta bu yon tan so sor phye ba'o/ / de la lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /nga ro rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /'dren pa dang ni bkug pa dang / /bsgyur ba dang ni ltengs nyid do/ / ( rol mo'i 161

brda sprod gsam byed ngag sgron/bstan bcos las ) sngon 'jug yi ge lnga bo la/ /pho dang ma ning mo dang ni/ /shin tu mo dang bzhi ru dbye/ /( rtags 'jug gi rtsa ba las) lta bu rigs so sor phye ba'o/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi ni/ 'gro ba dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal ba dang /'chag pa'o/ /rjes 'jug bcu yi don shes na/ /'bri dang klog dang 'chad rnams kyi//mtshams sbyor sgra la thogs med cing / /'brel bar smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur//( sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las) lta bu bya ba so sor phye ba'o/ / nged tshang la nor sum cu dang lug brgya lhag yod/ lta bu grangs ka so sor phye ba'o/ /dang sgra sdud pa dang 'byed pa la 'jug pa gam ngam sogs 'byed sdud kyi 'jub/ pa dang mtshungs so/ /gsum pa/ rgyu mtshan/ rgyu dang 'bras bu 'grel ba'i don can ston pa ste/ chu skyar lding ba dang chu yod par shes/ sman 'thungs pa dang nad sos/162

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/dang sgra/ brtson 'grus chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten pa dang / yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas/ lta bu'o/ / bzhi ba/ tshe skabs/ bya ba'i dus ston pa ste/ cong brdungs pa dang tshoms chen du 'tshogs/ nam langs pa dang slob grwar 'gro ston khar bslebs pa dang lo tog smin/ nyi ma shar ba dang pad ma rnams kha bye bar 'gyur/ lta bu'o/ / lnga ba/ gdams ngag— don gang 'grub par byed pa'am legs par sgrub pa'i gdams ngag gam thabs dam pa ston pa ste/brtson 'grus rtsoms dang mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa na/ mkhas par 'gyur ba'i dmigs yul de 'grus byed kyi thabs sam gdams ngag gam gdams pa ni brtson 'grus yin par dang sgras bstan pa yin/ de bzhin du/rtsa tshig 'di dag blo la zungs dang bkol sa mang / rgyal bo na re/ lha mo drang por spros dang / kho bo shin tu dga'o/ ( bya 163

brda sprod gsal byed ngas sgron/mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las/) —bya de khrung khrung dkar po/ /nga la gshog rtsal g.yor dang / /thag ring rgyang la mi 'gro /li thang bskor nas sleb yong / /da rung snying gtam lags pas gsan mdzod dang / /'grogs lugs dgra la tshol dang zab pa yin/ /snying gtam bu la gsong dang brtan pa yin/ /kha 'don gre bar skyil deng btsun pa yin/ /mtshang gtam bar du gsong dang mkhas pa yin/ /rang mtshang rang gis brus dang mkhas pa yin/ /gzhan mtshang lhod la zhog dang dge ba yin/ /blo gtad snying gis skyongs dang ngo mtshar che/ /(mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba las/)ha cang dga' ba'i dus dang khro ba'i dus/ /sems la gang yod kha nas 'chor nyen yod/ /de phyir dran shes sngon du bsten byas nas/ /kha 'don gre bar skyil dang btsun pa yin/ /( bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba las) lta bu sogs so/ / drug pa/ 'gal ba/tshig snga phyi mi mthun par ston pa ste/dpa' rtsal che dang rig pa zhan/ —— thos myong dang mthong ma myong /164

༄— le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/dang sgra/— bshad pa mang dang lag len nyung / nga la sgor mo yod dang khyod la mi skyi/ lta bu kyang yang 'ang gsum mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan du 'jug pa dang mtshungs/ bdun ba/ 'jug yul/ byed pa bo gang gi bya ba 'jug sa'i yul ston pa ste/ 'grul ba dang kha brda byed/ gnas tshul dngos dang bstun nas thag gcad par bya/ mi gang mdza' ba mi brten pa/ /de dang 'grogs par su zhig 'tham/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon mdog mdzes kyang / rgyan du re na blun po 'khrul/ /( sa skya'i legs bshad las/) skye bo phal cher rang nyid dang / /mthun pa'i rigs kyis gnod pa skyel/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar dzwa na1 /'od zer gzhan rnams brlag par 'gyur/ /( gong dang gcig) lta du sogs so/ /brgyad pa/ gang dang ldan pa/khyad gzhi gang la khyad chos gang zhig ldan phar ston pa ste/brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i mdun/ /dka' ba ni ring du 'bros/ /khong ni skyes thob kyi shes rab dang / sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig red/ 7dgra bo snyan par smra na yang / /blo dang ldan pas yid mi brtan1 /chu 166

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/skyar byi la des pa yis/ /pha rol gsod la rtag tu brtson/ /( sa skya'i legs bshad las) lta bu sogs so/ /dgu ba/ mtshungs gsal gyi sgra 'dren pa/dpe can gang la dpe gang sbyar ba mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra drangs nas ston pa ste/ mdzes pa'i bzhin ras ni zla ba nya gang ba dang 'dra/skad snyan pa pi wang gi gdangs dang nor dogs byung /mtshungs/ nga 'di'i brjod pa khebs che skong gting zab pas rgya mtsho dang mkha' dbyings tshad ni 'di tsam mam/ /chu gter zabs su 'di tsam zhes/ /sus kyang gzhal bar mi spobs pas/ khyod thugs de dag nyid dang mtshungs/ / ( sngags pa'i dpe ste/ snyan ngag spyi don las) lta ṭa thog4 so /don tshan gsum pa/ nge pa pa5 nga ṭa nga /de 'di gnyis ni nges bzur ste/ /

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ nges bzung /— tha snyad snga ma'i tshab tu dang / /dngos po brjod don dus rnams las/ /ring la de dang nye la 'di'o/ / sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/ tha snyad dbang du gsum yin te/ /dngos po'i dbang du bzhi ru 'gyur/ /dus kyi dbang du gnyis yin no/ /zhes de sgra'i 'jug pa dgu lung du bstan yod la/ don thob kyi 'di sgra gsungs med kyang /de sgra dang rigs bsgres na/ 'di sgra yang / tha snyad dbang du gsum zhes pa'i nang tshan tha snyad kyi tshab tu 'jug mi rung ba'i lhag bcas phud/ gzhan rnams nye ring mi gcig nga 'i sgo nas sbyar rung bar mthong ngo / /des na de sgra dang 'di sgra gnyis ka'ang tha snyad kyi tshab tu 'jug rung la/ dngos po dang dus kyang ston rung bas/ thun mong gi ming la nges bzung zhes btags na 'grig par 'dod do/ / de yang de sgras ring sa bo dang / 'di sgras nye sa bo bstan pa'i sgo nas/ ltos bcas kyis don tshan bzhir 'jug pa la/dang bo/ 'a snyad snga ma'i tshab rtu 'jug pa/tha snyad gang slar brjod pa'i dgos pa yod tshe/ ring sa bo la de sgra 167

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/dang / nye sa bo la 'di sgra tshab tu sbyar ba/blo gros ni rma chu rdzong gi rdzong dpon yin/ de'i thabs mkhas/ zhes pa na/ rdzong dpon pa ba'i khyad par snga ma sbyar ba na/ gang ming blo gros zhes smos shing / khyad phar phyi ma thabs mkhas zhes pa sbyar tshe/ bshad ma thag pa'i ming de slar len mi dgos shing / thag ring na yod par bltos nas tha snyad de'i tshab tu de sgra sbyar kag bstan pa red/ dpe cha 'di khyod la sbyin/ 'di'i kha gsal zhing don 'byor/'di la ltos dang go rgyu mang / zhes par/ tshig snga ma sbyor ba la dngos po rang gi ming smos shing / tshig phyi ma rnams sbyor tshe/ dngos po nye logs su yod par bltos nas/ dpe cha zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di zhes smos pas chog pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin/chu skyes ni pad ma yin la/ de'i dbyibs mdzes/ de'i dri zhim/de'i rtsa ba zas dang sman byas chog nyin byed ces pa nyi ma yin/ 'od stong can yang de yin/ 'gro ba'i sgron me yang de yin/ long ba'i kha lo ba yang de yin/ dge rgan gyis ri mo zhig bris byung / khyod kyis1 ltos dang / 'di gson nyams dang ldan pa zhig red/ 'di la 'bri rtsal thun mong ma yin pa zhig 168

le'u gsum ba don tshan gsum pa/ nges bzung / mchis so/ / gu ling gser zer ba 'di yin nam/ 'di nga la tshongs shig ngas 'dis rgyan cha zhig brdung dgos/ lta bu rnams so/ / gnyis pa/ dngos po ston par 'jug pa/ bden pa'i dngos po'am/ gsang ba'i dngos po'am/ bdag gi dngos po'am/ gzhan gyi dngos po gang rung zhig thag ring zad du yod pha la de sgra dang / thag nye na yod bar 'di sgra sbyar nas ston pa ste/ gcig bden pa'i dngos po ston phar 'jug pa ni/ pa skabs su bstan bya'i dngos po gang gi ngo bo nyid drang bo'i sgo nas ston par 'jug pa ste/nad pa de'i nad da dung de bzhin red ce na/ dngos po zhes pa'i nad kyi ngo bo'am na tshul so na gnas pa bden par ston ched/ nad pa thag ring sa zhig tu yod par bltos nas mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra dang sbyar nas de bzhin zhes go bar byas pa dang / 'di 'di ltar phris zhes par/ shugs bstan gyi dngos po yi ge'am ri mo mig lam du snang bar bltos nas/ bri bya'i rnam pa'am 'bri tshul 'di ltar zhes drang por bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin/de'i tshe dpa' bo srid pa gzhon nu de no thabs mkhas shing shes rab dang ldan pas sdo ltar mi rigs zheg zol gyis smras/ ( gzhon nu zla med kyi rtogs 169

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/brjod las/)mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang / /gzhan gyi yon tan chung ngu'ang len/ /de ltar rgyun du spyad pa yis/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen par 'gro /( sa skya'i legs bshad las/)khyod gdong ri dwags mig gis mtshan/ /zla ba ri dwags nyid kyis mtshan/de lta na yang 'di mtshungs nyid/ /khyad 'phags min zhes ngo bstod dpe/ /(mtshungs pa'i dpe yang zer te snyan ngag me long las) lta bu'o/ /gnyis/ gsang ba'i dngos po ston phar 'jug pa ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po zhig gzhan gyis shes par dogs nas gsang bar ston par 'jug pa ste/ khyod kyis de bris tshar ram1 zhes pa na/ gtam smra ba'i tshe/ gzhan— la go bar mi 'jug ched/ brjod bya'i dngos po dngos su mi smra zhing / lkog tu gyur par bltos nas/ de zhes pas brda sprod sa'i nyan mkhan gyis go bar gyur pa dang / 'di gzhan la ma bshad ces pa na/ brjod bya'i dngos po gzhan la gsang phyir/ mngon sum du snang bar bltos nas/ 'di zhes pas go bar byas pa'o/ /de bzhin/ nga tshos gros kha byas pa 'di gnas skabs su kha srung rogs byos/170

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ nges bzung /de gzhan la ma ston/ — lde mig de rgyun du 'jog sa de la bzhag yod/ lta bu'o/ / gsum/ bdag gi dngos po ston par 'jug pa ni rjod pa bo rang dang rang nyid dang 'brel ba'i dngos po ston byed du 'jug pa ste/ nga'i slog pa de tshe ring gis gon nas bud song ba na/ bdag gi dngos po ste slog pa ni logs su med par bltos nas de zhes pa sbyar nas bstan pa dang / rang re'i slob grwa 'dir mi rigs mang ngo / /zhes pa na/ bdag dang 'grel ba'i dngos po bye slob grwa ni mdun du yod par bltos nas 'di sgra sbyar nas bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin/ nga 'di mi bkod pa can snyeg skren/ kho je'i 'dra par 'di khyod la ster/ lta bu'o/ / bzhi/ gzhan sgro dngos po ston par 'jug pa ni/ mi gzhan pa'am gzhan dang 'brel ba'i dngos po ston byed du 'jug pa ste/ kho tsho'i khang ba de phub pa bzang / zhes pa na/ gzhan dang 'grem ba'i dngos po khang ba ni thag ring sa zhig tu yod par bltos nas de sgra sbyar nas bstan pa dang /khyod kyis bris pa'i 'char gzhi 'di yongs su 'grig go zhes pa na/ gzhan dang 'byel ba'i dngos po 'char gzhi ni mig lam du yod par bltos nas/ 171

brda spyod gsal byed ngag sgrod /'di sgras bstan pa'o/ /bye bzhin/ dpa' chen de nges nges dpa' chen zhig red/ ri mgo'i lug khyu dī bsod nams tshang gi yin na thang /gdong 'di 'dzum pa'i me tog 'bar/ /g.yo ba'i mig gi bung ba can/ sprang bo/ rdoX ṭwāṃ ༵༷ bo de/ sa can/ nang snya bye bye ༵ da ༷bye byeX rdo/ sa/ /( mon gling g.yul 'gyed las) lta bu rnams so/ /gsum pa/ brjod don ston par 'jug pa/tshig snga ma nges par bzung zhing tshig phyi ma drangs nas don kha tshang zhig ston pa ste/ mi dga' dga' mdog byed pa de/ /pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i rtags/ /mi sdug sdug mdog byed pa de/ /mo gsar bag mar bkun ba'i rtags/ / ( snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las) zhes pa na/ tshig snga ma de sgras nges par bzung zhing tshig grob/sa phyi ma drangs nas/ na gzhon dmag la 'gro tshul lam/ bu mo gnas la 'gro tshul bstan pa'o/ /gal te tshul 'di dag nye sa nas mthong ste brjod pa yin na/ de sgra'i tshab tu 'di sgra sbyar chog de bzhin/172

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ nges bzur / pa— ma kyi bya spyod ngan pa 'di/ /ba'i na du lhung ba'i snga ltas yin/ / sngar gtam dar gyi mdud pa de/ /da dung ma grol dam lags sam/zhe 'dod rdo yi ri mo de/ /da dung ma zum bkra lags sam/ /dam bca' snying gi phar ba de/ /da dung ma bad ba brtan lags sam/ — /(gtam pad ma'i tshal ra ra ra gyi zlos gar las)lta du rnams ma/ / bzhi ba/ dus ston par 'jug ba/ skabs thog byed bzhin pa'am/ 'byung bzhin pa'am/ yod bzhin pa'i dus ni da lta ba yin zhing / nye bas bltos nas 'di sgra dang /dus da lta ba'i skad cig snga ma yan chad thams cad 'das pa dang / skad cig phyi ma phan chad zloms cad ma 'ongs pa yin pa/ ring bar bltos nas de sgra sbyar nas ston pa ste/ de ring gi nyi ma 'di shin tu dro'o/ /gal la thug pa'i dus 'dir tshang mas bsam blo gtong yags bya dgos/tshe 'dir dgos pa'i lto gos gtam gsum po1 /ma byung bsams nas skyo ba skyes pa min/(snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las )spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi phrin las rnam bzhi skrun pa'i skabs 'dir/ 173

bad krod gsal byed ngag sgron/ slob grogs tsho rig pa'i bang mdzod las ji 'dod sgrub pa'i yid bzhin nor bu thabs kyis longs shig lta bu rnams las 'di sgras dus da lta ba bstan pa'o/ /na ning gi lo der/ nga slob grwa 'dir yong ba yin/ rgyal dbang lnga ba bzhugs pa'i skabs der/ bod kyi rig gnas dar rgyas che zhes grags/ na gzhon pa'i dus de'i ring la rtsed mo la g.yeng bas yon tan bzang bo zhig sbyong ma thub/ lta bu rnams las de sgras dus 'das pa bstan pa'o/ /sang nyin nyi ma shar ba'i dus de la 'gro bar bya/ 'gyur bzhi mngon sum du byung ba'i dus de la thon tshe/ 'dod yon longs spyod deng sang gi yan dang yan zhig yin srid/ lta bu dmas las de sgras dus ma 'ongs pa bstan pa'o/ /don tshan bzhi ba/ spyi sgra/gang ci ji su du nam drug /

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ spyi sgra/spyi la ga ba'i sgra yin te/ /—dpe dang gzhal la ji sbyor zhing / / don la ci dang mi la su/ /grangs la du dang dus la nam/ /gang ni de dag kun la 'jug / spyi sgra 'di rnams gtso bor don bye brag pa zhig dmigs su mi 'dzin par spyi la khyab pa tsam ston pa'am dri bar 'jug pa yin lnga 'di dag so so'i 'jug sa mi gcig ste/ su ni gang zag dang / du ni grangs ka dang /nam ni dus tshod dang / ci ni don dang / ji ni dpe dang tshod dpag par 'jug cing / gang ni de rnams 'jug pa'i khongs mtha' dag la 'jug rung ngo / /de dag so so yang don gsal byed kyi sgra ci rigs dang sbyar ba'i 'jug pa mang ste/ zhig ste slad phyir la la ci/ /snyed srid ltar bzhin skad 'dra ji/ /zhig dag tsho 'am rnams la su/ /zhig du tshod yang dag la nam1 /gang ni de rnams ga cher sbyar/ / de ltar dogs pa'i don la ci zhig ma nges pa'i don la ci ste/ rgyushe 76

brda krod gsal byed ngog sgron/mtshan gyi don la ci phyir ram ci slad/ dri ba'i don la ci la/ yod tshad la ji snyed/ dus tshad la ji srid/ dpe la ji 'dra'am ji lta bu'am ji ltar/dpe don mtshungs pa la ji bzhin ( ji lta ba bzhin) / gzhan gtam la ji skad/ gang zag gcig la su zhig 'ga' la su dag mang ba la su tsho'am su rnams/ dus ma nges pa la nam dang nam zhig dus kyi cha la nam du/ dus skabs la nam tshod/ dus rgyun la nam mang / lta du ci rigs su sbyar chogagong gi don gsal byed kyi sgra rnams las/ ste/ srid/ skad 'ga' ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams gang sgra dang sbyar rung ngo / / spyi sgra rnams don la 'jug pa rnam pa bzhi yod de/ dang bo/ spyi khrab ston pa/rigs can spyi la khyab pa tsam ston byed du 'jug pa ste/ngan pa phal cher rang gi skyon/ /gang yin gzhan la 'god par byed/ / yon tan skyon gnyis sus kyang gsal/ /'dres pa 'byed shes mkhas pa yin/ /ngan pa ji ltar bcos gyur kyang / /rang bzhin bzang bo 'byung mi srid/ / —176

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ spyi sgra/ rgyun du gzhan gyis bskyang dgos pa'i/ /skye bo nam zhig ci nas nyams//shes 1—— 1—— /ste/111 ka(11 ༷/da ra ba da ba sa skya gas bshad las/ci ste lam tshod ma zin na/ ma khu stag gdong dpon la dris dang shes/(gru gu go rdzong las/) don rgyan tshig rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan ji snyed pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su rtogs shing mtshan gzhi'ang ji lta bar 'god mkhas/dbyar sa bzad spang la ci yang skye/ rgan shes rab rna bar ci yang thos/nus pa chung zhing yan lag ches phra bas/ /stobs ldan ljon pa gzhan la 'khril byas te/ /mthon por 'phags pa rang gi mthur rlom yang / /nam zhig rang mdog myur du ston par nges/ /(khyad chos tha dad tha dad min pa'i bsdus brjod de dung dkar bas)lta byu sogs so/ / gnyis pa/ bye zag ba gsal byed du thog mar byu tsam ston pa/rigs rnams las bye brag pa zhig dmigs su bzung nab mngon par gtod ched thog mar rigs spyi la khyab 5 tsam ston par 'jug pa ste/gang la yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i/ — /dkon mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /(sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/)

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/kang zhig bsten na yon tan kun/ /'dod dgur sbyin pa'i kho bo'i rje/ / ( si tu'i 'grel chen las/) ji srid ngo tsha yod gyur na/ /de srid yon tan rgyan gyi mchog / ( sa skya'i legs bshad las/) pa bu mo'i ngo sus zin pa de la ster ro/ / ( rgyal bo srong btsan sgam pos rgya bza' gong jo khab tu bzhes pa'i rnam thar las) lta bu sogs so/ /gzhan yang / slob dpon gang nyid sku khams bzang bar smon/ zhes dad / pi wang ji bzhin nyid kyi gsung dbyangs snyan/ zhes pa'i nang gi gang nyid ni de nyid dang / ji bzhin ni de bzhin yin pas/ rigs can bye brag pa zhig ston par 'jug pa yin la/ de las ngo mtshar gyur pa gang / /zhes pa'i gang ni spyi tsam ston khul gyis med pa'i mtha' chod pa'o/ / gsu ma pa/ spyi khrab tsam dri bar 'jug pa/rang gis ma nges pa'i don gang gzhan la spyi khyab tu dri bar 'jug pa ste/khyod gang nas yong / yong grogs du yod/ yong don ci yin/ su la re ba bcol/ ji ltar bya/ nam 'gro / bu mo khyod ni de ring gang nas yong / /do nub 'gro ba'i sa yul gang du 178

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ spyi sgra/ 'gro /khyod la pha ma gnyen tshan ji 'dra yod/ /'jig rten gtan grogs bdag po su 'dra yod/ /khyim dang longs spyod bu tsha gang 'dra yod/ /bu mo khyod kyi ming la ji skad zer/ / ( snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las) lta bu sogs so/ / bzhi ba/ gdam nga dri bar 'jug pa gdam gzhi gcig las gdam bya gang rung zhig gsal byed du dri bar 'jug pa ste/khyod la dpe cha gang dgos/ sum rtags dang snyan ngag gang slob kha sla/ 'gro 'dod mi mang dang su 'gro bar 'jug rgyu/7 sha dang bag thum min pa med/ khyod kyis rdo za/ sang nyin dang gnangs nyin nam 'ong /—rgya ma du dgos/ gong che chung ji 'dra red/ lta bu sogs so/ /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/don tshan lnga ba/ dgag sgra/ma mi min med dgag sgra ste/ /ma mi gnyis ni thog ma dang / /min med gnyis po rjes su sbyor/ /min la ma yin ma red dang / /med la mi 'dug mi snang dang / /mi gda' mi mnga' zhes kyang bya/ /ma mi min med rnams tha snyad gang gi thog ma'am rjes su sbyar tshe/ sbyar yul gyi don de med pa'am ma yin par ston pas dgag sgra zhes bya'o/ /sbyar yul ni spyir skor bzhi yod pa las/ gang la gang 'jug pa dang gang mi 'jug pa gsham gsal/dang bo/ bya ba 'gog pa/ bya ba byas zin pa'am byung zin pa dang / byed bzhin pa'am 'byung bzhin pa dang / byed 'gyur ram 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa las/ ma ni 'das pa dang skul tshig gnyis la 'jug pa/ ma btab gnad du zug pa'i mtshon/ /ma 'thungs khong du song ba'i sman/ /ma zos yid 'phrog sbrang rtsi'i ro/ tshig gi khyad par rnams la yod/ / 180

le'u gsum ya'i don tshan lnga ba/ dgag sgra/(rgyal bo lugs kyi bstan bcos las )tshon gyis ma bsgyur mthon mthing ne'u gsing gzhir/ /ma bkram me tog sna tshogs tshom bus mdzes/ /bskul ba min par bung ba'i mgrin dbyangs kyis/ /ma 'phrogs yid kyi chom rkun dpyid kyi dpal/ /(phyi'i rgyu cung zad tsam gyis 'bras bu ston pa'i srid pa can te bod mkhas pas/)spyin pa chu yin rung sla bar ma gtong /khyi bos nas ma rdung /rang phan gzhan gnod ma byed1 lta du'o/ / mi ni da lta ba la 'jug pa/chang mi 'thung / du ba mi 'then/ zho yod na khyer shogadeng rabs can bzhi'i bgro gleng nang / /la la lkugs pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /tshan rig mi shes blun po la/ /bshad rgyus dben pa chos nyid do/ /(kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa ste rdo rje rgyal bos/)gnad 'gag mi phig dper brjod phreng / /mang yang mgo bo 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /lta bu'o/ / min ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa gnyis la 'jug pa/ 'di ngas nyos pa min/ blo bzang gis byin pa yin/—khyod kyis bshad pa min na/ khos shes sa med/

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/nga de ring 'gro rgyu min/rtsis rig go rim bzhin du ma bslabs na shes rgyu ma red/ lta bu'o/ /med ni dus gsum ga la 'jug pa/bkur rgyu cang med/dpe cha dpar ma 'di sus kyang bltas medazhing 'debs kyin mi 'dug lta du sogs so/ /gnyis pa/ khrad chos 'gog pa/khyad gzhi gang rung gi rang bzhin nam rnam pa'am tshul dang tshad sogs 'gog pa la/ ma mi min med bzhi bo 'jug chogaskyid kyi mgo 'phang ma mtho/ /sdug gi sems 'phang ma dma'/ /mi 'grig 'grig pa'i las ka las/ /lha khang la skor ba brgyab pa dga'/ /(bya sprel gyi gtam rgyud las/ )skye sgo de 'dra yag pa min yang / chags sdang gi rus thon pa zhig yin/bzang med ngan med dgra gnyen mi phyed pa'i gzu bo zhes pa gson yang shi ba nyid dang mtshungs/ lta bu sogs so/ /gsum pa/ dngos po dang grangs 'gog pa/de la min dang med gnyis 'jug pa/dgra lan ma 'phrod dpa' bo min/ /zas lan ma 'phrod mdzangs ma min/182

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ dgag sgra/zla ba skyengs byed mdzes pa 'di/ /zla bas tshar gcod pad ma min/ /de phyir khyod kyi gdong nyid do/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges pa'i dpe/ /(gtan 'bebs kyi dpe'ang zer te snyan ngag me long las )de ba tshang na las thub gsum min na bzhi yod/lag pas bde ba can la 'phen mkhan med/ /rkang bas bzung nas dmyal bar 'phen mkhan med/ /rang gi skyid sdug rang gi lag na yod/ /rang gis rang nyid mi bslu shin hūṃ gces/ /(bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba las )'dod pas gdung la khrel med ngo tsha med/ /bkres pas gdung la stobs med mdangs kyang med/ /nad kyis gdung shā gnyid med bde ba med/ /(rgyal bo lugs kyi bstan bcos las)lta bu sogs so/ / bzhi ba/ 'gog pa'i 'gog pa/ med pa las log pa yod par byed pa dang / min pa las log pa yin par byed pa la/ dgag sgra bzhi bo skabs dang bstun nas gang 'tsham 'jug pa/mi ster rgyu dpe medakhyod kyi lag na med don med/ bshad na mi skyid sa med/song na mi sdug sa med/shes na mi bshad pa med/ bshad na mi tshar ba med/

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/phyi mar mi lta chos pa min/ /phyis 'byung mi lta dpon po min/ /(gru gu go rdzong las1) khyod la bshad rgyu yod dang / nga la bden pa med pa min/lnga ba/ gnyis byed 'gog pa/zla bor gyur pa'i chos gnyis ka phyed phyed bkag nas cha gnyis ldan pa'i chos gcig gi ngo bo tsam ston pa ste/rong ma 'brog rgya ma bod/ bya ma bye'u/ 'phur ma lding / shi ma gson/ya ma zung / lta bu sogs so1 /yang / kha cig gi (dper brjod du/ ma yin nam ma red zer ba ma yi ngo bo nyid du 'dzin pa mi 'grig ste/ min pa'i mtshan nyid du nges/ mi 'dugami bdog mi gda' rnams la mi'i ngo bor bzung ba'ang mi 'grig ste/ med pa nyid du nges te/ dper na/bshad rgyu mi 'dug ces pa/ bshad rgyu med zer ba las/ mi bshad zer ba min/mdzo ma yin zhes pa/ mdzo min zer ba las/ ma mdzo zer srol med/kho'i ma red ces pa/ kho'i min zer ba las/ kho'i ma zer ba min/ lta bu sogs kyis gsal bar mngon no/ /

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dang bo/ yi ge'i ngo bo/rtags 'jug gi skor/le'u dang bo/ yi ge spyi bshad pa/—don tshan dang bo/ yi ge'i ngo bo/ming phrad rtsom pa'i gzhi ru gyur pa yi/ /skad kyi gdangs te yi ge rnam gnyis las/ /gnas dang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur mi gsal zhing / /sgra tsam shas che ba ni dbyangs yig dang / /gnas byed rnam 'gyur gsal zhing skad gdangs ni/ / khyad par can du gyur pa gsal byed do/ /dbyangs gsal gtso byed mgo 'dogs 'phul rten rnams/ /gang rigs sbyar bas ming dang phrad sogs byung / /ming phrad sbyar bas tshig tu grub— pa dang / /tshig phreng spel ba ngag gi brjod pa'o/ /spyir 'jig rten khams na skad rigs sna tshogs yod pa dang /de mtshungs yi ge'i rigs kyang mod/ rags par bsdus na/ yi ge sbyor 1 85

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/klog can dang / dpe ris can gnyis su 'dus so/ /rigs 'di gnyis ka'i grub lugs mi 'dra bas/ ngo bo'ang de 'dra mi gcig la/ dbyangs gsal gnyis rtsa bar byas nas gnas rnams su byed pa rnams phrad pa las byung ba'i bod yig lta bu'i yi ge sbyor klog can gyi ngo bo ni/ ming dang phrad sogs rtsom pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs yin zhing / dngos po gang dang gang gi ri mo'i rnam pa tsam bris pa de rim gyis yi ger gyur pa'i rgya yig lta bu'i yi ge dpe ris can gyi ngo bo ni/ skad kyi gdangs sam sgra gang zhig 'bru ru chags pa ma yin gyi/ skad cha mtshon byed kyi rtags tsam yin no/ /zhes rgya skad kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung rnams su bshad pha ltar ro/ /de la bod kyi yi ge gcig gam gnyis sam du ma 'dus pa'i ming gzhi'i mthar rjes 'jug gang rung zhig sbyar bas/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming dang / tshig sbyor byed kyi phrad du grub pa dang / ming du ma rnam dbye'am tshig phrad kyis mtshams sbyar nas tshig tu grub pa dang / tshig gi phreng ba spel nas gzhung don gsal bar byed pa brjod par grub bo//don tshan gnyis pa/ srog dang rkye na gyi yi gesrog yig dbyangs dang tsheg gnyis te/ /gsal byed nyi shu rtsa dgu la/ /

le'u dang bo'i don tshan gnyis pa/ srog dang rkyen gyi yi ge.a yi dbyangs kyis brjod pa dang / /yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung bar/ /i rnams phal cher zhugs dgos phyir/ / bod yig tsheg gis ma bcad na/ /tsheg khyim 'grub par mi srid de/ /sngon rjes ming gzhi 'khrul gyur pas/ / brjod bya ston byed mi nus phyir// /tsharkyen yig dbu dang shad gnyis te/ /dbu khyud yig mgo ston byed tsam/ /tshig lhugs skabs su chig shad tsam/ /tshigs bcad dang ni don tshan re/ / rdzogs pa'i mtshams su nyis shad 'thob/ / brjod pa yongs rdzogs bzhi shad 'bri/ /le'u mtshams bar dang gal 'dzugs su/ /sprul shad 'bri ba'i lag len yod/ /thig mgor yig rdog gcig byung tshe/ /tshugs thub ched du spungs shad 'bri/ / tshig mthar ka ga sha byung ba/ /

— — —— —༷༷ — brda sprod gsal rgyad ngag sgron/rkang ring shad du brtsis pa yin/ /nga 'a shad gong phyi tsheg 'bri/ / dbyangs dang tsheg la srog ces bya ba ni/ yi ge rnams kyi srog tu zhugs pa'i don ma yin par/ yi ge rnams brjod pa gsal bar byed pa'i nus pa ster ba'i sgo nas srog zer ba yin/ gzhan dag gi 'jug pa gsal bas ma spros so//gzhan yang / rgya rim pa bdun zhes bya ba ni/ tsheg khyim mi 'khrug pa tsheg gi rgya/ tshig rkang mi 'khrug pa shad kyi rgya/ brjod don mi 'khrug pa le'u'i rgya/ sho lo ka mi 'khrug pa bam po'i rgya/ bam po mi 'khrug pa bam po'i grangs kyi rgya/ mtha' mi 'khrug pa sne thig gi rgya/ glegs bam mi 'khrug pa gdong yig gam spyan khyer gyi rgya rnams yin/ tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba bzhi'am/ tshig lhugs kyi tsheg dbar sum cu so gnyis(sla rtsis su tsheg dbar sum cu)la sho lo ka gcig dang / sho lo ka sum brgya la bam po gcig tu brtsis pa dang / po te che ba la shog grangs lnga brgya dang / 'bring ba la shog grangs bzhi brgya yas mas dang / chung ba la shog grangs nyis brgya nas sum brgya'i bar yin no//don tshan gsum pa/ pha ma bu tsha'i yi gepha ni gsal byed nyer dgu ste/ /

le'u dang bo'i don tshan gsum pa/ pha ma bu tsha'i yi gebarjod bya ston byed gtso bo'i phyir/ / ma ni a ste gsal byed kyi/ /skad gdangs skyed pa'i gnad kyis yin/ /du yig i ldog e yo dang / / ya btags ra btags drug yin te /pha ma'i yi ger phar bltos nas/ /5 ka nas ha'i bsdi sna~X ༵ rdo dīXrdo ṭwāṃ dī kau ༵/ yi/ na dod ni/ —brjod rdoXdī byed kun bye skad gdangs 'tho snyen pa ༷'i byed pa da ༵na / pa'i phyi sdi /ma steng na zhwa ltar mdzes pa gsum ste/ gug gu 'bring bu na ro dang / 'og na gdan ltar mdzes pa gsum ste/ zhabs kyu ya btags ra btags bcas drug ni bu yig yin te/ pha ma'i yi ger phar bltos shing gdags su rung la/ pha ma'i yi ge rnams de dag la ma rba ltos shing gdags su med pas so/ /'o na wa btags dang la btags gnyis ci'i phyir bu yig tu ma bzhag ce na/ wa btags ni sgra mtshungs pa'i ming gi khyad par gtod pa'i dang / ming gzhi sngon 'jug tu ski 'khrul bar byed pa'i rtags tsam te/ dper na/ bza' ba'i sha dang ri dwa gas shā lta bu las/ ri dwags —zhes pa'i dwags kyi ming gzhi 189

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ da la wa ma btags na/ da yig sngon 'jug tu 'khrul srid pa dang / ri dwags kyi shwa la wa btags med na bza' ba'i sha la 'khrul srid pa'o/ /la btags ni ming gzhi dang bsdebs na rang gzugs dngos su yod par ma zad/ rang sgra'ang bu yig gzhan dag ltar 'gyur ba med pha'i phyir/ bu yig gi gras su dang bo'i slob dpon gyis ma bzhag pa yin no/ / (pho mo ma ning gi yi ge zhes bya ba'i don tshan rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs su bshad par bya'o//) don tshan bzhi ba/ mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi yi geka sogs gsal byed sum cu las/ /ra mgo ldan pa ka ga nga / / ja nya ta da na dang ni/ /ba ma tsa dza bcu gnyis te/ /la mgo ka ga nga ca ja/ /ta da pa ba ha dang bcu/ /sa mgo ka ga nga nya 7/ / da na pa ba ma tsa la'o

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi yi ge mgo can gsum gyi klog tshul ni/ /—ra mgo lce rtse 'dar ba dang / / —la mgo lce glod rgya yangs bskyed/ /sa mgo so yi bar nas dbyung / /'dogs can ya ra la wa ste/ / ya btags ka kha ga dang ni/ /pa pha ba ma bdun yin te/ /ra btags ka ṣa ga da dang / / pa pha ba ma sa ha bcu/ /—la btags ka ga ba za dang / /ra dang lnga ste wa btags ni/ / ka kha ga nya da tsha dang / / zha za ra la sha ha 'o/ /gzhan yang grwa rtswa phywa sogs yod/ / 'dogs can wa ni rtags tsam ste/ /ya ra la gsum 'dogs can gyi/ /sgra gdangs la lda ches mtshungs pas/ /ming gzhi'i sgra zur thon par bgyi/ /

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/mgo 'dogs ldan pa sum brtsegs las/ /ra mgo ya btags ka ga ma/ /sa mgo ya ra 'dogs pa can/ / gnyis ka'ang ka ga pa ba ma'o /gang la gang btags go rim bzhin/ /gnas nas dbyung zhing cig car bklag /gal te zur zhig mag pas na/ /sbyor klog mi dag yig skyon 'byung / /sngon 'jug rjes 'jug yang 'jug rnams/ /rtags 'jug skabs su bshad par bya/ /'dir cung zad bshad dgos pa ni/ mgo can 'dogs can sum brtsegs can rnams kyi mtshan gzhir mgo 'dogs gang thob ma sbyar bar ming gzhi rkyang ba tsam bstan pa klog bde ba'i ched du yin/mgo can ra la sa gsum gyi klog tshul las/ /ra mgo can ni lce rtse rkan la gyen du phrad pa rlung gis bskyod nas 'dar ba dang cig car ming gzhi gang gi gdangs phyung ba yin te/ rka lta dur dpe mtshon na/ lce rtsa rkan phug dang bral nas gdangs thon pa'i thog mar ri zhes grags pa dang / la mgo can ni lce rtsa mgrin pa dang / lce rtse rkan la reg nas/ rlung lce mtha' gnyis nas 'don 192

le'u dang bo'i don tshan bzhi ba/ mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi yi gepa dang lhan tu ming gzhi gang gi sgra 'byin pa yin / lja lta bur dpe mtshon na/lce ngos sdun so nas sgra thon pa'i thog mar lid ces grags pa dang / sa mgo can ni lce rtse'i mtha' gnyis so rtsar reg cing / lce rtse dang so'i bar nas rlung phud pa dang sbrags nas ming gzhi gang gi gdangs bton pa yin / sta lta bur dpe mtshon na/ lce rtse so dang bral nas sgra byung ba'i thog mar sri zhes grags pa yin la/ gzhan rnams kyang de bzhin rigs bsgres nas shes par bya'o/ /'dogs can ya ra la wa bzhi'i klog tshul ldas/ wa btags ni gong du bshad zin pa ltar ming gzhi gang la btags kyang rtags tsam ste/ spyir sgra zur thon pa med mod kyang / brda rnying zur ma chag pa rnams la sgra zur 'byung bzhin yod de/ swa ste la so ste dang / dwa phrug la do phrug lta dur 'don pa ni/wa sgra'i zur thon pa'i rtags so/ /ya btags can dang / ra btags can dang / la btags can la la klog ma dag na sgra gcig par gyur 'gro/ dper na/ gra dra bra gsum skog pa dag na/ gra sgra mgrin pha dang / dra sgra lce rtse dang /bra sgra mchu las byung bas khyad par gsal/ kla gla bla gsum las/ kla sgra mgren pa dam zhing drag pe'i tshul gyis dang / gla sgra mgrin pa glod cing zhan pha'i tshul gyis dang / bla sgra ma mchu ya sor reg pa'i tshul gyis 'don pa yin pas khyad gsal/ gzhan dag kyang de bzhin bsgres nas shes par bya'o/ /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/don lnga ba/ sbyor mi rung ba che khag bcu/dbyangs bzhi gang yang mi 'jug pa/ / wa dang wa btags can rnams so/ /sngon 'jug thob par mi srid pa/ /wa 'a ra la ha a drug /'dogs can ga yis mi 'phul zhing / /la mgo can la 'dogs bzhi bral/ /brtsegs 'phul ba yig kho nar nges/ /'phul yig rang sder 'jug mi dpe/ /ming gzhi mgo 'dogs zung ldan ni/ /ka ga pa ba ma las med/ /ming gzhir 'phul tshul med pa gsum/ /pho ni ma ning la mi 'jug /mo yang pho la 'jug mi 'gyur/ /ma ning rang la rang mi 'jug /gsal byed rnams las wa yig la dbyangs bzhi bo gang yang mi 'thob ste/ming gzhir 'jug pa rang gzugs tsam dang ha cang nyung zhing / 'dogs can 194

le'u dang bo'i don tshan lnga ba/ sbyor mi rung ba che khag bcu/rnam pa bzhi las wa btags can la yang gug gu sogs dbyangs bzhi sbyor mi rung bas/ wa la med kyang chog pa'i yi ge gcig ces grags so/ zhar byung du/ra btags tra sna lta bu'i ming gzhi can te/ sle tres dang tron dang tres sam lta bu zhang zhung gi skad dang / sgar ma sgyun sgrubs snrel zhi rnams/ legs sbyar gyi tha snyad bod skad du drangs pa las bod skad rang min pa dang / thra ni rjig ces lham gyi sgra dang / dgya ni dgyes dang / bgya ni bgyi bgyid bgyis(ngo bo gcig)dang / mgra ni mgrin dang mgron dang / lga ni sgang ba dang / lnga ni grangs kyi lnga dang / spo ni stag lpags zhes drug sgra bsdus nas gzhi dang thad kar sbyor skabs dang / stsa ni stsol dang bstsal(ngo bo gcig)la sogs pa ni/ yi ge re re bar zad ces grags so/ /sngon 'jug lnga bo gang gi 'jug yul du'ang mi 'gyur ba'i yi ge ni/ wa 'a ra la ha a drug yin pa las/ ra la gnyis la 'phul phyed thob pa'i yi ge zhes kyang bya ste/ rkyang ba la 'phul mi 'thob kyang / mgo can du song ba/ brla lta bu 'phul thob pha'i phyir ro/ /de yang rla dang sla mgo can gyi sde tshan du gtogs zhes sngon byon mkhas pa kha cig gis bzhed pa'i snga ma don gyis dben yang /phyi ma tshad ldan du mthong ste/ ming gzhi la sa mgo yod med bya ba'i ming du bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas byung ba yin te/ dper na/ rnam pa bsgyur nas 'gyur/ chu la sbangs nas bangs/ bu gu bsnyal nas nyal ba/ lta bu/ de bzhin 196

bad krod gsal byed ngag sgron/sa la btags sla la yang / bslangs nas langs/ bslad nas lad/ e lob tu slob/ lta bu ming gzhi brtsegs pa can byed pa'i las dang / rkyang ba can bya 4'i las te/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba yod pa'i phyir/ deb 'dir yang sla zhes pa mgo can du bzhag pa yin no/ /ya ra la wa bzhi bo gang yang sngon 'jug ga yi 'jug yul du mi 'gyur zhing / mgo can gsum las la mgo can la ya ra la wa gang yang gdags pa med pa dang / brtsegs yig la yongs grags su/ rkyang 'dogs la ming gzhi nyis rtsegs su mi rtsi/ mgo can la nyis rtsegs dang / mgo 'dogs zung ldan la sum brtsegs su brtsis so/ /des na brtsegs 'phul la sngon 'jug ba ma gtogs gzhan bzhi bo 'jug par mi 'gyur zhing / mgo 'dogs zung ldan gyi ming gzhi ka ga pa ba ma lnga las med/ sngon 'jug lnga bo rang sde'i yi ge gang la'ang 'jug pa'i dpe med do/ /ming gzhi gang dag la sngon 'jug gang mi 'jug pa'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ sngon 'jug gi pho ba yig ni/ ming gzhi'i ma ning gi yi ge kha cha tha pha tsha lnga la 'jug par mi 'gyur la/ sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis po yang / ming gzhi'i ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha lnga bo rang la mi 'jug go/don tshan drug pa/ yi ge'i rgyu/yi ge'i rgyu ni gang dag yin zhe na/ /196

le'u dang bo'i don tshan drug pa/ yi ge'i rgyu/gnas dang byed pa rlung dang rnam rtog bzhi/ /gnas ni brgyad de dog pa'i gnas la ni/ /mgrin pa sna dang spyi bo'i klad spubs gsum/ /yangs gnas khog rkan lce so mchu dang lnga/ /gzhi'i rgyu 'di ni dril bu'i khog pa bzhin/ /byed pa lce gtso de dag gnas rnams su/ / phrad dang cung phrad btsum pa phye ba dang / /dog pa yangs pa drug tu byas pa yin/ / —'byin byed rgyu 'di dril bu'i lce dang 'dra/ /rgyu las yi ge ji ltar dbyung zhe na/ /rnam par rtog pas yi ge'i rnam pa shar/ /di nas yi ge brjod 'dod kun slong skye/ /de yis nang gi rlung la g.yo bar byed/ / 'di ni skul bar byed pa'i rgyu yin te/ /dril bu 'khrol byed skyes bu lta bu 'o/ /rlung ni g.yo bas gnas dang byed pa dang / /rtsol ba rnams ni bskyed de dbugs phyung dang / /lhan cig yi ge so so'i gdangs rnams skye/ / 197

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/skyod byed rgyu 'di lag pa lta bu'o/ /don tshan bdun pa/ sgra'i nga ro'i dbye ba/—brjod bya 'khrul med ston pa dang / /bri bya yang dag rno bri ba'i ched/ /sgra yi nga ro drang ba dang / /bkug pa dang ni smad pa dang / /sgreng ba bstod pa rnam pa lnga/ /ma 'dres gsal bar thon pa gces/bod yig la dbyangs kyi nga ro lnga yod de/ ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs ci rigs la 'phul rten yod med gang yin rung / a yi dbyangs dang ldan pa yod do cog ni drang ba ste/ sgra mnyam par byas nas 'don pa dang / de bzhin gug gu can ji snyed pa bkug pa ste/ sgra spyi bo'i cha nas gug par byas nas 'don pa dang / zhabs kyu can ji snyed pa smad pa ste/ sgra 'phang mar la phab nas 'don pa dang / 'byung bu can ji snyed pa sgreng ba ste/ sgra gyen du bkyags nas 'don pa dang / na ro can ji snyed pa bstod pa ste/ sgra 'phang mthon po byas nas 'don pa'o/ /de la nga ro drang ba can dper na/ bslab par bya ba mtha' yas rnams/ /mtha' dag rang byan bya dka' yang / /rang la 198

— le'u dang bo'i don tshan bdun pa/ sga'i nga ro'i dbye ba/ —gnad pa khyad par can/ /gang dag 'bad pas sbyang bar bya/ /(dbyangs a gcig tu nges pa ste rdo rje rgyal bos)lta du dang / nga ro bkug smad sgrong bstod bzhi dper na/ mtsho sngon mdo stod bod ljongs rong 'brog khrod/ /mi rigs spyi yis ci 'bri ming tshig bzhin/ /sdeb legs cher 'jebs dpe med mdzes byed de/ /myur 'khyug sgyu gus phul byung tshul du skrun/ /(dbyangs bzhi'i nges pa ste tshe tan zhabs drung gis)lta bu'o/ / de la dbus skad du sngon 'jug dang mgo can rnams kyi sgra'i zur ha lam nyams par gyur pa'i dbang gis/ dbyangs kyi nga ro'i dbye ba mngon par phyogs pas zhib cha thon cing / am skad du mgo 'dogs 'phul rten rnams kyi sgra'i zur ma nyams par ji bzhin thon cing sgra du ma 'dus pa'i shugs kyis/dbyangs kyi nga ro'i dbye ba dbus skad de bzhin mi gsal te/ dper na/ rol mo sna tshogs cig car du 'bud 'khrol rdung ba'i sgra 'dres ma las/ rol mo gcig gi sgra zur du lhang nger mi 'thon pa lta bu yin gyi/ sam skad la dbyangs kyi nga ro med pa ma yin no/ /de yang rol mo'i bstan bcos las/ so sor spel ba tha dad rang du drangs pas gsal ba dang / bsres nas spel ba tha dad du ma gcig tu drangs pas snyan pa'i skad du smras pa bzhin no/ /mi rigs gzhan pa'i brda sprod spu ba kha cig gis/ am skad la sgra'i nga ro med/ ces dang /sga'i nga ro meng pa'i skad cha rjes lus red/ ces kha tshon bcad pa ni/ sam 199

bad krod gsal byed ngag sgron/skad la byang cha goms cha med pa'i spyi brtol smra ba tsam du zad de/ gcig tu/mda' gzhu yi ni 'phrul 'khor ltar/ /rang sgra rkyang bas mi nus phyir/ /de dag tshogs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rna ba bde bar byed pa yin/ /zhes rol mo'i bstan bcos las gsungs pa lta bu'i sam skad kyi snyan cha ma rtogs pa dang / gnyis su/ yi ge'i sbyor ba mi gcig pas/ don gyi ngo bo sna tshogs ston pa/ sgra drag zhan bar ma sogs kyi khyad par gyi byed las yin la/ sgra rnam par dbye ba'i zhib cha lhag par gsal na/ tha snyad lhag par 'byor/ ngag rtsal lhag par che/skad rigs gang la khyad chos 'di dag yongs su tshang na phun sum tshogs pa yin pa'i am skad kyi legs cha 'di'ang ma rtogs par mngon/ payin na yang / a mdo'i yul skad la lar dbyangs kyi nga ro'i dbye ba mi gsal ba'i skyon yang snang zhing / de lugs khyab cung zad che ba rnam pa bzhi yod de/gcig ming gzhi gcig par i dang u zhugs pa'i sgra'i nga ro'i khyad par mi gsal/ dper na/ ri dang ru/ grub dang grib/ thig dang thug tshigs dang tshugs/ 'jig dang 'jug kag dang sgyug la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis/ nga mtha' can dang sa mtha' can la u dang yo zhugs pa'i nga ro'i khyad par mi gsal/ dung dang bong/ dgung dang dgong / gus dang gos/sgyung dang skyong / bzhus dang ba'os la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /260

le'u dang bo'i don sa bdun pa/ sgra'i nga ro'i dbye ba/ gsum/ rjes 'jug 'dra zhing 'greng bu zhugs yod med kyi sgra'i nga ro'i khyad par mi gsal/ rang dang ring / shes dang shas/ bzhad dang bzhed/ sgag dang sgeg skad dang sked la sogs pa lta bu'o/ / bzhi/ e ldan mtha' med can dang / e yod med gang rung gi sa mtha' can gyi nga ro'i khyad par mi gsal/ ge dang gas/ re dka ras dang res/spras dang spre/ she dang shas dang shes/ skye dang skyes la sogs pa lta du rnams nges tsā klog zur phyin pa dang sgra'i nga ro gsal bar thon na/ brjod bya'i don rnams rjod byed kyi kha lce dag pa'i sgo nas gzhan la 'khrul med du go brda sprod thub pa dang / bri bya'i yi ge yang sgra gdangs ji bzhin dag par 'bri thub pa'i phan thogs che'o/ / des na ka kha thog mar slob pha'i dus nas bzung ste/ yi ge re re ba'i gnas byed rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i klog zur phyin par sbyang dgos/ de nas rim bzhin ka sogs la dbyangs dang mgo 'dogs 'phul rten sbyar ba'i klog dag par sbyangs thog tshig phreng shar mar 'don dus kyang / tsheg khyim re re'i yan lag dag gi rang sgra thon tsam gyis ming gzhi'i gnas byed rtsol ba dang lhan cig klog zur phyin par brjod cing / skad cha bshad bshad dang nyams thon par byas nas 'don rgyu gal che'o/ 1 201

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ don tshan brgyad pa/ nga ro'i rtsa ba gsum/nga ro'i rtsa ba gsum yod de/ /a dang ha dang 'a gsus mo/ /a sgra'i cha dang ldan pa ni/ / ka ca ta pa tsa lnga dang / /ha sgra'i cha dang ldan pa ni/ /kha cha tha pha tsha lnga dang / /'a sgra'i cha dang ldan pa ni/ /ga sogs lhag ma bcu dgu 'o/ /de yang sgra'i gzhi rlung gi shugs 'byung ba'i gnas kyi rtsa ba ni/ khog pa dang mgrin pa gnyis yin la/ mgrin pa btsum zhing dog par byas nas stod du shugs bskyed de gdon pa'i yi ge'i rtsa ba ni a yig go khog pa nas shugs bskyed de gdon pa'i yi ge'i rtsa ba ni ha yig go mgrin pa bye zhing yangs par byas nas smad du shugs bskyed de gdon pa'i yi ge'i rtsa ba ni 'a yig go /de la a yig gi sgra'i cha dang ldan par mgrin pa btsum zhing rlung shugs che bas stod du grim pa'i sgra drag pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge ka ca ta pa tsa lnga bo pho yig go /ha yig gi sgra'i cha dang ldan par khog pa nas shugs cung zad bskyed 202

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dgu ba/ dbyangs gsol rnams kyi gnas dang byed pa'i sbyor ba/ de rlung shugs ran pas sgra bar ma'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge kha cha tha pha tsha lnga bo ma ning ngo / /'a yig gi sgra'i cha dang ldan par mgrin pa phye zhing rlung shugs chung bas sgra zhan pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge ni ga nga ja nya da na ba ma dza wa zha za 'a ya ra la sha sa ha bcu dgu mo yig go /mo yig de rnams las rlu nga shugs phra mo sna nas 'dren zhing sgra shin tu zhan pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge nga nya na ma bzhi bo shin tu mo dang / rlung shugs smad du glod pa sgra ches zhan pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge ra la ha gsum po mo gsham mo/ /don tshan dgu ba/ dbyangs gsal rnams kyi gnas dang byed pa'i sbyor ba/ka kha ga nga a ha 'a/ / lce yi rtsa dang mgrin las bskyed/ /i e ca cha ja nya dang / / tsa tsha dza zha ya sha rnams/ / lce dbus yan chad rkan la reg 1ta tha da na za la sa / lce rtse so rtsams da nas bskyed/ /

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/sngo/ yo pa pha ba ma wa/ /mchu btsum pa 'am cung zad phye/ /nga nya na ma sna las kyang / /ra ni lce rtse spyi bo las/ /thams cad khog pa las kyang ngo / / ka kha ca cha ta tha dang / /pa pha tsa tsha sha sa ar/ /mgrin pa man gyi sgra med la/ /gzhan rnams de dang ldan pa 'o/ /gsal byed kyi ka sde rnams lce'i rtsa ba'i byed pa mgrin pa'i gnas la sbyar bas dang / ca sde rnams lce rtse dang nye ba'i byed pa rkan gyi gnas la sbyar bas dang / ta sde rnams lce rtse'i byed pa so'i gnas la phrad pas dang / pa sde rnams mchu btsum pa'i byed pa mchu'i gnas la sbyar bas bskyed cing / rjod tshul gyi thu par yang sde ba bzhi rnams go rim bzhin du/ dang bo rnams dam pa/gnyis pa rnams dam lhod ran pa/ gsum pa rnams lhod pa/ bzhi ba rnams shin tu lhod par brjod pa ste/ sde ba rang rang gi snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma kod pa'i tshul gyis brjod dgos pha dang / tsa tsha dza gsum ni lce rtse dang shin tu nye ba'i byed pa so ngang zan 'bel ba'i gnas la sbyar bas bskyed cing / rjor 204

le'u dang bo'i don tshan dgu ba/ dbyangs gsal kams kyi gnas dang byed pa'i spyor ba/tshul ni dam pa dang / ran pa dang / lhod pa dang / wa ni mchu dang mgrin pha'i byed pa mgrin pa dang mchu'i gnas la cung zad sbyor la khad du bskyed cing /rjod tshul ni lhod pa'o/ /zha sde 'i zha ni lce rtse dang nye zhing lhod pa'i byed pa rkan gyi gnas dang phrad pas dang / za ni lce rtse dang shin tu nye zhing lhod pa'i byed pa rkan gyi gnas dang phrad pas dang / 'a ni lce rtsa dang nye ba'i byed pa mgrin pa'i gnas la cung zad nye ba'i tshul gyis dang / ya ni lce'i sked pa dang nye ba'i byed pa rkan gnas la sbyar bas bskyed cing / bzhi bo'i rjod tshul lhod pa'o/ /ra sde'i ra ni lce rtse gyen du sgreng ba'i byed pa spyi bo'i spubs dang 'brel ba'i rkan gnas la phrad pas dang / la ni lce rtse'i byed pa rkan dang 'grel ba'i so'i gnas la sbyar bas bskyed cing / gnyis ka'i rjod tshul shin tu lhod pa dang /sha ni lce rtse dang nye zhing dam pa'i byed pa rkan gyi gnas la phrad pas dang / sa ni lce rtse dang shin tu nye zhing dam pa'i byed pa so dang 'brel ba'i rkan gnas la reg pas bskyed cing / gnyis ka'i rjod tshul lhod pa'o/ /ha ni lce rtsa'i byed pa mgrin pa'i gnas la sbyar bas bskyed cing / rjod tshul shin tu lhod pa'o/ /a ni lce rtsa'i byed pa mgrin pa'i gnas la sbyar bas bskyed cing / brjod tshul cung zad dam pa'o/ /dbyangs bzhi'i i ni mgrin pa las byung zhing spyi bo'i cha nas bkug cing cung zad dog por byas pa'i byed pa can dang / u ni mgrin pa dang mchu las byung zhing / de yang mchu ma reg tsam du zum zhim 'phang smad 205

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/de cung zad dog por byas pa'i byed pa can dang / e ni mgrin pa las byung zhing spyi bo'i cha dang cung zad 'dres shing gyen du bsgrengs te yangs par byas pa'i byed pa can dang / yo ni mgrin pa dang mchu las byung zhing / de yang ma mchu gyen du btegs pa ltar 'phang bstod de yangs par byas pa'i byed pa can no/ / 'dir gnas dang byed pa rnam gsal gyi dper brjod re gnyis bkod na/ pad ma'i phung bo phyur bur spungs pa ni/ /dung ba myos pa'i 'bad pas spyod par byed/ /de ltar gtan 'dun bde legs 'thob ched du/ /'thad ldan don dam gtam der mno bsam thongs/ /(gnas gnyis su nges pa ste dbyangs can dga' blos)zhes pa'i rkang ba dang bo dang gnyis pa'i gnas dang byed pa ni mchu dang / gsum pa dang bzhi ba'i gnas so rtsa dang byed pa lce rtse'o/ /dpag med pad ma'i phung bo spungs pa'i dbus/ /khrag khrig dga' mgu'i sgra sgrogs 'khor 'gro'i khyu/ /de dag rtag tu nan tan 'dus te mthar/ /zang zing rtsi bzung so so'i tshang rtser song / /(gnas bzhi nges pa ste dung dkar bas)zhes pa'i rkang ba dang bo'i gnas dang byed pa mchu dang / gnyis pa'i gnas mgrin pa dang byed pa lce rtsa gtso bo/ gsum pa'i gnas so dang byed pa lce rtse/ bzhi ba'i gnas rkan dang byed pa lce rtse dang shin tu nye ba lta bu sogs so/ / 206

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan dang bo/ ming gzhi'i rtags kyi dbye ba/———1 ———— ba/'u ga sa pa/ rtags 'jug pa bshad pa/ming gzhi dang 'phul rten rnams kyi yi ge so so ngag nas rjod pa'i tshe/rang rang gi skye gnas la byed rtsol dam lhod dang rlung shugs che chung gang rigs su sbyar ba'i grag tshul/ pho mo ma ning gi skad gdangs dper byas nas/drag zhan bar ma'i khyad par gsal bar gtod cing / 'jug pa bzhi'i sgo nas tshogs gsum gsal bar byed pa yin pas/ rtags kyi 'jug pa dpyis phyin par sbyangs na/ gzod sgra shes na don la mi rmo 1ros/ zhes pa'i nges pa mnga' brnyes par 'gyur ro/ / —don tshan dang bo/ ming gzhi'i rtags kyi dbye ba/bod yig rtags kyi dbye ba la/ /spyir btang dbyangs mo gsal byed pho/ /ming /zhi'i nang gses rtags kyi khyad/ /ka ca ta pa tsa lnga pho/ /kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning / / ga ja da ba dza dang wa/ /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/zha za 'a ya sha sa mo/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ /ra la ha ni mo gsham ste/ /a ni mtshan med ces kyang bya/ /spyir bod skad du nye bar grags pa'i yi ge rnams la pho mo gnyis su dbye ba'i dbang du btang na/ dbyangs yig mtshon byed i u e yo bzhi ni shes rab kyi rang bzhin mo dang / ka nas a'i bar mthar thug pa gsal byed sum cu ni thabs kyi rang bzhin pho yin te/ mo yi yi ge med pha na/ /pho yig brjod pa med par 'gyur/ /pho yig de dag rnams la yang / /'jug par bcas pa med na ni/ /don rnams brjod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /ka sogs gsal byed du pho yig yin pas/ ga ja/ da rnams klog tshe/sgra shin tu lhod par byas nas sna sgra dang ldan par/ ka kha 'ga' nga / ca cha 'ja' nya/ ta tha 'da' na/ zhes bton na mtshan nyid dang mi mthun par gyur —te/ gtam du/ ga la yin par/ 'ga' la yin/ zhes dang / ja 'thung ba la/'ja' 'thung / zhes dang / da dung la/ 'da' dung / zhes mi zer ba dang /sbyor klog tu/ gang la 'gang dang / jag la 'jag dang / dom la 'dom/ zhes mi 'don pas gsal/ de dag sngon 'jug gi 'dzug yul du song tshe/ gzod mo yig tu gyur pa yin no/ /'o na kha cig gis de ltar 'don don ci zhe na/ ka kha 208

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/ga gha nga / ta tha da rnya na/ zhes legs sbyar gyi klog tshul gyi dbang du shor ba yin la/ sdod rang skad du gong du smos pa bzhin sna sgra med par byed rtsol lhod pa'i tshul gyis 'don pa yin no/ / —gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams ming gzhir song ba'i tshe/ ka ca ta pa tsa lnga bo — rjod pa'i byed rtsol gyi shugs shin tu grim zhing drag pas pho dang / kha cha tha pha tsha lnga bo rjod pa'i byed rtsol grim lhod ran pas ma ning dang / ga ja da ba dza wa zha za 'a ya sha sa bcu gnyis rjod pa'i byed rtsol cung zad lhod pas mo dang /nga nya na ma bzhi bo rjod pa'i byed rtsol shin tu lhod pas shin tu mo dang / ra la ha gsum po rjod pa'i byed rtsol ches shin tu lhod pas mo gsham dang / a ni dbyangs gsal gnyis la 'gro bas/ mtshan med kyi yi ge zhes kyang bya'o/ /de ltar sde tshan lnga ru dril ba'i dgos pa ni/ de rnams ming gzhir song ba'i tshe/ rang rang gi skye gnas las dbyung ba'i byed rtsol dang rlung shugs mi 7dra ba'i khyad par dbye phyir dang / de la sngon rjes rnams sgra gdangs ji ltar 'jug pa'i gzhi ngos gzung ba'i phyir ro/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/dang bo/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba/sngon 'jug ming gzhir 'jug pa'i tshe/ /pa 209

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron /skad gdangs nam pa bzhi ru 'gyur/ /ba pho ga da gnyis ma ning / /'a mo ma ni shin tu mo'o/ /ga da ba ma 'a lnga bo ming gzhi byas tshe/ rang rang gi gnas las byed rtsol dang rlung shugs cung zad lhod pa dang / ches lhod par 'jug pa'i mo yig yin yang / sngon 'jug du byas tshe/ ming gzhi dang phrad pa'i stobs kyis klog pa'i tshe/ skad kyi gdangs mi 'dra bar gyur 'gro/ de la sngon 'jug ba ni skad gdangs drag pas pho dang / ga da gnyis skad gdangs ran pas ma ning dang /'a ni skad gdangs zhan pas mo dang / ma ni skad gdangs shin tu zhan pos shin tu mo dang bcas rtags kyi dbye ba bzhi yod do/ /gnyis ba/ sngon 'jug gi 'jug yul/gang zhig gis ni gang dag la/ /'jug pa'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ /sngon 'jug pho ste ba yig ni/ /pho yig ka ca ta tsa da nga / / pamo yig ga da zha za sha /sa bcas rkyang ba bcu la 'jug /brtsegs pho rka ska rtsa mi dang / /210

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/ta brtsegs gsum0bcas bdun la 'phul/ /mo yig ra mgo sa mgo yi/ /ga nga nya na bzhi gnyis brgyas/ /rja rdza ta brtsegs gsum dang sla/ /bcu bzhi sngon du 'jug pa 'o/ / sngon 'jug ma ning ga yig ni/ /pho yig ca ta tsa gsum dang 1 /mo yi yi ge nya da na/ /zha za ya dang sha sar 'jug /sngon 'jug ma ning da yig ni/ /ming gzhi pho yig ka pa dang / /mo yig ga nga ba mar 'jug / mo yig 'a yis 'phul ba ni/ / mo yig ga ja da ba dza/ /ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha'o /shin tu mo mas 'phul ba ni/ / ④ ta brtsegs gsum ni rta lta sta gsum mo/ / — ② mo yig ra mgo sa mgo yi/ /ga nga nya na bzhi gnyis brgyad/ ces pa ni/ mo yig ra mgo can rga rnga rnya rna bzhi dang / sa mgo can sga snga snya sna ba'i dang bcas brgyad yod par zer/211

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ma ning kha cha tha tsha dang / /mo yig ga ja da dza dang / /shin tu mo yig nga nya na'o/ /'phul yig rang gi sde ba lo/ /nam yang 'jug par mi srid cing / / rang rang 'jug sa'i rkyang 'dogs dang / /brtsegs 'dogs phal cher 'jug pa'o/ /sngon 'jug gang zhig ming gzhi gang dag la 'jug pa ni/ spyir rtags 'jug gi rtsa ba las/ pho ni pho dang mo la 'jug /mo ni mo dang ma ning la/ /ma ning yang ni pho mo la'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de yang zhib tu bshad na/ sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni/ ming gzhi rkyang ba'i pho yig ka ca ta tsa bzhi dang / mo yig ga da zha za sha sa drug dang bcas bcu la 'jug ste/ dper na/ bka'/ bco/ btu/ btso/ bgo bde/ bzhu/bzi/ bshu/ bse/ lta bu dang / ming gzhi brtsegs pa'i pho yig ra mgo can rka rta rtsa dang / la mgo can lta dang / sa mgo can ska stag bcas bdun dang /mo yig ra mgo can rga rnga rja rnya rda rna rdza dang / la mgo can lnga dang / sa mgo can sga snga snya sda sna sla bcas bcu bzhi ste nyer gcig la 'jug ste/ brko/ brta/brtse/ blta/ bsko/ bste/ bsums/ brgal/ brnga/ brje/ brnya/ brda/ brnan/212

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/bka bldag bsgo/ bsngo/ brnya/ bsdu/ bsno/ bslab/ lta bu sogs te/ khyen bsdoms ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs sum cu so gcig la 'jug pa'o/ /sngon 'jug ma ning ga ni/ ming gzhi'i pho yig ca ta tsa gsum dang / mo yig nya da na zha za ya sha sa brgyad dang bcas bcu gcig la 'jug ste/ gcu/gte/ gtso/ gnye/ gdu/ gna'/ gzhi/ gzu/ g.yo/ gshe gsal/ lta bu sogs so sngon 'jug gi ma ning da ni/ ming gzhi'i pho yig ka pa gnyis dang / mo yig ga nga ba ma bzhi dang bcas drug la 'jug ste/ dku/ dpe/ dga'/ dngo/dbu/ dme/ lta bu sogs so/sngon 'jug gi mo yig 'a ni/ ming gzhi'i mo yig ga ja da ba dza lnga dang / ma ning gi yi ge kha cha tha pha tsha lnga dang bcas bcu la 'jug ste/ 'go/ 'ju/'do/ 'bel/ 'dzi/ 'khu/ 'chi/ 'thu/ 'pho/— 'tshe/ lta bu sogs so/ / sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni/ ming gzhi'i mo yig ga ja da dza bzhi dang / shin tu mo nga nya na gsum dang / ma3nga kha cha tha tsha bzhi dang bcas bcu gcig la 'jug ste/ mgo mjal/ mda'/ mdzo/ mnga'/ mnye/ mno/mkhar/ mchi/ mthu/ mtshe/ lta du sogs so/ /sngon 'jug lnga bo rang rang gi sde ba'i ming gzhi gang la'ang mi 'jug pa dang / wa btags can la sngon 'jug gang yang mi 'thob pa dang / la btags 213

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/can la ka ma gtogs mi 'phul ba dang / ya btags can dang ra btags can la ga yis mi 'phul ba dang / la mgo can la gdags pa gang yang mi 'dogs pa noms gong du bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /des na sngon 'jug gi da ba ma 'a bzhi las/ da yis rang gi 'jug yul gyi ming gzhi 'dogs can za ma gtogs dgu la 'jug ste/ dkya dgya dpya dbya dmya/ dkra dgra dpra dbra/ lta bu dang / ma yis rang gi 'jug yul gyi 'dogs can dra ma gtogs bzhi la 'jug ste/ mkhya mgya/ mkhra mgra/ lta bu dang / 'a yis rang yul gyi ming gzhi 'dogs can dgu bo kun la 'jug ste/ 'khya 'gya 'phya 'bya/ 'khra 'gra 'dra 'phra 'bra/ lta bu dang / ba ni rang yul gyi ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs gnyis las dra ma gtogs bcu bzhi la 'jug ste/ bkya bgya/ bkra bgra bsra/ bkla bzla brla/ brkya brgya/ bskya bskya/ bskra bsgra/ lta bu sogs so/ /sngon 'jug lnga bo'i 'jug yul blo ya 'dzin bde ba'i mdor rtsa/ gas 'phul ca nya ta da na/ / tsa zha za ya sha sa dang / /das 'phul ka ga nga pa ba /ma dang drug ste 'as 'phul ni/ /kha ga cha ja tha da dang / /pha ba tsha dza bcu yin te/ /

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/mas 'phul kha ga nga cha ja/ / —nya tha da na tsha dza dang / /bas 'phul rkyang ba ka ga ca/ /ta da tsa zha za sha sa/ /mgo can bas 'phul 'jug min te/ / ra mgo rba rmar mi 'thob cing / /la mgo lta lda min pa med/ /sa mgo spa sba sma gsum spong / / gsum pa/ sngon 'jug gi sgra'i 'jug tshul/pho ni drag pa'i tshul gyis te/ /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin/ /mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis te/ /shin tu mo ni mnyam pas so/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngon 'jug lnga bo rang rang gi 'jug yul la sgra ji ltar byas nas 'jug pa yin zhe na/ sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni/ ma mchu ya sor sbyar nas byed rtsol drag pa'i tshul gyis 'jug —pa ste/ bka'/ zhes pa dper brjod na/ bu sgra cung tsam ka sgrar zhugs nas cig car grags pa/ lta du dang / ma ning gi ga yig ni/ mgrin pa dang lce rtsa nas rlung shugs ran phar bskyed pa'i 215

brda krod gsal byed ngag tshon/tshul gyis 'jug pa ste/ gcig ces pa dper brjod na/ mag sgra cung tsam cig sgrar zhugs nas lhan tu grags pa dang / ma ning gi da yig ni lce rtse rkan la reg nas byed rtsol ran pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa/ dgo zhes pa dper brjod na/ sad sgra cung tsam go sgrar zhugs nas grags pa dang / mo yig 'a ni/mgrin pa dang sna nas rlung shugs zhan par phyung ba'i tshul gyis 'jug pa/ 'tshe/zhes pa dper brjod na/ 'an sgra cung tsam tshe sgrar zhugs shing mnyam du grags pa dang / shin tu mo yig ma ni/ mchu btsums shing rlung sna nas shin tu glod par phyung ba'i tshul gyis 'jug pa/ mgu zhes pa dper brjod na/ 'am sgra gu sgra la zhugs shing cig car grags pa'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyang rigs bsgres nas shes par bya/ mdor na/ bas 'phul so mchu reg pa las/ /gas 'phul gre ba'i phugs nas dbyung / /das 'phul lce rtse so rtsar reg /'a phye ma btsum gnyis ka sna'o / / bzhi ba/ sngon 'jug gi 'jug don/gcig bya byed las gsum sogs kyi go don1bdag gzhan bya byed las gsum dang / /dus gsum sogs kyi brjod don dang / / de rnams rten cing 'grel ba'i tshul/ /

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/mdor bsdus tshig gis bstan par bya/ /byed pa la ni gtso phal gnyis/ /byed pa gtso bo sgrub mkhan dang / / —byed pa phal ba sgrub spyad yin/ /las la bya yul bsgrub bya gnyis/ /bya ba'i yul la las tsam dang / /bsgrub par bya ba las dngos yin/ /bya ba la ni rigs gnyis te/ /byed pa dang 'brel bya ba ni/ /byed pa'i las zhes brjod pa dang / /las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ni/ / bya ba'i las zhes btags pa yin/ / bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang / /byed bzhin pa ni da lta ba/ /byed par 'gyur ba ma 'ongs pa /skul tshig ma 'ongs khongs su 'dus/ /de rnams phan tshun 'bril lugs ni/ /byed pa da lta ba yis dngan /

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/las ni ma 'ongs pa yis sgrub/ /bya ba dus kyi rnam bzhag ltar/ /bab dang bstun nas sbyar bar bya'o/ /de rnams tshig gi phreng ba las/ /so so'i mtshan gzhi rnam gsal bya/ / shing bzos sta res nags tshal du/ /sdong bo bcad nas chod pa las/ /shing bzo byed pa gtso bo dang / /sta re byed pa phal ba yin/ /nags tshal gcad yul las tsam dang / /sdong bo gcad bya las dngos yin/ /bcad dang chod pa'i bya ba gnyis/ /snga ma byed pa'i rtsol ba dang / /phyi ma las kyi 'gyur ba yin/ /shing bzo sta re bcad pa gsum/ /bdag gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / / nags tshal sdong bo chod pa gsum/ /gzhan gyi khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /218

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/shing bzo la sogs zhes pa la/ /sbyar ba'i cha shas ngos 'dzin du/ /1gcod pa bo yis gcod byed kyis/ /gcad sa'i gcad bya bcad chod ces/ /tha snyad 'di ltar btags pa yin/ /'gro dang shar zhes bya ba sogs/ /bya byed tha mi dad pa ste/ /rang gi ngang gis grub pa'i rigs/ /bdag gzhan dbye bas ma khyab bo/ /gnyis/ sngon 'jug gi 'jug don/pho ni 'das dang ma 'ongs dang / /las kyi dngos po sgrub pa yin/ /ma ning gtso cher ma 'ongs dang / /bsgrub par bya ba'i las la 'jug /mo ni ha lam da lta dang / / byed pa dag la 'jug pa yin/ /shin tu mo ni spyir btang du/ / —bdag gzhan dus gsum kun la 'jug /219

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/de yang sngon 'jug rnams ming gzhi rnams la dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa yin zhe na/ sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni/gcig 4sa gsum gyi nang nas byed pa bo gzhan dang dngos su 'grel ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa bsgrub pa'i ched du 'jug pa yin/ dper na/sa bon btab nas me tog bzhad pa'i rjes/—ser ba bkag cing gnod pa tshar du bcad/g.yul kha bcags nas 'bru mdzod bkang bar bzhag—khang bzang bkab cing sa gdan btengs nas bsdad/—lta bu sogs/ bas 'phul kho nas bya ba 'das pa bstan pa dang / de as bzhad pa/ bsdad pa/ lta bu byed pa bo gzhan dang ma 'brel bar rang gi ngang ngam shugs kyis bya ba 'das par grub pa nyung ngu tsam yang yod pa dang / spyir byed pa'i rtsol bar 'jug pa'i bya ba'i ming gi rnam bzhag tshang ba'i 'das par yang 'jug med/ rnam bzhag mi tshang ba'i 'das par yang 'jug yod/gsar brje bsgrubs nas rgyal khab gsar ba btsugs/ /las byed bskyangs pa bzang bas kun gyis bsngags/ /chu mdzod bskyild cing glog gis las rigs bskrund/ /kun la bslangs nas bsgrigs pa'i 'char gzhi bstard/ /lta bu sogs sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug gnyis kas 'das pa bstan pa'o/ /220
