le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/gnyis/ byed pa gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba ma 'ongs pa bsgrub par 'jug pa ste/rtags kyi 'jug pa bslab par bya/ / tshig don brtag phyir dpe cha blta/ / tshod bgam phyir na bsam par 'gyur/ / 'khrul med bsgrub ched bden pa bdar/ / lta bu sogs bas 'phul ma 'ongs pa la spyir yang 'jug mi 'thob pa bo / /gsum/ bdag gzhan gnyis las gzhan te/ bya ba'i yul dang las kyi dngos po bsgrub par 'jug pa/(gsham gsal las la thig rtags dang byed par 'byugs rtags kyis mtshon pa/)bza' btung tshims pa'i dge phrug rnams/ /༷ ༷ bsgrub bya'i don du bslab la 'bungs/ /— —blta rgyu bltas shing bsgyur bya bsgyur/ 1༷ ༷ brtag par bya ba'i gnas la bsam/ /—lta bu sogs bas 'phul ma 'ongs pas las kyi dngos po bsgrubs pa'o/ /sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis ni/ gcig tu/ byed pa gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba ma 'o ngas pa dang / gnyis su/ las kyi dngos po bsgrub par 'jug pa/ mnyam du dper brjod na/ gsad bya'i gte bo kasad par bya/ /

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/de byings gtang bar bya ba ni/ /—gdul bya yin te dam la gdags/ /— sems gso mkhas na gcar bar 'gyur/ /— —lta bu sogs dang /dkar nag dbye ba dpyad par bya/ /༷ dbab bya'i srid jus don du dbab/ /— gcad par bya ba gcad rgyu mgyogs/ /— dge bskul skyon dgag bde la dgod/ / lta du sogs so/ /rtsa bar/ ma ning gnyis ka da ltar ched/ /gsungs pa/ sgo kun la ma brtags pas/ gnad du khel med par mngon/ ma ning gnyis ka gtso cher ma 'ongs par 'jug pa las/ da ltar bar 'jug pa ma yin pa'i rtags gnyis mchis te/ gcig ni/ ming gzhi gcig par 'phul yig mo dang ma ning gnyis ka 'jug rung ba'i rigs la/ da lta bar mo yig 'a ma gtogs ma ning gi 'jug pa med/ dpe cha gdon bya 'don byed/ rgyan cha gdags bya 'dogs byed/ sdun nas dgag bya 'gog byed/ mar la dbab bya 'bebs byed/ lta bu sogs dang / gnyis ni/ ming gzhi brje rung ba'i rigs la yang / da lta bar mo ma gtogs ma ning gi 'jug pa med de — lag tu gzung bya 'dzin byed/ thang la gzhag bya 'jog byed/ chu sogs dbo bya 'pho byed/ dgra sde gzhom bya 'joms 222

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/byed/ lta bu sogs kyis ma ning gtso cher ma 'ongs par 'phul ba gsal/ des na sngon 'jug gi ma ning gnyis kyis da lta ba bsgrub pa ni/ ming gzhi'i dbang gis mo yis 'phul mi rung ba'i rigs tsam ste/ sdong bo gcad bya gcod byed/ phyi ru gtang bya gtong byed/ ras sogs gshag bya gshag byed/ thur du dpyang bya dpyong byed/ khrog sman dbur bya dbur byed/ lta hūṃ sogs ma ning gis da lta bar 'phul ba nyung shas tsam yin la/ 'di rigs las gug gu can/ zhabs kyu byen/ 'greng bu can gsum shed mtshungs pa phud pa gzhan/ na ro med pa can ma 'ongs pa dang / yod pa can da lta ba yin no/ /sngon 'jug gi mo yig 'a ni/ las gang gi byed pa dang / de dang 'grel ba'i bya ba da lta ba bsgrub par 'jug pa/ bal 'breg rnams kyis lug bal 'greg gin yod/ /ba ba ———— 'khel spyad 'phang gis skud pa 'khel bzhin mchis/ /'tha ga byed 'phrul 'khor gyis ni 'thag par byed/ /——ba ba ba 'thag pas thags ma 'tshong mir sprad nas 'khyer/ /ba ba ——ba lta ba sogs dang / bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba med cing bya ba rang gi ngang gis 'grub bzhin pa la'ang 'jug pa mang ste/ sprin 'khrig glog 'khyug char ba ༷bab/ /bye'u mi ༷phur khung du ༷dzul/ 1lta bu sogs kyis gsal/yang / da lta ba mo yig 'as 'phul ba'i rigs las/ ming gzhi'i dbang 223

gi 'o ni gis 'phul mi rung ba nyung/ shis ma ngas pa ma nga sa 'phul rung ba nyung shas ga dang bcas pa/shes/ 111 /bye/ (11 /ste/'a na 'jug sa sgrub pho lod pa dgo/zed lta 'ing 'gran bhe~X ra//༵ 'dze la rtsa me 'bor 'bal//'a ma'am ṭwāṃ da dmi// so bdang ma'ong ba gnyi ka'i/yi/ cilta bu gas da go ba dang ma zings paga~X gro kyis bsgyu gag par gyur pa rnams nga du bshad na pa ltar ga gas sa bsgyur nas khyad pa to gosngo das/ gi shi mo yi 'i tshig giyin 'jug na tu ma ga 'jug pa bya ga ga gzugs rjes/ 11(111 me /ste/ (11rnams ra 'jug yang 'jug dang na da da khyad cung zad na pa 'gyur bye nyung bas/ bdag gzhan dang dus gsum kun la 'jug par 'gyur / khyen mo khyen ci khyenamaX bya sngags byed ma da shig ma da/ba mdzad ma0 dzad ba mdzod cig mdzad/1bab ༵1 ma༅ pa gord cig mad/so 1༅ zlobyemazo bya mtshird ga mgard/ sngolta rdo 4gas dang / brag tu skul ga dang lhag par da lta ba la ma na

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/'jug mi 'thob pa'ang cung tsam yod de/mnyam bya nyan byed nyond cig mnyand/man ma bya nom byed noms shig mnams/———— mnye bya nyed byed mnyes shig mnyes/༷༷ ༷༷ mnab bya nab byed nobs shig mnabs/———— lta bu sogs so/ /sngon 'jug ma bya ba rang shugs su grub par 'jug pa'ang skor zhig yod de/ mnyes pa/ mthun pa/ mngon pa/ lta bu sogs so/ / don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/dang bo/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye —ba dang 'jug tshul/rjes 'jug ga nga da na dang / /ba ma 'a ra la sa bcu'i/ / ga da ba sa bzhi bo pho/ /nga ma 'a gsum mo yin zhing / /na ra la gsum ma ning ste/ /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/pho ni drag pa'i tshul byas nas/ /ga mtha' mgrin pa grim pas dbyung / /da mtha' lce rtse so rtsar sbyar/ /ba mtha' so mchu reg pa las/ /sa mtha' so yi bar nas dbyung / /mo ni zhan pa'i tshul byas nas/ /nga mtha' lce rtse rkan sbyar cing / /ma mtha' mchu btsum sna nas 'dren/ /'a mtha' gre ba'i phugs nas phyung / /ma ning ran pa'i tshul byas nas/ /na mtha' lce rtse so rtsar thug / rlung shugs cung glod sna nas 'phud/ /ra mtha' lce rtse 'dar ba dang / /la mtha' lce rtse rkan sbyar cing / /lce mtha' gnyis nas rlung phyir gdon/ /pho la skyes bu rab 'bring gsum/ / ga mthar sa sbyar skyes bu rab/ /drag pa'i drag par 'don pa yin/ /226

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/drag pa'i ༷ na dī ra dī~Xg par bya/ // / yang 'jug med pa pho mtha' ni/ /drag pa'i zhan par brjod pa 'o/ /mo la mo dang shin tu mo/ /nga mar sa sbyar mo tsam ni/ /zhan pa'i drag par 'don pa dang / /sa mtha' med pa shin tu mo/ /zhan pa'i zhan par brjod pa 'o/ /ma ning 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang / /mtshan med ma ning gsum du dbye/ /yang 'jug yod dam med kyang rung / /pho dang phrad na drag par 'gyur/ /bar ma'i drag par 'don pa dang / /drag med mo phrad zhan par 'gyur/—/bar ma'i zhan par brjod pa ste/ /de gnyis 'gyur ba ma ning yi na/ / yang 'jug ldan pa mo dang phrad/ / cho

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/drag zhan gnyis ka'i cha ldan pas/ /mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes bya ste/ /zhan nas drag par gdon par bya/ /da drag yod dam med kyang rung /ma ning rang dang phrad pa na/bar ma tsam du klog pa ste/mtshan med ma ning zhes bya 'o/ / rjes 'jug bcu bo ming gzhi gang rung gi rjes su 'jug pa'i tshe/ ga da ba sa bzhi bo sgra drag par gyur pas pho dang / nga ma 'a gsum sgra zhan par gyur pas mo dang / na ra la gsum sgra bar mar gyur pas ma ning du gyur to/ /de yang gang ming brjod par/ 'phul dang ming gzhi dang bcas pa'i sgra rnams rtags kyi dbye ba ltar zur dbyung dgos par ma zad/ rjes 'jug gi sgra'ang rtags kyi dbye ba bzhin zur 'thon par 'jug dgos/ des na ming gzhi'i rjes 'jug pho yig yin na/ de dag gi sgra gdangs drag pa ste shed che ba'i tshul gyis gdon pa yin zhing / nang gses kyi khyad par ni dper na/ slog pa yag pa sgyun pa zhig dang thug /rab rgyas tshang ni gang na bsdad yod dris/ /ṭwāṃ dī bye ༷dī/ ༵ga da ༷ sgra/ slo ( gi dī nga mtha/ zhi 'thu ༵ga ce dī ༵mgrin ༷rte dam pa/ra ༵rdo 228

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/nas grag par byed pa dang / de bzhin rjes 'jug gzhan rnams kyi sgra la'ang rang rang zhugs sa'i ming gzhi'i dbyangs gang yin pa ldan par bya'o/ /bsdad dang yod kyi sgra mtha' ad dang yod ces lce rtse rkan dang 'brel ba'i so rtsar sbyar nas grag par byed pa dang / rgyas dang dris kyi sgra mtha' as is zhes rlung shugs lce ngos dang so'i bar nas phyung ste grag par byed pa lta bu'o/ /ming gzhi'i rjes 'jug mo yig yin na/ de dag gi sgra gdangs zhan pa ste shed lhod pa'i tshul gyis gdon zhing / nang gses kyi khyad par dper brjod na/mar rtsam zos shing zho 'o 'thung /— /yid tshim sems dga' ngo yang 'dzum / /zhes pa las yang / shing / 'thung gsum gyi sgra mtha' 'ang 'ing 'ung gsum lce rtsa rkan la sbyar cing rlung sna nas phyung ste grag par byed pa dang / rtsam/ tshim/'dzum gsum gyi sgra mtha' 'am/ 'im/ 'um gsum kha btsums shing rlung sna nas phyung ste grag par byed pa dang / dga' yi sgra mtha' 'a ni mgrin pa phye zhing sna nas cung zad phyung nas grag par byed pa dang / zho lta bur rjes 'jug 'a don gyis thob pas sgra mtha' 'o zhes grag par byed pa lta bu'o/ / ming gzhi'i rjes 'jug ma ning yin na/ de dag gi sgra gdangs bar ma ste/shed ran pa'i tshul gyis gdon zhing / nang gses kyi khyad par ni dper na/'gyur bzhi'i phrin las spel ba la/ /rgyund rgyal kha len par brtson/ /zhes pa las/ phrin/ she/ len/ brtson bzhi'i sgra mtha' in/ un/ en/ yon bzhi 229

brda sprod gsal byed ngas sgron/ lce rtse rkan dang 'grel ba'i so rtsar sbyar cing rlung sna la drangs nas grag par byed pa dang / 'gyur dang/ par gyi sgra mtha' ur dang ar ni/ lce rtse gyen du —bslangs shing rlung gis bskyod nas grag par byed pa dang / rgyal dang/ spel gyi sgra mtha' al dang el ni/ lce rtse rkan la sbyar cing dbugs mtha' gnyis nas phyung ste grag par byed pa'o/ /de lugs legs par shes na/ ming gzhi gang rung gi rjes 'jug da ba phan tshun dang / na ma phun tshun dang / e ldan mtha' med dang e med sa mtha' can phan tshun nor mi srid do/ /rjes 'jug la yang 'jug zhugs yod med kyi dbang gis sgra'i 'jug tshul tha dad pa brgyad du gyur pa las/ ming gzhi gang gi mthar yang rung /rjes 'jug pho yig rnams zhugs pa sgra drag pha gzhir bzhag pa'i nang gses ga mthar yang 'jug sa zhugs pa na/ 'jug yang 'jug pho yig gnyis phrad pa'i stobs kyis/ brjod pha'i sgra gdangs drag pa'i drag par 'gyur ba la skyes bu rab ces bya ste/ pags/ khegs/ bsgrigs/ sngogs/ lhugs/ lta bu sogs 'jug yang 'jug ga dang sa gnyis ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs rtags gang rung la zhugs kyang / rang gi nus pas lce rtsa rkan la btegs shing ya mgal ma mgal cung zad btsum zhing dam pa dang / shed ches che ba'i tshul gyis 'don pa'o/ /ba mthar yang 'jug sa zhugs pa na/ rjes 'jug pho yig gnyis phrad 230

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/pa'i stobs kyis brjod pa'i sgra gdangs drag pa'i bar mar 'gyur ba la skyes —bu 'bring zhes bya ste/ rtibs/ thabs/ bsgrubs/ snyobs/ 'debs/ lta bu sogs 'jug yang 'jug ba sa gnyis ming gzhi gang gi rjes su zhugs kyang / rang nus kyis ma mchu ya sor sbyar cing / rlung so bar nas phyung ste/ shed che ba'i tshul gyis brjod pa'o/ /ga da ba sa bzhi bo gang nyid ming gzhi gang rung gi rjes su 'jug pa na/brjod pa'i sgra gdangs drag pa'i zhan par 'gyur bas skyes bu tha ma zhes bya ste/rjod tshul bshad zin pa ltar shed cung zad che ba'i tshul gyis klog pa'o/ /ming gzhi gang rung gi mthar/ rjes 'jug mo yig rnams zhugs pa sgra zhan pa gzhir bzhag pa'i nang gses nga ma gnyis la yang 'jug sa zhugs pa na/ rjes 'jug mo dang yang 'jug pho nang phrad kyi stobs kyis brjod pa'i sgra gdangs zhan pa'i drag par 'gyur ba la mo tsam zhes bya ste/ spangs/ khengs/ljongs/ dngangs/ rungs/ skyems/ 'thams/ bsdoms/ mnams/ lta bu sogs 'jug yang 'jug nga dang sa gnyis ming gzhi gang gi rjes su zhugs kyang /rang gi nus pas mgrin pa lhod par cung zad btsums shing rlung sna nas phyung ba dang sprags/ kha gdangs pa je chung du bsgyungs pas/ shed zhan pa cung zad drag par 'gyur ba'o/ / nga ma 'a gang nyid rjes 'jug byas pa ka/ rang nus kyis brjod pa'i sgra 231

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gdangs zhan pa'i zhan par 'gyur ba la shin tu mo zhes bya ste/ rjod tshul bshad zin pa ltar sa mtha' can las shed cung zad zhan par 'don pa'o/ /ming gzhi gang rung la rjes 'jug ma ning zhugs pa/ sgra bar ma gzhir bzhag pa'i nang gses/ na ra la gsum la yang 'jug da yod dam med kyang /ming gzhi pho dang phrad pha'i nus pas/ brjod pa'i sgra gdangs bar ma'i drag par 'gyur ba yin te/ dkond/ cer/ brtol/ dpard/ btsald/ lta bu sogs ming gzhi pho yi byed rtsol gyi nus pas/ yang 'jug da yod med gang rung gi rjes 'jug ma ning dag gi sgra je drag tu 'gyur ba'o/ /ma ning gsum yang 'jug med par ming gzhi mo dang phrad pa'i nus pas/brjod pa'i sgra gdangs bar ma'i zhan par 'gyur ba/ gan/ 'jun/ sbyin/'or/ gnyer/ lhur/ rmel/ mnal/ rol/ lta bu sogs ming gzhi mo yi byed rtsol gyi dbang gis/ rjes 'jug ma ning gi sgra je zhan du 'gyur ba yin te/rigs 'di gnyis rim bzhin/ drag dang phrad na drag par 'gyur/ /zhan dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur/ /zhes 'gyur ba ma ning du grags pa yin no/ /ma ning gsum ming gzhi zhan cing yang 'jug drag pa'i bar du zhugs pa na/ drag zhan gnyis dang phrad pa'i stobs kyis brjod pa'i sgra gdangs bar ma'i drag pa dang zhan pha gnyis ka'i cha dang ldan par gyur pa na1 mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes bya ste/ brgyand/ nyond/ mnard/ brdard/ bruld/232

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/meld/ lta bu sogs sgra zhan pa nas je drag tu 'gyur ba yin/ma ning gsum ming gzhi ma ning la zhugs pa'i tshe/ yang 'jug yod med ji ltar yang / sgra drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bar/ bar ma nyid du gnas pa na/ mtshan med ma ning zhes bya ste/ mkhyend/ mchan/ thor/ phrald/khyerd/ 'tshal/ lta bu sogs brjod pa'i sgra gdangs ran pa tsam yin no/ /gnyis ba/ rjes 'jug gi 'jug yul/rjes 'jug bcu bo sgra tsam du/ /ming gzhi kun la 'jug rung yang / / ming dang phrad du mi 'grub pa'i/ /ming gzhi rnams la mi 'jug go / yang 'jug da sa gnyis yin te/ /ga nga ba mar yang 'jug sa/ / —na ra la mthar yang 'jug da/ /spyir btang 'jug ste skabs thob sbyar/ /rna shes kyi 'jug yul gang don dang ldan mi ldan la mi ltos par sgra tsam mtshon pa la/ rjes 'jug bcu bo ming gzhi thams cad la 'jug rung ngo / /de la don dang ldan pa dper na/ nor/ mda'/ rkus/ sgrog brtan/mdzes/ drug stong / lta bu sogs la rjes 'jug sbyar bas/ dngos po'am/ bya 233

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ba'am/ khyad chos sam/ grangs ka ci rigs shig gi ngo bo tsam brjod pa'i ming du grub pa dang/ gis/ tam/ cing / zhes/ lta bu rnams la rjes 'jug sbyar bas/ don gyi khyad par mtshon byed kyi rnam dbye dang tshig phrad kyi sgrar gyur pa yin no/ /don dang mi ldan pa dper na/ hag mgud/ rjon/ spyal/ lta bu rnams rjes 'jug sbyar ba ba klog sa 'gro yang / ming phrad gang du'ang mi 'gyur zhing sgra tsam du zad pas/ bod rang gi tha snyad du 'jug pa med mod/ yin na yang / mi rigs gzhan gyi'am/ sems can nam bem po ci rigs shig gi sgra tsam mtshon par sbyar chog go/ yang 'jug da sa gnyis kyang spyir rang rang thob sa'i rjes 'jug rnams dang— bcas te 'jug yul gyi ming gzhi kun la 'jug rung yang / bye brag tu dus kyi rnam bzhag dang/ ming gi khyad par sogs la bltos nas/ don gyis thob pa ltar 'jug dgos/ dper na/ bsgyugs so/ /grongs zin/ 'dems shigathums dang/ phyind to/ /bsgyurd tshar/ khyerd cig speld dang / yongs rdzogs/ stobs shugs/ phyugs rigs/ lta bu sogs te/ de rnams la yang 'jug ma sbyar na/ ldog pa'am ngo bo gzhan mtshon par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa/ 'jug yang 'jug gi 'jug don/ming gi sgrub byed rjes 'jug ste/ / ming rnams gang las 'byung ba'i gzhir/ /

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/pa rjes 'jug bcu bo ma bcug na/ / don gyi ngo bo ston mi srid/ / bya ba'i ldog pa tha dad dang / / sgra gcig ming don mi gcig pa/ /ston byed gtso bo yang 'jug ste/ /don thob ji bzhin 'jug pa yin/ /brjod pha'i sgrub byed tshig dang / tshig gi sgrub byed ming / ming gi sgrub byed yi ge'o/ /yi ge ming du 'grub mi 'grub/ rjes 'jug kho nar rag las pas na/ sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/ sngon 'jug yod dam med kyang rung / /ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yin la/ /nyis 'brel yod dam sum 'brel yod/ /a li bzhi las gang ldan yang / /rjes 'jug bcu bo ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ rjes 'jug ci'i phyir 'jug pa'i gnad bstan pa yin no/ /'o na/ me/ lha/ sngo/ mtho/ dkri/ brgya/ lta du sogs la rjes 'jug med mod/ ming du grub 'dug pa min nam zhe na/ skad gsar bcad du/dga'/ gda'/ 'ba'/ bka'/ dpa'/ lta bu sogs kyi 'a mtha' spangs na/ la la sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi 'khrul bar 'gyur ba dang / la la sgra sbyor du mi rung bar 'gyur ba'i dgos dbang gis rang sor bzhag pa ma gtogs/'a mtha' zor yang bas bsdus kyang mi skyon pa mtha' dag dngos su mi 'bri 235

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/bar mdzad mod kyi/ thob thang med pa ni ma yin te/ rnam dbye tshig phrad dang ming mtha' 'dren tshul gyis gsal/ mdor na/ 'a mtha' rkyang 'phul rnams la dgos/ /mgo 'dogs dbyangs ldan rnams la spangs/ /yang 'jug gi 'jug don ni/ bya ba'i ldog pa tha dad pa dang/ ming gi brjod bya khyad par ba sgrub par byed pa yin te/dang bor dper na/ bya ba'i ming / bslab/ slob/ bslabs/ slobs bzhi bo shes par byed pa'i cha nas ngo bo gcig kyang / dus gsum dang bcas pa'i cha nas ldog pa so so ba yin pa dang / gdon/ 'don/ bton/ thon bzhi bo klog pa'i don du ngo bo gcig kyang / dus skye thad du ldog pa mi gcig go /des na yang 'jug bya ba'i ming du phal cher 'das pa dang skul tshig la 'jug go/ gnyis par dper na/ grogs pos mar grog 'khyen/ /lug gi 'gro lugs bzang / lta du dngos po'i ming khyad par ba'o/ /khur yang bag yangs po/ rings par ring du thon/ /lta du khyad chos kyi ming khyad par ba'o/ /'phag nas yar la 'phags/ /then pas gzhas kyang 'thend/ /lta bu bya ba'i ming gi khyad par ba'o/ / deng rabs bu rab tsho/ /phyugs las spel nas phyug lta bu dngos po dang 236

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/khyad chos gnyis su bye ba'i ming khyad par ba'o/ /logs su log 'ong ba'i/ /gzig la gzigs par 'gyur/ /lta du dngos po dang bya ba gnyis su phye ba'i ming khyad par ba'o/ / dog kyang dogs mi dgos/ /drang mor drangs na 'drong / /lta du khyad chos dang bya ba gnyig su phye ba'i ming khyad par ba sogs su bsgrubs pa ha cang mang dzes —bzhi ba/ 'jug mang 'jug goming mtha' 'dren tshul/ming gzhi gang gi mtha' rten te/ /—rjes 'jug yang 'jug gang yin yang / /ming gi cha shas phyi ma dang / /rnam dbye tshig phrad drang ba la/ /phal cher rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dang / / nyung shas gnas mtshungs 'dren pa ste/ /gnyis ka'ang brjod bde 'i dren pa yin/ /'jug yang 'jug gis ming mtha' ste ming gi cha shas phyi ma 'dren pa 'di/'dod rgyal gyi ming ngam ming rkyang ba bsgrub pa la dmigs pa yin gyi/ rjes grub kyi ming ngam ming 'dus ma dang ming gi tshogs pa bsgrub pha la dmigs pa ma yin no/ /ming mtha' 'dren pa la rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dang / gnas 237

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/mtshungs 'dren pa rigs gnyis yod cing / gnyis ka'ang brjod bde ba'i phyir ro/ /de la rtags mtshungs 'dren pa ni/ pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drang / /mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drang / /ma ning gis ni ma ning ngo / /zhes pa ltar/ming snga ma'i rjes 'jug ga da ba sa bzhi ga dang / yang 'jug da sa gnyis gang rung gis/ ming de nyid kyi cha shas phyi ma pho yig ka ca ta pa tsa lnga bo dbyangs dang ldan mi ldan gang rung zhig drangs pa'o/ /thog ka ltag ka cig car/ dbyug to/ gcig pa/ tsog pu/ cog tse/ tog tse/ dpyid ka berd ka zhald ta/ 'dod pa/ chad po/ grod pu/ nub kabatab pa/ tsub po/ gab tse/ skas ka stabs ka gsus pa/ lus po/ grogs po/lta bu sogs so/ /rjes 'jug mo nga ma 'a gsum pos/ ming mtha' mo yig ga ja da ba dza wa zha za 'a ya sha sa nga nya na ma ra la ha rnams dbyangs dang ldan mi ldan gang rung zhig drangs pa'o/ / gsum ga ljang gu/ jo jo/ sre da/ gang du/ ngo bo/ ldum bu/ che zhe/ za ba/gu ya/ khu yu/ zhe sa/ 'u su/ lha nga/ snang ngu/ zha nye/ ma ne/ gong ma/ mda' mo/byu ru/ bze re/ lta bu sogs so/ /lnga bo bhe~X ༵ ldan ṭwāṃ rnyi nan gang dī ༷ draX dī ༵ ṭwāṃ/nga/ mtha' ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha 238

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/dgun kha/ g.yul kha/ g.yer kha/ mtshon cha/ dkor cha/ rol cha/ mel tshe/dbal tsha lta bu sogs so/ /rtags mtshungs 'dren pa khyab che yang / skor zhig de ltar sbyar na brjod mi bde bas/ gnas mtshungs 'dren par byed do/ /gnas mtshungs 'dren pa ni/ rjes 'jug gi skye gnas kyis ming mtha'i skye gnas rang dang gcig pa'am nye ba zhig drangs pa ste/ rim pa/ sdom pa/ zhim po/ skum po/ grib ma/ rib ma/ mdzub mo/ 'thab mo/ bstod ra/ smad ra/mtshal li/ mas le/ lta bu sogs gnas mtshungs 'dren pa'o/ / mthun pa/ tshon po/ ston mo/ khrol ma/ rol mo/ ltad mo/ dred mong / nor du/ sor mo/ thal ba/ lta bu sogs gnas bsnyen 'dren pa'o/ /ming gi sbyor ba las/ 'jug yang 'jug zhas ming mtha' rtags mtshungs sam gnas mtshungs drangs pa min yang / de ltar sbyar ba shin tu mang / lag pod/ stod kor/ 'thab grol/ zhabs tog yungs dkur/ dgang zag chem zhu/ mtha' 'khob/ phun tshogs/ sher phyin/ yul khams/ lha bu sogs rtags mtshungs sbyar ba'o/ /prog zhu/ rtog ge gyid lug lo thang / dor rta/ tshal nan/ blo bzang/tsan dan/ lta du sogs gnas mtshungs sbyar ba ste/ rjod pa bde ba'i sgo nas ngag snyan par grub pa sdeb sbyor gyi mchog byin pa yin no/ /'jug yang 'jug gis phrad kyi sgra sogs 'dren pa la/ rnam dbye drug pa 239

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/dper mtshon na/ da ba sa kyi ga nga gi /na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi/ /'a dang mtha' med 'i dang yi/ /zhes pa las/ rjes 'jug gi pho yig da ba sa gsum la kyi dang / mo yig ma la gye dang / 'a la 'i'am yi sbyar ba rtags mtshungs drangs pa dang / pho yig ga la gi dang / ma ning na ra la gsum la gyi dzin ba/gnas mtshungs drangs pa yin no/ /'o na rjes 'jug da ba sa gsum la ki zhes mi 'jug par/ kyi zhes 'jug don gang zhe na/ da ba sa gsum gyi sgra rim bzhin lce rtse dang / mchu dang / so las byur ba'i rkyen gyis/ lce rtsa dang mgrin pa las byung ba'i ki sgra ston na bzhun cha zhan pa dang / lce rtsa dang mgrin pa ma bde ba'i phyir rjo/ yan/ byed ༵ṭwāṃ dī dī rdo dī ṭwāṃ na~X na rnyi/ba ma/'di nim khas pa gang zhig gi blo bzo min gyi/ gna' mi'i ngag gi sdeb sbyor las ngang gis grub pa yin no/ / yang / tshig phrad kyi rgyan sdud dper mtshon na/ ga da ba sa drag mthar kyang / /nga na ma ra la mthar yang / /'a dang mtha' med 'ang dang yang / /zhes pa las/ 'jug yang 'jug pho yig ga da ba sa rnams la kyang dang / mo yig nga ma 'a gsum la yang('a dang mtha' med la 'ang dang yang)sbyar ba ni rtags mtshungs drangs pa dang / ma ning na ra la gsum la rgyan sdud kyi sgra ma ning med pas yang sgra sbyar ba yin mod/ rtags gnas gang mtshungs min pas brjod pa 240

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bzhi ba1 sgra mtshungs bsgyur bas nyams mtshon tshul/de 'dra mi bde'o/ /kha skad du yin yang la yin rung zhes pas gsal/ de bzhi de gzhan rnams kyang rigs bsgro bar bya'o/ / don tshan bzhi ba/ sgra mtshungs bsgyur bas nyams mtshon tshul/ khyad chos ston pa'i ming rnams las/ / sgra mtshungs mnyam sbyor rigs gnyis mchis1 / gcig di sgra gnyis kun tu mtshungs/ /cig shos nga ro yod med tsam/ /de rnams don nyams mtshon pa la/ / sgra gdangs bsgyur ba'i khyad par gyis/ / mthong thos dran reg gang brjod pa/ /mngon sum snang ba ji bzhin yin/ / — sgra mtshungs pa gnyis mnyam du sbyar ba/ dbor na/ tsha tsha/ pi pi/ khru nga khrung / phum phum/ kla klo/ zhang zhung / lta bu sogs nyung nyung zhig dngos po'i ming du grub pa ma gtogs/ phal cher khyad chos kyi ming du grub ste/ gzugs(kha dog las rtsa ba'i kha dog sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi dang / yan lag gi kha dog snang ba/ mun pa/ grib ma/ nyi 'od/ sprin/ du ba/ rdul/ khug sna brgyad dang / dbyibs ring thung / lham skum/ mtho dma'/ phya le ba/ phya le ba 241

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/min pa dang brgyad bcas 'dus)dang / sgra(zin pa'i sgra dang ma zin pha'i sgra 'dus)dang / reg bya('byung ba'i reg rme sa chu me rlung bzhi dang / 'byung — — 'gyur gyi reg bya 'jam tsub/ lci yang / bkres skom/ grang ba bdun bcas 'dus)dang /— bya ba (rigs gsum 'dus)dang / yid kyi 'gyur ba sogs gang — — ༷ — ༷༷ —ci'i khyad chos sna tshogs mtshon pa'o/ /de la ming gi grub lugs rnam pa gnyis yod de/—gcig ming gang rung gi cha shas snga phyi gnyis ka gcig pa/kyur kyur/ khyug khyug gul gul/ lcig lcig chil chil/ ljab ljab/ rtab rtab/ tham tham/ dob dob/ nar nar/ phrul phrul/ spud spud/ mog mog tsar tsar/ 'dzong 'dzong/ zir zir/ 'ur 'ur/ yab yab/ sig sig lhung lhung/ lta bu sogs so/ /'di'i rigs las/ sgra grag tshul dang / gzugs g.yo tshul la/ spyir btang rags pa tsam mam/ cung dal ba bar mtshams yod pa dang / myur ba bar mtshams med pa dag mtshon par/ gang gi rjes 'jug ra'am la yin na/rim bzhin/ kyur kyur mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur mkhas pa/ bye'u phrug kyu ru kyu shes bas — — —ru grag shug lu kyu ru ru 'bud/ lta bu grag tshul dang / thigs chu tsar tsar — — — — shes bsabyed/ khrag tsam bhe song / gos bkrus nas gcus pa dang chu bhe hūṃ ka 'bab/ lta bu 'byung tshul dang / sa 'gul byung nas khang ba gul gul g.yo/ glog skud gu ——— ——— —242

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ sgra mtshungs bsgyur bas nyams mtshon tshul/༅lu byed/ lta bu 'gul tshul te/ rnam pa spyi tsam pa la sgra 'dra ba gnyis re dang / dal sal so so'i ming gzhi dang rjes 'jug tsheg gis bar phye zhing de la ming gzhi'i dbyangs drangs pa dang / mgyogs na ming gzhi phyi ma dor bar byu1rngo(/ / —mtha' rten can gzhan dag yin na/ phrag shing lcig lcig ldem/ khyi rgan lam du dungs se dung / tsha rgyas nas rtsa spud spud byed//glog zhu khra khra rig rig mig deb pab za bzhin 'khyugs se 'khyugaX sgo thag thag thag tu rdung / lta bu 'gul tshul grag tshul sogs spyi re btang ba la sgra 'ad ba gnyis re dang / cung tsam dal ba la sgra gnyis re'i bar du se sgra bsnan pa dang / mgyogs par sgra gsum bskyar bar bya'o/ / pa gzugs kyi dbyibs sam kha dog dang / bya ba sogs kyi khyad chos tsam mtshon rngor/ ri 'dzong 'dzong / gon rgyu lug lug 'od lam lam/ rtswa sngo sngo /rta rkyang rkyang / rtab rtab por yar ba4 me lhab lhab 'bar/ lta bu sog sa dang / de rnams glo dur du 'gyur ba'am gsal bar mngon pa sogs kyi nyams mtshon par/ khyad zos kyi ming gi cha shas phyi ma bsubs mthar/ rjes 'jug rang 'dra zhig la 'greng bu sbyar ba/ me 'ur re 'bar/ thag pa rbad de chad/ rdo ring lhan ne 'greng / bco lnga'i zla ba lam me— ba/ lta byu sogs dang —/ yang na/khyad chos skye ming 'brel chags pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar mthar/ rjes 'jug 243

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/rang 'dra e dang ldan pa zhig sbyar ba/ me tog dmar ldem me bzhad/ g.yag rgan nag 'jol le ba zhig nor khyur 'ongs/ bgro/ thu thag sder re sar lhung /slog pa lci stug ge ba zhig sgyun/ lta bu sogs so/ /gnyis/ ming gang rung gi cha shas snga mar dbyangs bzhi gang yang med pa dang / phyi mar dbyangs bzhi gang rung zhig sbyar yod pa ste/chal chol/ ljan ljin/ rnyang rnying/ rtab rtob/ than thun/ ldam ldem/ phyad phyod/ brang greng / myag spyog rtsab rtsub/ tsham tshom/ rdzan rdzun/ zhar zhor/ zam zim/ 'ar 'ur/ yar yer/ rab rib/ lang ling / shar shur/ sab sob/ hral hrul/ lta bu sogs so/ /de yang gzugs kyi dbyibs sam rnam pa'am g.yo ba gang ci'i ngang tshul dang / yid kyi 'gyur ba sogs bskyar zlos su byung bar mtshon na/ ming gang gi rjes 'jug rang 'dra la 'greng du re sbyar ba/(cha shas snga ma'i rjes 'jug bsdus chog)dper na/ tha gu thang nge thung nge/ lam kya ge kyog ge gon rgyu rnya nge ༵ bhe/ nas sna sgyura~X bas khral bye~X ༵ / chang 'byas / bzungs lta bu so nas gas bye re yin ba/ rngo smyo yin dus/—kha cig gis/ kyag kyog thar thor/ lta bu sogs ni kyag ge kyog ge tha re sogs khyad sbyos ba mtshon dī dka ṭwāṃ bye bye rdo dngo ༷na da rdo/ / kya~X ge kyo ga ge da/ nga /ra tha re thor re sogs kyag kyog dang / thar thor sogs kyi bskyar zlos yin no//244

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ bod skad kyi sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul/don tshan lnga ba/ sdod skad kyi sgra gdangs ka thun par 'gyur tshul/gangs can skad du tha snyad mang bo zhig /ngag nes rjod tshe phan tshun byed rtsol gyis/ / sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs 'di / / legs par rtogs na 'gi klog kun la phan/ / — rtsa bod yig ni bod skad kyi khyad chos thun mong ba ji bzhin gtan la phab pa yin pas/ bod skad dang thod mi thug sa med mo ga yin na yang bod skad kyi tha snyad mang bo zhig ngag tu brjod par sgra gdangs mthun par —'gyur ba'i gnas lugs ma rtogs pa gtso bor bzung ba'i kha cig gis/ bod yig dang bod skad thod mi thug ces bla brdol sprad rje / zlos gar sogs kyi tshig sbyor go sla bar byed ched/ kha skad ltar yi ge gang 'dod du bris pa dag cha nyams pa'i dbang gis/ gzhan gyis bltas na lhag par go dka' bar gyur snang / la las de lugs ma shes par/ yi ge dag par 'bri 'dod 'dod du ma dag pa byol med du bris pa'ang sna nga / de'i phyir 'dir bod skad kyi sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul mdor bsdus shig spro bar bya'o/ / sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi'am/ tsheg khyim snga phyi'i sgra gdangs 'gang mi gcig kyang / ngag nas rjod pa'i tshe/ byedage gyi shan phan tshun zhugs nas sgra 246

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gdangs mthun par gyur 'gro la/ 'di ni brjod bde ba'i bla thabs shig ste/sgra gdangs gnyis mthud nas myur bar klog tshe/ gnas dang byed pa'i sbyor ba mi 'dra ba de gnyis ka'i khyad chos ji bzhin bklag dgos na/ brjod mi bde phyir/ de gnyis ka'i sgra rtsol mthun par bsgyur nas brjod bde bar byed pa yin no/ /de la lugs 'byung mthun 'gyur/ lugs ldog mthun 'gyur/ bye brag mthun 'gyur/ yongs rdzogs mthun 'gyur/ nang gses mthun 'gyur/ phyi rol mthun 'gyur bcas rnam pa drug yod do/ /dang bo/ lugs 'byung mthun 'gyur/ming gcig gi cha shas ma mas cha shas phyi ma mthun par byed pa zhig yin/de yang gtso cher snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi gnas dang byed pa'i rtsol ba bsrangs pa'i shugs kyis/ phyi ma'i ming gzhi'i rang sgra 'byung khom med par/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi sgra'i khyad chos dang mthun par 'gyur ba yin no/ /dper na/ga lag pa la lag hwa/ las legs po la las legs two/ grogs po la grogs hwa/ mthug po la mthug go ltar grags pa sogs ni/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug ga yi lce rtsa dang mgrin pa'i rtsol ba dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas pa phyi mar 'dres nas/ phyi ma'i ming gzhi'i sgra grag tshul mthun par gyur pa'o/ /nga ngang ba la ngang nga / rkang dung la rkang 'dung / seng ge la seng 'gesdong bo la sdong 'ong ltar grags pa sogs snga ma'i rjes 'jug nga dang dbyangs 246

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ bod skad kyi ma gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul/kyi byed rtsol gyi khyad chos phyi ma'i ming gzhir zhugs nas sna nas rlung rgyu pas sgra mthun par gyur ba'o/ / da bstod ra la bstod dra/ skad rigs la skad drigs/ bod yig la bod cig 'od zer la 'od tser ltar grags pa sogs/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug da yi byed rtsol phyi ma'i ming gzhir zhugs nas sgra mthun par gyur pa'o/ /na srin bu la srin 'bu/ tshon po mtshon 'bo/ kun rigs la kun 'drig1 don grub la don 'grub ltar grags pa sogs/ snga ma 'i rjes 'jug gi na sgra phyi ma'i ming gzhir zhugs nas sgra mthun par gyur pa'o/ /ma skam pa la skam 'ba'1 —thom du la thom 'bu/ dam pe la dam 'be/'dam bag la 'dam 'bag ltar grags pa sogs/ sdo ma'i mchu btsums pa'i sna sgra mi mar zhugs nas sgra mthun par gyur mas / — 'a lha khang la lha 'ang / wa zhwa la wa ya/ bcu drug la bcu rug phyi dro la phyi ro ltar grags pa sogag snga ma'i shugs bstan gyi 'a rjes 'jug gi rtsol ba phyi mar zhugs nas sgra mthun par gyur pa'o/ /ra dkar bo la dkar ra/ nor du la nor ru/ ser ba la ser ra/ myur bo la sgyur ro ltar grags pa sogs/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug ra'i 'dar sgra phyi mar zhugs nas sgra mthun par gyur pa'o/ / la yol ba la yol la/ ril shu༄ ril lu/ gdal bu la gdal lu/ rul 247

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/dri la rul ri ltar grags pa sogs las/ sdun ma gsum gyi rjes 'jug gis phyi mar mthun par byas pa dang / rjes ma ni ming gzhi dang rjes 'jug gnyis kas phyi mar mthun par byas byung /sa dpa' ris skad du/ chos pa la chos bsa' rtsis pha la rtsis bsa'/gnyis ka la gnyis ska/ las ka la las ska ltar grags pa sogs/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi byed rtsol phyi mar zhugs nas sgra mthun par gyur pa dang / rogs pa la rogs bsa' zhes grag sa pa/ yang 'jug gi sgra phyi mar zhugs nas mthun par gyur pa'o/ / gnyis pa/ lugs lhog mthun 'gyur/ming gcig gi cha shas phyi mas cha shas snga ma mthun par byed pa ste/ phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gi byed rtsol sdun la shor nas/ snga ma'i ming gzhi'am rjes 'jug la khyad chos de zhugs nas sgra mthun par 'gyur ba yin/ dper na/ sa gzhi lnga sag gzhi/ mda' gzhu la mdag gzhu ltar grags pa ni/ klog mgyogs pa'i dbang gis/ snga ma'i 'a mtha' dngos shugs ci rigs kyi sgra ma thon par/phyi ma'i gas 'phul gyi sgra thon byung ba'i phyir ro/ / mi dgos la mir dgos dang / ma dka' thal la mar dka' thal ltar grags pa ni/ das 'phul gyi byed rtsol snga ma'i 'a mtha8 la zhugs shing rlung gis bskyod nas cung zad 'dar byung ba'i phyir ro/ /248

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ bod skad kyi sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul/— rgyu mtshan la rgyum tshan/ rgyal mtshan la rgyan mtshan ltar grags pa ni/ phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gi byed rtsol snga ma'i rjes 'jug la zhugs nas mchu btsums pa'i sna sgra thon byung ba'i phyir ro/ / go 'phang la 'go 'phang ltar grags pa ni/ phyi ma'i zha —sngon 'jug gi sgra snga ma'i ming gzhir zhugs nas sgra zor yang bar gyur pa dang / dkyil 'khor la dkyin 'khor ltar grags pa/ 'as 'phul gyi byed rtsol snga ma'i la mthar zhugs nas/ la sgra 'an sgrar gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa/ bye zag mthun 'byur/ byed rtsol gyi dbang gis/ ming gi cha shas gcig gi bye brag cha shas cig shos kyi tshab byas nas sgra mthun par 'gyur ba dang / cha shas gcig gi bye brag ste dbyangs brjes nas/ cha shas cig shos dang sgra mthun par 'gyur ba rigs gnyis yod de1 snga ma dper na/ dar ba la da ra dang / phyar ba la phya ra dang / phyur ba la phyu ra ltar grags pa ni/ cha shas snga ma'i rjes 'jug ra de cha shas phyi ma'i ba'i tshab byas nas/ phyi ma snga ma'i bye brag tsam du sgra mthun par gyur pa lta bu'o/ /phyi ma dper na/ bu mo la bo mo ltar yigs la/ smad pa'i nga ro dang bstod pa'i nga ro mtho dman mi gcig pa gnyis mthud༄ nas klog tshe brjod mi bde phyir/ sgra 'phang mnyam par byas nas snga ma'i zhabs kyu phyi ma'i na ro'i dbang 249

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/du shor ba dang / bcu lnga la bco lnga dang / bcu brgyad la bco brgyad du bris pa yang / smad pa'i nga ro dang drang ba'i nga ro mthud nas 'don tshe brjod mi bde ༷ bas/ phan tshun sdeb mthun par bcos nas/ snga ma'i bye brag ste zhabs rtsan ror brjes te/ bstod pa'i nga ro dang drang ba'i nga ro sdeb mthun par gyur pa ༷ lta bu'o/ / bzhi ba/ yongs rdzogs mthun 'gyur/ khyad gzhi'am tshig grogs gzhan dang 'brel ba'i ming gcig gi cha shas gnyis myur bar klog tshe/ phan tshun shan zhugs nas yongs rdzogs sgra gcig tu mthun phar 'gyur ba zhig ste/ dper na/sgo nga / sla nga / po ti lta bu sogs/ drugs bsdus nas khyad gzhi dang thad kar sbyar tshe/ bya sgong / khro slang / gsung pod ltar sgra gcig tu mthun par gyur pas/ de bzhin bris pa'o/ / — byu ru/ rdo rje/ shes rab lta bu sogs tshig grogs dang 'grel tshe/ byur dkar/ phyag rdor/ sher 'od ltar sgra gcig tu mthun par gyur pas/ de bzhin bris pa yin no/ / gzhan yang / thu ba la tho' dang / 'phye ba la 'phyo' dngan mche ba la mcho' ltar grags pa sogs kyang / rjes 'jug 'a dang ming mtha' ba'i byed rtsol phan tshun shan zhugs nas/ yo ngas rdzogs sgra gcig tu mthun par gyur pa 260

le'u gnyis pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ bod skad kyi sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul/yin no/ / — pa lnga ba/ nang gses mthun 'gyur/ —ming gcig gi nang gses sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi'i byed rtsol phan tshun shan zhugs nas sgra mthun par 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ am skad du sngon 'jug lnga bo'i sgra'i zur mngon par thon pa'i dbang gis/ ming gzhi skor zhig gi klog tshul sngon 'jug gi byed rtsol gyi khyad chos dang ldan par gyur yod/dper na/ bgazhan la g.yan ltar klog pa ni/ ga sngon 'jug gi mgrin pa dang lce rtsa'i byed rtsol gyis/ ming gzhi zha yi gnas dang byed pa'i phrad sa ltag kar bsnur nas sgra cung zad lci ba'i ya ltar grags yod/bzhag la bsag ltar klog pa ni1 ba sngon 'jug gi byed rtsol mchu yin zhing / lce'i rtsol ba med pa'i dbang gis/ ming gzhi zha yi lce rtsedang nye ba'i byed pa rkan la reg pa dang bral nas/ zha'i cha dang ldan pa'i ya ltar grags/dpa' la da hwa' ltar klog pa ni/ sngon 'jug da yi lce rtse so rtsar phrad pa las mchu yi rtsol ba med pa'i dbang gis/ ming gni pa yang mchu btsum pa'i rtsol ba ha lam med par gyur nas hwa ltar grags/dbang la da lung ltar klog pa yang / sngon 'jug da yi byed rtsol gyis ming gzhi ba yang so mchu ma reg pa tsam du rang cha dang ldan pa'i wa ltar grags/251

brda spod gsal byed ngag sgron/'bar la sna sgra dang ldan pa'i par ltar klog pa ni/ sngon 'jug 'a yi sgra mgrin pa las byung zhing rlung sna nas 'gro ba'i dbang gis/ ming gzhi ba la sna sgra zhugs nas 'ba' ltar grags/ gzhan yang / sngon 'jug rnams kyi sgra drag zhan bar ma'i khyad par gyis/ming gzhi'i sgra yang sngon 'jug dang mthun par 'gyur ba sus kyang gsal te/'dir ma spros so/ /drug pa/ phyi rol mthun 'gyur/ming gang zhig phyi rol gyi phrad gang dang 'brel rung / rjes 'jug gi byed rtsol gyis phrad de nyid kyi sgra rang dang mthun par byas byung la/ dper na/zhing la zu 'dren/ dmag la zhugs/ rgyal khab la phan 'dogs/ su la dga' sogs la/ zhing nga chu 'dren/ dmag ga zhugs/ rgyal khab ba phan 'dogs/ su 'a dga'/ zer ba lta bu'o/ / bskor nas 'gro/ 'thab nas rgyal/ yong nas bsdad/ bsams nas dga' sogs la/ bskor ras 'gro/ 'thab bas rgyal/ yong ngas bsdad/bsams mas dga'/ zer ba lta bu la sogs pa'o/ / gzhan yang / yod do/ /yin no/ /bzang ngo / /lags so/ /lta bu rdzogs tshig gi thob thang dang / 'grig gam/ red dam/ shes sam/ go'am/ lta bu 'byed sdud kyi thob thang la sogs pa'ang rigs 'di'i bo/ ngas su gtogs 262

le'u ba pa'i don tshan lnga ba/ bod skad kyi sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul/pa'o/ /mdor ka sdus na/ bod skad kyi tha snyad phal cher ngag nas rjod pa'i tshe/sgra gdangs phan tshun thogs pa med pas/ so so'i gnas dang byed pa'i sbyor ba ji bzhin zur phyin par 'don lob byas na/ yi ger dag cha thon sla/ yin na yang / tha snyad skor zhig zur phyung nas mgyogs par klog tshe/ byed rtsol phan gom sa gshi dī~X rdo pyo dī~X dī rdo dī ༵ rdo dī/gas nas dī gdang se ༵/thun par 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs 'di byung ba red/ de la yi ge sgra ltar bris pa ni/'khru ༵ ba 'byung srid ༵༷ rang ༵ra ༵zha/ ga dī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ra ma bri/dhi rdos ni lu/ gas 'di legs par rtogs na/ bod yig dang bo—de skad 'brel ji ltar chags pa'i zhib rdo ༵ bhe sbyo dag sbyi dī/na ༵ sa/ba~X klog nga~X ༷ gsan ༵sa lte'o // /brjod bya bris — — — (— 4 — ma 1

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/tha ——— ga 1)/ (11'u gsum pa/ bya ba nga ga gzugs 'gyur lugs bshad pa/ —don tshan dang bo/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs shes pa'i dgos pa/ming gi rigs las dngos po'i ming dang / khyad chos kyi ming dang /grangs ka'i ming bcas brjod bya'i chos de rigs dang 'dra bar gnas skabs su 'gyur ba med phar snang bas na/ rjod byed kyi sgra yang rang sor gnas par brten/ de mtshon byed kyi yig gzugs kyang 'gyur ba med pas/ blo la 'dzin sla zhing / don la 'jug bde mod/ bya ba'i ming ni sems can gyi rtsol ba dang / bem po'i 'gyur ba mtshon byed kyi brda yin te/ brjod bya de tshor dus kyi rnam bzhag dang / bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba yod pas/ de rjod byed kyi sgra la'ang khyad par yod la/ de mtshon byed kyi yig gzugs la'ang dus gsum skul tshig dang bzhi'i rnam dbye yod par ma zad/ bdag gi khongs gtogs byed pa bo dang 'grel ba'i bya ba ste byed pa'i las dang / gzhan gyi khongs 254

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan dang bo/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs shes pa'i dgos pa/gtogs bya ba'i yul dang bas ba'i bya ba ste bya ba'i las dang / bdag gzhan gang du'ang mi gtogs pa'i bya byed tha mi dag ste/ rang gi ngang gis grub par snang ba'i byab yang yod pa'i dbang gis/ bya ba'i ming gi 'gyur lugs de dag ma shes na/ 'bri klog 'chad gsum sgra gzugs don gsum ji lta ba bzhin du 'phrod dka' ste/ rang skad goms shugs kyis ji ltar 'jug pa shes kyang / ci phyir 'jug pa mi shes pas/ — yig skyon byung ba tshig skyon don skyon du 'gyur srid/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs dang / bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa'i rnam bzhag sogs khong du chud na/ tshig sbyor tshul la mgo mi rmongs pas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum du thogs pa med 'gro ste/ tshogs gsum dag cing gsal ba/ ngag phreng tshags dam pa/ go rim 'grel chags pa/ tshig nyung don rgyas/ thos dga' mthong spro sogs kyi bogs thon nas/ 'dod pa ji bzhin za ba'i mchog tu 'gyur srid/bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs kyi gnad ma zin —na/ yig gzugs bzhi 'gyur/ sum 'gyur nyis 'gyur/ mtha' na mi 'gyur ba'ang yod de/ nyog 'dzings che ba'i tshul du snang bas/ rtsid skud mgo sbogs khab mig tu 'tshud dka' ba'i dper 'gro mod kyang / dad pa'i sa long yod na/'dren pha'i lcags kyus zin na/ 'jig rten khams kyi dngos po gang dang gang yin pa'i 'gyur tshul la nges srol re yod/ chos nyid de rtogs na/ gzhan 266

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ dbang gi sdug bsngal de rang dbang gi bde bar bsgyur thub/ de bzhin bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs la rtsad bcad cing mtha' dpyad na/ nges srol mnga' brnyes par gyur pas/ dkar nag rkya 'thab pa'i mdud 'phying rnam par grol nas/ bslab la mar las spu phyung ba bzhin/ go sla zhing 'khyer bde ba/ tshegs chung la don che ba zhig 'ong / 'jug la kha gsal zhing don 'byor ba/ go brda sprod mkhas pa zhig 'ong / de'i phyir 'dir rtags 'jug gi dgongs pa dang bstun nas/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhag gi zhib cha dang / bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs dang / bya las dang byed las phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i 'gyur lugs so sor phye nas bstan par bya'o/ / don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhaga'adus byas gang yang mi rtag pa yin te/ de la rgyu dus kyi ma skyes pa'i cha dang / rang dus kyi skyes la ma 'gags pa'i cha dang / 'bras dus kyi skyes zin 'gags pa'i cha gsum re yod pa'i dbang gis/ 'gyur ldog de dag mtshon byed kyi bya ba'i ming la yang ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba dang / 'das pa ste/dus gsum gyi khyad par yod do/ /der brten bya ba'i ming tshig sbyor du 'jug tshe/ dus spyi dang bye brag gi bab dang bstun rgyu ha cang gal che'o/ /266 —

le'u gsum ga don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhagadang bo/ bya ba'i ming gi dus gsum spyi tsam ba/ — bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhag spyir btang ba la/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum du phyed cing— / gtam gleng ba'i gnas skadas ni da lta ba yin la/dus 'di la bltos nas dus tshod skad cig snga ma yan chad dus 'das pa dang /skad cig phyi ma kan chad dus ma 'ongs pa yin/ —de ring gi dus da lta ba 'di la bltos nas/ kha sang phan chad dus ba pa dang / sang nyin phyin chad dus ma 'ongs pa yin/ zla dang / lo dang / dus rabs dang / bskal ba sogs kyang rigs 'gres/ de bzhin las sam don gang byas zin pa'am byung zin pa ni 'das pa dang / byed bzhin pa'am 'byung bzhin pa ni da lta ka dang / byed par 'gyur ba'am 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni ma 'ongs pa ste/ de rnams mtshon byed kyi bya ba'i ming yang dus kyi rnam bzhag ltar 'jug pa rtags kyis mtshan pa gsham gsal/ bung ba me tog bzhad sar/ ma bos mgron du phebs snang / lta bu byung zin pa dang / zla ba bcu yi bar du lus la bzung / /btsas nas nyin mtshan sha yi drod la sbyar/ /snyan par bos shing brtse ba'i 'dzu me gyes bsus/ /sor bcu'i rtse la g.yengs te nu zhos gsos/ /gnyid dang lto bcag yid bzhin nor ltar bsrudīs/ /de yi drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar shog /(dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i pha ma'i drin gzo ma las)lta bu byas zin pa brjod pa 267

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/yin pas/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa sbyar ba'o/ /yid 'ong chu 'dzin 'khrig pa'i klong dkyil sa/ /gsal ler 'khyug pa'i glog gi rtse dga' dang / /lhan cig dbyar rnga snyan par grag bzhin du/ /char rgyun zim bur babs 'di zhing ba'i gsos/ /(tshig rgya na rig pa'i sgo 'byed las)lta bu 'byung bzhin pa dang / lus sa la 'gre ldog pa dang / skra 'bal zhing / brang rdung / ngag yum sras kyi mtshan nas 'bod cing 'o dod byed/ /yid mya ngan dang 'gyod pas rab tu gdung ba'i tshe/ /(bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las)byed bzhin pa brjod pa yin pas bya ba'i ming da lta ba sbyar ba'o/ /dpyid ka'i drod 'bab pa'i dus/ dar dang kha ba zhu la/ rtsi shing sogs skye rgyu red/ lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / yang dang yang du blta dgos la/ — bltas pa rnams la bsam dgos so/ /lta bu byed par 'gyur ba brjod pa yin pas bya ba ma 'ongs pa sbyar ba'o/ /bya ba'i ming gi dus gsal byed kyi sgra dus gsum so sor du ma re yod de/bya ba 'das pa gsal byed kyi sgra la/ zin/ tshar/ gyur/ byung / song / byas/myong sogs yod/ dper na/ dpe cha bsgrigs zin dpar byung btsongs tshar bas/ bzhin ras 'dzum par gyur nas dga' song ngo / /lta bu dang / a mdo'i phal skad du/ bya ba 'das pa gsal byed kyi sgra/ bya ba byas zin pa la btang 258

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhagadang / 'gyur ldog dal gyis byung zin pa(bltas na mi go ba)la bzhag dang / 'gyur ldog myur du byung zin pa la zhes pa sbyar cing rdzogs tshig dgos na zig(ze)ces sbyar/ de dag rim bzhin dper brjod na/ yi ge bris btang zig yul la bskur btang nga (la)/ rnal 'byor skyid la grogs po bslebs bzhag /gcig pur skyo ba lhag med sangs thal/ /glo bur dga' spro nyi ma shar bzhag /(zhal dkar ba'i dam thar las)/rta 'drogs sod / sga lhung song / snga ru chag song zig lta shu sogs so/ / des na 'ga' zhig gis kha skad du/ nyi ma shar song / rta brgyugs bzhagadar chags btang zig zer ba 'dra bris pa bod skad kyi bshad srol dngos dang 'gal lo/ / gzhan yang / myong zhes bya bas byas zin pa bstan pa'i dbang gis bya ba'i ming 'das pa mi 'jug par da lta ba 'jug pa'i srol yang yod de/ glog brnyan de ngas mthung / kho lha sa la 'gro ma myong zig lta du'o/ / bya ba da lta ba gsal byed kyi sgra la/ bzhin/ yod/ 'a pa dug gda'/ mchis/snang / byed sogs dang / 'brel sgra na rten can(kyim/ gyin gin yin)das/cing zhing shing sogs kyis poms sbyar nas 'jug ste/ slob— grogs la las 'bri bzhin pa/ la las dpe 'ji 'don gyin gda'/ la las glog pra lta yin mchis/ la las rtsis rig sbyong gin snang / la mas da bsdur byed cing 'dug259

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/tshang mas las la brtson par byed do/ /lta bu dang / am skad du bya ba byed bzhin pa'am 'byung bzhin pa'i tshig grogs su go zhes pa 'jug cing / go ni gi yod ces pa'i tshig sdud yin te/ ci zhig bzo gi yod la/ ci zhig bzo go zer ba dang / nga 'gro gi yod la/ nga 'gro go zer ba/ lta bu dang / 'di 'dra'i tshig gi zla bsdu la gi zhes pa 'jug ste/ dpe cha 'don gi yod gi zhes pa la/dpe cha 'don go gi zer ba dang / kha ba 'bab g.yod gi zhes pa la/ kha ba skad du go/ dī yin/ ba ṭwāṃ red// ce/༵ dī /dang ba/ rdo bus ska da du /gi ༵na / lha/red/ ces pa 'jug pa mang bas/ 'dir yin dang red gnyis ka'i 'jug pa rags pa tsam bshad par bya'o/ / yin red gnyis ka'i 'jug don gcig kyang 'jug yul mi gcig ste/'jug don ni skabs bab kyi brjod don nges par bstan pa dang / rjod byed kyi tshig re zhig rdzogs par byed pa dang / bya ba ma 'ongs pa gsal byed kyi tshig grogs su sbyar ba bcas yin la/ 'jug yul ni rang phyogs la yin dab / gzhan phyogs la red 'jug pa'o/ /de la rang phyogs kyi brjod don nges par bstan pa la/ nga yin/ ngas bshad pa yin/ nged tshang gi rta yin/lta bu dang / gzhan phyogs kyi brjod don nges par bstan pa ‘ma/ yi ge 'bri mkhan rig 'dzin dīd/ kho tsho'i 'gan khur rdod/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe 260

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhagaskrun khang gis dpar pa red/ lta bu'o/ /rang phyogs sam gzhan phyogs rjod pa'i tshig re zhig— rdzogs par byas pal/ ngas bsam 'char bshad nas tshar song ba yin1 khong gi se 'dzin grwa kha ba la rgyugs len gyin yod pa red/ lta bu'o/ /bya ba ma 'ongs pa gsal byed kyi tshig grogs su/ rang phyogs la am skad du rgyu yin zhes pa dad / dbus skad ku gi yin zhes pa dang / gzhan phyogs la am skad du rgyu red ces pa dang / dbus skad du gi red ces brjod pa yin te/ phyi dro gnam 'dab rgyu red/ khyod ma 'gro/ skyon med/ kho tsho 'gro gi red/ rje yang 'grogs nas— dgro sa/ dun/ nga ma song na/ kho tsho dga' gi zlo rjed/ lta bu'o/ /brda rnying du byed 'byur ram 'byung 'gyur mtshon byed du sa lam bya ba ma 'ongs pa 'jug pa dang / deng gi 'brog skad du'ang / dri rgyu 'ig yod/ yi ge bslab rgyu gal che/ zer ba lta du'i rtags thon/ yin na yang /rgyu pa ni bya ba ma 'ongs pa gsal byed kyi tshig grogs yin pas/ deng rong skad du rgyu sbyar sa'i bya ba'i ming ma 'ongs pa la da lta ba 'jug pa khyab che ste/ khrims la sbyor rgyu red/ srog khrims gcod rgyu red/ gsod rgyu red/ lta bu'o/ /bod yig ni sgra gzugs don gsum phan tshun rten cing 'brel bar byung ba yin pas/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhag gal/ tshig sbyor du dus gsal byed kyi sgra sbyor mi sbyor dgos pa yod snyen la mag las/ bya ba'i ming la la rjod byed sgra ltar yig gzugs re gnyis las med pas/ dus kyi khyad par 261

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgrod/ gsal bar ston pa'i dgos pa yod na/ gzigs kyin yod/ gzigs go gi/gzigs par bya/ gzigs rgyu red/ gzigs zin/ gzigs byung / lta bu sogs tshig grogs kyis bsgyur dgos/ dus gsal byed kyi sgra kun zor yang bar byas nas 'don pa yin pa shes phar bya/gnyis pa/ za ba'i ming gi dus gsum bye zag pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus gsum bye brag pa ni/ dus gsum gyi nang gses yang dus kyi dbye ba bzhi re yod de/ gtam gleng ba'i gnas skabs gang yin yang gnas skabs de dang / de'i sngon chad dang phyin chad kyi bya ba brjod du yod pa dang / bya ba 'jug par snga phyi'i go rim yod pa dang / brtag pa mtha' bzung gi bshad tshul sogs yod pa'i phyir ro/ /—gcig bya ba 'das pa las/ 'das pa tsam dang/ 'das pa'i 'das pa dang / 'das pa'i da lta ba dang / 'das pa'i ma 'ongs pa bcas rnam pa bzhi yod do/ / 'das pa tsam ni/ gong gsa' bya ba byas zen pa'i 'das pa tsam mo/ /'das pa'i 'das pa ni/ 'a das pa'i dus kyi sngon du bya ba byas zin pa'i 'das pa ste/ spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyis/ bdag pho lo bco brgyad kyi steng nas/ gling dkar po'i sde srid bskyangs nas/ pho lo dgu bcu lhag la bltebs byung / 'di'i ring thad du phyi dgra la mgo btags lus 'bul/ nang 'bangs 262

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhag— —la dbang log khral log ye nas ma byas/ (gru gu sho rdzong las)zhes pa lta bu/ 'das pa'i da lta ba ni 'das pa'i skabs der byed bzhin pa'i da lta ba ste/ a stag klu mo dang / lcags nag nam mkha' rlung zin/ gdong tsha 'brong rgyas zhal dkar gsum sngon thon gyis ru sna drangs shing 'ong ba na/ 'jam rje dang bka' blon bzhi'i bla 'brong lnga bo rtswa za zhing yod par gling dmag byung ba mthong / ('jar gling g.yul 'gyed las)zhes pa lta bu/ 'das pa'i ma 'ongs pa ni/— 'das pa'i skabs der bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs pa ste/ gal te lha kho mo la mi dgyes na/ kho mo dus nam gyi tshe na gsad kyang srog lha'i phyag tu mchis/ zhes dang / gal te lha yi rgyal khab tu/ /mchis nas deng la thug gi bar/ /skyes pa gzhan zhugs lta ci smos/ /yid la dran pa'ang ma bgyis na/ /nang bar sa lu skam po las/ /myu gu sngon po skye gyur cig /(bya mgrin jon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las)ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis/ bya ba da lta ba las/ da lta ba tsam dang / da lta ba spyir btang ba dang / da lta ba'i 'das pa dang / da —lta ba'i ma 'ongs nga1 bcas rnam pa bzhi yod/ — da lta ba tsam ni gong gsal bya ba byed bzhin pa'i da lta ba tsam mo/ /da lta ba spyir btang ba ni/ bya ba gang dngos su byed kyin yod med la mi ltos par/ spyir de 'dra'i spyod tshul 'ig bar zabs sa mang bzhin pa zhig yin 263

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/ pas/ byed sgra'ang 'jug mi srid de/ skyes mchog rang gi skyon la lta/ /skyes bu ngan pa gzhan skyon 'tshol/ /rma bya rang gi lus la rtog /srin bya gzhan la ltas ngan gtong / /(sa skya'i legs bshad las)zhes pa lta bu dang / kha skad du 'di rigs gsal byed kyi tshig grogs gi sgra yin te/ gtam la mtshon cha med kyang / /mi snying dum bur gcod gi ka lta bu'o/ / da lta ba'i 'das pa ni/ da lta ba'i dus su bya ba byas zin 'das pa ste/'di'i nang gses rnam pa lnga yod la/ gcig ni/ dus da lta ba'i skad cig yan chad byas zin pa ste/ ngas da lta bris tshar nas kho la sprad byung / lta bu dang /gnyis ni/ bya ba gnyis las snga ma go rim gyi dbang gis 'das pa'i tshul snang ba ste/ skad cha bsams nas bshad dgos/ /rtsam pa bldad nas mid dgos/ /lta bu dang bo brtsams pa mthar ma 'khyol/ phyi ma'i bya ba 'byung mi srod/ ces pa ltar 'das pa'i dbang du btang ba dang / gsum ni/ bya ba'i rgyun ma rdzogs kyang mgo brtsams zin pa'i dbang gis 'das par brtsis pa ste/ bltas kyin bltas kyin 'gro go gi song gin song gin rkang ba na bar 'gyur/ lta bu dang /bzhi ni/ brtag pa mtha' bzung gi 'das pa ste/ sman 'thungs na nad drag la/yon tan bslabs na los lob/ lta bu dang / lnga ni/ 'grub nges pa'i dbang du btang ba'i 'das pa ste/ am skad du 'di rigs gsal byed kyi tshig grogs su/ btang gi btang rgyu red/ btang la/ ci rigs 'jug pa khyab che/ gtam 264

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhagami 'tshog pa la ma bshad/ gzhan la bshad btang rgyu red/ byis pa'i lag la bzhag na bcag btang gi lta bu dang / da lta ba'i ma 'ongs pa ni/ skabs bab kyi bya ba ma rdzogs pa ste/ bsgrubs nas 'grub nye/ bris nas tshar la khad pa/sman 'thungs nas nad drag rgyu red/ lta bu sogs so/ /gsum/ bya ba ma 'ongs pa las/ ma 'ongs pa tsam dang / ma 'ongs pa'i ma 'ongs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i da lta ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i 'das pa bcas rnam pa bzhi yod/ma 'ongs pa tsam ni/ gong gsal bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs pa tsam mo/ /ma 'ongs pa'i ma 'ongs pa ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus de'i gzhug gi bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs pa ste/ de ring sang nyin shog 'drud dgos/ gzhas nyin khyod tshang la g.yul kha gcag rogs la 'ong / lta bu/ma 'ongs pa'i da lta ba ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus skabs de'i bya ba byed bzhin pa'i da lta ba ste/ de 'phror nga lan krig la 'ong dus khyer yong / khyod 'gro kha nga cig bos/ lta bu/ma 'ongs pa'i 'das ‘shā ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi bya ba grub pa'i dbang du btang ba'i 'das pa ste/ khyod song na nam 'ong / zhing gregs nas tshar na 'ong / tshe ring drug skor lta bu'i/ /ma shi tshe ring byung na/ /mthun pa spun bzhi lta du'i/ /yun ring gnas pa zhus chog /lta bu dang / am skad du/ 'di rigs 26du

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/gsal byed kyi tshig grogs la btang dgos zhes pa sbyar ba/ bri bar bya ba de sang nyin cis kyang bris btang dgos/ zla mjug bar du dpar btang dgos/ lta bu sogs so/ /don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/bya ba'i ming gi 'das pa dang/ /da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa/ /skul tshig bcas kyi 'gyur lugs ni/ /spyi bye thor du gsum du 'dus/ /bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs ni/ sgra drag zhan bar ma'i sgrub tshul yin te/ sngon rjes ming gzhi'i rtags kyi 'jug par rag las/ spyir sngon 'jug lnga bo mthu che ste/ ba yis 'das ma 'ongs gnyis dang / 'a yis da lta ba dang / ga da ci rigs kyib ma 'ongs pa ston pa dang / ma ni rang gi 'jug yul spyi la phal cher 'jug pa dang / skul tshig la sngon 'jug gtan khel can ma gtogs 'phul mi 'thob bo/ / de yang sngon 'jug lnga bo rang rang gi 'jug yul ma yin par 'phul mi 266

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/rung ba dang / ming gzhi gtan chags can la sngon 'jug dus kyi rang bzhin ltar rang dbang du sbyor mi rung ba dang / dus gsum dang skul tshig gi rnam bzhag sngon 'jug la mi rten par 'jug yang 'jug dang dbyangs kyi khyad par la brten pa dang / byed pa'i las dang bya ba'i las kyi ngo bo mi gcig pa dang /sgra gdangs mi 'gyur ba la yig gzugs gcig pa sogs kyi dbang gis/ yig gzugs mi 'dra ba mtshan mo'i skar tshogs ltar shar nag rang rang gi 'jug yul nyid gsal bar byed pa yin no/ /de'i 'gyur tshul ji 'dra mad yang nges thor dī dī dī/sum bye bsdus bsdu ru nga /ngo /du/sa gsum spyi khyab pa dang / bye brag pra dang /dang bo/ dus gsum 7sbyi khrab ba'i sbor tshul/sngon 'jug gsum gyis dus gsum ga / bsten pa dus gsum spyi khyob pa/ / — 'das par bas 'phul da lta spyir/ / — 'am 'phul nyung ngur gas 'phul dang / /ma 'o nges mang shos gdas dang / / nyung shos bas 'phul bstan pa dang / / — skul tshig khar khes ma gtogs pa1 / spyir btang sngon 'jug mi —'thob cing / /267

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/ming gzhi gang sde'i dang bo yis/ /'das dang gnyis pas skul tshig dang / /gsum pas da lta ma 'ongs grub/ /gal te da lta ma 'ongs pa'i/ /ming gzhi 'phul dang mi mthun na/ /gang 'tsham zhig dang brjes nas sbyar1 /dus gsum spyi khyab pa ni/ bya ba'i ming gi dus gsum gyi dbye ba sngon 'jug gsum gyis rnam par bstan pa zhig ste/ de la sngon 'jug las 'das pa la bas dang / da lta ba la 'as dang / nyung ngu la gas dang / ma 'ongs pa la ga da ci rigs sam yang na bas bstan pa dang / skul tshig khar kher ma gtogs sngon 'jug mi 'thob bo/ /'gyur lugs 'di rigs kyi khyad chos bya ba'i ming gi spyi mtshan du snang bas/ 'gyur lugs gzhan gnyis kyang 'di dang 'byel chags pa mang ngo / /skor 'di'i ming gzhi ka ca/ ta/ tsa sde ba bzhi la khyab che/ bya ba'i ldog pa gang ston byed kyi tha snyad de'i ming gzhi phal cher sde ba gang zhig gcig tu nges shing / sde ba de'i yi ge dang bo 'das pa dang / gnyis pa skul tshig dang / gsum pa da lta ba'am ma 'ongs pa'i ming gzhir grub cing /bzhi ba 'di rigs kyi ming gzhi gang la'ang mi 'jug go /de rnams las da lta ba'am ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i 'phul gang 'jug yul dang ma mthun na/ ming 268

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/gzhi de bsubs nas sde ba gzhan lag gnas dang byed pha gang mtshungs kyi yi ge zhig ming gzhi 'di'i kha mal du 'jug pa nyung shas shig kyang snang / 'di rigs kyi mtshan gzhi ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba dang / skul tshig dang /'das pa ltar rim bzhin dper 'god na/ (bya yis ma 'ongs pa dang / byed kyis da lta ba dang / cig zhig shig ci rigs kyis skul tshig dang / 'das par tshig grogs ma sbyar bas bstan pa go bar bka) — ka sde gnod pa dgag bya 'gog byed khogs shig bkagadagra bo dgum bya 'gum byed khums shig bkum/ g.yul du dgye bya 'byed byed khye zhig bkyes/ mdud pa dgrol bya 'grol gyed khrold cig bgrol/thag pas bkyig bya tshogashed khyigs shig bkyigs/gon rgyu bkru bya 'khrud byed khrus shig bkrus/ ga rtsam pa bgam bya 'gamago 'goms shig bgams/thog nas bgom bya 'gom byed 'goms shig bgoms/ ca sde phas rgol gzhom bya 'joms byed choms shig bcom/thabs kyis gas bya 'jun byed chund cig bcun/khab tu gcur bya 'jur byed churd cig bcur/ dum bur gcag bya gcog byed chog shig bcag —269

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgro na/ ske rags bcing bya 'ching byed chings shig bcings/ta sde gdan dkar gding bya 'ding byed thongs shig btings/ sa bon gdab bya 'debs byed thobs shig btab/dgra dpung gdul bya 'dul byed thuld cig btul/thag pas gdag bya 'dogs byed thogs shig btags/gcig tu btu bya 'thu byed thus shig btus/phyi ru gtang bya gtong byed thongs shig btang /da thang ma bdal bya gdal byed gdol zhig bdald/rjes su gda' bya 'ded byed ded cig bdas/tsa sde sa la gzug bya 'dzugs byed tshugs shig btsugs/ nang du gzud bya 'dzud byed tshud cig btsud/kha ni btsum bya 'dzum byed tshums shig btsums/mar khu btsag bya 'tshag byed tshogs shig btsags/zha ja mdun du gzhag bya 'jog byed zhog cig bzhag sman khu gzhib bya 'jib byed 'jibs shig bzhibs/ za dza mda' la gzur bya 'dzur byed zurd cig bzur/lag tu gzung bya 'dzin byed zungs shig bzung /chud ni gza' bya 'dza' byed gzond cig bzas/270

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/lag pa gzed bya 'dzed byed zed cig bzed/sha cha nyes pa bshag bya 'chags byed shogs shig bshags/ lta bu sogs te/ 'di rigs kyi ming gzhi 'gyur tshul sde ba gcig pa dang mi gcig pa gnyis su 'dus shing / ming gzhi spum 'gyur can— ka ca ta tsa sde ba bzhir nges pa las/ ca sde'i ja dang / tsa sde'i dza ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi ga sngon 'jug gi 'jug yul du mi 'gyur bas/ sde ba gzhan las zha dang za so sor drangs nas ming gzhi bzhi 'gyur can du log pa yin/ ming gzhi nyis 'gyur can skor zhig sde ba gcig pa ste gong dang mtshungs/ skor zhig sde ba mi gcig pa ste/ zha dang ja/ za dang dza/ sha dang bye po —sum du nges/ spying gzhi rkyang ba gcig pa can ga da gnyis tsam du zad do/ / gnyis pa/ dus gsum bye zag pa'i spyor tshul/ dus gsum nang gi dus gnyis la/ /sngon 'jug dag gis bstan pas na/ / dus gsum ma khyab bye brag pa/ / bas 'phul 'das dang ma 'ongs bstan/ /da lta skul tshig sngon 'jug med/ / de min ga das ma 'ongs dang / / sngon 'jug 'a yis da ltab stan /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/'das skul spyir btang 'phul mi 'thob/ /ming gzhi brtsegs pa gcig pa dang / /rkyang ba gang sde'i snga ma ni/ / 'das dang skul tshig grub pa dang / / phyi ma da lta ma 'ongs grub/ /dus gsum bye brag pa ni/ dus gsum las rnam bzhag gnyis sngon 'jug dag gis bstan pa zhig ste/ ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs ci rigs kyi 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa sngon 'jug ba yis bstan pa de'i da lte ba dang skul tshig la 'phul mi ka'athob cing / sngon 'jug ga da ci rigs kyis ma 'ongs pa dang / 'a yis da lta ba bstan pa gang gi 'das pa dang skul tshig la 'phul mi 'thob la/ ming gzhi brtsegs pa gcig pa dang / —rkyang ba phal mo che sde ba gang gi snga ma 'das pa dang ma 'ongs par grub pa dang / phyi ma da lta ba dang skul tshig tu grub bo/ /'di rigs kyi mtshan gzhi dper 'god na/ ka dpe cha bklag bya klog byed klogs shig bklags/shing dpar brko bya rko byed rkos shig brkos/slob grwar bskyal bya skyel byed skyol zhig bskyald/ga ko ba brgyang bya rgyong byed rgyongs shig brgyangs/bya ba bsgrub bya sgrub byed sgrubs shig bsgrubs/272

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum ba/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/nga yu khu brnga bya rnga byed rngos shig brngas/ dgra la brngam bya rngam byed rngoms shig brngams/nag nyes bsngog bya sngog byed sngogs shin bsngogs/ja phan tshun brje bya rje byed rjes shig brjes/nya 'khru ba brnyang bya rnyang byed rnyongs shig brnyangs/ bhelag pas bsnyal bya snyal byed snyold cig bsnyald/ ta zangs dem brtib bye rteb byed rtibs shig brteb sa/lwa ba bltab bya lteb byed ltob cig bltabs/ ltad mo bstan bya ston byed stond cig bstand/da phan par gdam bya 'doms byed 'doms shig gdams/dom dī dī brdung bsdam ༵ sdom byed sdoma~X shig bsdama~X// na yid la brnag bya rdog byed brnags shig nogs/ srol ngan bsnub bya snub byed snubs shig bsnubs/pha ba gnas nas dbyung bya 'byin byed phyungs shig phyung /so sor dbral bya 'phral byed phrold cig phral/ tsa bya dga' bstsal bya sprul byed 'ad cig bstsald/steng du brtseg bya rtseg byed rtsegs shig brtsegs/273

brda sprod gsal byedang ga sgron/ dza phu dung brje bya dzee byed rdzes shig brdzes/snod du brdzang bya rdzong byed rdzongs shig brdzangs/zha rta mchog bzhon bya zhon byed zhond cig bzhond/za sha thud bza' bya za byed zo zhig bzas(zos)/yang yang bzla bya zlo byed zlos shig bzlas/ ra byin gyis brlab bya rlob byed zlobs shig brlabs/don med brlag bya rlag byed zlogs shig brlags/sa rig gnas bslab bya slob byed slobs shig bslabs/g.yo sgyus bslu bya slu byed slus shig bslus/lta bu sogs te/ ming gzhi brtsegs pa bas 'phul rung ba yod tshad rigs 'dir 'dus shing / 'di rigs kyi ming gzhi re re ba ni/ ka ga nga / ja nya/ ta da na/ tsa dza/ zha za/ ra sa bcu bzhi dang / 'gyur ba gnyis can pha ba tsam mo/ /gsum pa/ dus gsum thor bu ba'i spyor tshul/dus kyi dbye ba khar kher re/ /'phul res bstan la dus gsum spyir/ /rjes 'jug yang 'jug yod med dang / /dbyangs kyi 'gyur bas bstan pa ni/ /thor bu ba ste ming gzhi ni/ / 274

— le3 gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/—nyung ngu tsam las gcig pa dang / / yig gzugs 'gyur med dus kyi khyad/ /tshig grogs sbyar nas bstan pa 'o/ /dus gsum thor bu ba ni/ dus gsum gyi dbye ba khar kher re sngon 'jug res bstan pa ma gtogs/ spyir dus gsum skul tshig— dang bzhi'i rnam bzhag ni 'jug yang 'jug dang / na ro 'greng bu thob min gyis bstan pa zhig ste/de yang 'phul dang ming gzhi khar kher tsam —las 'gyur ba med pa/ da lta ba kha shas la 'as 'phul dang / 'das pa nyung ngu la bas 'phul thob pa ma gtogs gcig tu nges shing / dbyangs yig lhong 'das pa nyung nyung la blo dang / da lta ba khar kher la e'am mthob pa ma gtogs 'dra la/ skor zhig 'phul gtan nas mi 'thob/ yig gzugs 'gyur ba med —pa'ang skor zhig yod/ de lugs dper mtshon na/ ka lam du dkyu byar kyu byed dkyus shig dkyus/kha sngon du 'khrid bya 'khrid byed khrid cig khrid/ga brtag dpyad bgyi bya bgyid byed gyis shig bgyis /nga mi sna mngag bya mngag byed mngags shin mngags/ca rang srog lceb bya lceb byed rtsebs shig rtsebs/cha rus pa 'cha' bya 'am byed 'cho zhig 'chos/275

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/ja lkog tu 'jab bya 'jab byed 'jobs shig 'jabs/nya dpe khrid mnyan bya nyan byed nyond cig mnyand/pags pa mnye bya nyed byed mnyes shig mnyes/ta phan tshun gtug bya gtug byed gtugs shig gtugs/tha glog skud 'then bya 'then byed 'thend cig 'thend/da mgron du drang bya 'dren byed drongs shig drangs/na gdams ngag mno bya nod byed nos shig mnos/pa thur du dpyang bya dpyong byed dpyongs shig dpyangs/phrul bar dprul bya dprul byed dpruld cig dpruld/go gnas spag bya spog byed spogs shig spags/pha gad snyigs phyag bya 'phyag byed phyogs shig phyags/ ba dang du blang bya len byed longs shig blangs/rdza mar blug bya ldug byed blugs shig blugs/ja chang blud bya ldud byed blud cig blud/ gsang ba sba bya sped byed sbos shig sbas/ma bde sdug myang bya myong byed myongs shig myangs/ri ma rmo bya rmod byed rmos shig rmos/ tsa thal 'tshub gtsub bya gtsub byed gtsubs shig gtsubs /276

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ — bya ba'i ming gi sag gzugs 'gyur lugs/sa ba — tsha nor lug 'tsho bya 'tsho byed 'tshos shig 'tshog shādza— phrin las mdzad bya mdzad byed mdzod cig mdzad/ zha 'o zhag gzhab bya gzhab byed gzhobs reg gzhabs/ za za ma bza' bya za byed zo zhig zos/ya lkog tu yib bya phob byed skrebs shig yibs/ ra ston mo rol khye rol byed rold cig rold/la kha nas lab bya lab byed lobs shig labs/sha skam lug bsha' bya bsha' byed shos shig bshas/sa bud shing gse bya gse byedag ses shig gses/'gyur med dka' thub dpyad bzod mu 'thud 'thab bzhin las/ re ba grub pas kun gyis yang yang bstod/lta bu sogs te/ 'di rigs las ma 'ongs pa'i mtha' med dam 'a mtha' skor zhig gi dod du da dang / nga mtha' kha shas kyi dod du na sbyar na da lta bar grub pa/ da lta ba mtha' med dam 'a mtha' can la rjes 'jug sa dang / rjes 'jug can— la yang 'jug sbyar na 'das par grub pa/ dbyangs bzhi gang rung ma 'ongs par thob na de byings kun la thob pa/ ma 'ongs pa dang 'das par dbyangs mi 'thob pa can gyi da lta ba mang phyogs dang skul tshig dag la na ro thob pa dang / da lta ba nyung shas la 'greng du thob pa yang yod/ ming gzhi las 277

brda spyod gsal byed ngag sgron/ blu'i da lta ba'i dod du ldu 'jug pa tsam las/ de byings tshang ngo cog gcig pa/gsal byed wa 'a ha ma bzhi las gzhan nyer drug byed pa gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba'i ming gi ming gzhir 'jug pa'o/— /bzhe ba/ byed ba gzhan dang ma 'drel ba'i bya nga'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/ byed pa gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i/ /bya ba'i ming gi 'gyur lugs ni/ /spyir na thor bu'i tshul du snang / / skul tshig thob pa ha cang nyung / /gong gsal bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs kyi dper brjod khar kher tsam ma gtogs tshang ma byed pa'i las te/ byed pa gzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba'i ming gi mtshan gzhi yin la/ byed pa gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ nyi ma shar/ nga 'gro/ tshod ma skye/ zer ba'i shar ba/ 'gro ba/skye ba lta bu sogs byed pa rang gi ngang gis grub par snang ba'i bya ba dang /sdong bo bcad nas chod/ bzung nas zan/ bsad nas sod/ zer ba'i chod pa/ zin pa/ sod pa/ lta bu sogs bya ba'i las te/ las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba rigs 'di gnyis ka'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs gong gsal gyi dus 278

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming go yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/gsum thor bu ba dang ha lam 'dra3nga / mi gcig sa ni ming gzhi brtsegs ma rab tu nyung ba dang / pho yig ka ca ta tsa bzhi'i ming gzhi rkyang ba nyin mo'i skar ma'i rjes su 'gro ba dngad kul tshig kyang gang zag la 'jug rung ba nyung ngu ma gtogs med pa'i dbang gis/ ming gzhi ྅gyur ba gnyis can ha cang nyung zhing mi 'gyur ba rab tu mang ngo / — /gsham gas gyi dper brjod las kor rtags brgyab pa yig gzugs ka'agyur ba dang / thig rtags brgyab pa yig gzugs nyis 'gyur can yin/ sum 'gyur dang bzhi 'gyur la rtags brgyab med do/ / — —— grim bya'i 'grig lam grims nas rgyal/rgyug rtsal mngon rtags dbugs mi sngam/me lce mardod zlor zi 'dod chas/ —'khol bya'i chu khol skom nas 'thung / tsha la nye yang za ka rte/ bal 'phyings sed dka' gra mi 'phying /༷༷ sman la mjed na nyal sar nyol/ ༷ ༷ rtab po brtab rgyu sdogs nas brtabs/bltam bya ltam byed ltoms shig bltams/lto tshe mi 'byid phyid na dga'/༷ ༷

bad sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/bab bya 'bab byed bobs shig babs/bzi sman brgyab ste sprud nas sos/'tshig rgyu tshig kyang 'dzad rgyu zad/ — — — —thed la rubs nas lug khyu zhogs/— —lhung rgyu lhung nas 'dam la zug— — mi 'ju zos nas ma zhu ba/— —gnyid las sad nas dkar sar lhags/shes bya lob rgyu bslabs nas lobs/ — —gzhung la rem nas rang don yal/— ma lus yongs rdzogs lon nas bzhad/lta bu sogs te/ ming gzhi brtsegs ma ska/ rga/ rta/ lta/ lda/ sda/ spa/ rdza/ sla/lha/ lta bu bcu kha tsam min pa med cing / de dag ming gzhi byas nas bya las mchon pa can yang ha cang nyung / yig gzugs 'gyur ba ma'i ming gzhi mang phyogs gcig pa dang / nyung phyogs mi gcig pa ste/ cha dang sha/ ja dang zha/pha dang ba/ dza dang za/ lhu dang lhu/ lta bu rnams so/ /

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ bya las dang byed mas dzin tshun rten cing 'gre' ba'i 'gyur 'u rgas/don tshan bzhi ba/ bya las dang byed las phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i 'gyur lugs/bya ba'i las dang byed pa'i las /phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i lugs/ /gtso cher ming gzhi gcig pa dang / /ming gzhi sde mthun gnyis su 'dus/ / bya ba'i las dang byed pa'i las kyi rgyu mtshan sngon 'jug gi skabs su bshad zin mod/ 'di gnyis ka'i phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs go sla ba'i ched du/ 'dir yang gshar sbyang gi tshul du cung zad spro na/ byed pa'i las ni las gang bgyi ba'i byed pa(byed pa gtso phal gnyis 'dus)dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang / bya ba'i las ni byed pa'i rtsol ba 'jug sa'i las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba yin/ dper brjod na/ dar rgyas kyis rta bzung nas zin pa na/ dar rgyas ni 'dzin pa bo dang / rta ni las dngos dang / rta bzung ba ni byed pa'i las dang / rta zen pa ni bya ba'i las so/ /de yang bzung ba ni byed pa pos las la phar 'jug pa'i rtsol ba ste/byed pa dang 'grel ba'i bya ba yin pas/ byed pa'i las zhes bya zhing / bdag gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / zin pa ni las las tshur snang ba'i 'gyur ba ste/281

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/las dang 'grel ba'i bya ba yin pas/ bya ba'i las zhes bya zhing / gzhan gyi khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /phar 'jug tshur snang du grub nas rgyu las 'bras bu smin pa'i tshul 'di/ bya las dang byed las phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i 'gyur lugs yin la/ 'gyur lugs 'di'i khyad chos mngon par gsal ba zhig ni/ byed las bya las la bltos na sgra gdangs cung drag gzugs 'gyur cung che/ yig tshogs cung mang / mtha' dpyad na/ 'gyur lugs 'di gtso cher ming gzhi gcig pa dang / ming gzhi'i sde ba gcig pa gnyis su 'dus so/ /dang bo/ bya las dang byed las ming gzhi gcig pa'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/ming gzhi gcig pa'i rkyang brtsegs ni/ /brtsegs pa bdag dang rkyang ba gzhan/ /ming gzhi gcig pa'i rkyang ba ni/ /'phul can bdag dang 'phul med gzhan/ /bya ba'i las dang byed pa'i las kyi yig gzugs 'gyur lugs ming gzhi gcig pa las/ ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs gcig pa dang / ming gzhi rkyang ba gcig pha rigs gnyis yod de/ snga ma'i khyad par ni/ ming gzhi brtsegs pa bdag ste byed pa'i las dang / rkyang ba gzhan te bya ba'i las yin la/ gsham gsal gyi dper brjod las kor rtags brgyab pa byed pa'i las dang thig 282

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ bya las dang byed las phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i 'gyur lugs/rtags brgyab pa bya ba'i las so/ — rnam pa bsgyur nas legs par 'gyur/ ༷ skud rkya ma bsgrims ci la grim/ —bsnyal pa'i bu gu nyal nas 'dug —chu mgo nyog phar ma snyog cig /— gzu bas bsdums nas 'dum par 'gyur/ / ༷ tha gus bsdams nas ha cang dom/ / —dri ngan ma bsnams rang gar mnam/ —go rim nog par ma snog cig /— chu la sbangs nas myur du bangs/ /lag rtsal sbyangs pa byang ma che / / —gang thub sgyur bas mi myur ci/ / ༷ dug gis snyos pas myos pa yin/ / —rig pa ma bslabs rang lob med/ / —gyang hrul ma bzlogs log par dka'/ / —dang du blangs na ci yang lon/ / —gnyid rkyal ma bslangs lang rgyu med/ /lta bu sogs khyab che'o/ /phyi ma ming gzhi rkyang ba gcig pa'i khyad par ni/ byed 283

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/pa'i las spyir btang la sngon 'jug yod pa dang / bya ba'i las phal cher la sngon 'jug med pa dang /nyung shas la 'a sngon 'jug tsam du zad/dper na/gyang ngos gnyul nas nyul ba dang //—dbyug pas gnyogs nas sha rus nyog/—mgron du drangs pa ma lus 'drongs// ༷༷ thang ma bdal nas phyi la 'dol/ ༷ shed kyis mnan kyang ma non pa/—cog tser bzhag nas ma zhog lhung /—blo la bzung yang zin sa med/—sman gyis gsos nas legs par sos/—lta bu khyab chung ngo/ /gzhan yang ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs gang rung las/byed las dang bya las khyad par cung zad tsam yod pa'am/go gcig chod can yang khar kher yod de/ tshod ma bskyed nas skyes pa mgyogs//—snod zhabs brtol nas brdol bar 'gyur// ༷ sha rug bskams nas rab tu bskams// ༷ skyon cha bsal bsal ma lus bsal// ༷༷ bsrings kyang bsrangs nas ma bslebs pa//284

—— lde'u gsum pa'i don tshanā bzhi ba/ bya las dang byed mas phan tshun rten cing ba bdi 'gyur 4 bas1dpyid lug 'tshos kyang srog ma 'tshos / ༷ lta bu rnams so/ / gnyis pa/ bya las dang byed las ming gzhi spe ba gcig pa'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs/sde ba gcig pa'i rkyang brtsegs ni/ / brtsegs pa bdag ste pho sgra dang / /rkyang ba gzhan te ma ning yin1 / sde mthun ming gzhi rkyang ba'i khyad/ /byed las 'das pa pho yin na/ /bya las ming gzhi ma ning yin/ /byed las 'das pa ma ning la/ /bya las ming gzhi mo ru 'gyur/byed las ming gzhi mo yin na/ /bya las de bas zhan pa'i mo'o/ /byed las da lta ma 'ongs pa sde ba gang gi gsum pa yin/ /ma 'ongs nyung shas sde gzhan las/ /byed rtsol gang mtshungs drangs pa la/ /

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/bya las ming gzhi'ang de gar 'gyur/ /skul tshig gi dang bya las kyi/ /ming gzhi gang sde'i gnyis pa yin/ /bya las dang byed las kyi ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa las/ ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs sde ba gcig pa dang / ming gzhi rkyang ba sde ba gcig pa rigs gnyis yod de/ snga ma'i khyad par ni/ byed las kyi ming gzhi brtsegs pa pho dang / bya las kyi ming gzhi rkyang ba ma ning ngam/ khar kher zhig mo yig yin pa'ang yodade/ dper na/ rkang ba bskums nas nang du 'khums/ / ༷ rdzing bu ma bskyil ngang gis 'khyel/ /—khyi ngan ring du bsgyur nas 'khyur/ / ༷ sdong bo chu la bskur nas 'khur/ / ༷ lcags skud dkyogs nas 'khyog par 'gyur/ / ༷༷ long bas bltas kyang mthong sa med/ / ༷ lu ba bskyon nas sgyun pa dang / / ༷ phung bo gtor nas thor sang ngo / / ༷ de 'dra ma stung thung 'gro la/ /—yang yang bstabs nas mang du thob/ /—'o phye chu la bstems nas 'thim/ /—286

me'u gsum pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ bya las dang byed las phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i 'gyur lugag — — go sa spar nas mthon por 'phar / ༷ — nor spug spel na 'phel kha mgyogs/ / — — — glog 'od rno spros 'a don me da/ — ༷ gzugs mtshar sna tshogs sprul nas ma'i phrul/ / — ༷ phyogs gcig spungs nas phung bar 'gyud/ / lta bu sogs khyab cung zad chung rngo / /bku ra nas khur zhes pa'i khur dang /bskyon nas gyon zhes pa'i sgyun— lta du deg 'dir yul dang 'brel bas bya ba'i las dang / ngas khur ngas gyon zhes byed pa dang 'brel3 byed pa'i las su 'gyur la/ bstungs rnos thud / bsnyungs nes nyung da lta bu'i thung dang nyung dag kyang skabs 'dir bya ba'i las su grub mod/ gzugs thung ba'i mi nyung /zhes pa'i skabs su khyad chosta kyi ming du nges so/ / ༷ ༷ phyi ma ming gzhi sde bo gcig pa'i khyad par ni/ — byed las kyi 'das pa'i ming gzhi pho yig yin na/ bya las kyi— ming gzhi khar kher ma gtogs ma ning du 'gyur zhing / byed las kyi 'das pa'i ming gzhi ma snang yin na/ bya las kyi ming gzhi mor 'gyur la/ byed las kyi ming gzhi mo yin na/ bya las kyi ming gzhi byed rtsol de las zhan pa'i mor gyur 'gro byed las kyi skul tshig gi ming gzhi dang bya las kyi ming gzhi phal che re lde ba gang mthun gyi gnyis pa yin/byed las de tsho'i da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i ming gzhi phal cher sde ba gang 287

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/nyid kyi gsum pa yin zhing / ma 'ongs pa nyung shas kyi ming gzhi sde ba gzhan las gnas dang byed pa gang mtshungs shig drangs pa'i rigs kyi bya ba'i las kyi ming gzhi'ang phal cher de nyid yin 'gro de tsho'i dper brjod dang so so'i gzugs 'gyur tsam rtags kyis ma na pa gsham gsal/dgag bya'i gnod pa 'gog byed khogs// ༷ bkag nas e 'khog khog byung ngo // ——pha bong dgad rgyu khod cig ces//'gad byed e 'gad bkad de gad// ༷ ༷ thag pas bkyig bya 'khyig byed khrigs//bkyigs nas ma 'khyigs 'khyig rgyu dang // ༷ ༷ 'jun byed khrims kyis gcun bya chund//mi 'chun bcun nas legs par chun//— —gcag bya'i rdo ni gcog byed chogs//'chag rgyu min yang bcag nas chag/— — —gter rdzas gdon rgyu 'don par byed//thond cig bton nas 'thon rgyu thon//— ༷ —zhags pa gdab bya 'debs byed thobs//btab nas ske la thebs par 'gyur// ———388

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan bzhi ba/ bya 'as dang byed las phan tshun rten cing 'drel ba'i 'gyur lugs/thur du dpyang bya dpyong byed dpyongs/ / dpyangs nas 'phyang rgyu gyang rtsar phyang / / — ༷ —go re da thul nas phrul bar 'gyur/ / ༷༷ 'phud rgyu mi 'bud phud nas bud/ / — —gnas nas dbyung bya 'byin byed phyungs/ /mi 'byung na yang phyung nas byung / / — —thal rdul gtsub rgyu gtsubs pa la/ / 'tshul rgyu rab tu 'tshubs byung ngo / /— —gzug bya'i myu gu 'dzugs byed tshugs/ / btsugs nas mgyogs pas yongs su tshugs/ / —'thab la gzhug bya 'jug rgyu chug /bcug nas dga' dgar zhugs pha yin/ / ༷༷ bsum bya'i khug kha sum byed sums/ / bsums nas dam por zum byung ngo / / —gzhil bya 'jil byed myur du cild/ / bcil nas me dpung zhi bar gyur/ / —rdo rtsig bshig bya shig byed shigs/ / bshigs nas zhig pa drud nas tshar/ / —

brda krod gsal byed ngag sgron/lta bu sogs khyab shin tu che'o/ /don tshan lnga ba/ bya ba rigs gsum rten cing 'grel ba'i byung tshul/ bya ba'i ming la rigs gsum yod de/ gcig ni bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ byed pa'i rtsol ba yin zhing / gnyis ni gzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba ste/ las kyi 'gyur ba yin la/ gsum ni bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ ngang gis byung ba yin no/ /bya ba rigs gsum phan tshun rten cing 'brel bar byung ba ha cang mngab yod tshul shes dgos par ma zad/ bya ba rigs gsum mtha' gcig tu nges pa med tshul yang shes dgos/de lugs khong du chud na/ bod skad kyi bya ba'i ming gi rnam bzhag dang khyad chos kyi gdengs thob nas/ 'bri klog 'chad gsum la phan chen po thogs par 'gyur ro/ /dang bo/ bya ba rigs gsum spyi 'brel ba dang khyad par/byed pa'i rtsol ba las kyi 'gyur ba dang / /ngang gis byung ba'i bya ba rigs gsum las/ / rten cing 'grel bar byung ba rigs gnyis mchis/ /290

le'u gas pa'i don sa lngab/ bya ba rigs gsum rten cing 'grel ba'i byung tso/ming gzhi gang mi sde ba gcig pa dang // ming gzhi gcig pa'i khyad pa 'di gnyis yin / / snga ma sde ba gang gi dang bo bdag /gnyis pa gzhan dang gsum pa bdag gzhan ni//gang la'ang ma 'brel ngang gis byung bas yin// gsham gsal mi dper brjod las/ kor rtags dang / thig rtags dang / 'khyag rtags gsum gyis rim bzhin bdag dang / gsan dang /bdag gzhan ma 'brel ba mtshon pa'o// bkyigs nas 'khrigs kyang bab kha nas sdigabakugs na 'ams kyang sdug bsngal mi phyog go/ mdud pa bkrol nas ma 'dzo ci phyir dzi// bkab nas khebs pa'i 'og tu gab nas 'dugabakang nas gos pa'i chang ni can ༅ 'thung /khye ngan bkag nas las skad ྾ 'a ka/ rgas nas ma ༅3gra yis༄ma nas ༅/ rwa co ༅ pa bkug sa ༅ pa lo/ bkas nas tsho gsangs gas pas snang / lus la rma 1bab pos nas gos pa min/ 29

brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron/bcug nas ma chug rang ga zhugs pa yin/ ༷ ——bcag nas ma chogs ngang gis chag pa mtshar/ ༷ —thag pa bcad kyang ma chod ci la chad/ — —bton nas ma thon ngang gis don pa yin/ ༷ ༷ gdul bya btul nas thul bas dul bar gnas/ ༷ ༷ thum gyis btums nas dum pa bcu gnyis byung /— —shog bu tha nga ba bsdings nas 'thi ga pa min/dprul nas phrul ba'i gor brul skam po za/ — —me tog kha bye byes nas phyed pa min/ — ༷ btsugs nas ma tshugs 'dam la zug par gyur/ ༷ —bshigs nas zhig pa rim gyis 'jig par 'gyur/ ༷ ——brtol nas brdol ba'i khung nas thol gyis byung / ༷ —bstems nas ma thim rkang ba bye ma dim/ ༷ ༷ 'bel ba gang mang spel nas 'phel ba min/ —— ༷ ༷ lta bu sogs las phal cher ming gzhi rkyang ba yin la/ bdag 'grel gyi ming gzhi sde ba gang gi yi ge dang po yin zer ba 'das pa gzhir bzung ba yin/ gzhan dag gi ming gzhir 'gyur ldog med do/ /'di rigs las ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs spel ma'ang nyung zad cig yod de/ bdag 'grel gyi ming 292

le'u g.yo pa'i dod tshan lnga ba1 bya ba 'i༄ gsum rted cing 'brel ba'i byung tso/gzhi tsugs pa dang /— gzhan dag gi ming gzhi rkyang ba gin/ ming gas mo rim gong bzhin no/ / — — phyi ma ming bzhi gcig ba'i brtsegs pa bdag / — rkyang bags dang bdag gzhan tshog khyad/ / — spo mar gas phyi mar na ro med/— / — ming gzhi rkyang ba gcig pa 'ang ku sems da/ / rdzubaslabs nas ldobs skyen pas na ci yang lob sgyu — lag rtsal ba sbyangs —nas 'a sgyungs bsgyur ba tsu byeng / / —— gya lda la sbyar nas 'byor ba khrur nas 'dug / gcig tu 'domasaX bsdams nas dom pas na/ / slod nas rted pa min yang khyi las rmed/ / — mil 'dal ba shal nas 'kho man/ / lta bu sogs rigs snga zlo tsha khyab chung zhing ༷/ ༷ byed pa'i rtsol ba mtshon pa'i ming gzhi brtsegs pa'i mgo can dor na/ las kyi 'gyur bar log 'gro/las kyi 'gyur ba'i na ro dor na/ ngang gis byung bar gyur 'gro ba ni/ 'di rigs kyi khyad chos gtso bo yin/ bya ba'i ming rigs gas gyi khyad 5ra gtso bod ga ni/ sgra drag zhan bar ma la rag las te/ byed pa'i rtsom ba snyu drag ma 'ams bas mtshon pa dang /293

brda sprod gas byed ngag sgron/las kyi 'gyur ba la sgra bar mas mtshon pa dang / ngang gis byung ba la sgra zhan pa'am yang bas mtshon pa'o/ / bya ba'i ming rigs gsum kyi yig gzugs tha dad pa yin mod/ gzhan 'brel dang bdag gzhan ma 'brel ba'i ma ba rigs gnyis kyi yig gzugs gcig pa'ang yod/ dper na/ kha dog 'gyur ba bsgyur nas 'gyur ba min/phyogs gcig 'dres pa bsres nas 'dres rno min/ bskyil nas— 'khyil ba'i chu ni 'khyil zhing 'dug lta bu rnams / so/ / ༷ — bye ba rigs gsum las/ bka 'brem gyi bya ba la skul tshig thob pa dang / gzhan 'grel gyi bya ba la skul tshig 'i 'thob/ bdag gzhan ma 'brel ba'i bya ba las/ gang zag la 'jug rung bar skul tshig thob pa dang / gang zag la 'jug mi rung bar skul tshig mi 'thob bo pa gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming rigs gsum —mtha' gcig tu zas pa med tshul/ rtsol ba 'jug sa'i las kyi dngos po de/ /rtsol byung yin na bya los logs su med/ / bya ba rang gi ngang gis grub pa la/ / bya las byed las gang yang don gyis stongs/ / gong gsal bya ba'i ming la rten cing 'brel ba'i rigs gsum gyi dbye ba 294

le'u gsum pa'i don tshan lnga ༅1 bya ba rigs ga rten cing 'brel ba'i byung tshul/mngon sum du yod spyang / gas gsum du 'dzoms pa'i mas — — de/ las kyi dngos po sdor medagang / rtsol ba gas can zhig tu grub pa la/byed pa'i las yod rdo kyang da rgya ba'i mas med de/ skye ba'i 'ams pa/ tha ge 'bri ba/ ri rme brko rga lta sge rnams ma/ /las kyi dngogopo sngar yod pa / byed pa'i rtsol ba las/ rnam pa gas zhig‘ tu gyur— 'gro ba ka byid pa'i la so dang bya ba'i las —gnyid ka yod mod/ — de lugs —dang) 'brel ba'i rang byung gi snang tshul med pa lnga bdag gzhan dang— ma bam ba'i— bya bo med de/ ras gshags nas shogs pa/ gdan drangs na so 'drongs —pa/ bltas nas mthong ba/ 111 1—— 1—— 111 zhes 3zhes rje — — sgyur lta bu gas / / ma gang zhag rang ga ngang gas bya ba('gyur ldag)'byung ba las/ byed po'i las su mi rung ba la/ bya las dang byed las gang yang med — de/ nyi ma shad ba/ rlung g.yug pa/ me tog bshad pa/ lta bu sogs so/ /sems can ga zhig las la ma bltos par/ b.rang ṣe 'du byed ngang ngam shugs kyis byung ba la/ bdag gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba tsam las med de/ nga 'gro/ rta rgyug byis pa tsho mnyam du brtses/ lta bu sogs so/ /— gzhan yang / dpe cha bltas tshar / gon pa bzos nas grub song / chang 'thungs nas bzi/ lta pū sogs ༄ tshig gi sbyor ba bdag gzhan mnyam du 'grel ba'i tshig gi rnam ba dang 'dra yang / mtshan nyid mi gcig ste/ skabs 'di'i tshar ba dang / grub pa dang / bzi ba rnams/ las kyi 'gyur ba dngos 295

brda spyod gsal byed ngag sgron/ min gyi/ byed pa'i rtsol ba'i phyis 'byung tsam bstan pa yi na no/ /yang / ngang gis dbyung ba'i ma ba noms/ bdag dang 'grel ba'i bya bar sbyar na/ tshig grogs kyis bsgyur chog dper na/ rta rgyug pa dang / rta rgyug — par byed/ zer ba'i tshig gnyis kyi don mi 'dra ste/ tshig snga ma'i rta ni rgyug byed de/ byed pa rta rang gi rang shugs kyi bya ba yin la/ tshig phyi ma rta ni brgyug bya ste/ las la bkod nas/ byed pa bo gzhan zhig gis kha lo sgyur ba yin te/rta rgyug gtong ngam/ rgyug par byed ni/ byed pa'i las su gyur pa yin no/ /dpe de bzhin/ 'od 'char bar byed/ tshogs su zhugs par 'jug lta bu sogs rigs bsgres nas shes par gyis shig /

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ bsod nams tshe ring /mdun shog mdzes ris tshe gomadun shog gzigs byang / grags pa/par sgrig 'char 'god/ la ha'i yun/brda sgyud gsal byed ngag sgron/dpa' ris sangs rgyas kyis brtsams/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe kun khang gis par du bsgrun/(zi ling grong khyer thun rin lam sgo mang 10)mtsho sbyo1 ༵ sna sa pa dī khang gis dpa dī/kram/ deb tshad/ ho smis 850 ya 1 168 1732dpar shog9 876 yig grangs khri141998lo'i ga bar par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1998lo'i zla9bar par bengs dang po dpar/padapar grangs/ 0001༷ 2000 1ci257— 6420— 0707—670 660rin gog de ba ༵ rdo rngo// sgor—rnyi ṭwāṃ:
